reviews.title: Fontainebleau Las Vegas: Luxury, celebration, and modern elegance
reviews.text: Our stay at Fontainebleau Las Vegas was truly spectacular. From the very beginning, Leslie at reception welcomed us with warmth and professionalism, surprising us with a $150 credit to celebrate my birthday and our anniversary. This thoughtful gesture elevated our celebration and set the tone for an unforgettable visit. Mike at concierge was equally outstanding, ensuring every detail was seamless.The room was impressive and ultra‑modern, with intuitive electronic controls for curtains, drapes, and lighting that added both comfort and sophistication. Housekeeping kept everything impeccable, enhancing the sense of refined luxury.Beyond the casino, the restaurants, the variety of bars, and the world‑class facilities were fabulous, offering a perfect mix of style, atmosphere, and culinary excellence. With its $3.7 billion investment, Fontainebleau is far from ordinary. It redefines what a Las Vegas resort can be. We are absolutely delighted with our experience and would recommend it wholeheartedly to anyone seeking an unforgettable stay.

reviews.title: Our new favorite hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: Book your stay at the Fontainebleau without hesitation! I spent way too much time researching whether or not to stay here - only to decide to give it a try… and we LOVED it. In the past we’ve stayed at Mandalay Bay, Aria, Venetian, Cosmopolitan, Encore, and Wynn. Fountainbleau is our new favorite. For this trip, we spent 1 night at the Wynn before switching to the Fontainebleau for 3 nights.I have a separate review of our stay at Wynn, but suffice it to say it felt outdated and ‘tired’ compared to the Fontainebleau. We arrived at the Fontainebleau at 11:50am on a Wednesday. Were greeted by smiling valets who opened the doors for us. Seems like a small gesture, but great service gives the right vibe to start your stay (Wynn valets were chit chatting instead of opening doors for guests). The lobby is breathtaking. The smell of fresh flowers is a nice welcome. It looked like there was a small line about to form but Oscar directed the two families in front of us to different agents, then told us to follow him and checked us in himself. He was friendly and helpful. Room was ready, no wait. Oscar gave us a room of the 65th floor, with a great view of the Sphere. The friendliness of the staff at the Fountainebleau was significantly superior to the Wynn. The room is awesome. Clean. Beautiful. They did an incredible job with the design and branding. Bow ties everywhere. Clean white and blue design makes you think it’s a Vegas casino meet Santorini. High ceilings. Luxe atmosphere. Plenty of tables and slots. The casino is not crowded but not dead either, it strikes the right balance of enough people that it’s a buzz, but without the crowds. It’s perfect. A lot more people at night - still the right balance.  The promenade is great, and the food options are excellent. We ate here several times throughout our stay. The Salmon bowl at Bar Ito is excellent. The Black Jack burger at Capons incredible. The Bird (Turkey, avocado, bacon, Brie) sandwich at Nona is the best Turkey sandwich we’ve ever had. Lots of options for coffee, like ‘Break’ at the food court, Chez Bon Bon, or Cafe Cuto (very close to guest elevators, 2nd floor). The gym is superb! Large, spacious, lots of machines. Modern. Feels like going to a real upscale gym. I recognized Gaten Matarazzo (Dustin from Stranger Things) working out in the gym, but he had his headphones in so everyone left him alone. Turned out he was presenting one of the awards at the NHL Awards later that afternoon. Pool area is awesome. Lots of pool options and great service. The servers were on point and attentive. Limited menu selection to your chairs, but full menu if you want to go to La Cote for lunch. Food was delicious and service was great (believe our server was Nashawn. Super friendly). We also had dinner one night at the Washing Potato (upscale Chinese. Great food. Great vibe. Showed up at 9pm with no reservation and were seated promptly). Hotel checkout time is 11am but they extended us to noon without a fuss. If you’re doing Uber, there are 2 rideshare locations for pick up. Just stick with the North rideshare. It’s easier. The south rideshare is downstairs and every Uber driver seems to get confused (they circle around the Taxi area upstairs and don’t realize they need to go down the ramp). North rideshare is easier. Also, bring your own water bottle as the hotel has those airport water bottle stations throughout the casino, where you can refill your own water. The room also has a small cooling drawer besides the mini bar, which is great to chill BYO drinks or late night snacks.  Everything about this hotel just put all the other hotels on the strip to shame. And btw - the water pressure! Excellent. I’m buying the same shower head. Sportsbook is one of the better ones around too. I’m pretty set of sticking with Fountainebleau for my upcoming visits. Nothing else on the strip compares. If you don’t mind taking an Uber to/from shows or clubs - book this hotel without hesitation and have a blast!

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant hotel . The check is friendly . The rooms are the best - they are so clean and comfortable. Beds are amazingly comfy , there is a fridge for drinks and snacks . We had a view over looking  the sphere which was fab . The food court is really good with some really good places to eat . We ate at Dons Prime which I have to say was amazing both in service and food and would highly recommend . The casino is really good , it’s really spacious and drink service was good - there is a lovely bar in the center which is nice  . Highly recommend this hotel .

reviews.title: Wanna-Be.
reviews.text: TL;DR:  FONTAINEBLUEAU has potential, and the public areas are impressive. BUT it's low-class and disappointing.  Wanna-Be.  HOWEVER, I really want you to stay here because then you will help free up occupancy at the good places we like to go to normally :)   We (couple) go to Vegas an average of 1/month for 15 years now, almost all high-end casinos (we have our favorites).  This is the first time we stayed at FONTAINEBLUEAU (4 days), and we will not be back.FONTAINEBLEAU disappoints.-- Public areas are impressive. Shiny and huge. But!... -- Rooms are very subpar.--  Weird super disgusting grease (KY?) smeared in blobs on the window.  Very obvious.-- Room window in general super dirty (from the inside).-- Huge nest of long black hair inside the shower.  Yuck.-- Sinks have super water-savers, almost non-functional (drip drip drip) -- Very heavy (50 lbs+) rock room table not secured to tiny wooden foundation -- dangerous.-- Check out on TV did not work.-- Check out on email did not work.-- Half the number of towels of other casinos on the strip.-- Tiny individual shampoo pouches (reminds me of Motel 6, etc.). Smells disgusting (opinion).-- Tiny hard white soap for the sinks -- low quality and literally as bad as Motel-6 quality.-- Lamp in room did not work, and no access to plug to fix it.-- Window black-out shades/curtains close randomly during our entire 4-day stay.-- Housekeeping staff has very loud conversations for 45+ minutes daily outside the room door!... disruptive and insensitive.-- Concierge gave us completely wrong information regarding picking up our concert tickets.-- Location (not factored into my low review) is abysmal.  -- casino drinks were the worst I've had from anywhere in Vegas (including lowest-end places).

reviews.title: Very nice and well-managed hotel - I would return!
reviews.text: I had a wonderful time at my stay at Fontainebleau Las Vegas. My work convention was in the hotel and systematically, it was well organized. Our rooms were spacious. Service was top notch. The restaurants in the hotel never want to make you leave. I really love this hotel and would definitely go back to stay or stay at another location. Thank you for a stress-free stay.

reviews.title: They're thieves.
reviews.text: The worst hotel experience. After an external shattering of a glass, the supposed value of the card was charged “in Chinese”. Even when they reported it they said it had been a bird and even gave us another room.They never answered after they took office, but they did make a letter of claims to American Express full of lies. There's no other way to call this but a robbery.Never go to this hotel!

reviews.title: Excellent stay!
reviews.text: From check in to check out, everything was great. Ashley at the front desk was very sweet and welcoming. Our favorite bartenders are now Javier & Alex at the pool bar. They made our afternoon so much funner. Cant wait to go back!

reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel
reviews.text: Personally I didn't experience some of the negative comments around the piped scent (more to follow on that one) or the poor hygiene standards. The standards were immaculate in every area we experienced always people cleaning, housekeeping standards were excellent. The only issues I found was the smell of cigars around the casino area and the bleau bar in the centre of the ground floor (not a massive problem just when walking past a cigar smoker which may explain the comment/review about the overpowering piped scent, rather have that than disgusting cigars IMO). The drinks and food were expensive in the hotel however this is Vegas so kind of accept it but no more expensive than Dubai for example. The food we had was of excellent quality. Location was perfect in the slightly quieter north end of the strip, however only a 15min walk to the Strat or the Dueuce bus which goes up and down the strip for $16 a 24 hr pass stops outside north and south, its a 20 min ride up to Freemont Street or a 25 min ride down to the Las Vegas sign. Overall this hotel was fantastic and would highly recommend it, if in Vegas again we would definitely stop here.

reviews.title: Warning for Allergy Sufferers and Guests Sensitive to Fragrance
reviews.text: I want to leave a warning for anyone with allergies, asthma, mast-cell issues, or even mild chemical sensitivity: the scent diffusers at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas are overwhelming. The fragrance is so thick you could cut it with a knife—you can literally taste it. The smell is strong enough that you notice it 30 feet outside the property, and once inside it is intense enough to make people with even moderate sensitivities genuinely sick.For context, I do not live in a bubble and would describe my sensitivity level as somewhere between mild and moderate. I’m not opposed to signature scents at hotels either. In fact, if I could bottle whatever Wynn and Encore use, I’d run it in my own home. But staying and walking through Fontainebleau felt like spending 24 straight hours inside an Uber with the cheapest gas-station air fresheners hanging from every surface.The scent is so heavy it affects the taste of your food in the restaurants. I eventually learned to breathe through my mouth while covering my face with my shirt every time I left my room. My first day in Vegas was ruined before I even realized what was happening—just 30 minutes on the property triggered a pounding headache, itching of my scalp and back, and complete nasal congestion. When I called home to say I’d arrived safely, my boyfriend immediately said, “You sound awful,” without knowing I was having a full reaction.If you have any kind of fragrance sensitivity, I strongly recommend avoiding this property.For those without sensitivities, the hotel itself is lovely. The price was reasonable, the service excellent, and the rooms are comfortable. I was a bit disappointed that the developers didn’t take the opportunity to surpass Wynn and Encore in design and build quality (particularly with regard to the uninspired common areas) but perhaps there is only one Steve Wynn and one Roger Thomas.  If those spectacular properties were not next-door for comparison purposes, or if this were a large convention hotel and casino anywhere else, it would easily set a standard for quality and design.  I have two more nights here covering my face,  breathing through my mouth, dousing myself in antihistamines and avoiding common areas because it is a prepaid reservation through a third-party vendor.  Wish me luck!

reviews.title: Disappointed and dirty room for a 5 star
reviews.text: I was really excited to stay here. It looked like it could compete for #1 in LV. But when we got to our room, there was something smudged on the wall. Pubic hair was in the shower and bathroom floor. Cleanliness should be non negotiable for a 5 star. But it was an issue in our room. When we notified staff, they took their sweet time coming to help. They didn’t bother to clean it but just abruptly moved us to a new room, which is fine but there was no apology but they did give $25 casino credit. The new room was clean and beautiful, as you should expect from a 5 star.

reviews.title: Still Extraordinary and Exceptional
reviews.text: Many a stay at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas since our first and still extraordinary:  A at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas decidedly did not disappoint to say the very least. The establishment presented with exceptional and extraordinary attention to the most minute of guest and aesthetic detail only overshadowed by the exemplary level of servicing.The accommodations were superb and well thought-out inclusive of provided amenities. Where the likes of the Bellagio rooms have become dated and stale, this resort is fresh, innovative, welcoming and crisp. Similarly, the common areas exhibit the same ambiance and thoughtfulness to curating the overall experience. Unfortunately, where the culinary offerings within were vehemently energetic serving up remarkably brilliant fare, the gaming area lacked said energy and vibe due to the simple lack of persons therein.The writer is confidently hopeful that given time that this outstanding and incomparable venue will draw in the crowds in filling the common areas. With this said, the lack of masses in attendance did not significantly detract from the experience and was soundly augmented by consummate and commendable servicing. The staff came across as being a genuine part of the Fontainebleau “family” providing caring and conscientious servicing to the extent of making the guest feel more than welcome and an appreciated included member of the same intimate family. In speaking with staff, the majority seem to have come from other top-tier competitors in the fervent belief that they could contribute in such a significant way in making this establishment the best on the Strip. Consequently, “exemplary” servicing throughout….Finally, for those concerned with the distance from the central Strip, a short walk destines one in the heart of everything. Although, with such extensive offerings within the Fontainebleau Las Vegas, there really is no reason necessitating leaving in the first place.My entire group looks forward to many more return engagements….

reviews.title: High expectations but left a little salty
reviews.text: When my wife and I walked in the lobby we felt like celebrities.  The place is beautiful and massive but after a few days it starts to feel like a hotel within a luxury mall.  Far enough away from the strip to avoid the congestion and chaos but close enough to walk there.  Also within walking distance of Fremont Street. The gym is spectacular.  The staff was great. The casino is clean and nice but allows smoking including cigars.  That was annoying and I smoke cigars. Most of the pools were closed due to ice rink set up.  Our suite was big and had a great view of strip and sphere.  I know it is Vegas but $54 for two glasses of house wine at the main casino bar is a joke.  $27 for a smoothie in the food court is also absurd.  My wife and I make great livings but overcharging for basic drinks and food pissed us off. We found a local liquor store and walked around with our own cocktails after night one. Also, as we read in several reviews, get rid of one ply toilette paper and clear some space in the room fridge for guest waters (so guests don’t have to buy $20 bottles from you).  Those little things make a five star hotel a four star. This is a nice, clean and modern hotel but we left feeling a little salty and will try somewhere else next time.

reviews.title: A five star rating but could still be subtly improved......
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed at the Fontainbleau for 5 nights, with five other relatives and friends also joining us.I had spent ages looking at the various reviews of all the other hotels in Las Vegas, and that the Fontainbleau hotel had still only been open for less than 2 years, and its modern look and feel swung it for us.   Hotel roomWe stayed in a best view golden room on the 69th floor.   I had pre requested a suite, but none were available on checkin.   We were not that disappointed though and the view was really good looking out onto the sphere.   These rooms have a large walk in shower, rather than a bath tub/shower as per the rooms that have the mountain view.  The fit and finish of the room was very nice and of a good standard and the bed very comfortable.   The air con was also efficient and relatively quiet.  One aspect to be careful with is the minibar and adjacent snacks.   If you remove an item for more than 60 seconds, you will be charged for it automatically.  On checkin we were also cautioned about this.   One aspect for us europeans that was also lacking, was an in-room coffee/tea making facility.   A minor issue but we missed that option.   The room was made up every day but again one minor comment is that the floors were only vacuumed once during our 5 day stay.   While we are not untidy, we would have expected this more frequently.   The rooms have touch panels for the lighting and also to close the curtains.  A nice touch, but they seemed to have a mind of their own on occasion and could take several goes to get the curtains either fully open or closed.   I suspect that long term these may be problematic.     Location.  We were aware that the hotel is located toward the far end of the strip, but we were aware of that and used the nearby monorail station at the Westgate hotel a couple of times, and equally enjoyed the walk to the other hotels, such as Caesars Palace etc.    On site parking.   The hotel has a huge self parking garage, which was free for the period of our stay having signed up to the members club.    Overall hotel quality.   As others have mentioned, the hotel communal areas are kept very clean and tidy and are beautifully finished, providing a modern, spacious and elegant feel.   Restaurant and bar options.  There is a wide range of options and all that we ate at, Dons Prime, Washing Potato (twice) and The Tavern were really very good.   During our visit, the SEMA car show was on, and the hotel was really busy as the exhibition centre is attached to the hotel.   It was pretty imperative that you booked the restaurant in advance to avoid disappointments, especially when looking to seat larger groups.  Fortunately I had made bookings on three nights for us well in advance.   The main bar area on level 1 was really busy in the evening and the staff were struggling to keep up, and it could take some time to obtain a drink and all seats taken.   On occasion we gave up and went to the bar on level 2 near the food court and koyu restaurant, as this tended to be less busy.   Collins bar was lovely and we enjoyed several visits there.  Worth a visit !I will be writing separate reviews for Don Prime and Washing potato.   One thing that I find frustrating though is that the online menus do not include the prices.  I really wish that this could be corrected, but note that others do a similar thing.   I just like to have an idea of approximate prices ahead of a visit.  Overall, a really lovely hotel and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay.   It's definitely a five star award but with some minor improvements could make it unbeatable.   We would certainly return again.

reviews.title: I really want to like this hotel…but I can’t
reviews.text: First time staying at the Fontainebleau. Had high expectations since it’s a one Michelin Key hotel.All the hardware are modern, elegant, more elevated than other luxury hotels on the strip.However, the hardware is the only thing to be impressed about. Our trip took a turn at night.Our room is facing the swimming pool. At 9 PM, some staff started working on the pool, likely cleaning as we hear loud jet stream cleaner noise. We thought it will be just an hour, so did not mind too much about it.They continued on deep into the night. With the loud machine noise until 3AM. Called the front desk at 1AM to complain and ask if they can start cleaning in the morning. I was shocked by the response: “We are a 24 hour resort, the staff needs to do things when it needs to be done”There was no apology at all about the noises, just a cold answer. This unprofessional is at a 5 star luxury hotel doubts me why they were awarded the Michelin key. Don’t think I would stay here again, the service is way below what it should be.

reviews.title: First and NOT last stay at Fontainebleau
reviews.text: This was our first stay at Fontainebleau and it will not be the last. The resort is the cleanest I have seen in Vegas in a very long time. From our room to the gaming area, it was spotless. We had numerous meals there and they were all delicious. The staff was extremely friendly and went out of their way at numerous times during our 4-day stay. It was refreshing knowing that it is hard to attract and retain good help in so many of the service industries all over the world... but they have some keepers!

reviews.title: Excellent hotel with great customer service!
reviews.text: This hotel is great! It is very clean, modern, and spacious. The rooms are large and technologically advanced. It is also a very short walk to the Sahara, which has the monorail to take you down the strip. We had a small issue with one of the room appliances and the staff were extremely accommodating to help us get it resolved. I’d recommend this to anyone coming to Vegas!

reviews.title: First Class Experience
reviews.text: An overall excellent experience.  The fact that the property is very new, certainly doesn't hurt.  Beyond that the hotel has a luxury feel without the Las Vegas tackiness.  The rooms are good size with large bathrooms.  The rooms that don't have a bath have a huge shower.  Until 12/31, they are not charging for o/n guest parking.  They also, do not charge that annoying "resort fee".  There is a large number working at the checkin desk.  No wait for checkin or out.  Service was excellent overall as well.

reviews.title: Luxury Stay
reviews.text: I had a great experience during my stay. From the moment we arrived, things started off on the right foot—we were able to check in early and the staff greeted us warmly even offering complimentary bottled water.The room was lovely spacious, clean, and with a beautiful strip view. The shower was impressively large, and the bed was comfortable.There was a minor hiccup with the toilet not flushing properly, but I called the front desk and maintenance arrived within about 10 minutes. They fixed it quickly and professionally.We appreciated the combination of comfort, service, and amenities and would definitely go back!

reviews.title: Worst hotel experience ever.
reviews.text: My wife, daughter and I stayed at Fontainebleau Las Vegas from August 28th to August 31st, 2025, and I’m disgusted by our experience. On the morning of the last day of our stay, we heard a loud noise in the room, however after sitting up in bed and looking around, we did not find what caused the noise and went back to sleep. A couple of hours later when opening the curtains in the room we noticed that a window was cracked. We immediately contacted the front desk to let them know.  Shortly thereafter security guards, concierge and maintenance personnel from the hotel arrived to inspect the damage. After looking over everything, they mentioned that it was likely caused by an external impact. We were then asked to go to the front desk to speak with a resort manager.The resort manager, explained that security had determined the damage was due to a duck impact, as they had found a dead duck in the area below the window.When doing our checkout, we paid the resort fees and some restaurant charges and then left.After coming home, I was blindsided with a $11,000 charge to my credit card. When I reached out to dispute the charge, their response was dismissive, unprofessional, and completely lacking in accountability. No evidence was provided, and no effort was made to fairly resolve the issue. I felt totally taken advantage off and fell like they expected me to just accept it. The final straw was when I was advised that their third-party vendor determined that we were at fault, but no other information was presented. I have never encountered this kind of blatant dishonesty from a hotel. I have since disputed the charges with my bank and filed formal complaints and even had an attorney send a letter to the hotel to dispute the charge and yet, have not gotten any response from the hotel. This is not just bad customer service, it’s fraud. The hotel management should be ashamed of this behavior.

reviews.title: Bogus resort fee
reviews.text: This is not a 5 star hotel. There is no coffee in the room. Not even a free water bottle in the room. The food in the food court is RIDICULOUSLY expensive. They are renovating the largest pool into an ice rink, so we could not get lounge chairs at the pools. $55 resort fee for WHAT?! Total scam.

reviews.title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Beautiful hotel with everything you need inside
reviews.text: The hotel is really beautiful and very big, with a casino, restaurants, shops, and bars all inside … you almost don’t need to leave! Everything was clean, and the rooms were comfortable and nicely decorated. Definitely a great place to stay in Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Perfect Stay!
reviews.text: Check in was a breeze and very courteous. Our room was on the 19th floor and the first impressions on the way was WOW! Chic and Posh! Our room was beautiful and had a great view of the Sphere. Overall, we had a wonderful 3 night stay!

reviews.title: A spectacular hotel
reviews.text: I was here for a two-day conference and was amazed by the beauty of this hotel. Brand new, it represents an unbridled luxury where the casino with its bright colors is out of tune in the midst of the many luxury boutiques (if there were no casino it would seem to be in Via Montenapoleone). Slightly outside position compared to the strip but really classy.

reviews.title: Thiefs at this resort
reviews.text: My eldest daughter decided to elope to Las Vegas so we booked three room at the Fountainebleau for the whole family. We were robbed!!! Someone came into my daughters room and took our families pearls and the Hermes bag that had her and her new husbands wedding gifts inside. We reported it to the resort and although they acted like they cared nothing was done. No return call, no follow up. I also reported the theft to the police as it  was over $4000. The officer that took my statement did tell me that when he was younger the same thing happened to him at the Venetian. So be aware!!!!

reviews.title: Very good rooms and service.
reviews.text: Despite being a massive convention hotel, it’s really a nice place to stay. Room was large and comfortable. Equally so for the bed. Bathroom super nice. Rooms on both sides of the hotel have beautiful night views of the city. You will want to be careful about staying on the side that faces music venues, since those can get very loud. I had to move rooms to the other side, but I figure that out quickly enough. Lots of good restaurants to eat at, judging by the menus. Casino is so-so. Location is mediocre as well, given that it is on the northernmost part of the strip. That said, I would stay here again in a heartbeat.

reviews.title: This place is huge and amazing!
reviews.text: It took more than 15 years to finish this place,  but it was well worth it. The place is huge! The place is grand! Tons of slots, tons of table games. Very spacious upscale casino. Many different restaurants; many shops. All upscale. Bring your wallet. The chandeliers are amazing. Wide spacious isles. It's worth just seeing the place. They could really make it excellent by making the table games lower limits and better rules. It's worth a visit.

reviews.title: Highly recommend, especially if you’re attending an event at the festival grounds
reviews.text: Friends and I stayed here to attend the When We Were Young Festival at the Las Vegas Festival Grounds. Everyone thought the hotel was incredible and you couldn’t beat the location for attending the festival, it was right across the street. The room was amazing, I stayed in a double queen room on the 65th floor, it even had a huge soaking tub, which was amazing after 12 hours on my feet at the festival. We also had a cabana at the Oasis pool on Saturday, which was also great. You really can’t beat the service either, all of the staff were incredibly helpful and friendly. I definitely plan on staying here again.

reviews.title: Absolutely Fabulous!!
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau Las Vegas is just absolutely fabulous!!! From the moment you arrive you are greeted with a smile. Andrew at the front desk was fantastic.  Derel Turner at the bell desk was so accommodating.  The lobby is spectacular.  The rooms are GORGEOUS.  The high end finishes through out the hotel are gorgeous.   A yes yes yes!! The pool is amazing!  The carpet still smells like brand new.  I would definitely stay here again.  I highly recommend!!

reviews.title: Beautiful Room With Impeccable Service
reviews.text: For business this hotel is perfect. The rooms are stunning and the conference facilities are extremely well located. All the staff here are superb and although LV is not my most favourite place to visit I would most certainly look forward to returning to stay in this hotel.

reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text: The customer service is not there.Not only I had an only experience but a friend of mine had also a worst experience.I love the hotel but the employees have an attitude and not a good one

reviews.title: Upscale strip location
reviews.text: I’ve stayed at almost every hotel in Las Vegas for the last 40 years, so I like to try anything new that pops up. Despite my disdain for staying anywhere on the strip, I opted for a weekend here. The hotel is simply one of the most beautiful in the world. The artwork, the flooring and the decorations are just amazing. The gym is the biggest and nicest gym I’ve ever seen in a hotel, however, it was usually pretty busy. You are best to work out early in the morning if you can do it.My emphasis is on the gambling, so I’m going to just talk about that. This is typical strip – you get worse payout odds, and all the house advantages. More importantly, the dealers making it a great experience with a few and far between. There’s nothing I hate worse than a dealer with no personality. The slot machines were as tight as anything I’ve ever seen and even when you hit a bonus, it was often a bust. Did not see many hand pays the whole weekend. No place to really watch sports unless you reserve a table at the Tavern- that really aggravated me. Had to walk across to Westgate to have the real Sportsbook college football experience. Food was typical- high priced and not memorable. Pool was overrun by college kids as it was their senior weekend and they flooded Vegas. Not going to complain about that though !Room was beautiful and clean. Best water pressure in the shower ever! Also no issues with hot water.

reviews.title: Luxurious rooms, but you pay for everything
reviews.text: Beautiful rooms and bathrooms. The gym is great. And they were filming Hacks on site, which was really cool. Big drawback for me was no coffee in the room. You can rent a nespresso machines… for $100!! Room service coffee was $17. That bugged me a lot. When traveling for business, coffee in the room is a must.

reviews.title: Vegas Elegance Far from the Vegas Glam and Actiom
reviews.text: I stayed at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas for four nights during a tech conference and it was a treat! Check-in was a breeze and from the moment I stepped inside the lobby just radiated elegance and beauty. My room on the 16th floor was pure luxury. Loved the comfy king bed and stunning views of the Vegas skyline. I was obsessed with the room’s techy touches like controlling the lights and drapes right from my bedside felt so fancy.Now let’s talk food... I splurged on room service one night and ended up with the most expensive (but yet delicious) nachos and Coke of my life. It was a jaw-dropping $71! The food court wasn’t exactly a budget saver either with fast food running about $45 per person. So bring your high-roller energy (or in my case my company expense card ).The casino looked modern and inviting, but I didn’t get the chance to test my luck as conference life kept me busy. My only real gripe is that The Fontainebleau is a bit of a hike from the main Vegas strip so wear comfy shoes or grab an Uber. Overall, I had a wonderful stay full of luxury, high-tech and Vegas glam.

reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.text: Fabulous hotel, extremely high quality. The bedding, facilities, staff, all 10/10. Stunning view of the strip. Highly recommended, wonderful stay.

reviews.title: We will be back
reviews.text: Wonderful decor, very accommodating and professional staff, excellent food at Vida, excellent cocktails - only the gaming result (slots) is not satisfactory even on the third visit.

reviews.title: Beware of Hidden Fees at Fontainebleau Hotel
reviews.text: I booked my stay at the Fontainebleau Hotel through a third-party vendor and paid hotel fees and taxes upfront, as pre-payment was required. Despite this, upon checkout, I was hit with an unexpected charge of over $249+ in additional taxes and fees — none of which were disclosed during booking or at check-in.The lack of transparency around these charges is deeply concerning. While the hotel clearly communicated the $150 food credit, they failed to mention these hidden fees until the very end of my stay. I’ve since contacted the third-party vendor, who is now investigating why these charges were added.If you value clear pricing and reliable customer service, I would strongly reconsider booking at this establishment. Unexpected charges like these should never be part of the customer experience.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Hotel, with lux room & plenty of great food choices
reviews.text: Gorgeous hotel, great room & tasty, diverse choices for food.Having stayed at many high end hotels in Vegas, it’s hard to be surprised but Fontainebleau did just that. From quick, organized checkin to thoughtful, friendly staff who went above & beyond. Whether calling down for foam pillows or extra towels..every request was handled quickly & professionally. The room itself was beautiful & well appointed & planned out with enough space, draws & closet area to accommodate an extended stay.The casino is clean & beautiful with well working HVAC system so you hardly notice any smoke. Food options are fabulous with plenty of variety from garment to takeout, small cafes, diner style & cute food court area for those who don’t want to eat at an expensive, fancy restaurant every night. They even have a little store with snacks, meds, drinks etc so you don’t have to leave the resort if you choose not to. The pool is lovely with plenty of open space & chairs. My only criticism is Uber pick up is a bit far & confusing, but that is true of many large Vegas resorts. So much to see with plenty of cute, hidden corners & art work to discover….can’t wait to return.

reviews.title: Showtime on the Strip
reviews.text: A great place to see a show, first class lounges and restaurants, to go with the best sound system on the strip. We look forward to seeing more band’s at this hotel in the future.

reviews.title: Best Hotel in Vegas!
reviews.text: This is by far the best hotel in Las Vegas . We have stayed at several hotels in Vegas and The Fontainebleau is exceptional and no other Vegas hotel can compare. Check in was easy and service throughout the hotel was excellent. There are 6000 red roses in the lobby that are changed daily. The hotel is 2 years old, luxurious and has spectacular views of the sphere and the Las Vegas strip. We had a best view gold room on the 53rd floor. We tried La Fontaine restaurant and Don’s Prime restaurants as well as the pool cafes and the food court. All were very good.  the casino is modern and bright and much nicer than dated snd dark casinos in the strip. The hotel is 2.5 miles from the Bellagio fountain and a quick Uber ride . We will only stay at this hotel now she we come to Vegas.

reviews.title: Excellent new hotel in Las Vegas (few minor hiccups however)
reviews.text: We stayed at Fountainebleau Las Vegas after switching hotels from New York New York. All I can say is WOW, this hotel is gorgeous. Immediately when we arrived in the uber, the friendly doormen greeted us. We walk into reception and see this huge display of red roses. The reception was busy, so they immediately opened another kiosk and was checked in swiftly, Overall this hotel was top notch, The only reason for the 4 star rating was the original room we had had a leak under the carpet which was only discovered on day 2 of us being there. Nevertheless the hotel moved us to a different room upon request. However it would have been nice if they offered us a free room upgrade or food voucher given the inconvenience of room switching. We also found the cocktail prices at the pool bar astronomical, I get this is vegas but honestly was shocked how much each cocktail cost. Also the first day we dined at an in house burger hotel, and didn’t find the quality there for the price.However despite these hiccups, I would stay here without hesitation if ever back in Vegas.

reviews.title: The worst experience ever
reviews.text: The worst service experience ever.I had a reservation since August for a convention (October 6), and when I arrived, the hotel’s system declined three different cards, including a debit card with enough funds. The staff admitted that many guests attending the convention were having the same issue, yet they offered no real solution.I even called my bank in Mexico, and they confirmed that there were no issues with my cards and that the charges the hotel claimed to have made never even appeared. Clearly, the problem was on their end.After wasting so much time at the lobby, I finally booked a room at the Hilton right across the street, and my card was accepted instantly — no problem at all.A traveler expects to feel welcomed and taken care of, especially after a long trip. Instead, this was the worst experience I’ve ever had at a hotel. A place of this level should never treat guests this way or have such a faulty payment system.I absolutely do not recommend staying here..#46536776-1

reviews.title: #1 Hotel Resort in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Wonderful resort, food choices first class.  The service level is unappareled compared to the other resorts.  The staff genuinely cares about the guests and will go out of their way to make sure your stay is perfect.   The pool area is perfect and secure, along with a lot of fun.

reviews.title: Fantastic Experience
reviews.text: Fontainebleau is a beautiful hotel and rooms were luxurious, spacious and meticulously clean.  Staff was very professional and friendly. I loved the variety of slots.

reviews.title: Modern Comfort & Average Service
reviews.text: Location (4/5)North end of the Strip, but easy to access rideshare.  Easy walk to Resorts World, Wynn, Venetian, and a Walgreens.Accommodations (4/5)Excellent room rate for a rewards member during a weekday.  Bleu King room was not a strip view, but located on one of the top floors.  Room was very clean and modern, however,  will say lacked the Las Vegas "wow factor" and was not as large as expected. Note: some Bleu King rooms have a shower and some have both a shower and tub; be certain to request at the front desk if this is important to you.  Service (3/5)Overall, service was adequate, but nothing stands out.  As I was new to the property, I wish the information provided by the front desk was more complete and welcoming.  Not once greeted by staff at the pool.  Blackjack dealers and pit bosses were kind and engaging, however, not many people playing.  Dining (3/5)Expensive as expected.  I sat solo at the bar at Don's Prime.  Service and food were mediocre.  Maybe the dining room is better?Atmosphere (4/5)Other than the casino, the property is inviting and the pool area was large.  A bit "sterile" as others have mentioned. Value for Money (4/5)Excellent rate for weekday stay as rewards member.  I likely would not pay rack rates for this property.  Cleanliness (5/5)The hotel was clean and fresh in all areas.Overall ExperienceI would return in the future if offered a good rate.

reviews.title: Great place for mother daughter get away!
reviews.text: My daughter and I go to Vegas every year. First time at Fontainebleau! We are spoiled now!! Loved everything about it. Rooms, casino, pools, bars, restaurants, and staff. We have found our forever vacation home!!

reviews.title: Wonderful time that I'd recommend to anyone
reviews.text: Great and beautiful hotel that is starting to feel like my home away from home that I'd recommend to anyone and everyone I know...

reviews.title: Very beautiful, high end hotel
reviews.text: A very beautiful hotel. Feels very clean and high-end. The pool is beautiful. The room was very clean and comfortable. The cooling drawer for drinks was appreciated. The only downside side were the prices. Yes, Vegas is expensive. But the restaurants, bars and pool area prices were extremely high. If your going to celebrate and just have a good time, just be prepared to spend a lot!

reviews.title: Great room and food.
reviews.text: Great room and view. The space was good. I am from Texas so I am use to space . The food at the hotel was good. The only problem I encountered was that our door didn’t shut. We had to make to sure the door closed. Our room was right by the ice machine and someone mistakenly came in our room, thinking it was the ice room. After that we had to make sure the door closed all the way. I did love how you could put on your privacy light and the service light for service.

reviews.title: A gem in the desert
reviews.text: Beautiful Hotel with a great staff waiting to help you.  Truly a gem in the desert!  The staff was very friendly and helpful.  The quality of the food at the restaurants was fantastic.  I would of liked to stay longer unfortunately it was a very short trip.

reviews.title: Good location, fair prices
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at Fontainebleau Las Vegas. The hotel is new and beautiful, with very appealing rooms that are not as clairvoyant as many other Vegas hotels. The cleanliness of the rooms was also good. The location is ideal, and the Price quality ratio for the rooms was fine. We didn't play at the casino, we just stayed the night. The coffeehouse offers fresh produce, but the prices are a bit high. Overall a recommended stay!

reviews.title: Pushing towards Top Tier
reviews.text: Price wise Fontainebleau is charging Top Tier rates. Is it worth it?  Yes if you’re catching a concert like the Tears for Fears residency, while staying, playing and partying poolside. Da Chicago Bears were in town and there was a notable fan base. Instead of going to Allegiant we opted to watch the game on the Giant Screen by the pool. Great decision! Sure you’re still paying stadium prices for food and drink, but way better people watching. The new concert showroom is not opulent, and neither are the hotels lobbies, but they’re classy.  And the staff is taking a page out of Steve Wynn’s playbook making you feel welcome.

reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.text: We stayed here on a business trip to visit a tradeshow. Great location next to the Vegas Convention Center. Beautiful hotel with friendly employees. Quick & easy check in. Our room on 62th floor was amazing. Automatic controls for the blinds, lights & A/C. We will be back to stay here again.

reviews.title: Overall a great hotel
reviews.text: Overall a lovely hotel which does not attract so many walk ins as further down the strip So it is a more pleasant experience.Such a shame the music by the pool is so loud first thing in the morning and so inappropriate.It’s pricy to eat.Dons Prime is excellent but Vida is really dreadful in every aspect.For such a huge hotel it is overall a lovely experience.

reviews.title: Great Weekend Getaway - Beautiful Casino.
reviews.text: Fontainebleau  was awesome!  Rooms are great, Service is great.  No complaints whatsoever and can't wait for my next visit.

reviews.title: Our only choice of Las Vegas resort!
reviews.text: Our 2nd stay at Fountainblue!  A luxury resort above the rest! Never disappointed! Always a memorable experience! We will be back!

reviews.title: Best wedding EVER
reviews.text: Very beautiful and perfect to avoid the crowds Great views Awesome pools and spas and viewsDelish pool side drinks and snacks

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.text: We stayed three nights and were beyond happy with our experience from the moment you walk in  everything is absolutely beautiful!   Check in was a breeze.  We were on the 38th floor in a room close to the elevators.  Rooms are probably the quietest that we've ever stayed in in Vegas and we've been coming two to three times a year since 1998 and have stayed at almost every hotel.  The bathrooms are huge with a big walk-in shower. In the room there's a table and two chairs. The bed was comfy and there's also a seating area by the full wall of windows with an excellent view of the strip.  Loads of restaurants and bars to eat in and the food court is elevated compared to any other I've seen. It's an a easy walk to resorts world or the Wynn.  The pools never seemed crowded.  Absolutely loved our stay here.  My only complaint if I had to come up with one is that the fragrance that they use in the hotel is pretty strong.  We'll definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Room with a view
reviews.text: This hotel is on par with the Wynn checked in early no problem a room was ready so didn’t have to wait. When we go to our room we were impressed we had a view of the sphere and part of the strip.

reviews.title: Top notch experience!!
reviews.text: Fontainebleau exceeded our elections from check-in to check-out.  Customer service is their main priority… Taking care of their customers and making sure they have an experience not just a regular stay makes all the difference… The food and choices of food is top-notch… The quality of food is worth the money for sure… My family and I have been going to Vegas for so many years and we have been Hilton members for so many years and have been so faithful to stay at the Hilton every time we come to Vegas… But we were given the opportunity to stay at Fontainbleu we took it, and we will not be staying at the Hilton when we are in Vegas anymore… Fontainbleau is our go to and I recommend it 100%. I recommend it to all my family whom I love and want nothing but the best…

reviews.title: Poorly maintained property but good restaurants
reviews.text: Arrival started out good with a great check in experience and they made us feel valued as a platinum Amex member.  Then the problems started: 1) TV remote did not work, 2) bathrobes were missing from the room, 3) they completely shut off the water without warning in the middle of taking a bath and did not restore running water until 5am the next day, 4) the phone in the room did not work, and 5) the Poodle Room hostess (tall white lady with blonde hair) was very rude and disrespectful not once, but twice during our stay there. She should be fired immediately.  Overall, this is not a 5 star hotel and nothing is being maintained.  There was also zero drink service in the casino the entire time we were there.  The only great thing is all the excellent food at Chyna Club, La Fontaine, and Don's, but we don't need to stay there to eat there.  We will stay at Venetian next time.

reviews.title: Best Hotels in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Excellent hotel I highly recommend the very comfortable rooms excellent view and is one of the newest hotels in Las Vegas super central easy access and good Internet

reviews.title: We loved the Fontainebleau LV
reviews.text: We loved the Fontainebleau LV.  To start the hotel is designed absolutely beautifully!  The restaurants, the rooms and the decor around the whole hotel are just stunning.  The rooms were clean, the cleaning person was wonderful and accommodating to our crazy times.  We ate at two of the restaurants and they service was spectacular.  The dealers were so nice--it was my daughter's first time at the tables and they helped to educate her.  Our stay was perfect.

reviews.title: Great overall property, our new “go too” in Las Vegas!
reviews.text: Was in town to see Tears for Fears who were playing in the venue there at the Fontainebleau which is a great place to see a musical performance.  At the property, there are lots of eating options, an amazing pool with lots of umbrellas to give you shade (often you don’t see that in Las Vegas), a great sports bar and plenty of gaming options if that’s your thing.  We had an upgraded suite which was simply amazing.  They even have a “cooling drawer” in the cabinet which is basically a fridge!  Was our first time at this property but it is now our favorite!

reviews.title: Best hotel in all of Las Vegas
reviews.text: This is the best hotel in all of Las Vegas. Incredible views of the sphere, walking distance to the sphere, great restaurants, great bands, beautiful decor. Would stay here again and again. And the rooms are impeccably clean, the beds are comfortable and the room is beautiful

reviews.title: Wonderful Trip Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at the Fontainebleau!  It is a wonderful beautiful friendly place to stay.  It is close to the busy area of the strip but not right in the middle of it.  We can't wait to come back.  The room was spacious and nice!  The view from the 53rd floor was stunning.

reviews.title: 5 days if the best !!!
reviews.text: Amazing amazing just amazing,From food to service customer service, the best pools in Vegas if we can move in we would🤣 hope to see you again soon thanks for the great service and friendliness and giving us great memories

reviews.title: New upscale Hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: Fontainebleau is a top tier hotel in Las Vegas room are nice and clean with lots of room. Spent the day at the pool was awesome. Lots of great food options.

reviews.title: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely Incredible Experience at Fontainebleau Las Vegas!
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived, this property blew us away. The entire resort is stunning, sleek, modern, and designed to impress at every turn. A huge shout-out to, Andrew at the front desk, who set the tone for our stay. His warm welcome and genuine care made us feel the love from the minute we checked in. Everyone we encountered, from housekeeping to restaurant staff, truly seemed invested in making our visit unforgettable.Our suite was spectacular, spacious and beautifully appointed, with a mesmerizing view of the Sphere that lit up the skyline every night. It felt like having our own private show right outside the window!The pool area is fantastic, with plenty of space to relax and soak in the Vegas vibes. The club was a highlight of our trip, the music was so good I literally couldn’t leave the dance floor. Pure energy and pure fun!I also have to rave about the gym, it’s AMAZING. Spacious, state-of-the-art equipment, and the kind of atmosphere that actually makes you excited to work out (even after a late night of dancing!).We were in town for a company convention, and Fontainebleau managed to be both the perfect professional venue and an exciting playground once the sessions were over. If you’re considering a stay in Las Vegas, this is where you want to be.

reviews.title: Chose another hotel...
reviews.text: Everything is a hassle.  Anything I need as a VIP involves 15 min phone calls without any possible results.  For the price of the room choose another hotel on the strip.  Fridge broken, no hot pot without a $23 charge per day, Cleaning the room took 2 hrs from request, and concierge couldn't book reservation but we called direct and got in no problem.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel but needs improvement
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau is a beautiful hotel rated five stars, but as with most strip hotels, really lack the in-room amenities and service that truly make a hotel a five star. No in-room coffee or tea, no turn down service, no complimentary bottled water and lackluster housekeeping. On the plus side, the beds were comfortable, the WiFi service superior and parking was included in the 50$ resort fee. The location is far from the heart of the strip. If you are attending a concert here, it’s worth a one or two night stay. Otherwise, there are more exciting five-star options on the Strip.

reviews.title: 1st class pool
reviews.text: 1st class pool, best pool in Las Vegas.  Plenty of sun and shade spots, great food too.  Pool attendants friendly and timely.

reviews.title: Great consistency over time
reviews.text: This is fifth visit in two years.  We are never disappointed.  We come back for the pools, food, cocktails, gaming, and friendly personnel.  Great consistency and high quality each visit across all restaurants, bars, and amenities.  Really friendly personnel across the board.  Love this place for an out of state trip each year.

reviews.title: Horrible customer service.
reviews.text: Needless to say, I love the fountain blue experience in Miami and I had a blast,  however the fountain blue in Las Vegas customer service is the absolute worst. They literally lie lie to your face about room availability when there is an issue or problems with your current room. Speaking to three different people nothing was done. Your voice is not heard at the fountain blue while it is a beautiful hotel that customer service is horrible.

reviews.title: Business and pleasure - fun, easy, amenable stay.
reviews.text: It is located at the very end of the strip (North) so it is quite a walk away from most relevant casinos; however it also makes it more secluded and coveted. The decoration is impeccable and cleaning services will fix your room splendidly. I experienced some check-in issues which took a while to get fixed but the managers were attentive. Unless you are a big party person, you won't be able to get to the pool on the weekends as it is the hot spot for younger crowd day-clubbing. I was there for business and extended my stay for personal reasons and overall it was a great stay.

reviews.title: Would not recommend--there are better options in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The rooms were big and nice but there were multiple nasty stray hairs in the bathroom and bed. We ate at Mother Wolf and I became extremely sick that night after the meal with obvious food poisoning. I reported these issues to the front desk and a manager at check out. The response was, "we're sorry to hear that," and "would you like to report this to security?" This is not a 5 star 4 diamond resort response.

reviews.title: Fontainebleau Establishes Itself as One of Las Vegas' Finest Resorts
reviews.text: Fontainebleau has established itself as one of the premier hotel/resorts on the Las Vegas Strip. This was our third stay at the Bleau, and this was a highly memorable trip, thanks to exemplary, energetic employees who are committed to customer service at every turn. We tried a Noble Suite on the 65th floor during this stay and were rewarded with stunning views of the entire Las Vegas valley and landmarks up and down the Vegas Strip. Fabulous views and the suite had every amenity imaginable, including the best shower heads in Vegas, spacious common areas, a loaded bar, two bathrooms and a larger than king-sized bed. Everything about the suite was crisp and clean. On a scale of 1 to 10, the accommodations rated a 12 or 13! The restaurants at Fontainebleau are some of the best in Las Vegas. Don't miss Don's Prime for fabulous steaks and seafood, and Komodo offers a variety of asian dishes, as well as favorites such as grilled halibut and several chicken dishes. The Pagoda Box for dessert is the best in Vegas -- think of bananas foster inside a pagoda box made out of sweet grahams. -- beyond delicious! Fontainebleau Resort has become the true anchor property on the north end of the Las Vegas Strip and continues to deliver an unforgettable Vegas experience at a reasonable rate in all regards!

reviews.title: Stunning Hotel, Exceptional Service, Perfect for Events
reviews.text: We hosted our Orthopaedic Conference at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas this past weekend, and I cannot say enough good things about the experience. The hotel itself is immaculate, everything is super clean, and the rooms are absolutely gorgeous. The food was excellent across the board, and the service was truly top notch.The concierge and events team went above and beyond, and all staff were incredible — professional, attentive, and on top of every detail. They made coordinating a large event feel seamless.The only downside is that everything at the hotel is very pricey, so be prepared for premium costs. That said, the level of quality and service you receive makes it feel worthwhile.Overall, Fontainebleau is a world-class venue, whether you’re staying for leisure or hosting a major event. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Amazing. Book here if you want to be Amazed!
reviews.text: From the second you enter the Property to the moment that you leave the whole experience is Amazing. Book here if you want to be Amazed!

reviews.title: Excellent High Class
reviews.text: Excellent stay, a high end premise with exceptional customer service, gaming and restaurant options.  The ambience is amazing and bars are one of a kind experience!

reviews.title: Awesome stay! Staff went above and beyond and amenities were great!
reviews.text: Had a great stay at Fontainebleau! Staff were great in getting us checked in early which we really appreciated! Restaurants and food hall had a lot of great options and the food was delicious. My favorite part was the fitness center; it was clean, had a large space, and a wide range of gym equipment. Staff here were also very friendly and helpful! Would definitely stay here next time I’m in Vegas!

reviews.title: Fulfilled my year long dream
reviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

reviews.title: Definitely coming back
reviews.text: Such a nice hotel. Everything was beautiful and the people working there were super kind and attentive. The place is just gorgeous!

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, Room wasn’t super clean
reviews.text: Fontainebleau is a really beautiful hotel. We stayed 2 nights and the hotel was packed because of a boxing match. Some of the areas were transformed for the Netflix crew so I didn’t see everything. There was great energy. Despite all the people it was easy to still get drinks at the Bleau Bar and find a spot to layout at the pool. The music at the pool was great and felt like a calmer beach club.  I loved that you could scan a barcode to order drinks/food. The poolside casino was fun even though we lost our money there. Side note: It was nice that the pool had a shower for the afternoon we flew out since they could not offer late checkout.I had a chance to go to LIV for Tiesto and it was  great atmosphere for those who like the beach club vibe. I didn’t think the balcony’s would be good but they were even great spots too. The rooms are beautiful, bed is comfy, shower is huge and the bathroom has a fan in it! However our room was not deep cleaned. There were kid handprints all over the window, crumbs all over the window floor area, stain on the sheet part that was tucked in to the foot of the bed, and tons of little hairs all over the bathroom floor. The door was really thin, we could hear people walking by and doors slamming. In the morning you could hear housekeeping. Luckily we weren’t  next to the elevators or we would’ve had zero sleep. We stayed in the gold rooms and had a nice-ish view of the strip.I saw about 6-10 families with kid. The hotel is not catered towards children but I can see that there’s a few considerations for them including and a zero entry pool. We went for a couples trip and overall it was great.

reviews.title: Experience at FB
reviews.text: I stayed at Fontainebleau Las Vegas last week for a work event during fight week, and honestly, the experience was really disappointing. For a property with such high fees and luxury branding, the value just wasn’t there.Every meal I ordered came out cold, including a breakfast that was nearly $200 without alcohol. At the pool, I spent $180 on food only to be told ketchup with fries was an extra $3 charge. Drinks were $30 each, and even a quick coffee run ended up costing over $50. On top of that, we constantly had to chase down servers, who would disappear for long stretches.I expected so much more from a hotel of this caliber. Between the outrageous prices, cold food, and dismissive service, the overall experience was awful and not worth the cost. I truly hope the hotel takes this kind of feedback seriously and makes improvements for future guests.

reviews.title: Most memorable hotel
reviews.text: A stay here will change you! Fountainbleu is truly to good for Las Vegas, it’s just that special.  The attention to detail raises the bar and the Fountainbleu doesn’t miss a beat. The most beautiful restaurants and bars, delicious food (some of which can be found at the food court alone)! The staff is exceptionally friendly and seem to genuinely like working here.  You just have to experience this hotel, it puts the rest to shame.

reviews.title: A great time was had
reviews.text: Had a great time here! Room was beautiful, check in easy and the in room dining was great.  The lobby even smelled great! I didnt win at slots though...

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel and Hall Of Excellence is INCREDIBLE
reviews.text: Beautiful Hotel, great location and amazing staff. The Hall of Excellence is a MUST SEE for any sports fan, and even music fans. Some of the coolest memorabilia you'll ever see, all with a guided digital tour where you can scan the items and hear narrations from legends like Morgan Freeman, Tom Brady, Bob Costas, Marv Albert and even Oprah! Honestly, the coolest sports-related museum I've ever been to

reviews.title: "Bleau" Oasis at the end of The Strip
reviews.text: Fontainebleau is worth trying.  It's not in the heart of The Strip, but you can access the Monorail and there was never a problem getting a RideShare or taxi.  The views from the higher floors show less of The Strip and more of the vast, stunning landscape of the greater Las Vegas area, which at night is pretty, even peaceful beyond the neon.  Try a Fontainebleau "staycation" and eat at the great restaurants, shop in The Promenade and relax in the 3 pool area.  Mother Wolf is worth every penny, but get a reservation!!  Above all, the service from every staff member at the resort was perfect.  Truly focused on providing a wonderful, carefree experience.

reviews.title: Blueberry Pancakes!!
reviews.text: We stayed at Fountainebleau in the first weekend of September. Yajaira checked us in at the front desk and went over all the amenities with grace but efficiently. It was nice to walk around the property and check out the casino, pools, and restaurants. You also have shops around the hotel. I never felt bored. The pool was great as there are 6. Some were smaller than the others and there is also a pool day club. Drinks are taken care of if you gamble and sure enough we do. We had breakfast at the Vida Cafe and Promenade and the server recommended the blueberry pancakes. That was worth the trip itself. Must order! Ricardo was the agent who checked us out for the hotel and he did a great job ensuring everything was correct on our bill. I must say the training for the team was on par and I enjoyed the service at Fountainebleau Las Vegas.Thank you for a great stay. We'll be back!

reviews.title: Fontainebleau the place to Stay in Vegas.
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel.  Wonderful places to eat, super  friendly staff.  But I would like to hear more variety in music, hey play some 60’s and 70’s tunes.

reviews.title: The Fountainbleau--a great place to stay.
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay at the Fountainbleau in Las Vegas a great deal!  I attended a conference. I found the facilities wonderful.  My room was first class. The people who work there were very friendly.  I was treated great.

reviews.title: Attention to detail and service oriented!
reviews.text: This hotel is all about service! We were extremely satisfied with everyone we came in contact with! They went above and beyond to meet our needs!!!Must go back!

reviews.title: Luxurious Hotel with Great Amenities
reviews.text: We stayed at a Best Mountain View Queen Bleau room and were amazed by the beautiful view, especially at sunrise and at night. It was worth paying more to upgrade for a higher floor. The room has very comfortable beds with high thread-count bedding and the high quality soft pillows. The restroom had very luxurious bathrobes and the water pressure in the shower was strong, it felt like a spa. All of the hotel staff we encountered were very attentive and helpful. The hotel lobby smells amazing and was much less smoky than the Wynn and Venetian lobbies. We had a dining credit and enjoy our breakfast at Vida so much we went back the next morning. We loved our stay at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Great choice for stay on the Strip
reviews.text: Spent a week at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas for a work conference. The hotel is one of the newer properties along the Strip (although on the extreme end, across from Circus Circus), and the rooms, the gym and all of the facilities are bright, clean and comfortable. Accessibility to the conference center is easy as well. The on-property/resort restaurants provide plenty of good dining options at various price points. Staff were helpful from checkin through departure. Would stay here again.

reviews.title: Fontainebleau Review-08/27/25
reviews.text: Extremely poor offers (Free Play and Resort Credit) for best players. Extreme difficulty to advance to a higher tier compared to other casinos (e.g., Caesars, MGM, Resorts World, The Venetian, etc.). The High-Limit Slots is always nearly or completely empty, after having visited the property five times. The casino doesn’t seem to care about attracting players or retaining them. It was a struggle to open a Credit Line with the casino. The Bank Wires take too long to process. The High-Limit cashiers may need more training, as it takes them a long time to process transactions. There is a lack of entertainment. Limited options for restaurants. Except for a few of them, (e.g., Mother Wolf, Vida, and Chyna Club), the food quality is subpar and/or the prices are very high at restaurants. For example, La Fontaine has the most expensive American Breakfast on the strip, as far as I know. The website is cumbersome and not user-friendly. On a positive note the property is gorgeous and has beautiful, modern rooms. I was fortunate to have an excellent host, Jennifer Loucke, who is very responsive and available at all times. The Slot Attendants are very efficient and friendly. Chez Bon: Excellent quality but very expensive.La Fontaine: Good quality food, average service, very expensive.Don's Prime: Very good steakhouse.Komodo: Below average food quality, expensive.Kyu: The worst food. Mother Wolf; Best food, best service, might be noisy at times.Papi Steak: Average food quality for the price.Vida: Very good food with reasonable prices.  Washing Potato: very good food for the price.

reviews.title: We "Liked"our stay.
reviews.text: Lets start with the good...Super great smelling property.  Very clean.  Staff very nice.  Will stay here again for the right price without hesitation.Now the not so good....Casino is like a huge shopping mall with gambling.  Not very busy at all, I mean like nobody is there.  If it weren't for the Crawford fight, and Crawford staying here, there would have been less people.  The rooms are OK.  Water pressure in bathroom sink is horrible, but the shower is awesome.  Hotel room phone didnt work, no biggie just noted.  The location is just not good, unless you like walking over to Circus Circus and gambling.  Resorts World not a bad walk.  Wish this was in the center of the strip, then this would rate nearly perfect.  No Starbucks close by, big downfall for me.   Hard to believe there is no Starbucks inside this exceptional hotel.  Slots were super tight and no Poker room is a bummer too. The casino servers were literally the worst we have ever had in Vegas.  I got drinks faster by walking down to the Venetian and getting a drink there and then walking back, seriously.  In three days was asked 4 times if I wanted a drink.  So this is a mixed review.  Will I go back, Yes.  Do I hate the location, Yes.  Do I need drinks comped, No, but I'd like one now and again.Does it smell fantastic inside and not smokey, Yes.

reviews.title: Must Visit!!
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived, Fontainebleau set a new standard for luxury in Las Vegas. The property is absolutely stunning—every detail from the grand lobby to the modern rooms reflects elegance and sophistication. The design strikes a perfect balance between glamour and comfort, making you feel both pampered and at home.The staff was exceptional—professional, welcoming, and genuinely attentive. Every interaction, from check-in to dining to concierge service, exceeded expectations. It’s clear that customer care is their top priority.The amenities are world-class. The pools and cabanas create a true resort atmosphere, and the dining options are phenomenal—offering something for every mood, from fine dining to casual bites. The casino floor is vibrant and exciting, yet still feels spacious and upscale compared to many other Vegas properties.What really sets Fontainebleau apart is the atmosphere. The fragrance throughout the resort is intoxicating, the décor is chic, and the vibe is lively but never overwhelming. Whether you’re here for relaxation, entertainment, or nightlife, everything is thoughtfully designed to make your stay unforgettable.I can’t recommend Fontainebleau Las Vegas highly enough. It’s not just a hotel—it’s an experience. I’m already looking forward to coming back! ★★★★★

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: The Best Resort in Vegas!! Absolutely beautiful place and Customer Service Top Notch Hotel!!! Will most definitely recommend

reviews.title: Exceptional Stay from Start to Finish!
reviews.text: From the moment I arrived until the time I checked out, everything about my stay at this hotel was top-notch. The staff were incredibly welcoming, professional, and attentive to every detail, making sure my experience was nothing short of perfect.The hotel itself is beautiful, clean, and well-maintained, with all the amenities you could ask for. Whether it was the comfort of the room, the quality of the service, or the overall atmosphere, everything exceeded my expectations.I highly recommend staying at this hotel if you're visiting Las Vegas. It has become my go-to place whenever I'm in town, and I wouldn't consider staying anywhere else.

reviews.title: My trip
reviews.text: Overall I like the hotel just wish there was coffee available in rooms and the room I requested was available for me with a tub and just a little bit more effently with cleaning.  But was great stay the main thing that was a terrible factor was when we went to see a specific artist day club LIV was overly packed not enough pool space and was gross and just not enough for the amount of people who were there.

reviews.title: The best Las Vegas experience I have had.
reviews.text: I originally chose fountainebleau because that's where David Lee Roth was performing.I stayed 3 nights and four days, and after the first day I did not want to ever come home.Everything about the resort, was very classy. From the art decorations to the food in the restaurants to the absolutely beautifully laid out pools. and all the employees. This is definitely where James Bond would visit if he were to come to las Vegas.5 stars

reviews.title: Fantastic weekend!
reviews.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas feels fresh and modern from the moment you walk in. The décor is stylish and new, with a lot of attention to detail in the design. There are plenty of restaurants and bars to choose from, so you never run out of options.The service was great, staff were friendly and helpful throughout my stay. The rooms are clean, spacious, and comfortable, with everything you’d expect from a luxury hotel.Overall, a beautiful property that combines modern design, good service, and lots of dining choices.

reviews.title: Spent 450 on food and gambling and then have to fork over 20 for parking.
reviews.text: Beautiful but was told that parking was free under 4 hours, not the case!  Waited 2 hours for lunch at the pool bar.  Nice bar tender, not her fault, kitchen took a long time.   She needed additional help behind the bar, but again, not her fault.   Casino games are expensive even in the middle of the afternoon.  I won’t be coming back.  It was pretty.

reviews.title: Be wary of the pool area
reviews.text: Lovely luxurious hotel but have no care for guests at the pool with very strict rules on what can be taken into the pool area and mandatory bag searches. They also appear to encourage skin cancer with refusing to allow guests to put up the provided umbrellas for shade, even when there is no wind. Extortionate prices for day beds or cabanas, they would rather leave them empty than reduce the price to encourage usage even on weekdays. Pretty typical money grabbing corporate Vegas.

reviews.title: Weekend Excursion
reviews.text: This was my 3rd trip to Fountainebleau Las Vegas in the last 3 month. Everything about this resort is stunning and exceptionally clean! Very luxurious rooms with large bathrooms and in-room refrigerators. Open and close drapes at a touch of a button, Easy check out from your phone! Honestly I cant imagine staying any where else!

reviews.title: Exceptional place
reviews.text: Staying at Fontainebleau was an unforgettable experience. I wholeheartedly recommend exploring this exceptional place and savoring all the diverse restaurants it offers.

reviews.title: Favorite Vegas resort
reviews.text: 5th time staying at Fontainebleau, We love how easy it is to get to check in, All the staff were there for a quick and early check in, it always smells so good, the entire resort is beautiful, rooms are some of the best, pool has great seating options, bar, restaurant staff and ambiance are among the best. Players rewards is one of the best going right now. For us the location is great, it’s a little disconnected from the strip but for us it’s in the center of it. We go to the arts district, downtown or the main strip. All of it’s a short uber away. Or by car, if your staying your parking is free.  We travel to Vegas 4-5 times a year and blue has moved up to our preferred spot.  Already looking for our next stay.

reviews.title: Fountainbleu is 4 U!
reviews.text: Stayed here for my birthday trip to Vegas. We were upgraded to a higher floor with a view of the Sphere. Our room was clean, beautiful & bed was comfy. Those robes & slippers (yes Hunty). The pool party was fun. While I didnt win on the slots, I enjoyed playing at clean slots with attentive cocktail hosts. We ate at Washing Potatoe, so good. Thanks Fountainbleu for my great  birthday accommodations.

reviews.title: Great location, stunning decor, and amazing hospitality.
reviews.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas exceeded all my expectations. The location is unbeatable—right on the Strip, but just far enough from the busiest intersections to feel like a true retreat. It’s the perfect balance of convenience and calm. The hotel’s decor is absolutely stunning, with a sleek, modern aesthetic that still manages to feel warm and inviting. Every detail, from the grand lobby to the elegant room finishes, reflects thoughtful design and luxury.

reviews.title: Try the Fontainbleau! Awesome!
reviews.text: Very nice high end hotel experience! Rooms are big and comfortable. The hotel is easy to get around and the staff was very professional and pleasant. We got a great deal on an upgraded room with no resort fees!

reviews.title: FONTAINEBLEAU is the class of Vegas
reviews.text: The FONTAINEBLEAU Las Vegas is the jewel of the strip. It’s a fresh and clean hip classy resort that makes me keep coming back. I’ve stayed there multiple times and will continue to stay there. It’s by far the best value on the strip due to its amenities, staff and pristine facilities.

reviews.title: The Fantastic Fontainebleau
reviews.text: This is an absolutely wonderful property- it's on the same level as Wynn/Encore but, it's less crowded, cleaner, and more affordable.The shopping can improve with more boutiques but, I found it to be wonderful nonetheless. Motherwolf was a revelation- possibly the best Italian food I have ever had in Las Vegas. The pool was fantastic- I hold it in the same class as any in Vegas but, it was cleaner- service was better and it was an overall fantastic experience.

reviews.title: A+ hospitality, and breakfast at Vida!!!
reviews.text: So I strolled into the Fontainebleau one morning, and this was my first visit to Las Vegas. I was on a mission to collect as many $1 chips from as many different casinos as I could get my hands on. I had walked about 3 miles already this morning. I think it was somewhere around 9:30am when I walked in. Immediately I was taken back, this casino stood out FAR nicer than the other 30 or so places I had been too (including the Cosmo my close #2 fav). Lots of blues, silver and grays. Very 'cool' feeling as temps were going to be up around 105F for a high this day, that already made it feel super welcoming. On top of that I stroll over to a blackjack table for my $1 chip, and the pitboss comes over to me, Latrice, and she is super hospitable. She explained every floor, and accommodations on the property in extreme detail. I told her I was hungry, and she pointed out a couple of coffee shops on the second level. I told her I was more interested in a nice sit down 'bacon and eggs' kind of breakfast. She told me that there is a restaurant called Vida in the back part of the casino that made a great breakfast, and she was 100% correct. You get what you pay for in Las Vegas. It was a $40 breakfast consisting on 3x eggs, 2x pancakes, 3x sausage links, and a hashbrown patty that almost looked like a crabcake.
