The hashbrown patty alone is a reason to go back to this restaurant. The food was amazing. The only reason for the 4/5 stars is my experience at this hotel is the location. While the immediate location is fine, as is a stroll south, going north is ill advised after sundown as the neighborhood between here, and the Strat begins to deteriorate. I did make the walk in the late morning/early afternoon after breakfast. It was fine for me. I would not make this walk at night alone, in a group, maybe. Again the shout out to Latrice, as I was just a guy wearing shorts, and a t shirt looking for a $1 chip, and she acted towards me like I was the most important person to walk into the casino that morning.

reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.text: Amazing hotel. It is off strip but couldn’t fault it. We stayed in a King Gold Room with Best Strip view (6945) facing the strip and the Sphere. Very clean and comfortable. Hotel is just something else.

reviews.title: Beautiful Casino
reviews.text: We loved staying here!   It was absolutely beautiful and so high end.  The casino is amazing.  We actually won!  I love how it is at the end of the strip not in the middle of the craziness but easy to jump on the Duece bus and go onto the strip and visit the other casinos.  The pool was perfect after a day of walking.  Plenty of lounge chairs available in and out of the pool and bar service was great!  We also loved the food court to get bagels or pizza for quick bites!  Would def recommend!

reviews.title: Everything was great, but the prices were WILD
reviews.text: An impeccable facility, we loved the design and attention to detail. Everything feels new, well thought out, luxe, and distinctive. In a town full of mega-hotels, the Fontainebleau holds its own. Our room was awesome, from our view (51st floor) of the strip including the Sphere, to the spacious layout, to the high end finishes. And like any good Vegas property, everything you need for a vacation is on premise. There are a ton of different eateries, ranging from super high end to grab and go. The pool area is a sight to behold, including falconry agents who use birds of prey to keep the are free from pigeons (I kid you not). The casino is well appointed and the table minimums are accessible for just about anyone. The only reason this gets a 4-star instead of a 5-star is because of the cost. It's exorbitantly expensive, even by modern inflationary standards. We're fortunate to have the means to afford it, but know that you'll be shocked if you don't go in prepared. A few examples. There's a little coffee shop near the guest elevator bank where they recommended we go for our morning coffee. Two drip coffees were nearly $20, excluding tip. And mind you, there isn't a coffee pot in your room to do it yourself. Another morning my wife and I went to the food court and there's a wellness spot. We got a fruity smoothie, an acai bowl, and a single energy shot. The bill was $110. No exaggeration. Another day we had two salads (one with chicken, one with falafel) and two seltzers, the bill was $130. Like I said, inexcusably high prices that warrant a star reduction. Had the staff, facilities, design, or attention to detail not be ELITE, the pricing would've really been a massive red flag. Fortunately, this is as nice an experience (outside of the price tag) as you can find in Vegas.

reviews.title: Wonderful but needs improvement
reviews.text: The resort is very nice. I was so happy not to be down at the other end where it feels dirty and filled with a lot of undesirable people. Our room was very nice! Great size, comfortable bed, good water pressure, good  view of the Sphere from our room but not our friends room, some amenities included (a tooth brush would be a nice addition) with the ability to add on with purchased amenities (although VERY expensive). There were two issues our room. 1) The toilet was loose. 2) It’s a great shower head but it didn’t move, so I was shoved up against the wall opposite of the faucet, which was very annoying and made showering more of a task, plus water poured out on the bathroom floor. We enjoyed the Cafe Cuto bar area every morning and watched a game in the sports bar. We would have enjoyed watching from the front area but a $1,500 minimum for 4 people is ridiculous! It was college football not the Super Bowl! It was nearly empty too. And $150 a seat to sit at the bar stools facing the screen - it was empty! A crowd attracts a crowd. We had a cocktail in the Collins Bar while there was someone  playing the piano, which was nice but the cocktails were nothing special. At $25 a cocktail, they should be outstanding. I would have given them 5 stars if it weren’t for the issues mentioned above. If they listen to their customers and resolve these minor, but multiple issues.We would stay here again. Fingers crossed they make some improvements.

reviews.title: This is the best resort in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We looked foward to our second stay at Fountainbleau and really enjoyed spending almost all of our time on property. The hotel is beautiful, comfortable and has everything we needed for a relaxing and romantic weekend. The restaurants are excellent and we love the bars/lounges, each with their own signature cocktails and great service. Nowhere Lounge is a hidden gem in Las Vegas. We enjoyed an outstanding live three piece band that played classic R&B, hip hop and pop in a beautiful room and no cover charge.We also really enjoy the pool area. We even won a couple bucks in the casino.Fountainbleau is my new favorite Las Vegas resort.

reviews.title: Cannot wait to return to the Beautiful Fountainebleu!!!
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel. Spacious, clean accommodations, friendly staff, smoke free. Gorgeous pool area with lots cabanas, umbrellas and lounge chairs-some at no additional costs. Want to return and explore more of the property. This was for a Birthday celebration and loved it!!

reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: Our group of five couples met up at Fontainebleau for Labor Day weekend. Some of the group wanted to try a new place so we ended up here instead of an MGM property which we have been frequenting in recent years. We like to hang out at the pool in a cabana during the day then have dinner and gamble at night. Overall we found the place nice but very expensive. We appreciated the non-smoking environment but hated the strong scent pumped into the air and infused in all the soaps and lotions. We enjoyed our cabana in the Sun Club the first day but the second day we got booted to the regular pool because some high roller decided they wanted to buy out the entire Sub Club on a few hours' notice. The cabana manager originally moved us to two small cabanas but grudgingly agreed to give us a King cabana, the only one that actually fit our entire group. The only compensation we were offered was to knock $200 off our required minimum spend. We went to Papi Steakhouse for dinner Sunday night. It's super loud and there's a whole presentation when someone orders the $1000 Tomahawk steak so the lights flash and the staff come out holding signs and do a chant. That happened probably 5-6 times while we were there. The steak was fine but didn't have much flavor and the sides were dished out to everyone by the servers without asking who had ordered what. The table minimums were at least $25 so our group ended up going to other places to gamble two out of the three nights we were there. The room was nice, I was happy there are dresser drawers and the water pressure in the shower was amazing. I think in another few years it will feel like other higher end resorts on the stip. Everything was notably more expensive. Bottom line, it was fine but we won't be back.

reviews.title: Vacation for the win
reviews.text: Clean, classy and comfortable. Check in was a breeze. Rented a cabana on resort pass and it was perfect. Nicely tucked away and our server Taylor was so attentive five. This has to be the classiest hotel in the strip.

reviews.title: Loveee this hotel.
reviews.text: Loved this hotel, had a great experience. The hotel was so clean and new. The fitness center was amazing, had all the machines you need and they also offer classes which was great. I took a stretch class with Justin and I loved it. Coffee at Cafe Cuto was really good and they have a hotel guest only lounge where you can grab quick coffee and skip the lines or get a drink to start the night. The lounge is called Nowhere on the 2nd floor by the gym. Love this benefit bc the cafe lines get crazy! It was a far from the strip, but I honestly preferred it because it was a lot more relaxing and avoids the crazy crowds for everything. Had an overall great experience!

reviews.title: Five stars +++
reviews.text: Service!I have never experienced the same level of customer first service since the 90s.I worked at the Regent Beverly Wilshire in Beverly Hills for several years then the Mondrian West Hollywood, the Standard and the Intercontinental in SF so I have a good understanding of what it takes to have a professional staff attend to guests and Fontainbleu gets it. We decided to take an advantage of a promotion Fontainbleu extended after getting status matched to our 7 star Caesars rewards.Upon check in we were upgraded to a view Royal Suite. What a view!  Our host Kathy is amazing and because of her we decided to ditch our original plans of staying at our home casino Caesars and return to Fontainbleu for the remainder of our stay.Thank you Fontainbleu.We will be back for tears for fears in October!

reviews.title: Labor Day weekend 2025  FBLV
reviews.text: Extremely clean, fun vibe, yes, it is off the main strip however that provides a very quiet and relaxing night when you want to go to bed. It was absolutely perfect.

reviews.title: Unexpected Charges and No Real Support
reviews.text: I was incorrectly charged for a bar order I never made, despite having checked out 8 hours earlier and already being on my flight home. To make matters worse, I was informed that I must resolve the issue by phone due to a so-called “security policy.” This is highly disappointing and extremely inconvenient for an international business traveller. Whether this stems from intentional misconduct or poor management, the fact that their systems cannot even register when a guest has already checked out is unacceptable.

reviews.title: A Fantastic Stay from Start to Finish
reviews.text: I loved everything about my stay — from the stylish furniture and the spotless cleanliness to the excellent service. Everyone was super nice and always in a good mood, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable.The Fitness Center was excellent; I truly enjoyed training there. The equipment is modern, complete, and offers everything you need for a great workout.The pool area was another highlight — spacious, relaxing, and with a great music selection that created the perfect atmosphere.Overall, it was a fantastic experience being at your hotel, and I can’t wait to come back!

reviews.title: One Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: Fontainebleau took 17 years to complete, with many setbacks along the way. It was well worth the wait. Our first stay was for 4 nights in August 2025. Our room was on the 54th floor, looking toward the southeast. So we had a view of the Sphere and Encore as we looked toward our right out our window. The constantly-changing Sphere was mesmerizing to watch at all hours of the day and night. Our room was immaculately clean, decorated in white and shades of blue. There was a fridge drawer for guest use and a bunch of snacks and drinks for purchase, and a safe to lock up valuables. There were robes and slippers in the closet. The bathroom had double sinks and both a shower and a large bathtub. The toilet was separated from the rest of the bathroom by a frosted glass door. The room’s climate control worked well and we had very restful nights. The hallways were extremely wide and the whole vibe was one of comfort, crispness, and cleanliness. No smoke smell in any public or private areas. The lobby at Fontainebleau was amazing, with REAL vibrant red roses filling a number of huge urns and containers. We actually saw an employee in the early morning hours replacing any that were wilted. The artwork throughout the facility was huge and gorgeous. Do take the time to really walk the whole thing because around every corner is beauty- greenery, sculpture, photographs, and paintings. There were a number of grand escalators which were very tall and an adventure to ride. Fontainebleau has its share of designer retail, but the thing that is different is that it is located within the casino as opposed to in a street of shops with a mall-like feel. Similarly, the restaurants are along the perimeter of the casino. There’s a food court on the floor above the casino, but you really can’t call it a food court. It’s much higher-end. We ate two times at Washing Potato, which is on the casino level. Why two times at the same place? Because it was probably the best Pan Asian food I’ve ever eaten, in a truly unique environment. But that’s the subject of another review. There are several pools and they have a relaxed, chic vibe. I was impressed that they hired a company which uses natural methods to keep pigeons away, specifically, a large bird that pigeons fear, which was there with its handler, who was happy to do meet and greets. What a good idea, as opposed to using cruelty or chemicals!There are several fantastic resorts on the Strip, neighbors Wynn and Encore among them, but what truly sets the tone at Fontainebleau are its people. At every turn, there was a knowledgeable, friendly, helpful person available, and there were enough of them to make it seem that you were truly being looked after. I felt like this was the Vegas of 20 years ago in terms of service, presented in a fresh, gorgeous, clean way. This is a place for the young and hip party crowd, as well as the seasoned and relaxed leisure traveler. People make a big deal out of its location on the north end of the Strip. Yes, it’s not perfect, but it does seem that the epicenter of the Strip is starting to shift northward with the superior resorts of Wynn, Encore, Resorts World, and now Fontainebleau there, plus the Sphere located up Sands Avenue. We purchased a 3 day bus pass and rode the Deuce bus if we wanted to get further than our feet allowed. $20 per person for 3 days can potentially get you anywhere you want to go around the Valley. As in any other major city, keep your wits about you and be more diligent as the evening wears on. I had begun to get really discouraged watching all the videos coming out of Vegas about how bad it is now. Don’t believe all of them. Quality costs money. It’s a balancing act to be sure, but if you are willing to pay a bit more to have beauty, fine people, and clean furnishings around you, you will not be disappointed with this resort. My trip to Fontainebleau has restored my confidence that Vegas can be truly a world class destination. Congratulations, Fontainebleau, on an amazing resort!

reviews.title: Fake luxury, rude staff and trashy environment
reviews.text: The WORST customer service at a hotel I've ever had.First of all every single interaction with guest services and check in has been awful. I'm traveling for business and the room rates are close to 700 dollars a night. Check in the lines were extremely long and every agent was rude.Because of the lines the agent told me she gave me late checkout. I called to check on that later and told there was no notes on my account for late checkout. When I told her that was unacceptable that I was basically lied to, she told me there was nothing she could do.I've stayed in a lot of hotels in vegas and have never been treated like this.Overall the hotel is fake luxury. The crowd is gross the staff is rude and is not worth the price. Very dissatisfied

reviews.title: Excellent throughout, perfect stay! Well, minus the Hall of “Meh”xcellence
reviews.text: Excellent stay. Tom Brady’s Hall of excellence was a weird “meh”experience. Not meant for families really. The food was perfect. The atmosphere was incredible. Staff everywhere except the Hall of Excellence security were so nice. We rented a cabana. The food was great. Pools were clean. And the service was fantastic. Gambling options rock. Pool casino? I felt like JB at the FBLV. Will return soon.

reviews.title: Stunning hotel, would recommend a visit!
reviews.text: Lovely hotel, clean, friendly and lovely rooms. Only negative would be that it would be handy if gym was 24x7, esp for international travellers suffering from jet lag ;)

reviews.title: Glamourous experience.
reviews.text: Fontainbleau was a beautiful visit.  This hotel is very spacious; however, if you do not have good mobility, it may not be good for you.  The pool was great, not packed with people. We could easily find a chair; however, service out there wasn't the best.  All the food we had was amazing!  If you're looking for a honeymoon, anniversary getaway, this is perfect.  You can choose to have a view of the sphere, which is worth every penny!

reviews.title: Fontainebleau at Las Vegas best resort!!!
reviews.text: This place is so amazing!!! The people, rooms, pool, casino, everything is just outstanding. All the services people are really nice and helpful.

reviews.title: Superb Hotel to stay when in Vegas
reviews.text: We stayed in August 2025. The hotel is huge but once you work out what is where is easy to navigate. It was not busy.The rooms were spacious, modern and very clean. All of the housekeeping staff and hotel staff were friendly and helpful.The pool area was lovely and lots of sun beds available . The restaurants we used were very good. The gym was amazing .The hotel sits at the end of the main drag but it’s not too far to walk to the main places. Ubers are cheap and easy too .Definitely stay here again next time in Vegas.

reviews.title: Never staying anywhere else!
reviews.text: Beautiful, clean & bright! Best hotel on the strip! Yes, it is higher end; however well worth the money spent! Lobster roll in the food out should be your first stop! Also, recommend talking to the lady with the hawk at the pool!

reviews.title: Great Dining & Service, but Location and Value Could Be Better
reviews.text: Stayed at Fontainebleau for a two-night girls’ trip through Amex FHR. The property is beautiful, clean, and modern, though some areas feel a little bare. Check-in was quick and easy, and staff were friendly throughout. Loved the filtered water stations on the casino floor!Our Bleau Queen room was spacious, spotless, and well-designed with plenty of outlets (huge plus!). Noise wasn’t an issue. The only letdown was no upgrade despite booking through FHR, and the location is far from the main Strip.Dining was the highlight! Komodo was incredible (amazing cocktails, great vibe with a live DJ), KYU was very good, and breakfast at Chez Bon Bon was solid. The fitness center was also excellent - clean and well-equipped. Gaming was fun too, though craps table minimums jumped from $15 to $25, which was disappointing.Overall, a great stay with fantastic dining and service, but the location and value at full price make me hesitant. I’d return if there’s a good deal.

reviews.title: LIV Beach Club and Sun Club is a Vibe
reviews.text: Amazing property with the best pools in Las Vegas. LIV Beach with James Kennedy was Lit!  So much fun!!! The Veuve Clicquot Sun Club was super pretty and a cool vibe!  Nice restaurants and shops.  Overall property is very nice.  Would revisit.

reviews.title: good rooms and nice lobby
reviews.text: it is a nice place to stay with not too many people and a easy access to most of the places except the parking garage is a little far away from the guest rooms

reviews.title: What’s not to love?!
reviews.text: What’s not to LOVE?! It’s such an amazing resort.  Our host is amazing. The rooms are always clean, the staff is friendly, the floor service is great, and the food is incredible.  We saw the MAW, Christopher Cross and Toto concert at their theater and it was a great experience. Well ventilated, great sound and intimate.  Mother Wolf and the bagel shop is awesome, and this is coming from an old school NY Native. Best Italian I’ve had in years. “Icing on the west coast.  We love the Fountainebleau.  Every experience is amazing! Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.title: Exceptional experience at Fountainebleau…
reviews.text: A true mark of service and luxury , this hotel stands out in Las Vegas  in my opinión… staff is very efficient from the get go thru check out . Food and service at dining venues  is  always a good experience .. I highly recommend the hotel .

reviews.title: Probably best Hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: Hotel was excellent, Nice and clean, Pool party was awesome. Overall a great experience will be coming back !! Great Espresso Martinis at the bar :)

reviews.title: Absolutely Wonderful.
reviews.text: Beautiful, clean, and inviting. Staff couldn't be more friendly and helpful. Restaurants were top notch with fantastic employees.  Our room was amazingly Spotless!

reviews.title: Exceptional Experience
reviews.text: Great Food Good Times Excellent Customer Services Easy Access Plenty Parking Offers Retail Therapy-Shopping and Entertainment plus a place to Dance the Night Away

reviews.title: Relax.
reviews.text: The Fountainbleau is a great place to stay. Professional staff. Great room. Love the fitness center. I didn’t visit to gamble - just wanted a relaxing weekend. And I got exactly what I needed. And the location works great force. Close to the BEST 2 breakfast spots in LV. Closer to the arts district and all the local/off strip bars and restaurants. I have ZERO issues.

reviews.title: Best of the Best
reviews.text: Great all-around experience for hotel, gambling, food, spa and fitness center.  My new favorite property on the Strip!

reviews.title: Most memorable Vegas trip!
reviews.text: Think Wynn/Encore is the "place" to stay?? THINK AGAIN! The Fontainebleau is Next-Level! From the moment you arrive at the property you feel welcomed and special. The property is stunning, and the rooms exceed expectations in both comfort and elegance. The Casino is large, offers amazing gaming options and is extremely clean. Most importantly, in my opinion what diferentiates Fontainebleau over other properties is that the staff embodies a profound sense of pride in both the hotel and casino. It's a quality that seamlessly extends to every guest's experience. From personal experience - This is something you won't find at Wynn/Encore! The restaurants are incredible, the pool is glamorous, and the Spa is amazing! Can't wait to go back.

reviews.title: Yes! Finally the perfect Vegas hotel.
reviews.text: New favorite place in Vegas. Love being on the strip but away from the madness. Bars and restaurants were amazing. Motherwolf and No Where are awesome.  Staff was excellent and very professional. Pool area was perfect with great service.  Clean! The hotel is stunning. Had a great view of strip and mountains.  Look forward to returning.

reviews.title: Quick Visit
reviews.text: Wife and I were staying at two different casinos on the strip and wanted to check out the Fontainebleau because of the videos we saw on Instagram.  The resort is opulent. The center bar is very classy and everything is still new.  The people we encountered both guests and employees all seemed genuinely in a good mood.  We signed up for our rewards cards and then got a quick bite to eat at the food court.  This was the only downside I saw. The food court reminded me of a Simon Mall food court.  But dinner was okay.  My wife absolutely loved the selection of slots and had a great time. I hit the electronic craps games and the slots and, while I didn’t win anything sizable, I at least enjoyed myself. Same cannot be said of all casinos in Vegas.  We probably stayed two hours. Had to pay the now going rate of $25 for parking.  But again, it was fun.

reviews.title: Amazing Resort
reviews.text: Very friendly Staff. Room was impeccable. Very clean organized equipped with everything you need for comfortable stay. Incredible amenities. Multiple option on restaurant, bars and lounges, great gambling areas. The oasis pool 10/10.

reviews.title: Hotel and casino are beautiful, room was disappointing
reviews.text: I used the AMEX Fine Hotels deal and was told I was upgraded, but the room was their standard, lock-off room. It was on a high floor, but the view was of the rooftop of the convention center. We could hear everything in the rooms on either side of us and were woken up as partiers came back to their rooms around 3am. The bathroom was consistently 10 degrees warmer. The room reminded me of a Marriott room. The hotel and casino are beautiful. The pool is nice. The gym was super hot so we only stayed 20 minutes. We bought a two day pass on the monorail to get to the other end of the strip which is where everything we wanted to do was.

reviews.title: Overcharged and Overrated!
reviews.text: 1. Reserved strip view, and was given pool view. 2. Room was not cleaned prior to check in. Pubic hair by the toilet, trash in our ice bucket, a dirty q tip by the bed, and an empty tissue box!3. Vida restaurant charged us $175 for eggs, hashbrowns, and 2 mimosas. It was an error but glad we looked at the check and it still came up to $100.4. Pools were nice but 21+ pools were either closed or full of reserved chairs and cabanas that were EMPTY.5. We were awaken by repeated calls at 6am from the front desk asking if we need the police sent to our room!????6. The next morning we were awaken at 8am by a man that was "housekeeping" letting himself into room even though our DND light was on!! Wayyyy too much inconvenience for a 3 night stay!  For the price, just stay at the Wynn.

reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.text: Great experience beautiful hotel.  If you have AMEX book through them.I got early check in, late check out, free breakfast voucher, an upgraded room and an additional $100 voucher for dinning

reviews.title: My top resort in vegas
reviews.text: We all know the property that has been THE place to stay in vegas for years. The Fontainebleau should be on that list for you. Beautiful open resort and  very nice rooms. Arguably the best restaurants top to bottom of any property in town.  Have stayed several times in the 2 years they’ve been open for work, personal and with a business group. Every time we leave loving the FB experience.

reviews.title: No Coffee in Hotel Room
reviews.text: Hotel was beautiful and clean but there was not coffee in the room. I think that's a simple offering that would make a huge difference in my opinion. Instead, if I wanted to enjoy a coffee while I'm getting ready in the morning, as I often do, I would have to get dressed, walk downstairs, find somewhere that's open that probably takes 10 minutes to locate, then I have to wait in line and pay $15 for a coffee, then go back to my room. Building in this extra time is a pain

reviews.title: Thumbs up and will definitely return
reviews.text: Such a great Hotel / Resort to be and stay at. Food and shopping all great!!! Easy access to casino, valet, and restaurants!

reviews.title: Fantastic Stay — Clean Rooms, Great Service, and Fair Rewards
reviews.text: I’ve started staying at Fontainebleau regularly for business and it’s been outstanding. Easy to get off the Strip, with clean, modern rooms and great service. The casino and restaurants are top-notch, and rewards/comps are very fair. A perfect mix of convenience, comfort, and fun.

reviews.title: A top notch Vegas experience
reviews.text: We loved everything about our stay at Fontainebleau, from check-in to our guest room to drinks and dining to gaming. The entire resort is clean and well kept. The gym and pool are incredible. We'll definitely be back.

reviews.title: Better than most of the strip hotels
reviews.text: This is a great resort on the northern potion of the strip.   The casino is large with a great selection of table games and slots.   Many food choices with some great restaurants.  The room I stayed in was clean and modern.  The hotel staff provides excellent service.   This was my second stay in the past year and I will stay there again in the future.

reviews.title: amazing experience
reviews.text: the Hotel is amazing the facilites are great, the rooms are well decorated we strongly suggest the following restaurantsKomodo, Fontaine, Mother wolf, we travel with 3 and 6 years old kids pool was great for them

reviews.title: Best Hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: This hotel stands out as one of the finest in Las Vegas, offering an unparalleled level of luxury. For those seeking a VIP experience, this is undoubtedly the ideal destination.

reviews.title: Wonderful resort to stay at in Vegas.
reviews.text: I am a big fan of the Fountain Bleau Miami location.  the Vegas property did not disappoint.  The layout was well thought out.  Great restaurants.  The bar vibe was just what I needed after a long day.  The room was well designed with easily accessible lighting and drape controls throughout the room.  Elegant bathroom.  The room service was impeccable.   Overall, one of the most problem free stays in my travel history.  Beware of August though.  It was too hot to even enjoy the pool.  I think the sun bounces off the tinted windows directly into the pool area.  This would be great at a different time of year but in August was just too much for me.  However, if you are there to gamble, this is no big deal.  Great stay.  I would definitely go again for the right price!

reviews.title: 10 out of 10!
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel with stunning views! Excellent water pressure in the shower and soft comfortable beds. The pools are amazing

reviews.title: Luxury and friendly
reviews.text: I loved my time in The Fountaineblue Las Vegas, the staffs members all the time was amazing; check in and check out was very easy and fast. The room was perfect.

reviews.title: Wonderful spot
reviews.text: Amazing hotel! I was there for business, but mixed in a bit of fun toward the end of my trip. I like how it is a little removed from the heart of the strip, as it lends itself to a calmer, higher-end vibe. However, you can still easily walk or rideshare to the more lively spots. The service, ambiance, and pool were incredible. My room had an amazing view of the Sphere which I enjoyed every night. The blackout shades were effective at keeping out the light. Overall, would definitely return if I find myself back in Las Veas.

reviews.title: Best Las Vegas hotel by far
reviews.text: I’ve been going to Las Vegas once or twice a year for the past 14 years and Fontainebleau is by far the best hotel here! The overall experience is great, rooms are nice and very clean, restaurants are amazing and the bars/club is the best! I don’t think I could have lost in the casino if I had wanted to! Definitely will be staying here from now on!

reviews.title: Not the best experience I’ve ever had
reviews.text: I don’t know what to say. It’s just a big impersonal casino. Seems to be overrun with too many people all jammed together. Dealers vary from good to sad

reviews.title: Unwind and relax
reviews.text: thee best hotel in Vegas hands down the place is super clean and family friendly  my whole stay was very relaxing and my family loves it

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: Nice new hotel, clean and very large rooms with great views of the LV, especially the Sphere. Nice swimming pool and gym.I found the prices of minibar products and the general confusion of the lobby excessive

reviews.title: Fontainebleau worst 5 star ever
reviews.text: My first time staying here and last I had high expectations. When we got to the room it smells like sewage. It smelled so bad we had to stsy outside. We went back to front desk and they did nothing for us worst customer service ever. They down graded us to another room. Never staying here again. I never been treated so bad ever. There’s many other Hotels don’t stay here.

reviews.title: Disgusting room and horrible service
reviews.text: I have never received such horrible service from both the front desk and the manager about our room situation. We checked into our room to find it smelled horribly of sewage and when we went downstairs to switch rooms that’s when the rudeness and attitude came out from the blond lady in the front. She downgraded our room in response and said that was all she could do for us. Last time I stayed here I had such great service so I wanted to come back here and was instead treated like a speck of dirt on her foot. The manager came out and gave the same monotone unwelcoming response. This experience left such a sour taste in our mouths and we won’t be coming back here. There’s plenty of other great hotels to stay at in Vegas. We’ll definitely go back to sticking with Palazzo instead.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: I stayed at the hotel for 2 days during a work trip and it was excellent. The room was bigger than I expected, with a stunning view of the pool area and the Sphere, staff was super helpful and friendly and all the amenities were amazing (eg. a "cold drawer" next to the mini fridge so you can store your water and stuff, perfect!) No coffee machine in the room, but I learned that's normal for Vegas.

reviews.title: This is where you HAVE to stay in Las Vegas!
reviews.text: Why are you considering any other resort?! This one is the best! It's spectacular, with its modern, eclectic artwork all around the resort, its relaxing pools, and its close proximity to the Convention Center and the Strip. I have never stayed at a hotel where the staff was consistently genuine, friendly, helpful, and extremely knowledgeable. Definitely check out Le Cote cafe, the Hall of Excellence sports museum, the Tavern sports bar, and the spa--you will not be disappointed!

reviews.title: Bleu is top notch #1
reviews.text: You will not be disappointed in staying at Bleu.  From gaming, to shoppes, food and shopping, it has it all for your every desire.

reviews.title: Definitely going back!!!!!!
reviews.text: We went for my son's 14th birthday! We got upgraded to a suite and made the experience really nice! The food was amazing and every drink we had from the multiple bars where all really delicious!

reviews.title: Will be returning!
reviews.text: Great new hotel! Stayed for an event and loved that you could walk right to the convention center. Highly recommend for that alone. Rooms were clean and comfortable. Staff was friendly and helpful. Self-Parking was a breeze and included during stay. Hotel was easy to navigate. Only minor note is on the in-room fridge drawers - they never got cold enough. Very minor issue that probably won't even bother most!

reviews.title: Love this place!
reviews.text: This Casino is fabulous. From the first step out of the vehicle, the scent in the air, fresh flowers inside and the overall sensual atmosphere makes this hotel a no brainer for us. We have stayed here 4 times and never been disappointed!

reviews.title: DO NOT STAY HERE! AUGUST 2025 STAY RUINED
reviews.text: Checked in 8/02 at 12:45 AM (mobile check-in, just picking up keys) and the front desk never returned my ID. I thought I’d lost it, tore apart my room, retraced my steps, and called the desk—was told “no” and to file a lost/found report. Not convinced, I went down 3 separate times and was told each time it wasn’t there. Security even told me to stay in my room or risk being kicked out for not having ID. After crying and missing a paid event, my friend asked the desk one last time—and guess what? It was there the whole time. This wasted nearly 3 hours. When I asked the GM (dark hair, started shift 10:45 PM) how this could happen, she was rude and dismissive, only offering $100 food credit + late checkout. BEYOND UNACCEPTABLE. It ruined my stay.

reviews.title: Average Stay
reviews.text: We have only ever stayed in the Wynn and Encore on our past trips so I don't know if our expectations were too high because although this hotel looks like luxury once your staying its not very luxurious at all.The casino is big and has lots of slots and tables but the drinks service was so slow I think its because the ladies had so long to walk to get the drinks there didn't seem enough of them to keep on top of it.Our room was good really loved the bathroom but when we checked in although it had been cleaned there were crumbs on the carpet and hairs all over the bathroom floor, called down they sent someone in to sort it but when we returned at the end of the evening they had hoovered most of the crumbs and hairs but left quite a lot so ended up using my antibacterial wipes to get rid of them! Everynight we stayed there were people outside our room sitting in the hallway chatting really loud at 3/4 am, if your from the UK like us you will know how hard it is to go back to sleep when your woken up at 3am your body thinks its daytime so that was annoying.We tried a lot of the bars all were very good with a high standard of service but was quite taken back that on the Saturday when the day club finished people who had been partying there came to the main bleu bar in trunks and bikinis standing around the bar being really loud, not being the fun police, all for people having a good time but don't really want to be dressed up for a fancy dinner paying for a $25 cocktail with a side of obnoxious drunk chat and body hair.We used the pool twice both times struggled to get beds, people were reserving beds with towels and then not using them, we didn't want to pay for day beds for a couple of hours so made do with what we could find, not enough umbrellas to stay out too long in the sun. The pool area was pretty dirty, spilled drinks, food left under beds.On a positive note all the staff we encountered through the hotel were polite, helpful and enthusiastic.On summary if your looking for high end luxury this is probably not the hotel for you but with the prices they charge you do get a luxury room for a lower cost than some of the other luxury hotels just not the same experience.Would we stay here on our next visit no but I would visit for drinks in some of the nicer bars yes.

reviews.title: Luxury Hotel Experience
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau is a luxurious hotel/casino on the north end of the Las Vegas Strip.The hotel offers free parking for guests.  A member of the concierge team told us that free parking continues until midnight after check-out.Their customer service is extraordinary.  Every employee we interacted with was outstanding.  Each was friendly, polite, and helpful.LocationFor me, the biggest drawback to this property is its location.  It's far from the majority of the Strip action.  But mostly, I wish they had better neighbors.  Directly to the north is a vacant lot with The Sahara on the other side.  It's across the street from Circus Circus and there are two more vacant lots to the south.  Getting anywhere off the property I genuinely want to be is a walk.  That being said, the journey is excellent exercise and fantastic people-watching.DiningOverall, the dining options are, expectedly, on the pricey side.  We ate dinner at Mother Wolf and had breakfast at Vida.  I will review those venues in detail separately.  However, both were enjoyable experiences.We grabbed drinks at Bleau Bar a couple of times.  The service is friendly but a bit inattentive, especially for the price.  I ordered the Pancakes & Dopamine cocktail ($21) and my husband ordered a Mango Cart beer ($9).  All of the beer comes in either a can or a bottle.  I don't believe they have draft beer.  My cocktail tasted great; super smooth.  The issue I had with my drink is that it was mostly ice cube.  I feel like I paid $21 for about a shot glass worth of beverage.  $9 for a 12-oz can of beer that costs $11.99 for a six-pack is rough enough.  The drinks and service are not worth the price.RoomWe stayed in a Bleau King Mountain Best View room.  The room was clean and comfortable.  The only issue we had with the room was that we had to move the showerhead to face the corner to prevent water from seeping out between the top of the ledge and the bottom of the door.  The water pressure was intense.  If you liked being beaten up by water, this shower is for you.Check-OutThe only real issue we encountered was during check-out.  Because of the booking portal we used, we received a late check-out of 4:00 pm (the standard check-out time is noon), which we verified with the front desk while checking in.  We went to our room around 3:30 pm to gather our belongings and leave, but our keycards would not unlock the door.  We then had to go to the front desk during the hectic check-in time (3:00 pm), which was frustrating.  In the grand scheme of things, it was merely an irritating hiccup.  But I'm not sure why their reservation system does not allow for a late check-out without the guest needing new keys.The actual check-out process is simple.  I received an email with a link to review our charges, with a button to check out and email the folio.  I clicked the button and checked out.  My only issue with that is that I never received my emailed folio.  I took a screenshot, so it wasn't much of a problem.I would stay at Fontainebleau Las Vegas anytime and recommend it to friends.

reviews.title: Clean, well looked after hotel with great pool area
reviews.text: For our first time visiting Vegas, we were very impressed with the hotel. We were given a choice of a higher or lower floor. We chose higher, and were also upgraded and given a room with a great view. Full height window was great for a view of the sphere and the strip.The pool area was clean, and plenty of sun lounges.The hotel is further away from the strip but we knew this when booking so it wasn’t an issue, but one to bear in mind if you like to be central. Only issue we had was lack of quick bites suitable for a family. Lots of high end dining. We settled on sharing a pizza one night and it was almost $70! Way too overpriced for what it was in my opinion.Overall, we had a great stay and would recommend the hotel.

reviews.title: Impressed- would stay again
reviews.text: Wow! This place was fantastic! Excellent customer service from the concierge and the bell staff. There was also an oversized tub and great water pressure in the shower. The room was clean with a comfy bed and soft pillows. The room had updated technology. Just watch out for the mini bar. It’s done on a weight system. If you remove an item for more than 30 seconds you’ve bought it. Good shopping and great restaurants. Loved breakfast at La Fontaine. They also have a great chocolate shop called Cocoa Dulce that’s not to be missed.

reviews.title: No pool - denied a fun day in Vegas
reviews.text: Booked this hotel specifically for the pool. After we checked in, we found out that the pool was closed. Was told this was due to wildfires and high winds, although Wynn had their pool open. The boy at the pool unlocked the door and admitted that the staff had been sent home - probably just a way to save money and ruin my experience.

reviews.title: Looking forward to returning
reviews.text: Such a beautiful resort!  The restaurants are exceptional.  I ate at Mother Wolf, always a standout.  Chez Bon Bon is open 24/7 - I can grab coffee at 5am!

reviews.title: Fontainebleau uses clever marketing but the delivered product falls short in every area.
reviews.text: Restaurants were closed too early or just not open. Limited facilities overall. Rooms not cleaned. Called down 3 times for fresh towels that were never delivered. Hotel layout was odd - a cocktail bar in what can only be described as a shopping mall food court? The whole hotel lacked any kind of ‘Vegas vibe’. Over priced resort fee. Bad location. The list is endless. Fontainebleau uses clever marketing but the delivered product falls short in every area.

reviews.title: PESIMA
reviews.text: IF YOU GO TO LAS VEGAS NEVER CONSIDER THIS OPTION THEY CHEAT YOU WITH THE COSTS AND BESIDES THEY WANT TO CHARGE YOU THINGS YOU ALREADY PAID IF YOU DON'T LOOK CLOSE YOU PAY DOUBLE

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: 2nd time staying at this beautiful hotel and it didn't disappoint. We had a comp match and stayed the last 2 nights of our 13 night trip. From start to finish, the stay was exceptional. The customer service was outstanding everywhere. The room was gorgeous, fantastic pool area and my husband said the chicken sandwich he had from the food court was the best he'd ever had - so good he had it 2 days running. The chicken tenders from the same place wete also fantastic. The location wasn't an issue as we'd already done 4 nights at NYNY and 3 nights Cosmo and we weren't planning on straying far from the hotel as I'd planned it as a 2 night chill out/wind down stay. We also got a 1st spin bonus on pinball on freeplay and won $120 - we did pretty well on the slots as well.I would stay again in a heartbeat - don't let the location put you off - it cost us about $8 to Uber from Cosmo

reviews.title: Felt Misled and Overcharged
reviews.text: Arrived thinking I had a special rate, left with a bill twice the price—nearly $9,000. Misled from the start, poor management attitude, and left Las Vegas more disappointed than ever.

reviews.title: Clean hotel with great gaming and rooms
reviews.text: Clean hotel. Very quiet. Definitely recommend. It's a little far away from the main strip which is a bit of a bummer but overall a very nice experience with lots to do.

reviews.title: Best hotel on the strip we’ve been to in a long time
reviews.text: FANTASTIC hotel!!!  Highly recommend from the minute you walk in the door you were treated so well by all the staff the room was beautiful clean the best view we’ve ever had in the strip in the 40+ times we’ve ever been there. Just a really great experience and would highly highly recommend and definitely will go back again.

reviews.title: We will be back soon! The best hotel on the strip! Gorgeous!
reviews.text: What A Wonderful Experience! Gorgeous hotel! Wouldn't stay anywhere else!  Wonderful staff, very personable, & friendly! Went for my husband's 60th birthday. They made it very special by upgrading my room. And a flight at breakfast at Viva! Thank you for a great experience!

reviews.title: Wonderful stay near the Sphere
reviews.text: Amazing beautiful hotel with loads of hrs and restaurants!  Rooms gorgeous and a great vibe.  Nice casino also. Pool area was amazing also

reviews.title: Relaxing and opulent
reviews.text: Beautiful property and easy to navigate. The pool is most excellent with plenty of room and chairs. Restaurants were great and plentiful. Rooms masterly appointed and clean. Gambling is too tight though and minimums too high for my blood. The theater is fairly intimate with great acoustics and sound. We saw the Alabama Shakes concert here and loved it.  When having an Uber pick you up, specify north or south entrance. There are two places to be picked up, with no signage as to which entrance.  The only signs I saw pointed you to the rideshare pickup area which takes you to the north area past the lobby.

reviews.title: Great Experience! Would stay again.
reviews.text: Had a great time at Fountainebleau Las Vegas. Staff was friendly and accommodating. Rooms were very clean. Komodo had great late night dining. Get the wagyu & lobster fried rice. It was outstanding! Go see Pam @ Gucci if you're in the market.

reviews.title: Luxury in Las Vegas does not get better than this!
reviews.text: As a luxury wedding planner, I have the pleasure of visiting some of the most incredible resosrts in the world.  Fontainebleau Las Vegas is one of my favorites.  From the stunning, dynamic casino to the most impeccably appointed rooms and suites, every inch of this property is beautiful, well maintained, and the staff excels in every interaction.  Their ballrooms are spectacular and the perfect foundation that allows me to build out the most incredible experiences for my couples.  I could not be more appreciative of their partnership and support.

reviews.title: Resales ruining Fontainebleau concerts
reviews.text: My experience on the Fontainebleau Website was very poor.The resale tickets on sale for Toto are ridiculous and don’t even list at to what the face value was.Reselling is fine if you generally can’t go but that’s clearly not the case here and the extra booking fee is just extortion and they are no better than STUBHUB and Viagogo.Very disappointing

reviews.title: Worth the money
reviews.text: Spacious, clean suite. Cleaning service great. We had a great stay. The only thing we did not get were the closing times at pool. One day it was 7pm, another day 5 pm. We loved Don’s Prime and the gym.

reviews.title: New, Modern, Luxury Hotel in Vegas that’s seriously undervalued
reviews.text: Undervalued luxury hotel at the north end of the Las Vegas Strip. Just visited the Fontainebleau Las Vegas for the first time last weekend and was very positively surprised. The hotel is north of the Resorts World and Wynn/Encore and the newest hotel on the strip. So everything is in great condition. Check in was easy and receptionist was very nice. Rooms were also very nice, spacious, and again in great condition (can’t be said about all properties on the strip). I also really liked the modern decor in the rooms and all around the hotel. Given the hotel is on the northern end of the strip, foot traffic is a bit lighter which was great and so the hotel didn’t feel as overcrowded as some of the other hotels more central on the strip feel like. Parking was also for free for hotel guests - another plus. Ate at 3 restaurants on the property and 2 out of 3 were quite good. All in all, the Fontainebleau is a great (if not one of the best) modern luxury hotel in a calmer area of the strip. Would definitely come here again!

reviews.title: Gorgeous hotel with modern decor and technology, great service, everything you need in one spot!
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful stay at this beautiful hotel in Las Vegas. Massive property with a huge convention center. There is a large food court with everything from burgers to bagels to lobster rolls. They have everything from fine dining options to quick bites. The rooms were very spacious with modern decor. Huge bathrooms with separate showers and sinking tubs. The curtains and lights are all operated by a touch of a button… love the modern technology. They also have many restaurants, bars and shops. Of course there’s a large casino that serves free drinks while you play, Properly was ornately decorated and kept iextremely clean. There’s a massive gym with all of the most modern equipment and fitness classes are also offered. The pool area is beautiful and there a spa and even an IV bar. They have thought of everything. You don’t even need to leave the property if you don’t want to. Also LIV night club is on site . I highly recommend and would return.

reviews.title: Can’t wait for the next event/visit!
reviews.text: My stay at this property was perfectly enjoyable from start to finish. The staff were all very friendly and accommodating. I dined in only one restaurant, but the food was good. The coffee shop had an excellent latte. The meeting rooms and staff were outstanding. My pool experience was fantastic. My room was beautiful. I would highly recommend this property and event center.

reviews.title: Hidden gem that is not so hard to find!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful 3 night stay here. It was by far the best Vegas resort we’ve stay at. Every detail at FB exceeded my expectations. The high ceilings and artwork create a unique atmosphere that’s calming and peaceful. I am usually sensitive to smoke in casinos and never had an issue here. Check in was simple and staff was friendly. The security near the elevators are an extra touch and worth mentioning. We stayed in “basic” bleau queen room and can confirm was not least bit basic. The hallways are wide and highlighted with large frame art/lighting. We waited less than a min at the most for an elevator which was impressive considering the amount of floors here. The room was beautifully designed with so many extra touches including crown molding around the ceiling, a mini chiller for personal use, and the most plush/soft bed we’ve ever slept on in Vegas (wouldn’t recommend staying here if you prefer a firm mattress). I really appreciated the lighting options in the room and bathroom. It was so nice having a dim night light underneath the bathroom sink. Most importantly the room was spotless and I’m not saying that just bc the property is brand new but I must mention how clean the bathroom was. Housekeeping does an outstanding job here. Water pressure was 10/10 compare to other properties like cosmo and RW. We really enjoyed the shower and soak tub. The only “cons” here is that there were no coffee makers in room (probably standard in Vegas now) and the walls/connecting walls were a bit thin and could hear the people next door playing music in the mornings. If possible it may be worth requesting a room that is not a joining room to reduce the sound.The gym was fantastic and reminded me of an equinox style fitness center with many different types of machines/specialty equipment like Pilates reformers and TRX. They also offer free workout classes like yoga and Zumba in the mornings.The pool was lovely as it had tons of free umbrellas which is rare in Vegas and makes all the difference in 106 degree heat. The area is spacious and family friendly but with enough space to spread out if you prefer to have quiet adult convos/drinks. Pool is also open til 7 which is awesome. Overall no surprises here. We are already planning another trip back and look forward to checking out the dining options.

reviews.title: 31st anniversary at the Fontainebleau was nothing short of unforgettable. Luxury, care, and unforgettable moments.
reviews.text: 31st anniversary at the Fontainebleau was nothing short of unforgettable. Luxury, care, and unforgettable moments.

reviews.title: Superb experience but not great value
reviews.text: I stayed at FB, ate at Vida and La Cote, had drinks at the Taverb Bar, and hung out at the pool. It is a great hotel and the food and drink experience is outstanding, although it may not necessarily be a good value. It is definitely something worth splurging for. The drink service at the casino floor was responsive provided you are tipping appropriately. The pool is pretty chill and does not have loud music, with a good balance of adults and children, and not too crowded.

reviews.title: Nice Resort
reviews.text: Overall a good resort with good selection of venues.However, not a good experience at their main bar...Bleau.  Rude bar help. Bartenders who were very friendly and super nice.

reviews.title: Ridiculous overcharge
reviews.text: The hotel is ok really, not more than that. I booked 2 rooms for Memorial day weekend. When I check out - I always check the bills. I noticed there is an overcharge for $97.54 for minibar which we didn't use. The receptionist spoke to housekeeping, confirmed the whole minibar is there, and removed the charge. Imagine how I felt when this $97.54 was placed back on my credit card in June?! I called the hotel and explain that I have never used minibar and this is why I was credited this amount at the check out. However, the billing department wouldn't remove this amount from my card. Seriously, I spent $$$$$ at this hotel on 2 rooms, restaurants and casinos, do you imagine I would've fought $97.54?? This amount is not even worth a phone calls. It just I hate to be overcharged. After a few phone calls, you know what Fontaineblue - enjoy my $97.54, whoever had the drinks, which was not me.I will sure never stay there again. I know they don't care, since they will have enough other customers. Just advice - double check your bill and maybe shred your credit card after leaving.

reviews.title: Good but pricey
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, well-kept and the staff is very friendly but everything there is wildly overpriced compared to other hotels in the area

reviews.title: Great Hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel..elegant with lots of great amenities.l, attentive staff, lots of dining options.  Overall one of the best Las Vegas has to offer and we have stayed at alot of them.

reviews.title: New fav hotel on the strip!
reviews.text: Really is the best hotel on the strip - don't underestimate the luxury of being away from the strip. The newness is wonderful and all the restaurants are fresh and innovative. The pool area is so lovely 3 pools loads of seating, good vibes and pool side blackjack for those that do. Shops are ok some cute kids bits - was missing teenage appeal . We will stay again.

reviews.title: Will go back for sure!
reviews.text: It’s our second time staying at this hotel! Very nice hotel, great amenities and excellent customer service! The resort fees included the parking!

reviews.title: Close to a 5 star hotel, but not there yet, a few more teaks and it'll be amazing!!
reviews.text: Nice new resort on the North end of the Strip. Arrive July 26 for 3 nights. Hotel was FULL up on opening night, so no upgrade available, so even with high floor (61) the view was rather poor, the back empty lot and the Sahara, disappointing, but understandable with full occupancy. Valet was tough on that day as being so full, they handled it well, but it was still a bit hectic. Check in, quite good, no issues. Arrival in room, very nice, spacious, modern, very clean and well appointed, bathroom excellent. Issues with phone, not operational, and with my having cell phone issues, this became a problem. Had to contact several people and was the next day before issues resolved, disappointing for a so-called 5 star hotel. Also porterage, badly done, they could not deliver bags for several hours so I had to go back down and collect myself. Not a huge issue, and everyone was very pleasant, but again, this can't happen, no matter how busy at a 5 star resort. Stay in general, once bags retrieved and phone issue resolved, was all terrific. Won at their casino, a nice perk, drinks at Collins, very nice, bartender terrific. Even got bought a drink by a perfect stranger, very nice gesture. Never got to say "thank you" to whoever it was, but I thank them now as being amazing people and most generous. Days later ate at Papi Steak, very pleased. (see additional review). Did not get a chance to use their pool area but it is AMAZING, probably one of the best in Vegas. Elevated above the street level, it has an amazing selection of diff pool area, jacuzzi's, cabanas, even bars, dining and gambling outside. It's quite spectacular. I wish I had more time to spend a few hours and just relax but this vacation was jammed packed. But if you're a pool person, this should get a HIGH consideration. Checked out 3 days later, all fine on check out, quick, valet good. Generally this gets a lot of bad reviews, and I am not sure why. Yup, maybe it's located, across from the dive Circus, Circus is a turn off, I agree, but don't blame the hotel for that. Once that North ends redevelops, and I hope it happens soon, and once they work out the few kinks I experienced, this is going to be a MAJOR resort, and a top place to stay. I'd def recommend it, and would have zero issues coming back for a return visit. One other thing, sign up for the players club, used the card for gambling obviously, but at the same time, for any drinks, meals etc, as here it allows you to build points, that's sweet. I wish I'd had more time to same other food options as well as other lounges, but again, that may come in 2026. For right now, very happy with the stay and def a recommendation for someone looking for a modern and very clean and well decorated resort. It's very nice.

reviews.title: The best hotel in vegas!
reviews.text: Amazing staff, beautiful rooms and the view! Lovely! 💜💕 i would stay here all the time whenever I am in Vegas. I love the combination of colors of the whole interior esp the furnitures in the room! The staff are very helpful and always cheerful which I did not get in any other hotels I stayed at this month.

reviews.title: Nice Getaway
reviews.text: It was a fabulous experience! The decor spectacular. When walking inside you feel as though you have entered another world.

reviews.title: Hard to Believe.....but true
reviews.text: There was no food available in the hotel past 10 p.m. (on a Thursday night) other than disgusting room service at  obvious inflated prices.  The room service took 50 minute plus so plan accordingly if you are hungry!  The casino floor is reminiscent of a zombie apocalypse movie!  Zero energy and few humans to be seen anywhere other than dealers sitting around doing nothing.  The slot machine and video poker return was the worst I've experienced in 40 plus years.  The resort is a complete NA (never again).

reviews.title: Happy & Fun trip!
reviews.text: Casino setup, Luxurious Swimming Pool, Excellent Bars & Restaurants, Fantastic Shows, Excellent selection of shopping stores, Clean & specious Guest Rooms with the best & friendly staffs!The two ladies who helped us at the check-in desk, Melissa & Kenda were very supportive & kind! They're a great asset to your company!

reviews.title: Best getaway secret in Las Vegas.
reviews.text: Gorgeous property, exceptional, hospitality, and service. Tremendous variety of gaming,  Pool experience is second to none.

reviews.title: Fountaineblueau: A Jewel in Vegas
reviews.text: My first stay at Fountainebleau was for a slot tournament and it was a fantastic stay. The rooms are clean, veru modern--you can control  the lights and curtains at a push of a button. The towels , bedding and mattress were very good quality and the "blue" coloring in the room was pleasing. The staff was attentive and professional the whole time from the check in, cashiers, wait staff, and maintenance. A special acknowledgement to the cleaning staff, very clean rooms. There are many restaurants I ate at Papi's Steak House and Don's Prime, both were quality establishments if you like steaks.

reviews.title: Best hotel for gorgeous rooms and decor
reviews.text: Excellent hotel! Stunning decor, lovely place to visit with gorgeous rooms! Clean, beautiful and the most comfortable stay! Thank you!

reviews.title: Top notch!
reviews.text: Beautiful, extravagant property. The rooms were clean, spacious, high tech and the bedding was perfect. I love the pillows!

reviews.title: Great Times at the Fountainbleu
reviews.text: Great room and a great view.  All very clean and fresh.  Staff was outstanding in every area.  Highly recommend. The Vida cafe food service was outstanding and tasty.  My only negative was a late night room service order of a club sandwich that was over $ 45

reviews.title: Fontainebleau Las Vegas: A Great Place to enjoy some luxury
reviews.text: If you're a business traveler headed to Las Vegas, the Fontainebleau is definitely worth checking out. It's a comfortable and fancy place to stay, perfect after a long day of meetings.Checking in is very easy, which is convenient after traveling. The suites are impressive, with comfortable beds and ample space for work or relaxation. The bathrooms feature large showers and tubs. They also provide nice toiletries (Italian), soft robes, and slippers (even though I didn't use them).The conference spaces are well-designed and make for easy use. The Royal Ballroom is particularly large and they also have a large theater. The resort's proximity to the Convention Center makes it easy to attend events, This is on the north end of the strip so there isn't nearly the foot traffic like the center of the strip which limits the type of people that go along with that such as the street performers, etc...The hotel has a sophisticated atmosphere, the central bar is a great hub for meet-ups.The Fontainebleau Las Vegas is a great choice for business travelers or leisure travelers. The fabulous suites, conference areas, and location allow for a blend of work and luxury. I loved it and will definitely return!

reviews.title: Fontainebleau Vegas Noble Suite
reviews.text: We are local Vegas people. My SO took me to the Fontainebleau  for my birthday as we have not stayed in that hotel yet  Beautiful and they up graded our room as it was middle of the week to the Noble Suite room Love the view of the Sphere !  Room had two full bathrooms  separate bedroom, kitchen area with sink and they brought in a mini fridge part of room package  Hotel was quiet during mid week but we enjoyed walking around and playing there. Staff were great and very helpful

reviews.title: Check your bill at checkout
reviews.text: I went with my 15-year-old son. The amenities were good.At checkout there were charges that were supposed to be waived due to the special rate such as valet and foodFurthermore, housekeeping walked into the room started cleaning while we were still in there. I had to step out with my hair, wet and in PJS to wait for her to complete the task. The hotel is clean overall the service was good. We enjoyed our stay but check your bill at check out.

reviews.title: The best of the best
reviews.text: This resort is amazing.The room was perfect.The casino has a great selection of slots.The spa is incredible.Many thanks to my host.Kim H.This  is by far the best in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Happy place
reviews.text: The room perfect.  Large soaking tub, separate shower, terrific blow dryer. Plush robes, superb bed and linens.  Touch lighting and excellent air conditioner.  Great restaurants and swimming pools.  By far the best hotel in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Awesome surprise get-away!
reviews.text: The room was incredibly clean and super well done. Bed was amazing! Spa was out of this world. Michael worked to make our pool days incredible! Great experience!

reviews.title: Great place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Great place to stay. Very clean. Lots of options to eat within. Easy access to rideshare and staff were great. The casino was extremely nice and lots of options to play different things.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here from 23rd June to 3rd of July 25. We absolutely loved it the whole experience. Breakfasts to your room are a little pricey but good quality. The casino is great and the restaurant's are lovely especially Mother Wolf. If we could have we'd have stayed another week. I would absolutely love to go back there one day. Wonderful hotel x

Highly recommend.  Property is clean and new.  Rooms are fresh and crisp.  Service and employees are courteous.  Parking is safe.  Elevators are state of the art.  Only have to spend $2.5 for a tier credit.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: My wife and I recently stayed here and loved it.  Place is so big and clean we found ourselves wanting to just go back here for everything versus going to explore.The other casinos we walked thru on the strip felt like they were dark dreary and stunk.Pool area was great, restaurants were excellent and the gym was great too.  I’ll definitely be going back next time I’m in Vegas

reviews.title: Looks but not the service
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau is a beautiful hotel, everything is new, the casino has super high ceilings, and the pools are great. Where it lacks is service. I've stayed at Fontainebleau twice now and both times there were service issues. This time around it was my check in which took about 30 minutes from the moment I was face to face with a rep. There was no line. My room was not ready despite having a reservation and checking in at almost midnight. I was given a room all the way at the end of the hall which was a terribly long walk. Got to my room and the bathroom was not well cleaned, it was covered in hairs, either from staff or the previous guest. The first morning at breakfast at Vida I was told to step aside and wait for a table as they proceeded to seat couple after couple after me with no reservations. Once I asked to speak to the manager I was told they can only seat a solo at a 2 person table so the 20 or so open tables in the restaurant were not an option but every single couple that walked up after me could sit wherever there was an opening. This after terrible service at this same restaurant my last stay. (They have limited breakfast options) Overall, its a nice looking place. Food is good, the casino is fun and not crowded. They just really really need to work on their service. Almost every other casino I've stayed at on the strip has friendlier staff.

reviews.title: My fav spot
reviews.text: Hotel is stunning, so many restaurants and stores! Great gaming options. Beds are super comfy pool is amazing. Food and cocktails at the pool were yummy!

reviews.title: booking unbelievably difficult and website poor
reviews.text: don't use direct booking through player's club at this hotel. Clueless re customer support--tried to send me to reservations after asking a basic question after web use on site wouldn't respond. Would not try to game here if this is their basic response to basic questions

reviews.title: Nice experience! Location was the only negative
reviews.text: Very modern, nice pool and rooms, staff was very friendly and helpful, gambling here was fun, the dealers and dice men were great, food hall was great, restaurants were nice but we only tried Don's Prime, It was a nice steakhouse but nothing special, the only downside to this property was it's location, had to take a cab anywhere, when the strip reaches this property it will be one of the best on the strip

reviews.title: Awesome Stay, the perfect hotel out of the busy strip
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of staying at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas from July 4–6, and wow — what an unforgettable experience! From the moment I walked into the lobby, the luxury and energy of the space blew me away. Everything screams modern glam meets classic Vegas.🎯 ROOMS:The room was beyond amazing — ultra-spacious, with floor-to-ceiling windows that gave me a stunning view of the Strip. The design was sleek yet cozy, with a bed that felt like sleeping on a cloud. The tech amenities made everything effortless — from lighting to shades and even the espacious tube was amazing.🕐 CHECK-OUT:Check-out was smooth and easy, with flexible options. The staff was super accommodating — you could tell they’re trained to deliver that signature Fontainebleau service.💎 AMENITIES:This place has it all — incredible pools with the perfect Vegas vibe, a world-class spa, and a gym that honestly rivals any top fitness club. Whether you’re looking to relax or party, Fontainebleau hits every note.🍴 FOOD EXPERIENCES THAT BLEW MY MIND:	•	Bleau Blanc Rouge — The French restaurant is a must. Iconic hotcakes like you’ve never had before, crispy on the outside and fluffy inside — divine. The brunch here is something I’ll be dreaming forever	•	Miami Slice — If you’re craving something casual but ridiculously good, this is it. The NY-style pizza with a Miami twist is addictive — especially late night. You need to taste it is really good	🎆 OVERALL:Fontainebleau made this 4th of July weekend one to remember. It’s stylish without being pretentious, luxurious without losing that fun Vegas spark. Whether you’re here to celebrate, unwind, or indulge, this place delivers.

reviews.title: Amazing pool in Vegas
reviews.text: The pool is one of the best in Vegas. There are lots of chairs and umbrellas available all day long. The bar at the pool was also really nice. Plus there are even lounge chairs in the pool!Our room was available right on time and everything in the hotel is extremely clean.

reviews.title: Best hotel room in Vegas
reviews.text: We have stayed at several places in Vegas... I think this is possibly the nicest. It is every bit as good as Caesar's or Bellagio. I also liked the Rio's remodel rooms - stayed there in Feb, 2025. Back to FBleau - The view from the room was awesome. Its not a great view of the strip becuase that road curves. You do have a great view of the Sphere. The elevators were fast which was impressive because we were on 67th floor. The bathroom/shower were really nice. Nice robes. Cool auto blinds. It had the annoying snacks and fridge with drinks that auto bill if you touch them... but it also had an empty fridge door where you could put stuff if you wanted. I thought this was cool because sometimes its nice to buy drinks and have them in a fridge. We had other stuff planned, so we didn't spend much time at the casino, but the little bit we did, we liked. We didn't eat any of the places in the hotel, so i don't have any comment on those. All in all, it was beautiful and i'd go back. Wife thinks its the best hotel in Vegas and she's much pickier than me!

reviews.title: Great Accommodations and Experience
reviews.text: This was a great experience from the time we checked in until departure. The staff was very friendly and welcoming. Always greeted us with a smile and the willingness to help us. I have stayed at many of the Las Vegas hotel. This was the best stay I have had hands down.

reviews.title: We loved it.
reviews.text: Beautiful place very modern and luxurious.  Great specious rooms and well decorated. Incredible window view. Great service. Fancy restaurants. Luxurious stores.

reviews.title: Great atmosphere and food
reviews.text: Great atmosphere. Quieter than other parts of the strip which my wife and I appreciated. Quick taxi to center strip. Amazing food and drinks. Good casino. Would definitely recommend and would absolutely stay here again.

reviews.title: Beautiful Hote
reviews.text: Hotel is beautiful and rooms outstanding.I did not think food quality was the best for the price.Valet parking is 40.00 - a little excessve53.00 per night resort fee for any hotel will be the demise of Las Vegas

Attended for company conference which was held at same time as the NBA Summer League, so it was pretty busy. From the check-in to departure, the service was excellent. Lobby check-in agent took time to find me a room that I would like, and reviewed the location and floor. No issues with the room, very nice amenities, and very comfortable! Housekeeping cleaned just once as I don't want daily service. Excellent, clean and freshened room.  In - room dining team were professional and quick. Food was very good, and recommend the Crab and Corn bisque! Conference center was fantastic and the teams were very helpful. Overall, very happy with the location, and pool area looked fantastic though didn't have time for a dip.

reviews.title: Luxury is Back!
reviews.text: Beautiful ,classy well staffed. Every detail was carefully thought through. The Adult only pool area is a treasure. Excellent poolside bar service . Carefully curated beverages at the  bars, subtle security throughout. My only disdain was smoking areas in Casino if I was walking through to get coffee  or lunch.

reviews.title: FontaineBleau and Sphere
reviews.text: Certain rooms have the view of Sphere. On our way there, we saw the Sphere from the hotel's direction, so we asked the reception if there were any rooms facing the Sphere. She said yes and found a room facing the Sphere for us. It was such a plus for our stay.

reviews.title: Clean but over sized, and careful on bills
reviews.text: Check the bills as they overcharge fridge items, there were not breakfast and suitable dinning in the hotel area after 11 pm. Breakfast and pool closed at 7. Distance to elevator and lobby was a lot. Hotel was clean and brand new

reviews.title: Stressful
reviews.text: The persistent efforts by the security team to root out any potential loitering done by my son and his teammates (14 years old) was excessive. I can appreciate how serious gambling rules are about having minors on the casino floor, but even when they were on a different floor their goons went out of their way to make life miserable for the boys and me. Threatening to kick us out of the hotel (on the first night) and escorting the boys to their rooms and demanding to see my ID before releasing my son was beyond ridiculous. I’m the future the hotel should either make it clear that families are not welcome or at a minimum there should be a written policy about unattended minors and where they are allowed that should be provided when making a reservation and reiterated at check-in. I just can’t believe how stressful they made our 3 night vacation…Will definitely re-think where we go the next time we come to Vegas!

reviews.title: Great hotel and experience
reviews.text: The rooms are beautiful, clean, and have a high-end vibe without feeling over the top and a large bath tub you can sink into. We enjoyed the mini bar and variety of the room snacks.  Definitely one of the nicer spots I’ve stayed on the Strip.The restaurants didn’t disappoint either. Komodo and Papi Steak were both worth it, and even the food hall had solid options for a quick bite. The pool scene and LIV nightclub? Packed and full of energy — definitely Miami-style fun if that’s your thing.

reviews.title: Quiet, laid-back, and pristine.
reviews.text: I never stay this far north on the Strip; I'm often in the middle of the action, but staying in a newer resort was appealing and TripAdvisor offered me a Royal Suite at a deal I couldn't pass up.  I'm seeing lots of "Vegas is dead..." comments on social media.  No it isn't.  We were there for a Monday and Tuesday night; center Strip is a zoo.  Fontainebleau was quiet, though far from empty.  The pool was busy during all hours of the day.  The casino had plenty of players at all hours.  However, I love the atmosphere here.  I'm not in my 20s anymore and appreciate a resort that feels posh and relaxed.  Staff is at every entrance to keep trouble-makers at bay.  Elevator banks had additional staff to ensure you were supposed to be there.No parking fees made staying here an even easier decision and the garage made it very easy to navigate the property.  Very easy to get in and out of the resort, and being so far north on the Strip ensured traffic was never an issue.Get the room upgrade if you're able.  Our Royal Suite came with two full baths, my wife was very fond of the makeup counter in the master.  Two walk-in showers and a large soaking tub makes the room feel even more luxurious.  The water pressure was glorious.  Touch controls in bathrooms and next to the bed was also a very nice touch.  Our only dining experience here was breakfast at La Fontaine, which was very good.  We were seated immediately, though service was slow.  I will be coming back.  I do hope my next stay is as pleasant as the first.

reviews.title: Not a 5 Star Hotel
reviews.text: We were pretty excited walking in the door of the Fontainebleau hotel and just as disappointed walking out the door 2 days later.As other reviewers have noted, there are a lack of basic “amenities” offered.Should not have to walk 3 blocks to Walgreens because the hotel provides not even one freaking bottle of water in the room…..(unless you want to buy the big overpriced Fiji water via the room)Waited for turndown service that never came…..because there is none.Tried to go to the gym after dinner….closed at 7pm…..{Wow!}Went to Vida for breakfast for 2 mornings, first day excellent, second day eggs and turkey bacon came out ice cold.
