Everyone is thankful and appreciative that you are there and they let you know. Very clean hotel.  PLEASE keep it this way !!  We stay in lots of hotels ... usually under the Marriott umbrella.  The Fontainebleau has the best hotel beds and pillows we have ever had the pleasure of sleeping in.  I want to buy the mattress for our home.  We are Tempurpedic people but we actually love the mattress, pillows and the linens at this hotel.  We usually eat at Vida for brunch daily and the service and food there are good.  Ask for Aya !! She is a true gem.  We had dinner at Mother Wolf and it was good.  The cocktail we had was very nice.  The pasta is homemade but they were so busy our food came out lukewarm.  That was odd.  We live in Austin and have a lot of Italian restaurants that are better.  My husband says the hotel gym is very good especially for a hotel.  His only issue is he wishes it was open later -- it closes too early.  He likes to be able to work out at his convenience and that might be early or later.  This is an overall wonderful place to stay in Las Vegas.  It is at the end of the strip but we actually love that too.  Feels safer.  We will be back !!

reviews.title: Best hotel room I’ve stayed in
reviews.text: The rooms are a 10 out of 10. It’s just a beautiful room that was comfy linens are comfy. Everything about the room was a 10 out of 10. Everything was high tech, which was really cool. Bathtub was huge, check-in service was great. The bar, waitresses and pool bar waitresses not so friendly but maybe if you’re a man they will be. other than that it was a really beautiful hotel

reviews.title: Nice, but needs several fixes
reviews.text: Stayed here twice, I have some Pros and Cons:PROS:Location-some say its too far away from the main strip area; for me I lOVE this, away from the massive crowds around the Bellagio area. Woke up early Sunday morning, walked over to circus circus, got my Starbucks, and kept walking to Resorts World (very close and my favorite hotel in Las Vegas) and kept walking. Cheap mini-mart convenience store right across, and only a few miles from DTLV. And 1/2 mile walk to Bagelmania; what more can you ask for?Pool- Besides the terrible pool food (and ridiculously overpriced) its one of the best pools in LV hands down. Spacious, many areas and decent music. Free ice water dispensers everywhere too. You'll need it or be ready to cough up $40-50 for drinks.Gaming- I feel like I'm gambling in an airport or airplane hangar, but the game varieties have improved. They have only 1 single double deck table, but a couple tables with popular freebet 21 (called something else here I forgot) but easy to spot. $25 minimums were available throughout the day, and even $15 in mornings.Food- besides again, the awful pool food, Komodo and Chez Bon Bon are terrific (fancy Asian and 24hr pastries/snacks/drinks/gelato). Many other nice restaurants and a very nice food court with ample seating and a view of the casino floor.Free parking for all guests...this should be standard but most charge.CONS: Room bedsheets had stains, inexcusable. The mattress is easily the worst thing I've every slept in 50 years of my life, like a sinking marshmallow. However, rest of room clean and quiet.Pool food- As stated twice, worse quality than a gas station. Had the worst fries and chicken tenders in my life, couldnt eat after a few bites they were reheated garbage, disgusting and very overpriced. So, fix the beds, clean the sheets, serve non nuked food at the pool, and offer more double deck 21 and freebet tables. Also waaaay too many slots need more classic video poker machines with better payouts. Lots of open wasted empty space. Size is just waaay too big, and finally got the hang of the North/South parking garages...dizzying.

reviews.title: Would Recommend
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel/casino with excellent service, very friendly and helpful staff.  The Casino restaurants and bars are all unique and excellent, the hotel room was very modern and comfortable.  I was really impressed with the Casino staff at the hotel and restaurants, they were all really friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Fontainebleau is where it's at!
reviews.text: An absolutely incredible experience from beginning to end! Friendliest and most attentive staff anywhere on the strip! Beautiful rooms with comfortable beds and great water pressure in the shower. Highly recommend a massage and spa day. Mother Wolf is a standout in a huge lineup of great food.

reviews.title: Great experience.
reviews.text: Amazing place. A must in Vegas.Spacious, new, spotless, great people.Some of the words that we could use to describe our stay at Fontainbleau.The pools had had plenty of people but you still don’t feel overcrowded.Would go back again and agian.

reviews.title: Fontainbleau Resort Las Vegas Shines Like a Diamond
reviews.text: Excellent hotel. End of the strip. A somewhat hidden gem. It is actually a HUGE hotel and so glamorous and classy. Wonderful restaurants, shopping, pool, conference facilities, and rooms. I loved the room I had on a high floor. The view of the desert and mountains in the distance was magnificent. The staff at the hotel were all very customer-service oriented and professional. Great hotel, the Las Vegas twin of the Fontainbleau Miami Beach. Both are great properties and I recommend both. The Las Vegas property is actually newer, even nicer, and has a massive casino and so many cool bars, eateries, stores onsite. I could see people checking in for a weekend and not having to even leave the property!

reviews.title: Worst. Stay.
reviews.text: This is the worst stay ever. First, when I checked in, she had the wrong checkout date, which sent me into a panic attack, but when I checked the next morning, it was what I initially thought it was, not what she had told me. She must’ve been new. First two days I had my light on privacy and the housekeeping still came in and moved my pajamas to the dirty table. My curling iron was wrapped up. You’re not supposed to wrap curling irons up like that. I called them after the first day and told them I did not want them in there and they still came in the second day. I don’t know if there’s a miscommunication or what. Plus the privacy sign is very stupid and it looks like it’s a reflection of the exit sign right across from it so you really can’t tell Unless you put your hand over it that it’s on privacy. Like stop being fancy and just get a door sign that hangs over the door handle like normal. I also don’t like the bottles that the shampoo conditioner and body wash come in. It’s really hard to get the liquid out of those. I was also missing $40 worth of Starbucks gift cards when the housekeepers came in. I thought not to report because whatever it’s only $40. Now I’m thinking maybe I should’ve .  I called to let them know again. I do not want people in my room.Third day I couldn’t get in my room so then I went downstairs to reactivate my key. They reactivated it. Came upstairs. It did not work. Had housekeeping call Security. Security came his fab did not work either. They called engineering for the first time. Engineering came and to open the door fixed it or so we thought, the keys worked. I grabbed my stuff for work inside the room and left in a hurry to get to work.   I was late because all of the work computers were in the room and I couldn’t get in my room. After work come back to the room the key is still not working. They call engineering AGAIN.  Engineer comes up, supposedly fixes it, I have to leave to drop stuff for work off at a storage unit and drop my friend off at the airport. I get back. I talked to the front desk, she comes upstairs with me to make sure it works, it does NOT.  Again.  I have to go back downstairs and they obviously have to give me a new room because the door is broken. Shouldn’t maintenance check those doors and when the battery goes to 40% replace the battery for the door key? I have never had this issue in any hotel .  I get the new keys to the new room, but I Still have to wait on engineering to get in the room to get my stuff to then go to the new room. This was the THIRD time Waiting on engineering to get in my room.All they offered was to take off the resort fees. Shouldn’t I get a comped stay out of this in all the hassle I had to go through?  I tried but the lady Manager downstairs on June 4 was very snotty and catty and didn’t really give a crap.  I could tell when she was reacting to the hotel staff when the hotel staff was explaining what was happening with me in my room. I saw her roll her eyes. But then when I’m standing in front of her, she did not do that. Still is very upsetting.  Also, I have stayed here before in February and it was not this complicated though. I did have an issue also in February when they didn’t even know where to send me to pick up or drop off my Hertz Rent-A-Car. I feel like that is something the front desk should know.  They had no clue where I should park it to return it.Overall, a terrible experience. This is coming from someone who stays in hotel rooms all the time. I usually stay at Marriott and Hilton’s in Hyatt because of my status. But even when I did not have status, I’ve never had this many issues. I also do a lot on social media and cannot wait to make a TikTok/Reel about this.Apparently, the owner of this hotel is losing money and doesn’t care because he’s so rich. That is the rumor. It trickles down from the top!I check out tomorrow. We shall see how that goes.

reviews.title: Luxurious and Relaxing Experience
reviews.text: This resort is the epitome of luxury and comfort. The rooms are spacious, clean, and have incredible features even for the standard King Bleu rooms! The casino downstairs is lively enough to have a good time while maintaining an elegant feature. The restaurants are exquisite and you cannot skip Mother Wolf. The various wellness services offered are top knotch including IGK hair salon, IV drip (perfect to cure a hangover), and a beautiful looking spa. You won't ever regret staying here

reviews.title: Wonderful resort casino
reviews.text: Overall fantastic casino resort with a true resort feel. Enjoyed dining at Mother Wolf, The Tavern, and Washing Potato. Collins has fantastic artisan cocktails with friendly and fun bartenders. Also caught live music at No Where Bar with a band doing covers and standards.The fitness center is clean with many equipment choices. Pool is beautiful and kept at a great temperature.

reviews.title: Best Hotel and Casino on the strip
reviews.text: The best and newest hotel on the strip. It's light and bright, not dingy and dark.  Being from Florida I feel the Miami Beach influence.  The staff is 5 star from the moment you walk in the door. Even the standard room is bigger than most hotels upgrades.  The clientele is high end and classy sophisticated.   We are locals and go there often for dinner and events. Every restaurant there is excellent as well.   Best omkase on the strip in my opinion.  Views from the top floor as you enjoy the sushi

reviews.title: Great Casino
reviews.text: Fountainblau is an amazing Casino, beautiful spacious and everyone courteous and efficient. we enjoyed our stay immensely. The casino floor is very nice La Fountain restaurant is exceptional. The room was amazing great view. The check in very easy.

reviews.title: Class act!
reviews.text: Best Casino in Vegas from an experience and stay standpoint! Amenities are top notch, great restaurants and pool vibes. Lapis SPA is truly the best spa experience I have ever had. Rooms were really high class with great products in the bathroom.

reviews.title: New Hotel, Friendly Staff, Excellent food and a fun Casino
reviews.text: The bed was so comfy and the room amenities were outstanding.  Large soaking tub, robe etc.  I am use to staying at the Cosmo which is loud and Aria and the beds here were tops.  Place is beautiful We had the Beef Chow Fun at the Washing Potato I would Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Never leave the property!
reviews.text: This resort was everything one could ask for! The staff wanted to please at every turn. The rooms and facilities were beautiful and well maintained. The pools were numerous with chair-side food and drink service as well as bars nearby,  the workout facilities were very nice and well equipped. The restaurants food, service and variety were spectacular! I never left the property!

reviews.title: Amazing stay in Vegas at the best hotel
reviews.text: We love to stay at the Miami resort so we wanted to stay at the new Las Vegas hotel and it did not disappoint.  Just walk through other resorts in Vegas and you will appreciate Fountaineu Blue that much more.  Great atmosphere, great rooms and restaurants.

reviews.title: 1st experience and stay at Fontainebleau
reviews.text: I just checked out this morning (Monday 6-2,) after enjoying a long weekend visiting with family that live  in Henderson.  I have stayed at  several hotels on the strip and decided to stay here for the first time, and, the Fontainebleau is hands down now my favorite! I checked in on Friday 5-30 and a huge shoutout to Front Desk Agent, Delfa.  She was very friendly, professional , and answered many questions I had regarding the property.  I was upgraded to a suite on the 24th floor with an awesome view.  The room was spectacular.  Thank you Delfa for that great customer service!I will definitely be staying at the Fontainebleau on my next visit to Vegas!  What an amazing experience and a few of the other hotels on the strip need to step it up because the Fontainebleau has now set that bar pretty high.  Thanks again and I’m looking forward to my next stay.

reviews.title: A beautiful resort with many options
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, great room view of the city and sphere. Gorgeous room. Bed and pillows so comfortable! If I didn’t want to check out Vegas I’d stay in the bed all day! (Besides popping down to the pool!) Gaming available of course but we are not gamblers-but looked like others were having fun. Many different types of restaurants available. A decent variety of types and prices. Valets helpful with taxis, concierge helpful with suggestions when asked.

reviews.title: Amazing hotel!
reviews.text: Wow - this is my new favorite hotel in Las Vegas!  The property is stunning - just gorgeous!  We enjoyed Bar Collins, Bleau Bar and No Where and most of all Don's Steakhouse!  Do not skip on a cabana at the pool.  We were so well cared for by Ray, Deshawn and Chris.  Seriously - we had a day of heavenly relaxation.  The rooms are spacious and so beautiful!  Bathroom and amenities are top notch.  Can not wait to return!

reviews.title: BEST place to stay in Vegas!
reviews.text: We have traveled to Vegas MANY times and stayed at several different places, so we decided to give the Fontainebleau a try and we were SO HAPPY we did!! We arrived about 2 hours before their posted check in time and we had not requested an early check in, but that was no problem! We also requested a different room type and again, NO PROBLEM! We stayed in room 6261 and it was perfect! We had a GREAT view of The Sphere - which was so fun to sit in bed and watch it! The bed was comfortable and the room was spacious. I was so thankful for the refrigerated drawer so we never opened the mini bar. TIP: Walk across the street to the store by Circus Circus and get some drinks to fill your fridge and save some serious money! The bathroom was beautiful and the water pressure was seriously the BEST I have ever experienced at a hotel! We enjoyed meals at Capons (the burger was big enough to split between two of us and we shared the yummmmy truffle fries!). We ate the hot honey pepperoni pizza at Miami Slice (pricey - but hey, it's Vegas!), and guac and chips and an amazing chorizo & egg burrito that they serve all day at Roadside Taco. The pools were great and if you want a quieter scene, take an immediate left (after you grab some towels) and go to the adults only pool. You can't take any coolers or other drinks in the pool area (Even if other guests claim you can, they check bags at the door) but no one looks in bottles if you bring a drink inside of a closed bottle. There are water stations around - so it's nice to bring your own bottle to refill with water. It was a really great weekend at a beautiful hotel. Take a chance on the Fontainebleu! You won't regret it!

reviews.title: Another stellar visit
reviews.text: Another outstanding trip to the Fontainbleau. Have had the pleasure four times and was able to return over Memorial Day weekend with my teenage daughter. I was worried about the party scene, especially at the pool, but was pleasantly surprised how family friendly it was. Everything was great from check in to check out. We had a beautiful room on the 53rd floor with a downtown facing view. We celebrated her birthday with a dinner in Dons Prime which was also wonderful. As always the gambling was fine. Still hate that the blackjack tables pay 6:5, but was pleased to see affordable minimums even on the weekend. My only complaint was how slow the elevators were. I don’t think it could be helped because the place seemed very busy, but it took 10-15 minutes to get an elevator we could fit in while waiting on our floor. Already booked to return in August and can’t wait to return.

reviews.title: Fun pool day!
reviews.text: The pools at the Fontainebleau are fantastic -- we had a day pass to the resort and took advantage of a 100-degree day in Las Vegas. It's very laid-back vibe during the week but excellent service (check in with Javier, the bartender, and his crew).

reviews.title: amazing view
reviews.text: The hotel looks very impeccable, but in my room for the price I found some dusty and dirty objects like the tub ñ, I found some hairs, there was a toothpick forgotten on the floor, for the price you pay if I find it expensive, I got a room with an amazing view, I don't think it has a bad location, but if I would go back to that hotel, as far as the bed is very clean

reviews.title: Don’s Steakhouse
reviews.text: My family and I went to dinner at Don’s steakhouse and it was absolutely phenomenal! The weight staff didn’t miss a single beat. The entire dinner was a celebration of a special family event and they pulled out all the snoops. It was the most memorable experience than I’ve ever spent at any restaurant anywhere you are definitely coming back.

reviews.title: Fantastic but expensive
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau Las Vegas is an upscale, pleasant, friendly, and gorgeous new hotel.Staff was very friendly, pleasant, and professional throughout - from check-in, to room service, to restaurants, to poolside, to housekeeping, to checkout. A+ for staff and service.The room was very clean, a nice size, with attractive decor and useful furniture pieces. The bed was super comfortable and the shower was awesome! Great water pressure and heat. In fact, enjoying the water pressure of the shower was one of the small pleasures of the stay. A+ for the room.Main casino floor is gorgeous, with excellent ventilation. I hardly ever smelled any smoke though people were clearly smoking. They don’t have a poker room (which I would’ve liked), but seem to have everything else. Casino floor felt fun but also spacious and non-crowded. Rideshare areas are convenient and well-marked. A for the casino.Pool was also awesome, with a neat layout, and multiple pools. They even had a fun little movie night on Sunday where they played Top Gun on a screen. A for the pool. Got a couple strawberry daiquiris and they were really good, albeit expensive ($24 for one 12oz). And I think the cheapest beer was like $9?Which brings me to the only real drawback about Fontainebleau -  ALL food and drinks are expensive. They have a food court, but it’s upscale and pricey too. Want a quick couple slices of pizza and a bottled water? That’ll be $34. Chicken sandwich, fries, and a coke? $46. And I’m just talking about the food court. The little grab and go coffee shop was also the same. Ate a single meal in the sportsbook and got room service one night - both those meals were $70-some dollars. The food tastes good, but make your peace ahead of time with the fact that it’s all very expensive. So B for food options.I could afford it and was OK with it. And I know it’s Las Vegas, but it was honestly still kinda exhausting after 2.5 days to have no escape from the high food prices. So for this reason, for me, the value proposition overall wasn’t quite there to give them a full five stars. But if they’d mixed in a few low-cost options, I would have easily given them five stars. If anyone from the hotel is reads this, if you would consider adding just a few  lower-cost options (maybe 1 restaurant, one coffee shop, and one low-cost alcoholic drink at the pool), that’d go a long way towards making the stay more comfortable. I’d still eat in one of the more expensive restaurants, but giving us the ability to mix it up would be greatly appreciated.That said, overall I had a great stay and really enjoyed the Fontainebleau. I’d consider staying here again. And btw FLV, Resorts World, and Encore/Wynn, there seems to now be a critical mass of good stays, eats, and shopping in this northern end of the strip - another plus. It’s also walking distance to The Peppermill.So if you want an upsacle, gorgeous, friendly and fun experience, Fontainebleau Las Vegas is a great option!

reviews.title: Roland & Debbie 33rd wedding anniversary at Fontainebleau
reviews.text: 1st time stay at Fontainebleau.  Yes, we will visit this resort again! Outstanding Pool Deck. Gaming area was clean. Plenty of professional and friendly staff throughout the resort.  Parking was easy.  Access to our room was easy.  Plenty of dinning options throughout the resort.  Room was clean with a great view of both the mountains and the Las Vegas Strip.

reviews.title: Great option with modern amenities
reviews.text: Was at the property for a corporate event. Everything was managed well except that my room was not ready when I arrived around 3:30 PM. They took my mobile number and texted when it was ready which took couple of hours. The room that was eventually allocated was on the 70th with great views. Their housekeeping team does a great job, food at the event and the one meal we had at one of the restaurants were all nice. The staff was well trained and were polite & helpful.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Highest quality resort in Vegas.  Will not stay anywhere else!  Room was outstanding.  Best showers ever!  Resort not crowded.  Super luxurious and not expensive for what you get.   Komodo restaurant is an awesome experience!  We stayed at another resort for part of our visit to Vegas and are so disappointed that we didn’t stay at Fountain Blue the entire time.

reviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas.
reviews.text: This place is amazing. Clean, organized and the staff so accommodating. The lobby is beautiful. Checking was a breeze. The staff was so caring and amazing. The room was spacious and clean. The bathroom was huge. I will certainly come back.Bye Bye Resort World

reviews.title: Cheap Service !!
reviews.text: Worst experience. We booked 3 month in advance we asked for a higher floor since we have an infant. They gave us the lowest floor. So it was noisy all night and smell vigarettes, we talked to a manager she did not care. We had to leave and go to the wynn where we usually go. Wynn made our stay better and even upgraded us to a suite when they heard our experience about fontainebleau. You can build luxury but it s not easy to provide a luxurious service!! Staff needs hospitality management classes

reviews.title: Such a shame !
reviews.text: It’s such a shame about this hotel. The hotel itself is beautiful and the casino is nice. The Housekeeping is a disgrace, stay a second time here and encountered the same issues, unclean room and very poor housekeeping, on this occasion they could not move us due to the hotel being full. The room had long black hairs all over the bathroom, mouldy taco of some sort in the chilling drawer, which housing keeping came to remove and did not bother cleaning the sauce from the chill drawer. No cotton wool in the vanity pot and toiletries were very limited. This hotel is supposed to be 5 star and clearly isn’t in terms of cleanliness, get this sorted Fontainebleau!!

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau is really a gorgeous and immaculate resort-casino. The staff was incredible from the minute I pulled up to the valet,  till the end of my stay.  Everyone was so helpful and inviting. It's hard to explain but the energy that the Fotainebleau radiated was wonderful. The food was excellent and I highly recommend the Hangover Hamburger at the Tavern in the Sports Book.. I highly suggest bringing your workout clothes and taking advantage of their excellent fitness center. Afterward, be sure to relax beside one of their many crystal-clear pools.My stay was well worth every minute spent there, and I honestly didn't want to leave.

reviews.title: Fontainebleau 4 U!-YES!
reviews.text: The FontaineBleau-from the moment you exit your vehicle.   To the moment you walk into your style of room.   You will find Elegance.  This New Hotel is special.   They did not skimp on service for their Guest.   A MUST Stay.   Oh!  And remember to visit Chez Bon-for breakfast, and adore their BowTie Croissant.

reviews.title: Great Hotel, worth every penny
reviews.text: The feeling I got when entering my room is priceless! Just gorgeous, innovative and comfortable. The hotel is pricey, but it is worth every penny. The hotel is new and exudes elegance which creates such a great experiences.My favorite restaurant is la fontaine, exquisite, fresh and delicious.

reviews.title: Hooked!
reviews.text: This was probably the best Vegas resort i've ever stayed. The purpose of my trip was just for relaxation. The rooms are immaculate, a beautiful shower and gigantic bathtub. Pool deck has enough chairs & umbrellas for everyone.  I'll be back!

reviews.title: Very nice hotel with a confusing layout, but good amenities.
reviews.text: The hotel is one of the nicest in Vegas, some good dining options and generally comfortable. We always enjoy Don's Prime, but the pool needs some better options. We had issues with cleanliness, although after a few calls management stepped in to help.

reviews.title: Most Underrated Hotel of 2025
reviews.text: Amazing hotel. Fresh and clean lobby. Bars are well established and plenty of options to hang out with people to talk and drink. Komodo restaurant is a must. Great vibes and amazing food. They have a very friendly team of staffs and the restaurants is surrounded with gorgeous aesthetics.

reviews.title: Couple with a twist
reviews.text: Like this place very clean elegant this time around it felt more populated and a more lively atmosphere than our last visit. I feel the rewards actually feel like your getting something Wish they had a bar that would have a DJ and would turn into a little club type of feel

reviews.title: A Must!
reviews.text: Everything about this hotel and property far exceeded my expectations. From the thoughtful design details throughout to the incredible dining options and standout restaurants, every aspect was exceptional. Most impressive of all was the outstanding team that runs the property — warm, professional, and attentive. This is officially my new go-to spot in Las Vegas. I enjoyed it so much, I’m now tempted to plan a trip to their Miami location.

reviews.title: Probably won’t go again
reviews.text: I had pre-booked this stay with a travel agent. It was prepaid in full with American Airlines vacations,. Michael at the desk wanted me to pay another $800, I refused and said I’ve already paid for this and showed him proof. he told me that he didn’t even have me down as a confirmed reservation (which is incorrect because I had previously called to verify the reservation on file ). I had given him my card to run for incidentals, but instead he had already ran my card without my authorization for the full amount. I refused to sign his document authorizing the charge because I didn’t authorize it. After Michael spent some time discussing on the phone with someone, it was determined that the Fontainebleau did not have my payment and they blamed it on American Airlines vacations. They did nothing to help resolve the issue. I had to go call American Airlines vacations and have a conversation for 30 minutes before I was able to come back to the desk and check in. They then had my payment (suddenly after AAV called). When I asked if this happens a lot, I was told that sometimes reservations come in without all the information and when that happens, they create a new one with the information they have. A female that finally checked me in advised me that they had me at the very end of the hallway and she asked if I would rather be closer to the elevator, I said yes, I would like that very much as we plan to be walking quite a bit up and down the strip. So she said she would change it to a room closer to the elevator. As we finally found the set of elevators, we need to take because no one told us there were three sets of elevators for different floors, and we get to our floor and found our room was at the very end of the hallway we couldn’t have been further away from the elevator, which is completely fine, but she shouldn’t have asked me if I wanted to change if she didn’t intend to change my room at all. I find this all to be ridiculous. I later had to deal with receiving a refund as I had already been charged the $800 that I did not authorize. reviews.title: Great Experience at Fountainebleau
reviews.text: What a beautiful resort! The pool is a hot spot and there are plenty of bars to keep the cocktails flowing. They also have some great shopping, wonderful gaming and the rooms are top notch.  I also like that it's not overly crowded in the casino, but the LIV night club is on point.

reviews.title: Not a luxury Property -- One and DONE!
reviews.text: Listen, it's just not a great property.  So sorry to provide negative feedback, but it's just the truth.  There are dozens of options in Las Vegas that offer better amenities, location, convenience, dining options, and certainly better trained and friendlier staff.  We had multiple rooms for 3 or 4 days in May 2025. The breakfast options are awful; service at Vida was unacceptable, we had to speak to the manager twice.  They had a 20 minute wait with more than 60% of the tables empty, probably because they were understaffed.  All the King Blue Suite rooms are most proximate to the elevators, if you want a quiet room it can only be a double queen.  But wait, 100% of the Suites are only King bed rooms.  They do not have Suites with double queens.   The light controls in the room are impossible to read, they are not internally lit, so not possible to use them in the dark.  turning off the lights also turns off the bathroom night light, thats really stupid.  The worst is the beds have a platform that has a wider footprint than the mattress so its very easy to misjudge the space needed to walk around the bed, I smashed my foot several times on the platform and so did several people in my party.  There is no Poker Room.  The convenience store is atrocious and opens late.  The Gym is amazing, I'll give them that.  I know running a luxury hotel in las vegas is probably one of the most challenging businesses one could imagine; but your ownership group elected to do it, so they knew what they were getting into.  I cannot recommend this hotel, and Fontainebleau will NEVER be on my list of places to stay.

reviews.title: Overall a great experience
reviews.text: On the one hand, the property is stunning! The staff are very attentive and do what they can to help with issues that might arise. We had a room key malfunction and had to change rooms. There was a mix-up, and everyone tried their best to help resolve it. Overall, the rooms, views, and location are great. On the other hand, the lack of in room coffee and the cost of food options is a bit of a negative. The layout is really odd from the front desk to your rooms feel disjointed. The best part of our stay was the pool! Excelent staff, excellent pitchers, of drinks and a fantastic cabana..$10 beers in a bucket... We were able to use a large cabana all day and only paid the food and drink  minimum of $500. For 4 people, we found it well worth the cost. Food is expensive, and the pervibsil $26 chips and dip are not a great value. We like the seclusion of the property and took taxis to anything relatively easy. I noticed the gap between Ride share and taxis is narrowed.

reviews.title: Fontainebleau Hotel Review
reviews.text: Review of Fontainebleau Hotel, Las VegasThe Fontainebleau Hotel in Las Vegas offers a mixed experience that may or may not suit all travellers. On the positive side, the rooms are spacious and well-maintained, featuring clean interiors, comfortable beds and pillows, and a good-quality shower—ideal for a relaxing rest after a long day in the city.However, the hotel itself is vast and somewhat impersonal, lacking the charm or character that some travellers might prefer. While it is technically located on the Strip, it sits toward the northern end, making it roughly a 20-minute walk to more central attractions such as the Venetian Hotel.There are a few practical inconveniences to note. Rooms do not include tea or coffee-making facilities, which can be an issue for guests who prefer a hot drink in the morning. Housekeeping services appear to be inconsistent, with some guests reporting missed cleanings or delays. Additionally, the soundproofing in the rooms is subpar, allowing noise from neighbouring rooms and hallways to filter through. Another aspect that may not appeal to all is the very relaxed dress code—guests wear a wide range of attire, or sometimes very little of it.Be prepared for an added cost, as the hotel charges a city tax of over $50 per night, excluding tax, which can significantly increase the final bill.In summary, while the Fontainebleau offers clean, comfortable accommodations with generous room sizes, the lack of certain in-room amenities and the overall impersonal atmosphere may not justify the price for some travellers. Personally, I would not choose to stay here again.

reviews.title: Give Fontainebleau a try - you won’t be disappointed!
reviews.text: I’ve stayed at many properties on the strip and will definitely return to the Fontainebleau. Spent most of our time eating and drinking on property as there was no need to leave. The hotel is simply beautiful.  Even though it’s at the north end, it is accessible. Stayed in 5839 and had a perfect view of the sphere!  Immaculately clean room.  Value was good but depends on the day. Fun to watch at night. LIV Beach Club was on that side and the music was bumping til the wee hours of the morning but it was fine. Every single staff member we encountered was helpful and nice. The Lapsis Spa was first rate and the massage was the best I have ever had in my lifetime. The pool area is beautiful but get there early as they don’t police people reserving chairs with towels and leaving. Mother Wolf (shoutout to Joey) is one of my favorite restaurants on the strip. Had another great experience. Will be back soon Fontainebleau. Hoping to book a suite next time.

10/10! This resort is beautiful. I’m not sure why it would have low reviews.  Everything was exceptional. Friendly attentive staff and extremely clean. The food and drink price were totally on par for a Vegas resort. Everything we ate was spectacular! Mother Wolf will be one of my favorite places forever! We will be back!

reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: Excellent service, from check in to check out. Brand new hotel. Room has nice amenities, a great bed with several fluffy pillows, and a steamer for the wrinkled clothes. Plenty of restaurants and shops, nice gym and a great pool! I will certainly be back!

reviews.title: Fountainebleau - the best value 5* on the Strip
reviews.text: Returned to Vegas for the 7th time at the beginning of May 2025. Decided to try the new luxury hotel on the block, Fountainebleau, after visiting the previous year, just after the opening. Situated at the north end of the strip, the hotel and casino floor were a lot calmer than mid-strip properties, but still carried a lively atmosphere in the evenings. Navigating the strip wasn’t a problem as the famous Deuce bus stops right outside ($20 for 3 day unlimited travel ticket) . Other than this, Uber rides were less than $10 - 2 x on-site Uber pick-up points, North and South. Always use North as this is where drivers go. Our stay started on a positive note when we requested and were granted a high room (58th floor) with a Sphere view - always helps flying into Vegas on a Sunday night, when weekend visitors are clearing out and going back home. More rooms likely to be available. Rewarded check-in staff with decent tip - everyone happy. Room was great - very spacious - everything new - remote controls for drapes/sheers/lights etc. - plenty of power/charging points. Floor to ceiling  view was spectacular - best we have had in Vegas. The Sphere at night is something else! Bed was massive and so comfortable - made up every day of our stay. Fridge space provided (very useful) but no kettle, so pack a travel kettle for early morning coffee, rather than waste 30 mins treking thru hotel to fetch from Chez Bon Bon cafe. Bathroom was excellent. Huge bath, separate shower and toilet room, 2 x wash basins - good water pressure in bath and shower, but taps in basins not brilliant. Plentiful lotions/potions supplied whenever needed, towels changed daily. Service staff were all very welcoming and polite, without exception - a credit to the hotel. Plenty of food options on-site, covering all budgets. Chez Bon Bon cafe very good for hot/cold drinks, pastries, breakfast bites etc etc or Denny’s just down the road. Food court not massive, but useful for a quick snack - pizza, taco’s, burgers all good. Pool complex really good. - 6 different pools. Plenty of beds (with brollies)  available, in full sunlight all day (unlike Venetian!). Poolside Drinks/food service very good + choice of bars to use if shade needed for a while or a sudden urge to play cards/gamble takes you. As you would imagine, everything very clean and maintained immaculately. Gym was very impressive - didn’t use though - on holiday!  Casino floor very impressive and spacious. All the usual slots games that you would expect to see. Table limits were $15 upwards. Quieter during the day, but good atmosphere in the evening, especially in the huge centre bar. Overall, couldn’t fault Fountainebleau - brilliant holiday - everything delivered to 5* standard. Priced very competitively when compared to Wynn/Encoe, Belagio, Venetian/Palazzo,  Cosmo - excellent value for money.

reviews.title: Dirty towels
reviews.text: The hotel was very clean and the room was very clean. Although I had a bad experience regarding the cleaning of the room since when I arrived I found the towels very dirty, I called house keeping they did not answer me and I had to call the reception where they also did not solve me.

reviews.title: Anniversary Trip, First Timers
reviews.text: Got a nice package deal from United for three nights including air fare and a $100 meal voucher for our anniversary. Check in and out was easy, room was very nice with mountain view and the hotel food and gambling was on par with nicer casinos on the strip.

reviews.title: Pretty hotel, bad housekeeping.
reviews.text: Housekeeping was less than satisfactory. Staff was indifferent to the errors they made. Once the door was open when we got back in the evening. When we called housekeeping, instead of apologizing she said if nothing is missing it’s all good. We were not told that water was free in the ice room. Paid 48 dollars for water during our stay.

reviews.title: Dream Vegas
reviews.text: Perfect stay, beautiful fixtures and design, excellent service, superb dinning, comfortable and entertaining. Will return to this resort because most places won’t compare. Felt like the old Vegas, lots of happenings and people enjoying their stay.

reviews.title: Great staff!
reviews.text: This is a great resort with an exceptional staff. I had so many great experiences but must point out a few that were exceptional. Phil T., Casino Host, is great, Kimia Khorshidi from Registration was wonderful, Layla from Rewards was so nice and so helpful, Maria Ramirez of Guest Services was fantastic, Kevin from Fontainebleau Express was outstanding and Anaiya S. from Morris & Co was just lovely. Great rooms and great restaurants - but they could definitely use a 24 hour sit down restaurant. The casino is very nice - it’s spacious and comfortable. I just wish they would play more of a variety and better music and also turn up the ac because it tends to be on the warm side. Overall I had a very nice time and will be returning again in the near future.

reviews.title: What a waste!!!!
reviews.text: It was my 3rd and while I found this hotel to be one of the 3 best in the city, I had an experience that gave me the real picture.As long as you don't have a problem, everything seems to be an establishment to recommend, despite some small defects (poor location, a poorly thought out and often dysfunctional computer site, ...). Nothing serious to have a good stay.Unfortunately, during my last stay, things got so bad that I left my room in the middle of the night. I had a room on the upper floors with a view of the STRIP. At first glance, the perfect room. Except you're also on the side of the nightclub. As it was impossible to sleep, I went to the reception to see if it would not be possible to move to the other side of the hotel.Very nicely the receptionist tells me that there are only 2 bed rooms left, but she just needs to ask her hierarchy for approval. It was from that moment that everything went wrong because for some unknown reason she told me that the manager did not accept my request and that all he could do was allow me a checkout at 1pm instead of 11am and provide me with quiescent balls. I thought I was dreaming. Already in a low-end hotel, I would find it more than limiting, but with rooms over $300/night, it was carelessly insulting. Not being able to sleep anyway, I decided to pack my bags and leave this hotel immediately. I took the opportunity to pay my bill and cancel more than $3,000 of reservations for a planned stay at the end of the year. Seeing the reaction, I have the impression that they do not care about this decision and prefer docile customers who pay without ever complaining. I would point out that the manager never came to explain his choice and I received no apology. I felt that guests at this property should be happy to be chosen as hosts. I travel between 4 and 6 months a year and I have never seen such sufficiency, rogance. But I wasn't at the end of my surprises. Indeed, in the early morning, for security, I check if the checkout had been recorded and there I notice that it was not the case and that they had billed the night that I had not stayed at their house. While still in town, I decided to go there to settle this incident definitively and I was hoping to finally meet another Manager. I thought the former had crossed certain lines and that I would finally be entitled to an apology.I did not know the "culture" of this hotel and on the contrary I was the "bad" guest again. For the refund of the night, I had to fight because for them, if the computer system counts, it is difficult to go against their procedure. After long minutes of talking, the last night's payment was cancelled and I managed to "snatch" an apology. Neither sincere nor commercial, but they found that to get me out of the hotel you had to make a little effort. Either they are very rich and their arrogance allows them not to respect the customers, or they have great financial difficulties and you have to take all the money that customers bring without any flexibility. For me, Mass was said and I would never stay in this hotel again. It is possible that this message will receive a response from a formatted apology, but as I did not feel any humanity when I was here, I will allow myself to doubt the sincerity of these.For me, it's a complete waste because I was gradually building up my budget to stay in this hotel. The rooms are beautiful and very clean. In some departments, the staff do a good job and are always very polite.However, I think they have a big problem with middle managers. Either they have incredible pressure to achieve goals that are difficult to achieve or they are totally inconvergent in their business.If the customer is not treated well, I imagine it must be a dream to work there!!

reviews.title: Excellent place for a family trip, couples trip or bachelor party
reviews.text: This resort keeps getting better and better! The service and accommodations have tremendously improved. I have been here for grand opening with my family, a couples trip with my partner and a bachelor party for 17 guys and all the experiences were amazing and with the vast differences in groups- everything was accommodated. I highly recommend FB Las Vegas and have been to all the resorts in Vegas and can confidently say it’s becoming the best new spot in Vegas.

reviews.title: You won't get the Blue's at Fontainebleau!
reviews.text: Fontainebleau is 18 month new hotel, casino and resort.  What an incredible experience.  You can understand how a newer hotel is better laid out.  Make the Ballagio look dated!  The 6 pools with chairs, daybeds and cabana's were located on the 3rd floor easily accessible to the elevators.  Don't have to prance through the casino half naked in your bathing suits.  The food was incredible, recommend Don's.  Even the owner goes there.  They had a 24-hour french cafe that was nice, the promenade had more causal dining.  Well laid out.   The spa is second to none.  Will be going back.  Highly recommend

reviews.title: Celebrating Our 1st Anniversary
reviews.text: We got engaged in 2024 at the airport on our way to Las Vegas, so this year, to celebrate our 1st anniversary, we decided to splurge and enjoy a few days at the Fountainebleau. It was perfection and flawless, from check-in to the suite, room service, and a memorable anniversary dinner at Don's Prime. Highly recommend for any occasion!

reviews.title: Nightmare check-in experience
reviews.text: My friends and I booked three rooms for our stay, and unfortunately, the check-in experience was extremely disappointing. Two of the rooms had serious issues.One room had not been cleaned at all—it was left in an unacceptable state with dirty towels and trash throughout. My friends in that room had to wait over two hours before a manager was finally able to provide them with a new room.In another case, the front desk issued the wrong key three separate times. My friends staying in that room were forced to repeatedly walk back and forth through the hotel and casino, only to eventually be placed in an ADA-accessible room they did not book.The entire process was chaotic, frustrating, and far below the standard we expected. I’ve never had a worse check-in experience at any hotel.

reviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: The best resort in Vegas. Rooms are impeccable, gorgeous decor and very clean. Hotel is not smoky, bright and fresh smelling overall. Lots of dining options and several pools to choose from. Have stayed at other luxury hotels on strip (Four Seasons, Wynn) and FB would be my first choice!

reviews.title: Amazing hotel, wish location was better.
reviews.text: An amazing new hotel in Vegas, lovely casino, room was amazing. Only thing that let's it down is the location, it's just a bit far to walk to & from everyday if you're heading up the strip. But if you've been to Vegas before you'll know this & you can catch the bus ir taxi if need be.Would definitely stay here again when I'm back in Vegas, free parking which was a bonus too!

reviews.title: Top notch
reviews.text: Top notch...my wife and I enjoyed it.  Everything from the spa, gym, casino, and rooms were elegant, clean and new.  Check in was a breeze, the spa and restaurants were able to accommodate us last minute.  Staff was professional and polite.  Looking forward to our next stay.

reviews.title: Lovely place
reviews.text: Loved it.  I will be back as soon as possible.  The staff was great, the place was so clean and the restaurants were uncreditable.  I had a weekend with my family and we will go back again this moth. So many memories, what happened there never happened

reviews.title: An A-plus ultra hotel and casino.
reviews.text: A beautiful hotel with a helpful and pleasant staff. Our room was spotless. Common areas were spotless also. Great food choices too! The hotel was very easy to navigate. The casino was player friendly with an open and airy vibe. The artwork throughout the hotel and casino was amazing. After a long, cold Midwestern winter this visit to the Fontainebleau was the realization of a dream. My new favorite hotel in Vegas. Thank you.

reviews.title: Family trip with 90 year old mom!
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau hotel experience was flawless, especially with the need for accessible services. We pretty much stayed at the hotel exclusively and leaned hard into many of the offerings. From the viewpoint of making things not just easy, but enjoyable for a person needing extra services, they excelled. I used their concierge to request things like an accessible adjoining suite and room, airport transportation, mini fridge, and microwave. Everything was set up in the room at check in. We had an accessible mountain/strip view suite and adjoining room on the 53 floor. (Caveat: a lot of the strip view was of Circus Circus and Resort World, but you could also see the Sphere!)We loved the suite for a central gathering point for our group. Dinner first night was at The Tavern - no complaints there and we caught some of the NBA playoffs. Tuesday we had a cabana booked in the 21+ area poolside for the day. Absolutely great service, food and beverage. It was a windy day so we had that pool mostly to ourselves.  We were concerned we couldn’t hit the $600 minimum spend but that fear was unfounded! Tax and tip was an additional $150 for those that want to know these things. Dinner was at Korean BBQ KYU at Fontainebleau. We took our servers suggestions and ordered family style so tried a good percent of the menu. It was a terrific experience - drinks, wine, meal and service.  Approx $100 pp inc tax and tip. We spent Wednesday at the Fontainebleau pool again, sans cabana, and had lunch poolside. Definitely busier but it was easy to find places to accommodate our group. I would absolutely recommend this resort property!

reviews.title: Great property let down by housekeeping.
reviews.text: Great room and facilities, friendly staff, enjoyable casino, but poor cleaning -  a condom wrapper by the side of one of the beds was reported and resolved with a $50 F&B credit, but then the resulting condom was found by the side of the other bed afterwards. If I'm honest, not a great start to the trip.

reviews.title: Discriminatory Treatment of Disabled Guests at WWE Event
reviews.text: I attended the WWE event at Fontainebleau and had purchased designated wheelchair-accessible seating along with a companion seat. Upon arrival, we were shocked to be directed to sit in the aisle walkway, as our allocated seats had been covered—apparently to make the venue appear full on the telecast. My son remained in his wheelchair, while I was given a dining chair to sit on.Due to back pain, I moved to an adjacent empty lounge chair, which remained unoccupied throughout the show. A staff member then approached, yelling at me to return to my seat. I explained that my seat had been covered and was inaccessible. I was told the lounge chairs were for VIPs only, despite them remaining empty. Another attendant also insisted I move. I refused until we were provided the seating we paid for.I lodged a complaint with Guest Services, as this experience felt discriminatory and disrespectful. I was promised follow-up from Dakota in Customer Service, but no one ever contacted me. Both the venue and event organiser passed blame. The treatment we received—particularly as guests with accessibility needs—was unacceptable and deeply disappointing.

reviews.title: very nice hotel
reviews.text: very nice resort a bit far from the strip brand new roomdon s restaurant was excellent la fontaine not so good the chef who has been working wth big namedoesnt bring for myself anything special for this restaurant but the service was good  the food so so

reviews.title: May 2025
reviews.text: The floor service was lacking. The selection of machines were fine. It's a large casino so you have plenty of room. The perfume sometimes will drug you crazy. The employees did seem like to like to stand around and talk to each other really hated to bother them

reviews.title: New Vegas
reviews.text: i let the front desk upsell me, so i had a great room with fun views. The best touch was that upon request they put a humidifer in my room AND included distilled water for it. Room was clean and service was unobtrusive. Felt very different from the old-line Vegas hotels. Somewhat not central but worked fine. The BEST pizza downstairs in the Italian restaurant. The large pool wasn't open when we were there in late Nov because they were transitioning to winter setup.

reviews.title: Great for a relaxing family retreat!
reviews.text: Fountainbleau was exceptional! From their staff (Kira Lee - Oasis Pool Deck), clean and well kept rooms, outstanding amenities and great selection of food places! I would definitely come back and refer this place to my family and friends!

reviews.title: 10/10 experience- we will be back
reviews.text: I was a little apprehensive about booking here due to the mixed reviews. I can honestly say this hotel exceeded expectations. From the moment your walk in, it’s clean, modern and every encounter was extremely positive. No queue on check in, we upgraded our room to a royal suite with great strip view from a standard pool view which I’m very glad we did. The rooms are stunning. The personal fridge is a fantastic touch. The royal suite was beautiful and no complaints. We had great housekeeping & turn down service every evening. The food options were great, the only downside to the food court is that is closed at 10pm during the week. We landed and got to the hotel hungry at 10pm and everything was closed. Chez Bon Bon is open 24 hour which helped but is more of a coffee shop. We tried Miami slice, washing potato & the food by the pool during our stay and all were great. The poolside food etc wasn’t actually bad value as portions were big. Miami slice was incredible so is a must. The drinks service on the casino floor can be very slow, one night we never got offered a drink when gambling for 2/3 hours and hardly saw cocktail waitresses. It was down to luck and where you’re sat. The tables always had drinks service so if you’re at a table you’ll get drinks. There are lots of staff cleaning to casino space but suggest they add more cocktail waitresses. That’s the only downfall on the casino floor. When we gambled earlier in the day it was better for drinks naturally. Also positive note- the casino wasn’t very Smokey. I struggled with the smell in all the other casinos bar this one. So if you’re a non smoker this hotel is great. Craig at the sports bar was one of the best members of staff we encountered. He was excellent and very good at his job. Pool staff great, very attentive. Always were beds around the pool, although very busy on some days. We went to the over 21 section where there were always spare beds and still great service. This pool is also a million times nicer than any other hotel we’ve stayed in vegas. This hotel blows all the other hotels out the water in my opinion. It’s a little quieter being new which actually was really enjoyable. That being said it was still vibey. The other hotels in vegas feel old and run down to me now. The bleau bar was packed in the evenings giving some good vibes on the casino floor. The music was really good also giving a nice touch. I am extremely fussy with hotels and this hotel was genuinely 10/10. I have no idea how it has bad reviews. If you’re considering this hotel, book it. It’s a short walk to wynn (10 mins), Lyft or Uber to centre strip $12-18.  We will return very soon! Thanks to all the staff for making our trip incredible.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: By the bar is a machine that SAYS 10centsI put a one hundred dollar bill inPlayed the full amount on the button It took my $100 in two try’sI called the floor manager overHe AGREED I put $100  in AFTER OPENING THE MACHINE BUT IF YOU PLAY ALL LINES ON A 10Cents machine It is $50 a throw SCAM I WILL NEVER BET THERE AGAINBE VERY CAREFUL!!!!Never again

reviews.title: Conference in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Amazing Hotel, at walking distance from the Strip with outstanding rooms and services. Conferences room's are fully equipped. If you have any spare time you can enjoy pool or the club during night. Great offer of food is also present. Brand new Spa and everything with a  great crew always ready to help.

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: My husband and I went to Vegas for our 30th Wedding Anniversary and stayed at Fontainebleau. We could not be more pleased with our stay. The staff was super friendly, happy and helpful. The hotel is so beautiful and clean. I loved all the options available for restaurants. We ate at Komodo's and the food and service was top notch. We spent the day at the pools which were very clean and saw Pitfall at the theater on the property in the evening. I would highly recommend this hotel and can't wait to go back.

reviews.title: Another exquisite time at the Fontainebleau
reviews.text: Our third visit to the Fontainebleau. Just as lovely and enjoyable as previous trips. The Fontainebleau is a stunningly beautiful property with exceptional service and amenities. The Lapis Spa is a must-try for anyone new to the Fontainebleau and be sure to time your spa services to catch the breathwork/contrast therapy session in the Aufguss event sauna.  We invited a group of 20ish friends to join us this time and had a wonderful trip.

reviews.title: Book it! You won’t regret it.
reviews.text: Classy, clean, and great amenities! Fantastic pool and didn’t have to fight for chairs r or deal with people “reserving” chairs in absentia with towels. Mother Wolf on premises is a wonderful restaurant! There is also a great selection of casual offerings in a food court area on the mezzanine level called the Promenade.

reviews.title: Not bleau anymore
reviews.text: The whole experience was amazing. Great rooms, excellent service and outstanding food and drinks. Hit the Collin’s bar, it’s an often overlooked spot but Alex the bartender was great! Don’a steakhouse was fantastic and the pool service was fantastic.

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Everything was perfect. Even it's a huge hotel, all services work ok and on time. We were a group of 8 friends at a golf trip around LV, and Fontainebleau exceeded all our expectations. In house restaurantes are great and you have a very good variety of food to choose. A special mention for the gym, it was the best I visited in my whole life. I will repeat it again soon.

reviews.title: Beautiful property; bad location
reviews.text: We wanted to stay at this brand new property and we were excited for it after seeing LOVE with Kelly & Mark filming from this property last Spring. Typically we stay at the far south end at Mandalay Bay, so going into it we did know that it was not located in the best area of the strip. The property itself is very nice. The room was comfortable with nice bedding and towels. However, the room was smaller size and not as plush than our previous visits to Mandalay Bay and Encore. Every member of the staff that we spoke with from check-in to bellman to restaurant staff was very kind and professional and willingly helpful. Because we did have one issue, the employee at check out was so kind to drop the resort fees off our room charges without me even asking. That shows a well trained customer service employee. The biggest disappointment for us was walking past the disgusting area adjacent to the hotel every time we came and went. We found that Vegas as a whole has changed significantly in a negative way. It has become more dirty on the streets than it ever has been and people are out there smoking marijuana every place you walk outside. Unfortunately, after being annual visitors up till 2019, we most likely will never return. However, we are happy that we did get to enjoy a nice brand new Vegas hotel property.

reviews.title: First class!
reviews.text: I’ve stayed at my fair share of nice hotels but Fontainebleau might be my best experience ever. I was lucky to have an executive suite and am really impressed with how highend everything was built, the 5 star service with attention to detail and how clean everything was.The beds really stand out as do the restaurants there (Komodo has the best spicy edamame)The turndown service was 12/10 and valet / bell hops really took care of my group Fast Lane Drive. Really really impressive and worthy of this review Shout out to Bianca for helping our room block, Wes at LIV and both managers of the bellmen and valet. First class!

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Amazing 🤩 What can I say stunning , beautiful, well thought out, tasteful and modern.Shop fronts lovely just for the rich however lol.Casino not Smokey and gastly like others.Negatives. Conference delegates should be seperate from paying guests as so many of them.No facilities in room like a kettle with no free drinks or sun-dried like other hotels. Also spa is not open to hotel guests unless you pay extra🙄

reviews.title: La la land spectacular
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, I would say best in vegas. We almost chose Bellagio but were glad we chose this one as that had way too many tourists.Lovely clean rooms. Whole experience apart from no kettle  or additions in room was awesome. If you want to come away from the madness and have luxury after a full day on the strip this is the hotel for you 😊

reviews.title: Incredible Fountainebleau!
reviews.text: The room was luxurious and comfortable.  When I walked in the curtains automatically opened to the gorgeous floor to ceiling view of the City.  The tub was so long and deep that I could sit in it with water up to my shoulders.  Everything was absolutely perfect.

reviews.title: Unmatched Service, Stunning Design, and the Best All-Around Vegas Experience
reviews.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas exceeded every expectation and is now my go-to resort whenever I visit the city. From the moment I arrived, I was met with warm, attentive service—including a generous complimentary upgrade that made my trip unforgettable. Every team member I encountered went above and beyond, showing a level of hospitality that truly sets this property apart.The resort offers something for everyone. The casino floor is full of energy with a wide variety of games, upbeat music, and a fun, social vibe that makes it my favorite place to play in Vegas. The Tavern was a personal highlight—an incredible spot to watch live sports, place bets, and enjoy great service in a high-energy atmosphere.Though my trip was brief, I was able to take advantage of the fitness center, which was impressively equipped and offered complimentary classes and personal training options—perfect for staying active even on vacation. While I didn’t get a chance to visit the spa this time, the facility looked serene and will definitely be on my list for next time.One of the most unique experiences at Fontainebleau is LIV Beach. Though I missed the Calvin Harris performance by a day, the buzz from other guests said it all—this is one of the best daylife venues in Vegas. From world-class DJs to luxury design and production, it’s more than a pool party—it’s a full-scale concert under the sun.Every detail of the resort is thoughtfully crafted—from modern room technology to sophisticated design and world-class amenities. Fontainebleau Las Vegas delivers an elevated, all-encompassing Vegas experience that I would highly recommend to anyone visiting the city. I can’t wait to return.

reviews.title: Apa national
reviews.text: Definitely a five-star everything in the room was top notch. The restaurants were tasty but obviously Vegas expensive. Floor service sucked but the employees did love to stand around and talk to each other we saw a lot of that. I do suggest wearing a mask as the perfume is so heavy you'd want them to bring back smoking. Are trip included parking but for some reason they've thrown it on my credit card so now I have to fight them on that. Very clean. And they have really shown the biggest slowdown the casino was not that busy and I noticed the payouts on the grand awards were lowered that it other casinos

reviews.title: Relaxing vacation
reviews.text: The rooms were smaller than I expected for the price and they have a touch panel to turn on the lights and open the drapes, but they were kind of a pain to work. The resort though is beautiful, great service and the upscale restaurants are really good. Must go to the pastry and Gelato shop! unfortunately they closed the pool if it rains and it was closed most of the weekend when we were there. Luckily the Venetian was still open, so we went over there and enjoyed their spa and pool.

reviews.title: One of the best in Vegas!
reviews.text: This resort is incredible; the entire place is beautiful! The staff are super friendly and personable. They have reasonable nightly hotel rates and table game minimums. They have a ton of great food options on-site as well. They are all a little expensive, but the quality is great. Pro tip: Don't order drinks by the pool, they are very expensive, make sure to play at the poolside backpack or craps tables and get free drinks! The dealers at the poolside tables are some of the best in Vegas! Yes, this resort is at the north end of the strip, but it's much easier than you think to get to the other parts of Vegas. The Deuce's bus picks up right outside the resort and is an easy and affordable way to get around the strip.

reviews.title: Kind of conflicting
reviews.text: This review is the subjective opinion of an individual traveller and not of Tripadvisor LLC nor of its partners. Tripadvisor performs checks on reviews as part of our industry-leading trust & safety standards. Read our transparency report to learn more.

reviews.title: Amazing! Except guest services
reviews.text: We were staying at the Wynn but visited friends staying at the Fountainblue. Overall had a wonderful experience and the resort is breathtaking. mother wolf and LIV are some of the best times I’ve had in a while. As we left, I Put my CC down for a friend’s room folio, a few days later notice an unfamiliar charge (no big deal)Called the hotel and spoke with a gentleman in customer/guest services named Lorenzo, he was helpful and rectified everything until the call was about to end and I heard “cheap b*tch” faintly before disconnecting. Obviously this was not intended for me to hear but sadly I did. As a Jewish woman this is more hurtful than anything and a heartbreaking level of unprofessionalism I’ve yet to experience in a place with so much potential. Understandably everyone has bad days but I will not be returning after that distasteful interaction but wanted to share my experience for future reference. Do better FountainBlue Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Use the hotel and a place to sleep and not much more
reviews.text: Rooms are fine, view of the sphere was good. Bathroom was missing the most basic thing. A towel hook, you had to put the towel on the floor when you shower or walk across the bathroom for it.  Pool is ok, but the service at the pool was terrible. My wife was able to go earlier than I did, she was completely ignored the entire time by the young waitresses walking around. She felt like she wasn't pretty or skinny enough to deserve their attention. When I got there, she wanted to leave but I wanted her to at least have a drink and enjoy. I went to the bar and the bartender made the weakest $23 drink I have ever had. Poured our alcohol into a blender, added way too much ice, poured our two drinks and then the remainer of the blender down the sink. I just watched as the alcohol I had just paid for get thrown away. Tried our luck at Roulette. the dealer was terrible. He would just stand there looking around, bored out of his mind and would not help up place our bets at the other end of the table since we could not reach. Other players saw this and ended up helping up place the bets.  We were playing $250 a spin. You think a little assistance might be nice and land you a tip. We ended up stopping since he made my wife's first experience not one she would like to repeat. I have had great dealers at Caesars that actually want to help.

reviews.title: A perfect 10. Absolutely Stunning
reviews.text: Absolute gem of a hotel and conference center. Absolutely spectacular. Food, spa, fitness facilities and rooms. A perfect 10. The people were also very accommodating and easy to talk with. Concierge was very helpful with scheduling everything for shows and more. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend

reviews.title: Stay at the Wynn instead
reviews.text: Ive been to the FB 6 times since they opened. I spend more money than all of my other party members. All my party members receive comps and resort credits while I havent received anything.I normally split my time between the Wynn and FB. Going forward, the Wynn will be my hotel of choice. They at least know how to treat regular guests.

reviews.title: Pretty hotel, pretty terrible service.
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful but the service is subpar to say the least.  Room service took over 40 minutes to answer the phone and another 1 hour 15 to deliver.  Tavern service was so slow we canceled our food and left.  They have a long way to go on the service side to catch up to the other marquis Vegas hotels.

reviews.title: Wonderful and relaxing stay
reviews.text: Great room with a nice view of the Las Vegas strip and the Sphere. Complimentary slippers. Very clean throughout the casino and lounge area. I look forward to a future visit. I definitely recommend FountaineBleau. The casino is one of the newer attractions on the Las Vegas strip.

reviews.title: Disappointing Experience at a Property That Prioritizes Image Over Service
reviews.text: I wanted to love the Fontainebleau Las Vegas, but from the moment we checked in, the experience fell far short of what you'd expect from a luxury hotel.We were initially placed in a room that directly faced their massive LED marquee. The blackout blinds didn’t close properly, so our room felt like a 2 AM nightclub—impossible to sleep in. It took two days and multiple requests to be moved to a quieter room. Even then, we were given a configuration that required my sister to sleep on a rollaway bed because none of their larger rooms offer two beds—a surprising and frustrating limitation for a luxury property.Service across the board was lacking. Every simple request—extra pillows, toothpaste, basic amenities—required multiple follow-ups. It seemed like nothing got done the first time. I spent more time calling down to the front desk and following up than actually enjoying my stay.The final straw came when our reservation at Komodo was denied because "A-list talent" was in the restaurant. We were told we could dine at the bar instead—not acceptable for a pricey, special-occasion dinner we had reserved in advance. When we asked the hostess for her name, she refused to provide it.To the hotel’s credit, a manager did reach out after our stay and apologized for the experience. He offered to refund half of our stay, which I reluctantly accepted. Ten days later—still no refund. Just like everything else with this hotel, it’s all style, no follow-through.The Fontainebleau may look impressive on the outside, but the substance just isn’t there. When you’re paying luxury rates, you expect consistency, professionalism, and a commitment to guest experience—not excuses and broken promises.

reviews.title: Fourth time and keeps getting better
reviews.text: Fourth time there and this time we just stayed at hotel the whole time for events, restaurants, pools, hanging in our amazing room, and gaming.  The personnel are all very friendly and professional.  Best pools in Vegas and best craft cocktails across multiple venues.  The promenade and room service also have great food for when you don't want to go all out in the nicer restraurants and there is such a variety of high quality food, drink, and things to do.

reviews.title: Loved it!!!
reviews.text: Johanna C was not at the same hotel I was — this hotel was immaculate and gorgeous!! She must love the Luxor and the Excalibur or something, and probably never even stayed at Fontainebleau!! IHad a wonderful time in the hotel- the one complaint I did have was the Casino floor did not have the greatest Slot games so they do need a new Slot manager over there

reviews.title: Need better Housekeeping
reviews.text: Rooms need more cleanliness, vacuum, change sheets every new guest, higher quality of tv's & internet.The hotel it's spectacular, as the restaurants & Bars, the pool it great as the Spa.Cafe La Fontaine for breakfast & lounge, need to be open more time, it's close at noon, incredible!

reviews.title: 5 + Star Experience
reviews.text: 5 + Star , from the arrival to to check-out. The entire stay, and overall property was immaculate. Always someone within reach to ask questions and noticed security when moving through out the property. The staff at all areas where friendly and provided a great experience.

reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.text: Friendly staff in the pool. Good experience in the room nice and clean. Smell good when you walk in. Definitely will be back again. Enjoy the live music. Need more choices of the food. Make more affordable to all. Limited food choices. Beautiful place

reviews.title: They have a winner
reviews.text: Absolutely love, pulling in and being greeted with professional valet, concierge, front desk, all very professional and upscale. The room is appointed beautifully. The brand goes the extra mile and how they integrated the brand in their design everywhere. The place is timeless, classy truly, my favorite.

reviews.title: Lavish but a young vibe Hotel.
reviews.text: A young vibe hotel. A very big spacious hotel. The rooms were gorgeous and the bed was the most comfortable bed I have ever slept in. The restaurants were very over priced. The pool had a noisy beach club vibe. There was nowhere to find some peace and quiet. I had no complaints it just wasn't my age group type of hotel. It would suit young successful adults/groups.

reviews.title: Stylish Hotel With Great Amenities, But Security Deposit Felt Excessive
reviews.text: We stayed here for the fourth leg of our honeymoon trip along the West Coast of the USA. Overall, it’s a very stylish, modern hotel that offers a comfortable and enjoyable experience.Rooms: Modern, well-designed, and very comfortable, with spacious bathrooms — no complaints here.Food: Delicious and well-prepared, though a bit on the pricey side. That said, we felt it was worth the cost.Casino: Bright, open layout with high ceilings, which made it feel much more comfortable and less claustrophobic compared to others we visited during our trip.Pool: A beautiful space — it felt like swimming in a Mediterranean resort.Downside: The only real drawback, and the reason for the 4-star rating instead of 5, was the security deposit. At $650, it felt excessive for a couple. We understand the need for deposits, but this amount seemed disproportionate and not tailored to the average guest profile. It’s something the hotel should reassess based on the type of clientele they’re hosting. however, appreciated the quick return of the deposit compared to other hotels on pour trip. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would recommend the hotel — just be aware of the upfront costs.

reviews.title: Luxury in rooms, great beds,  ordinary casino, noisy location
reviews.text: Too expensive. Not that special. Layout is confusing and garage needs more signage to find your way around. Room was beautiful and floor to ceiling window provided good views. But the downside was not sleeping because you hear every road sound. I had to get up at 1:00 am to actually look out the window to see if we were by a racetrack due to engines revving and zooming for two hours. And that was on the 50th floor.   Last thing to note is it gets stars because of the most comfortable beds I’ve ever had in 52 trips to Vegas. Just needed some earplugs.

reviews.title: Foutainebleau Las Vegas -Spectacular!!
reviews.text: Fountainebleau is spectacular casino / resort. Check in was fast despite there being many people in line - the wait was only 3 or 4 minutes.  We found our room in common areas to be extremely clean and well maintained. The restaurants offered A wide variety of very good food in a very clean atmosphere.  Must be a fantastic place to work because everyone we saw working there was smiling.This was my first time staying here and I will definitely look forward to returning soon

reviews.title: This years Birthday outstanding!!
reviews.text: This place wasn’t short of beauty, style and grace. From valet to front desk and everyone in between exceptional service!! Beautiful amenities, structure ,build  ,quality ,and a hint of pure class. FONTAINEBLEAU you owe me nothing you are truly amazing.. Thanks for giving me and my husband such an amazing opportunity to spend my birthday celebration with you all; and experience this amazing community of hospitality and class …

reviews.title: Poolside covered in litter.
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel. Pool however, covered in litter. I asked a lifeguard if someone could pick it up but she said it’s not her job and she would let her manager know, but then sat and did nothing. Cups, napkins, cans all blowing into the pool. Where are the staff?!

reviews.title: Bedbugs!
reviews.text: Bedbug bites! Beware! Attitude of staff - they could care less. They see themselves as VIP in VIP lounge, instead of you!Strongly encourage people to look elsewhere, closer to the strip. Will NOT go back here .. Photos speak a thousand words!

reviews.title: Wonderful stay!
reviews.text: Absolutely gorgeous hotel! The accommodations are 5 star by far. Check in was a breeze and any staff that we dealt with were all professional and very friendly and helpful. The beds are super comfortable and the bathroom is luxurious. The rooms are beautifully decorated and the views are great! We will stay here  again for sure!

reviews.title: Save your money, disgusting hotel
reviews.text: What a garbage hotel. Disgusting, dirty and wanted $9 for an empty wine glass. NEVER AGAIN, don’t do it!!!!! POS hotel. Ghetto. UGH…what a disgusting place. Everything is low, ghetto, dirty and disgusting. The room is small and smells and the whole place is an arm pit garbage can. Save your money. Go to the flamingo if you must.
