reviews.title: Best New Casino Resort in Las Vegas
reviews.text: In my opinion, Fontainebleau is currently the best hotel on the strip. Rooms are roomy, clean, and well decorated making us feel at home. Plenty of pillows and the bed was very comfortable.  There are plenty of choices of eateries to satisfy everyone's tastebuds. Love the decor of the whole casino and the promenade area. One must try La Fontaine if you're visiting Fontainebleau as their breakfast/ brunch is the best in Las Vegas. Try out the Souffle Pancake and French toast - you won't regret it.

reviews.title: Best Hotel on the strip
reviews.text: This place has everything that you can imagine and more.  You do not need to leave the Hotel. The food is pricey but phenomenal.  If you love jazz check out the live music at NoWhere. Very nice Spa and pool. They also have plenty of slot machines. Check it out!

reviews.title: Family trip
reviews.text: The rooms are clean and very nice. I would recommend this hotel completely. Their staff is courteous, friendly and helpful. Food is delicious in the upstairs food court. Casino was beautiful, spacious and alot of fun slots. The Vida resturant has amazing breakfasts as well.

reviews.title: We will be back next year!
reviews.text: The hotel is an excellent place ti stay. The amenities and the room are amazing. Beds are comfy with warm blanket and soft pillows. The casino has a lot of machines to choose from and it's very clean.  The staff is very pleasant and the pool area was fun.

reviews.title: Hands down the best hotel on the strip and I've stayed at a *lot* of them
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau Las Vegas is the future of hotels in Vegas. It's obviously new so it's very clean and well kept, but it's modern and always an A+ experience. While there are other "luxury hotels" on the strip that we are almost all familiar with, FB LV delivers on the whole experience. The food options are fantastic, always great service, and it's clean and feels like you are in 2025 vs. some of the other "luxury" ones feel like you are in a very nice hotel for 2001.

reviews.title: Fontainebleau Las Vegas: Elevate Your Events, Embrace the Comfort, Ignite the Night
reviews.text: Step into a haven of comfort and impeccable cleanliness within the rooms at The Fontainebleau Las Vegas. Beyond your tranquil retreat, a world of delights awaits. Indulge in the diverse and delicious dining experiences, invigorate yourself at the fitness center, or bask in the Las Vegas sunshine by the inviting pool. As the day unfolds, the thrill of the casino floor beckons, promising excitement with every stack of chips on the table.For business, The Fontainebleau really knows how to put on a company conference and every need is catered for from corporate kickoff events to team breakout sessions and those tasty coffee and snack breaks.

reviews.title: The place you must visit in Vegas!
reviews.text: It’s a great experience to visit Fontainebleau.  It has a wonderful view in the room and you can see it by the window. It’s a nice place to hang out with family and friends! We will plan to come back here anytime soon! Highly recommended to whoever wanna come to Vegas!

reviews.title: Hope you don't want hot coffee!
reviews.text: The hotel itself was great, the room was  great and very comfortable.  The bed was super comfortable and all the room amenities were fantastic. The issues was the simple pleasures in the morning, My wife and I wanted coffee every morning and the room service charges were Vegas exorbitant so we went to the only couple of to go options to take back to the room and they had ridiculous wait times and no coordination between ordering basic food and coffee's with up to 10-15 minutes between when your coffee came and your food, so hot coffee, cold food or the other way around, it was different every day. Once the coffee's (that I was planning to bring back to our room for my wife) came first and 15 minutes later the food came, got to the room, cold coffee and the food was not even heated through.  Don't know if super expensive room service would have been better but as they source from the same place I doubt it.

reviews.title: 2 fun nights at Fountainbleau
reviews.text: Great ambiance, excellent restaurants and for the most part, super friendly and helpful staff. The only downside was their nightclub LIV. Security team and bouncers were very unfriendly and  almost confrontational, which at that price is a shame.

reviews.title: Amazingly awesome stay
reviews.text: We were there for a Staycation and birthday celebration. Our room was a King with a view of the Strip. It was very clean, the bed was very comfortable. Lots of restaurants with choices of cuisines. Pool areas are very clean. Service was excellent. Staff was very friendly and helpful. I would recommend it to everyone.

reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.text: Exceptional service. Well appointed, clean and fresh rooms. It was a busy weekend with WWE event and we never heard noise from the halls when we were in our room. Great selection of restaurants and games. Never had to wait for games or drinks.

reviews.title: HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE HORRIBLE HOTEL
reviews.text: This is by far the worst hotel on the strip! Came to Vegas for Wrestlemania Weekend and you think as the hotel sponsoring the event they would be more organized but it was horrible! Firstly been to Vegas multiple times and this hotel has no idea what they’re doing!!! Do not be a sponsor hotel if you cannot handle the capacity of people! We booked on Costco Travel so got a good rate for the weekend but boy did it come with a price!! First we landed on Thursday night and upon checking in we asked the employee at the front desks about the $200 credit we received from booking with Costco Travel… the check in clerk tells us we cannot use it for any in-room service dining and can only use it in restaurants on the property we said ok no problem. We made sure to ask her 2-3 times since the lobby was jam packed with lots of people and she gave us the same response. No problem, we ordered room service that night and  when it arrived the employee said to call back when we were done so that they can come pick up the dirty dishes.. DIRTY DISHES WERE NEVER PICKED UP BY ANYONE… we called back after we were done and no one ever came.. so the next morning we called back again and still NO ONE CAME.. so on the Saturday we went to the front desk and advised the clerk of the issue, she apologized and trued to contact the manager of the in-room service dining and still the issue not resolved… so on Sunday we asked for room service to clean the room…. I specifically left a note asking to pick up the dirty dishes since apparently no staff member knows anything…. Later that night came back from Wrestlemania & the dirty dishes STILL IN THE ROOM!! so I went back down the lobby explained the whole issue… I advised her how absolutely disgusting and gross this is!! the front desk clerk tells me I can’t leave the dishes in the hallway on the floor & that house keeping doesn’t pick it up.. she then proceeds to tell me that in-room service dining is supposed to leave the tray table outside and that is where we’re supposed to leave the dishes… I said ok no one left me anything and housekeeping didn’t pick it up so what now??? She tells me she’ll contact them and have some one come right away.. guess what NO ONE CAME… So at check out they didn’t give any paper receipt they would send it to our email… they sent the receipt to my email… 1) I got charged $15 extra for room service without being advised when we literally asked the question at check in &  it was labelled as ‘AFTER HOURS’ on the receipt but it’s supposed to be 24/7 service????2) they used the $200 credit on the in-room service when I was told that was not possible 3) I called after checking out since I only got the receipt by email and the service again still terrible …. No acknowledgement of the issues or even taking responsibly of the misinformation we were given!!!!Overall even through it was a great weekend this hotel is absolutely notorious and should be more empathetic towards people who choose to stay at their hotel!!!!! 😡😡😡😡😡

reviews.title: Could get better with major improvements
reviews.text: I just wanna say that this hotel is beautiful. It has gorgeous rooms, amazing restaurants, and everything here is set for success, but I have to say that it needs a lot of work to be a 5 star property. Not once did we have our room cleaned. That wouldn’t be a reason enough for me to never stay here again, but my number one reason for never staying here again is that there is no hot water. Well let me say there is hot water, but it takes 10 minutes to access it And for me that’s just never gonna cut it.

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is beautiful. Everyone was very friendly, helpful and good vibes. Our room was very spacious, super clean, and we had a beautiful view. The restaurant Komodo is amazing.  Everything we ordered was so delicious. The server was amazing can’t remember his name but everyone was very nice and attentive to us.

reviews.title: Awesome gym, Ok suite
reviews.text: Booked with Alex platinum. Stayed in royal suite with best view. No upgrade. Breakfast only $60 for two people. No priority checkin or direct access elevator for royal suite. Breakfast selection is limited if selected to use credit. Glass window was dirty so I couldn’t really have the best view. We stayed at pretty high floor but could still hear music from the pool right outside. Located far end of strip is not the most convenient. Room was great but AC directly blowing air to me on bed. Shower pressure low and wish there was a separate shower handle. Bathroom has good amenities like razer, toothbrush, Marvis toothpaste. TV poor quality but it got TLC channel. Fitness center was more than awesome but wish all treadmills were technogym.

reviews.title: My favorite resort
reviews.text: Fontainebleau has become my favorite hotel. I have stayed at all the major strip resorts, and it is nicer than any. But what really puts it over the top is how every employee seems to go out of the way to be nice to guests. Everyone from the front desk to the maids goes out of their way to be helpful and quite nice.  The room quality is second to none. The rooms are gorgeous with their own unique reserved style. Soft blues with pops of gold and other colors. Nice amenities like robes and slippers, excellent bath products, and essentially a built-in mini-fridge. The bathroom is lovely, functional, and spacious. Many rooms have an excellent view of the Sphere, which adds to the experience. And the resort has its own style. It is beautiful and totally cool but without trying too hard. It has over three thousand beds, but is relatively compact considering the size and is easy to get around once you understand the layout. You realize that it has a unifying theme and style, but it does not hit you over the head with it. I never feel crowded or rushed when in the hotel. Just an enjoyable oasis from which to experience Las Vegas. In short, it just seems to know who it is and does its thing. I just came back from a stay, and stayed there last June as well. It would be better if it were center strip, but It has so much going for it that I am happy to drive elsewhere for a meal or a show. I was by myself but had a great time at the Nowhere Lounge talking to the bartenders and listening to the live band. I also had a great time at Mother Wolf where the server Michelle and manager were very friendly. I will also note that within walking distance Westgate and the Sahara have cheaper eats and entertainment. For that matter, Circus Circus is close, and there is a McDonalds across the street from Fontainebleau. Fontainebleau is slowly gaining clientele and I would take advantage of the lower rates while you can.

reviews.title: Very nice hotel on end of strip
reviews.text: Really liked this hotel.  The only downside is that it's on the far end of the strip.  If it was in the middle...I'm sure prices would be much higher.   It's a really nice hotel...seems very modern...well designed.  Free parking is a plus and it's easy to get in and out.  Pool area is very well done with lots of shade opportunity.  Right next door to the convention center.  Overall...would definitely stay here again next time!

reviews.title: Wynn North
reviews.text: First the property is large. The openness in the first floor makes it feel very comforting. It never felt crowded even when all the machines ands tables were full. This was refreshing.  The openness also allows no smoke to linger. I never smelled any smoke in the property even with the guy next to me at the center bar smoking a cigar. Amazing. The food is outstanding. Didn't know what to expect> My first meal was a lunch at the Tavern which is the sportsbook restaurant. I had the fish with potato puree. It was amazing. This is the sportsbook! The room service waffle and French pressed coffee was Wynn level room service quality. All the restaurants here are amazing.I stayed at a Gold Level room/ Room was spacious and comfortable. The stand alone in this room was the shower. It was huge. Easily 6 times the size of my home shower. The shower head was high which was great for 6"4 me. also strong water pressure. The spa was great with an amazing massage and great spa amenities.Its the closest hotel on the strip to the Wynn. Excellent service without the Bougie..

reviews.title: Disappointing Follow-Up Stay After an Incredible Start
reviews.text: I stayed at Fontainebleau twice in the same week—first with my husband and child last Friday, and then again on Tuesday with my extended family. Our first stay was fantastic. The room was spotless, beautifully designed, and faced the Sphere—everything we hoped for and more. Based on that experience, I was excited to return and had high expectations.Unfortunately, our second visit was a complete letdown. I had booked three rooms and requested that they all be Sphere-facing and on the same floor. At check-in, I was told that wasn’t possible. The only Sphere-facing room available was on a different floor, and the rest had no views. We ended up giving the better room to our larger family group, assuming we’d still be well accommodated.What shocked me most was the front desk’s response: “You should have arrived earlier”—even though we checked in at 4 PM, the official check-in time. The tone felt dismissive and unprofessional.To make matters worse, the room I received was dirty. There were Dorito crumbs on the floor, makeup residue near the bed, dirty carpets I could feel through my slippers, and even pubic hair in the bathroom. It was unacceptable. I took photos because I honestly couldn’t believe the condition.After such a wonderful start to the week, this follow-up experience left a sour taste. I expected consistency in quality and service from a property of this caliber, and sadly, it fell short. I hope the hotel management takes this feedback seriously and improves both its cleanliness standards and customer service moving forward.

reviews.title: Now the Best luxury in Vegas
reviews.text: I’m a Vegas veteran and I finally found my favorite place   We’ve stated a lot of the big names down the road several times and even had our favorites but not anymore. This is the one.  From The check-in to the service to the room and the food the pool literally there’s nothing there. That’s not amazing. We’re already planning to go back ASAP.

reviews.title: We love our stay at Fontainebleau!
reviews.text: The room was spacious & really nice, the bedding, towels, toiletries were luxurious. The room and the entire hotel was perfectly clean. The staff and service was excellent everywhere in the hotel. The food was delicious in all the restaurant we ate and the drinks at the bars were really good. The food at the Sports Bar was amazing! It's a very safe place. They have beautiful pools and adult pools only. We stayed for an entire week and our stay was literally perfect! We will surely be back!

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: Everything is clean and inviting. This resort is truly luxury. The pools sparkled and the adultpool made our vacation so relaxing. Service is top level. We were treated like important guests at every venue. The Tavern, which is supposed to be casual dining, had top notch food and drinks.

reviews.title: Over the top!!!
reviews.text: Floor to ceiling windows with view of strip!  Amazing bathroom design, comfy pillows and robes.  Electronic connected drapes to open/close.  Room design and flow was beautiful. Had dinner at Mother Wolf which I highly recommend!!  Pool design is stunning with daybeds and lounges in the pool!!!

reviews.title: Do not let this hotel ruin your trip
reviews.text: The hotel is new, but the staffs were not very friendly. We had two reservations from Amex FHR and stayed there for 3 nights. We can hear clearly what people were talking in the hall from our bed. The housekeeper did not clean our room. The empty tissues were not refilled. There was still hair in the shower drainage. They did not hang the ropes that we left on the chairs. And what pissed me the most is that they did not empty the trash! When I checked out my first reservation to check in for the second one, I showed the photos to the front desk manager, and they did not do anything! For such an upper scale hotel, this is definitely not the service that I was expecting.

reviews.title: Room Perfect!
reviews.text: First time at the Las Vegas branch as have been to the Fontainebleau hotel in Miami.  This hotel does not disappoint.  Room perfect spacious size, clean, ideal for family of 3. Staff were very friendly and helpful.  Ideal as not so far from Freemont Street and Sphere.  We will definitely be back.

reviews.title: The Fontainebleu is our Numero Uno!
reviews.text: The Fontainebleu exceeds all our expectations at all levels- atmosphere, comfort, cleanliness, and gaming.  We play slots and find they have a great selection of games to keep us coming back for more as well as great drink service. The staff is friendly and I appreciate that. This has become our number 1 resort and we’ve stayed at many of the upscale Strip hotels. I have to mention….being close to Tacos el Gordo doesn’t hurt either - best tacos  in town! Fontainebleu is 10/10!!

reviews.title: Hiding prices for restaurants and spa
reviews.text: I'm at the hotel now. I wanted to check the different restaurants around the hotel. When I went to the website, no restaurant, from the very best to casual, had no prices listed. I called to ask about getting menus with prices and was told none have any menus with prices, which include the menu you are handed at the restaurant (this is for the more pricy restaurants. I've been coming to Las Vegas for many years. I've stayed at every 5 star restaurant and never have I gone to a restaurant that didn't have published prices. Seriously, if they don't tell you the price when you order, how does one they just aren't making up prices?Every person is entitled to know how much they are paying without making it very embarrassing by having to ask the waiter.I find this practice to be extremely rude to the customers who come to the Fountainebleau.I also found it is very hard to get prices for the spa. I finally found out a 4 hour day pass is $180, whereas other hotels, like The Wynn and Encore charge $100 for a day pass, without a maximum amount of hours. I could actually go to the Encore for $125 all day as someone who is not staying at the Encore. The Encore has an awesome spa.This '5 star' hotel has pretty low prices for rooms right now, and then  they try to get you because the hotel is further away from the strip, but I would say to explore the other restaurants of Las Vegas and let 'other people' eat at very overpriced restaurants which don't tell you the prices.  I'll be eating at Mon Ami Gabi tonight and watch the fountains.Shame on the Fontainebleau.

reviews.title: Disappointing start
reviews.text: First off, I will say that hotel is very beautiful and looks very much like a 5-star hotel. Having just redone my upstairs at home, painting it a nice shade of blue, I was looking forward to trying a new hotel in the same shade. I checked in last night. I booked through Amex Fine Hotels which comes with some nice amenities. One amenity is a possible room upgrade. I asked the person checking me in if I got an upgrade and she said yes.I went up to my room and found out my room was at the end of a very long hallway, so that would be #1 of not getting a good room. I waited until morning so I could see the view. The view is horrible. Certainly not one anyone would prefer.I've only seen the view of the Fontainebleau from the strip. I come to Vegas 5 or 6 times a year and only at the finest hotels. My view shows that this hotel is shaped like a U. I'm in the inner part of the U where I can stare at the other part of the hotel, blocking me from any view of the strip. It almost feels like I'm not even in Las Vegas.I'm pretty sure there are plenty of people who book rooms from all kinds of websites, and even then, they would never be happy they were assigned the room I'm in.Basically, putting me in this room totally mocks what American Express is trying to do.I'm here for 4 days, but I actually have another 5 days booked for next week. I think I'll have to change that trips destination to something on the strip.Just really disappointed. I feel like I've been shoved into a corner.

reviews.title: Beware of using the toiletries in the bathroom
reviews.text: I am very disappointed that I was charged over $50 for in-room toiletries. I have stayed in some of the best hotels and resorts in the US and abroad and have never had this happen. I had forgotten my body wash and since I was only there overnight, I used the provided toiletries only to now find a charge on my card for the use. Why are they even there if not complimentary? I saw no signage that they were charges for them. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Best Casino on the strip
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau Las Vegas is stunning—modern luxury, upscale dining, and elegant vibes. Gorgeous design, spacious rooms, and top-tier service make it a standout on the Strip. The service is attentive, and the atmosphere is classy without being stuffy. It’s a perfect spot for a refined Vegas getaway—definitely worth the splurge.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: I’ve stayed in quite a number of hotels in Las Vegas throughout the years, and this property is definitely one of the nicest in town. Check in was super easy and quick and the lobby and casino floor were clean and airy. Our room was great - quite spacious and impeccably clean. The tavern and sports book were great - good vibe and generous pouts at the bar. Yes, I get the complaints that the hotel is a bit removed from the center of The Strip. But you know that when booking here. I actually like the calmer atmosphere and the fact you can walk to the Arts District in about 15 minutes.Only complaint (and I know Vegas has gotten very expensive) is that everything costs a small fortune, from drinks to food.

reviews.title: Immaculate new property
reviews.text: Immaculate new property. Great service. Vida was great. Travis is great server. Rooms all new very comfortable. Casino service and pool service best I've seen. Check in and out sooooeasy. Easy access to Uber taxis. Just great place with latest technology and wonderful service.

reviews.title: Luxury!
reviews.text: Luxurious and well appointed. From dinning to nightlife…you never have to leave! I certainly did not want to end my vacation. The staff was kind and engaging. The room was sublime. Don’t be discouraged about the end-of-strip location. This resort has everything you need to have a great time in Vegas.

reviews.title: Wonderful hotel with excellent staff
reviews.text: Great service. Clean and quiet rooms. Luxurious surroundings. Very helpful attentive staff. Loved our experience! Good selection of restaurants with great food. Staff provided a great room with excellent views. Just ask when checking in.

reviews.title: Very good hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is very good, the service, restaurants and bars are nice.  Cleaning of the rooms is ok, but could improve. It was a pleasant stay.  The jazz bar had a great jazz group.  The Collins bar is very nice, I suggest the piano man could perform more time, he finishes at 10 pm and I think it is too early.

reviews.title: RUDE! Not willing to help find a solution, Extremely Poor!
reviews.text: Filled out an online form to be contacted. No response.Called earlier today, reservations was going to call me back. No Response.Called again and talked to room reservations AGAIN explaining I needed 2 rooms for 1-0 days (or a suite including 2 sep bedrooms and baths) connecting as traveling with an elderly person who needs assistance. This was not possible, only based on availability upon arrival. I explained again and the need we have and that upon arrival was going to be very tricky and if there's nothing that could be done.Response: we don't do that, have a great day. AND SHE HANG UP!!!!! UNBELIEVABLE!

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel with Great Rooms, But Confusing Layout and Frustrating Bathroom Amenities Hold It Back
reviews.text: Beautiful Hotel with Great Rooms, But Confusing Layout and Frustrating Bathroom Amenities Hold It Back

reviews.title: Would be awesome if customer service was better
reviews.text: Aesthetically, the hotel is visually appealing, but your customer service is very unorganized and that contributes to some stressors that guests should not experience.  Your lines were excessively long for checkout, which caused major frustration with several of your guests complaining as they waited for checkout.  You had very few people in your signature guest line, and some of your traffic should have been directed to these areas to cut down on wait times.  I had to request a manager, due to the possibility of missing my flight, because of the long checkout process.  I will say that your guest rooms were clean and spacious, but lacked some features that would be helpful.  Your electronic control buttons are a nice option, but they are hard to use in the dark, since you have no back lights on the buttons and we found that it was difficult to see what buttons to push when the room is not lit and there should be a light closer to the front door in order to see these options.  Also, we noticed there are no braille options on the control panel, and we were very surprised to see no ironing boards or irons in the room, only a steamer, which was not something we expected for a hotel of this quality.  Is there a reason that coffee makers or tea are not available in the room? Housekeeping did enter our room without the service light being on and we were surprised to come back to a room that had been cleaned and not requested.  Your ramp on the north side can be challenging when pushing someone up in a wheelchair or pulling luggage.  Your valet locations were very convenient, and the pools are beautiful.  Your hot tub seemed somewhat hidden from the rest of the pool area.  Overall, our stay was good, but we would be hesitant to stay again, due to the customer service.

reviews.title: Luxurious and Comfort
reviews.text: If you’re in for luxury, comfort and the best experience ever in your vacation then here’s your best choice.This hotel is amazing in and out. Everything about this hotel is luxury. Whether it’s your room, gaming and dining, you can always tell the difference.This is not my first visit here but every time I come to Vegas and know that I’m staying at the Fontainebleau, then I know that I will have the best stay ever.

reviews.title: Best Hotel Ever
reviews.text: Great and helpful staff. Check-in was fast and respectful agents. Extremely Clean excellent rooms. Beds and pillows are the most comfortable. Hospitality at it's best. Great pools and poolside service. Restrooms are huge and extremely clean.

reviews.title: New hotel close to the convention centre, friendly staff and nice rooms
reviews.text: A nice new hotel close to the convention centre, friendly staff and nice rooms. Good food choices with good food, but like all of Vegas - is expensive. Shame that pool does not open until 9am and closes at 6pm but again, that is Vegas. It is not crazy busy like "Aria/Cosmo" at the weekend but I liked that. Would recommend.

reviews.title: Will never stay anywhere else ... Amazing all around resort!
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience! will never stay anywhere else in Vegas. Supoer comfortabkle beds, immaculate rooms  and a fabulour shower! Multiple pools with bar service and restaurants. Fabulous food within the resort a favorite is the Tavern ... Poke Bowl is delicious. The french dip is melt in your mouth.  Yummy bloody mary at the Vida breakfast and always the best coffee and cappucino at the Cez Bon Bon.  Service is stellar throughout the resort. Gaming is exciting and never a wait for a drink. You have to stay at Fontaine Bleau You wont be disappointed!

reviews.title: Gorgeous hotel, on the quieter side .
reviews.text: Quick check in, lovely lobby with dreamy floral arrangements, super staff and gorgeous rooms. All of  the hotel dining has incredible food- and I  mean at every restaurant venue , the food was superb. Mother Wolf on the property  is not to be missed - probably the best Italian food I’ve had anywhere. The bathrooms are luxurious and the beds are very comfortable. Nice touches like automated drapes, robes, good lighting, magnifying mirrors , steamer , etc. We booked a Mountain View room and paid more, but didn’t receive it. Not a huge deal but keep track of what you’ve requested and paid for. The staff is fantastic. Always gracious and helpful ( shout out to the Sundry store employees) . All employees are there to make a difference and it shows. The bars on the property are sumptuous . Beautifully decorated and offering premium liquor ( any bar with Chopin Vodka  gets automatic A+)  . The coffee bar on 2nd floor is excellent and quick service. Fontainebleau is just a gorgeous, elegant hotel all around .  On a sour note, we booked at the IV DRIP and the staff and experience were awesome, except the gym was adjacent and the people working out dropped weights every few seconds and it sounded like the weights were gonna come crashing through the wall. Not a relaxing experience.   NO hotel gym needs to allow that kinda nonsense particularly when it affects other guests on the property. The gym manager needs to fix that.  The pools were lovely, we didn’t visit LIV beach but it looked fun. The hotel gambling area is so-so, kinda slow and not very exciting. I didn’t see much action and it didn’t appear to be many people taking advantage of the gaming. Synopsis: If you’re looking for a beautiful hotel , with great employees and on the quieter side, this would be a good fit. If you like more action and Vegas excitement , I’d try another hotel. We would stay there again as it suited our needs.

reviews.title: Nice view, nice room, terrible customer service.
reviews.text: I ordered food delivery to Fontainebleau Las Vegas. When the courier arrived, I called the reception and politely asked to have the food brought to my room. Reception informed me that it was against hotel policy and that concierge service was unavailable after 10:30 PM. They also informed me that the courier had only 15 minutes to wait. As a result, I was forced to get dressed and go downstairs myself.It took me about 8-9 minutes out of the given 15 minutes to reach the courier. However, upon reaching the entrance, I discovered that hotel security had already sent my courier away despite the promised 15-minute waiting period not being over. Due to the heavy traffic conditions typical of Saturday evenings in Las Vegas, it took the courier an additional 10 minutes to return.When I expressed my frustration and described the absurdity of this situation at reception, staff offered no viable solution besides advising me either to return to my room and come back down again later or to remain waiting downstairs for the courier’s return.To summarize clearly:	•	Staff refused to allow the courier to deliver food directly to my room door.	•	Staff refused to bring the delivery to my room themselves.	•	Staff refused even to hold the delivery at reception.	•	Staff only provided a 15-minute window for the courier to wait.	•	Staff forced me to dress and come down personally, yet still prematurely dismissed my courier.	•	Staff agreed with me about the absurdity of the situation but still provided no effective solution.Considering the level of this hotel—a 5-star establishment charging approximately $3,000 for a four-night stay—this experience is extremely disappointing and completely unacceptable.

reviews.title: Poor Hotel Room experience, Amazing Restaurants
reviews.text: Room was not clean and found toenails on carpet and hair in shower.  Front desk was not helpful and rude.  However, Mother Wolf Restaurant was outstanding, great food, service was over the top and best cocktails. Don't miss the speakeasy for great after dinner entertainment and cocktails.

reviews.title: Hotel has the "Wow" Factor
reviews.text: We had a fantastic stay at the Fontainebleau Hotel in Las Vegas! From the moment we arrived, the hotel delivered a serious WOW factor — it’s modern, beautifully designed, and impeccably clean. The overall vibe is energetic yet sophisticated, and the views are definitely a highlight. My room had an amazing view of The Sphere, which made the experience even more memorable.My sister, niece, and I thoroughly enjoyed brunch at Le Fountain — everything was fresh and delicious. We also had some incredible cocktails at the bar; they were both creative and expertly made.Highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a stylish and memorable Vegas experience!

reviews.title: Horrible stay
reviews.text: I wouldn't recommend this place to anybody unless you would like to have like the most inconvenience stay of your life. I didn't like the fact that you had to walk so far from the parking lot just to get to your hotel room. The people that asks you to show your ID Card are very rude and profile people. Their restaurants don't stay open past 10 PM.And they don't have space in the mini fridge. It's just all stacked with their drinks. And you can't move anything, pass 60 seconds without getting charged to your room.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: Great place to stay on the strip all though its not in the center of the strip it was still in a good location close to the Sphere, The Stratus, the famous Peppermill restaurant. It was clean classy and fun for all occasions. I would stay here again. No doubt.

reviews.title: Conference hotel with a club -  not for luxury travelers
reviews.text: The room was very clean and new, but that was the only reason we did not check out early. We stayed for 10 nights in late Mar/early Apr 2025 in a Royal Suite. While the room is very new and clean, the furniture is uncomfortable and the room is missing many features that I’d expect of a luxury resort (oddly basic showers, no sprayer or rain shower, no luxury bath products, etc). I did enjoy the clothes steamer.The staff were not well trained and there is no luxury service here. The Bleau Bar staff were by far the worst staff we encountered in all of Vegas. The security staff and the housekeeping staff here were absolutely lovely, though. The pool (despite it officially opening in March) was closed all throughout the weekdays unexpectedly. It was only truly open Fri-Sun when it was packed. There were no “lounging” or relaxation areas, everything is packed tightly together and constantly pushing for additional drink/food sales.The restaurants are also lacking, with very few mid-range options. The baristas all need additional training on how to properly use an espresso machine, especially for $9+ per coffee. The resort also does not provide any bottled water or any other includedWe have stayed in luxury resorts around the world, and while we know we can’t expect the same service level of Asian resorts in the US, the service here was truly disappointing. This resort is setup only for two types of clients: those who stay for two nights to go to LIV/partying or conference attendees. The location is also pretty bad. The walk to the Wynn is only about 10 min, but you have to walk through a pretty sketchy stretch to get there. It didn’t look so bad at first, but after a few days of walking it we encountered several different bad situations that made us decide to take Ubers the rest of the trip. I would never stay here again by choice, though my company is planning a conference here so I will be forced to return at some point.

reviews.title: You MUST stay here
reviews.text: We come almost monthly to Fountainebleau. The food, service, shopping and people are all amazing. We started coming here a year ago, and have come back at least a dozen times, and now we ONLY stay at Fountainebleau.  We are actually coming back in June and bringing our 10 year old with us. She is very mature for her age and has begged us to come and enjoy the shopping and eating. I know she will love the beauty that is Fountainebleau

reviews.title: Consistently Delivers
reviews.text: From the check-in experience, to the beautiful rooms, to the restaurants that keep popping up and the great gaming experience, the Fontainebleau continues to surprise me with every visit. I could not recommend enough, spending some time at the pool, in the Solo Club, and enjoying some omakase in addition to the great gaming environment.

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: I had a lovely stay at Fontainbleau. Check in was a breeze. Staff was very pleasant.  Arrived at 9:00 a.m. and room was available by 11:00 a.m. Receiving water at check in was a nice gesture. Upon entering my room the lights came on and the window shades opened automatically. My view was really nice. Room was clean and the bed was very comfortable. I went to a show at the Wynn. The walk was not bad at all. Even at night I felt safe as there were a number of people around. Don't let the location deture you from staying at this beautiful hotel. Check out was a breeze.....I checked out from my phone. I would definately stay here again!!

reviews.title: underwhelming at best
reviews.text: The room was nice, but there was party tape on my walls from the last guest.The tape seems silly, but once I fixated on it, I couldn't not see it. Made me wonder what else was overlooked.The hotel has a bar code you can scan to order food. But the system is not user friendly. it needs a search bar so if you want breakfast or hamburgers you can look by item. I stayed there 4 nights and chose door dash over room service because it was more user friendly. The staff was all really nice.While playing the machines, I ordered a drink and was ready to play. 20 min later I'm down 25.00 and still no drink. In fact, I only noticed 2 drink girls the whole time. So, to offer drinks and not have enough staff to serve the guests seems slimy. Based on the amount I spent on the room, I was actually very disappointed. next year I will be staying elsewhere

reviews.title: Great Customer Service Makes the Fontainebleau a Great Choice in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Excellent customer service abounds at the FONTAINEBLEAU LAS VEGAS. Staff went out of their way to provide a great hotel, dining and casino experience. Even the food hall offerings were over the top with great burgers, pizza and other fare. Our favorite restaurant was La Fontaine - we went twice to experience their spectacular brunch fare. Recommend the endless champagne, caviar bagel tower and tarte flambée.

reviews.title: 3 day stay
reviews.text: Clean and modern hotel, all thinkable amenities on site, great room view. Location is good, easy to explore the strip. Can recommend also as base to explore surrounding national parks. Reception can get busy as the hotel is huge. Would return when visiting Vegas again.

reviews.title: Lovely hotel!
reviews.text: Great hotel! Gorgeous, clean and the personnel were too notch! We had a great time at the Liv Beach pool. Super fun with a DJ! We also at Kumodo. Delicious food and excellent service! Holden was great! Rooms were clean and spacious and innovative! Everything you could want!

reviews.title: Best Customer Service and Rescue!
reviews.text: Beautiful facility at the north end of the strip.  This is our 3rd stay at the FB since it's opening.  This time we brought friends!  We booked several rooms.  They all loved the luxurious facility.  Only downside is there is only one food option (Chez Bon Bon deli) after 9:45 pm.  So do not expect to find any restaurants open here after a show.  There is also no food availability in the bar areas.Because we booked multiple rooms, there were a few hiccoughs with our reservation and billing.  A huge shout out to Jalena C. at the front desk.  She was very patient and understanding as we sorted out several issues.  Her ability to listen and problem solve (all with a smile) really made our day.  She easily melted our frustration away.  I hope management recognizes what an asset she is to your team!  We will be back.

reviews.title: Watch out for the service fees
reviews.text: Service fees were outrageous they told me that they would waive them if I book through them that was a lie I went to checkout and the front desk said they couldn’t do anything for me and the 2 rooms I booked and the extra $250 resort fees I asked to speak to a manager he called someone supposedly and said it would be taken care of and I would be credited but I need to pay the whole bill and a never received a refund

reviews.title: Loved everything
reviews.text: I went with some friends and we loved everything from the  service to the rooms and the casino was top tier! The aesthetic of this hotel is picture worthy and with everything to do it was worth every penny. Anything we asked for it was provided and it was with a gracious attitude and smile!

reviews.title: Las Vegas - Fountainebleau
reviews.text: Very nice property... make sure you communicate effectively with the front desk on your intentions of an extension...or you may come back from a outside excursion and have to seek your stuff...they don't play...all and all...a beautiful resort!

reviews.title: Best Resort on the Strip!
reviews.text: This resort is absolutely amazing! Cleanliness and helpful and friendly Staff made my stay here one of the best i have ever experienced! The Food and Drinks were Top Notch. Would totally recommend this resort to anyone looking to get pampered!

reviews.title: Amazing stay at this gorgeous hotel
reviews.text: We just returned from Vegas and our first stay at The Fontainebleau. We had a lovely experience. The hotel is absolutely stunning, and our room was beautiful. The service, from the front desk to the bellhops to the spa staff, was exceptional. We had an amazing breakfast at Vida; the most perfect Eggs Benedict and wonderful service. We enjoyed the Bleau Bar and the Collins Lounge. The Promenade Food Hall has some wonderful casual choices; we had a super last-day quick lunch at Roadside Taco that was delicious.The spa is a must-do if you stay here. Huge, absolutely beautiful space. My massage therapist, Ruby, was stellar. We enjoyed the infrared sauna, the salt room, the steam room, the hot tub, the snow shower (!), and the heated lounge chairs throughout. We spent a couple hours after our massages just exploring the facility and relaxing.The hotel is a bit further up the strip but still a good location. I would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: The extra mile.
reviews.text: Had concerns about booking this as we regularly stay mid-strip. From the first minutes any fears were allayed- the property is wonderful and the staff warm and enthusiastic.We had become used to apathy borderline rudeness at MGM and Caesars properties and this felt like it was a return to old school Vegas.The rooms are immaculate in design. The cleanliness and maintenance second to none.The resort features a pool area and spa that is probably the best we have seen.The dining options are varied and excellent with Dons Prime outstanding.Above all the peoples attitudes- wanting to help, check in housekeeping and rewards were excellent and special mentions to Cindy - Night Casino  Supervisor and Marina Snr Slot Host.When you’re deciding on your location you will see negative comments about where it is situated. It is a $10 ride anywhere in an Uber, Lyft or cab and that buys you excellence quality and value.So in making your decision you will have to decide whether to go that extra mile - our recommendation - definitely!We’re converted

reviews.title: Must stay when in Vegas
reviews.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas offers an exceptional experience with its amazing service and stunning design. The staff is incredibly attentive, ensuring every need is met with warmth and professionalism. The hotel itself is a visual masterpiece, blending luxury with modern elegance. From the elegant rooms to the breathtaking views, every detail is thoughtfully crafted. Whether you're here for relaxation or excitement, Fontainebleau promises a memorable stay.

reviews.title: Fountainbleu Vegas Needs Help
reviews.text: Beautiful property nice staff. They just are going to have a hard time keeping up with the other resorts because of a few issues.One is in the most important, my eyes burned like heck the entire time I was there I was continually putting in eye drops, which caused my nose to also run. I don’t usually have allergies this time of year.I’m pretty sure that I agree with the other reviews on this webpage about whatever they are pumping in to the air! The only other thing I could think of was they allow pets and they use some cleaner to sanitize in the rooms and that could’ve caused it.There is no seating anywhere in the entire huge open spaced lobby or some of the winding hallways because they don’t want anyone sitting - they want people to be in the casino, which is mostly empty…… but if they were smart, they’d  change this. It would look much more aesthetically pleasing- it’s almost like they ran out of money to finish it with couches and chairs like most good resorts have! Also beware that they do not have any coffee in the rooms! Very inconvenient Again, it’s like they ran out of funds for a small Keurig or Nespresso machine!They have some goofy rules about food -some bars you can take food into because they don’t offer any. Also, because there are no tables anywhere or furniture anywhere where would you eat? Besides the food court in the promenade - it is not that cool to sit up there. It’s like you are in a mall. So just know that if you get something in that promenade, you better just eat it there. There was a main bar that lets people bring their food in. We’re not talking about camping out, just a sandwich and of course you clean up your little mess! The resort is pretty I just think that there are better options in Vegas  that are more complete luxury resorts. There is too much competition there for a resort to fall behind in these ways. And they have some of the nicest designer shops! A waste not to fix these issues!

reviews.title: Exceptional Stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Excellent, exceptional experience at the Fontainebleau! The Spa is one of a kind! Stunning, luxurious accommodations and state of the art decor and restaurants. Love this property!!! The restaurants are impeccable, and the food presentation at all outlets are artistic and unique.

reviews.title: Unimpressive
reviews.text: This is the newest hotel/resort on the Strip. Amenities and environments are neck to neck with other top resorts. Elegance is how I described this resort. But I don't see how they set themselves apart with it's being further north of the Strip (not centrally located and in a rougher side of the Strip), with more rigid check in experience. They don't have the best panoramic view like Trump Hotel, they don't have the location like Bellagio or Caesar's or Venetian, their room size is about the same as other top hotels. The only thing they have is "it's new" but new will eventually become old. The only lever they can compete is through pricing. The rigid check in experience was unpleasant and draining, which killed the excitement and anticipation of staying in this place. I walked away unimpressed and will not consider staying here again.For the price they charge, you can stay in other more centrally located resorts on the strip and still have the same or way better experience.They wanted to scan every guest's ID and refuse to own up responsibility for any guest data security breach.The housekeeping was unresponsive when raising inappropriate behavior of a man on in front of the elevator waiting area near the hallway though the surveillance camera should have recorded it.Over-rated.

reviews.title: Everything Was Perfect
reviews.text: I went here in august and then i came back for christmas break in december. everything is so extravagant, literally everything. the hotel is beautiful, the food is so delicious, and so much more. the hotel is very remarkable with its architecture inside and art, making it have such a good modern vegas style. all the restaurants were full of life and fun. the pools and seating were so advanced and pretty. the best best best food was the pizza from miami pizza. i went here 2 times in the past year and i miss it so much already, that’s how much i love it. this hotel is seriously the best hotel in vegas and i can’t wait to come again. thank you for you making this hotel so worth it to visit!!

reviews.title: More subdued, quiet hotel with great bars and restaurants
reviews.text: Very comfortable, clean, large room (we had bleu king).  Beds/pillows were great.  Some electronics (like curtains), but not overly modern rooms.  Location is quite a ways from rest of strip (across from Circus Circus), so 15 minute walk to Wynn, 40 to Paris).  No real theme in hotel, caters to night clubs, and very high end restaurants and exclusive shops.  Free self park garage is very convenient.  In general, due to location and pricing in restaurants I would not return (we are in our 60’s), but if I were young, hip and rich it would be fantastic for the clubs and bars.

reviews.title: Nice!
reviews.text: We had a great visit to the Fountainebleau.  The hotel is clean and smells great.  Our room was very comfortable and spotless. We appreciated the refrigerated drawer and nice bathrooms.  We really liked the pool -- the vibe was festive but not a drunken rager.  The workout facility is amazing and overlooks the Strip.  The service was really what set the property apart.  It was exceptional when compared to other Vegas hotels.  Every single employee was not only good at their job but also really pleasant.  We booked through Amex Fine Hotels and Resorts and they honored each amenity seamlessly.  The only downside to the property is the location.  It's at the far north end with only Circus Circus nearby (yikes).  We took some long walks or ubers during our stay there, so if that bothers you, you may wish to stay elsewhere.

reviews.title: Exceptional service and staff. Good amenities. Boring decor.
reviews.text: We spent one night here on a Sunday night in a double room on the 68th floor with a spectacular view. The room was nothing special and it was gray. I hate gray rooms. But the view was incredible. The room was spacious enough for three of us and they had nice features like the floor ceiling drapes opening and closing with the push of a button. Actually, there were so many buttons it got a little confusing. The spacious bathroom had a soaker tub and a shower. Several light switches and I appreciated a nightlight switch. There was no coffee maker, but there are never coffee makers in Vegas hotels so I bring my own miniature travel water boiler. And make instant. They want you downstairs getting your coffee where you might gamble. (The only exception I have found by the way is the Marriott across from the convention center, which is a standard Marriott with all the typical business amenities, including a coffee maker yay. )Whoever trains, the staff here deserves a bonus because the thing that makes this hotel special is the wonderful service.  We had only been checked in perhaps 10 minutes when there was a knock on the door and a woman from housekeeping was there with a clipboard asking if everything was OK and if there was anything more we needed it. There was a mini bar which I did not plan to use, but she also showed us that there was a refrigerated drawer for your personal items you wanted to keep cool, which was very welcome. She also offered twice to send us up a microwave or a bigger refrigerator if we want it. We were only there for one night and we didn’t need it, but I was impressed. The Bellman brought up our bags quickly after we called down with our room number, and he offered to bring us an additional luggage rack because we only had one. My brothers told him we didn’t need it, but then he turned and asked me and I said sure why not. So a few minutes later, we got a second luggage rack. I was impressed at the hotels desire to make us completely happy.  When I checked in, they also gave me without asking a color laminated map of the resort which I appreciated because it seems nowadays they just want to give you a QR code, which is annoying. It’s so much easier just to look at a paper map in your hand. The casino just seems like a standard casino. Nothing special, but it did not smell smoky at all, which made me very happy. We tried to go down and look at the beautiful pool complex at 6:30 PM but unfortunately we couldn’t even walk out there because it was already closed and the doors were locked. That was super disappointing because I had to leave early the next morning, and I really wanted to see it. I was hoping maybe there was at least a hot tub and a fire pit we could enjoy. Photos of the spot it’s gorgeous, but we didn’t have time to check it out. We ate at the Komodo Asian fusion restaurant and loved it. We are vegetarian and it was easy to order delicious vegetable dishes. The cocktails were very expensive but also really really good. On the second floor, there is an upscale food court with fast food. It’s more attractive than most of its ilk, but we didn’t see anything we wanted to eat since we were not interested in slices of pizza or burgers. The reason I did not give this resort five. Stars is because of the decor. It’s supposedly only a year and a half old but the decor looks really tired and like it’s from the 90s. Dripping modern crystal chandeliers from the ceiling. Yawn. It doesn’t look shabby just boring. Especially in comparison with the other over the top resorts of this quality. Everything from the lobby to the casino to our room just looked bland and uninspired. I don’t know what they were thinking. Even the spacious lobby when you first walk in, had this fragrant and huge display of roses, but it wasn’t interesting to look at. The only decor element I liked was a huge mural sized  colorful painting that was similar to Basquiat. They definitely needed a lot more of that fresh element. Especially since they don’t have the best location on the strip I would’ve liked to have seen much more of a wow factor when I walked in.

reviews.title: Worth the walk from the main strip
reviews.text: I did not stay here, just went to explore. I was looking forward to seeing this place because of its very long history of being abandoned and incomplete. The casino is close to the main doors. Lots of restaurants, even vegan food options. The atmosphere seemed casual but cherry. Workers seemed cheerful, the piped in music was upbeat, it was bright inside with lights and colors. But the bathrooms. You must check out the bathrooms, enough said!I enjoyed my visit.

reviews.title: Amazing!!!!
reviews.text: Aesthetically pleasing, very clean room, amazing customer service, good food. Won $2k on the Wheel of Fortune slot machine! I will definitely stay at the Fountain Bleu in Las Vegas again! If you’re on the fence about staying there, don’t be; I love this resort!

reviews.title: Great food staff and fun
reviews.text: The property is amazing ! Great location to eat drink enjoy time with friends and family . Looking forward to seeing if they can offer the same comps as some of the other property groups on the strip. I would hands down give this property a chance if your looking and will def be a new long time supporter if they can make the comps work

reviews.title: Target on our backs.   Read review. Do you want your family treated as such?
reviews.text: From the first night having our dinner reservations cancelled for wearing open back shoes at Komodo, visiting desk twice but never receiving any resolution to the restaurant mess, the bellhops harrasing us because we ordered giordanos and take out, yelling at my fiancé chastising her saying they are in their better mind to cancel the order because you cannot door dash to this hotel, right up until checkout things having hotel security following us harassing me bc they thought my $40k Leica camera and lense case was full of guns, then escorting us out of hotel forbidding us to return unless we let them inspect our bags in lobby. which we refused. the guard told us that it will not be nice or comfortable if w choose to come back. see photos. this hotel is a nice property but for some reason. we had a target on our backs the moment we stepped in. I do not recommend staying here as it's over priced. thei discourage shopping or dining eksewhere and make no bones about making you uncomfor table if you choose to shop elsewhere.   The staff look down at you and don’t take you seriously.  The security was very threatening and made us fear for our safety.  While there is a lot of riff raff in LV mind you we did absolutely nothing to attract this type of treatment and were only trying to enjoy our first trip to Las Vegas together as a couple photographing the sights and experiences Vegas has to offer. We feeling less than human and left looking over our shoulders not knowing if we would have to defend ourselves.  Fountainblue single handedly ruined our vacation and soured our experience on the city.  Very sad. Very shameful.  Just our airfare was 3400 plus the rooms and what we spent.  All in all it was a 15000 week that left us feeling frustrated and unsafe.

reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text: Nice brand new hotel. Very classy. I wouldn’t stay here again. A little north of the strip and away from the action but peace and quiet is good. Good brunch and dinner restaurants, high end shopping. Casino is really nice! Food hall places are delicious and not too busy—although orders take a long time to fulfill. I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Great get away for the wife and I
reviews.text: Amazing time. Great staff. We did a day at the cabana and pool. Staff there was great. The min spend was reasonable. The bar nowhere was also amazing and great staff. We did dinner at Washington potato. Had the best server I’ve experienced in a very long time. Personally we have nothing but great things to say. I’d go back again

reviews.title: An incredible getaway!
reviews.text: The beautiful rooms were spacious and comfortable, with a fabulous view of Las Vegas! I highly recommend the Spa and all of the amenities included in each package! It was the perfect place for my daughters and I to spend quality time together!

reviews.title: Great stay.
reviews.text: The room was spacious, clean and comfortable. The bathroom was very large and had great amenities. We enjoyed food in the sports book it was delicious, we actually ate there several times, sandwiches were large we shared the meatloaf sandwich, the prime rib sandwich and have the chicken nachos!! The staff was friendly staff everywhere we went. This place is a prime example of you get what you pay for ... we paid and they did not disappoint!

reviews.title: We love the Fontainebleau
reviews.text: Just the best place you can stay.  Upscale, friendly staff, we won in the casino, so many food options.  What's not to love.  Vida for your morning start is a great place to eat.  We do like the pools but haven't been yet this year, we will later in the year when we return.The BEST casino floor staff in all of Vegas.  Make that all of Nevada!!  And plenty of nightlife with more and more big name entertainment always coming.

reviews.title: Room Good/Food bad
reviews.text: Room was nice. Views in room were nice. Casino is nice and clean. Staff was friendly. I was excited to see so much diversity in the staff. Love that parking is not charged to guests of the hotel. The food was not great. We ate at Vida for breakfast. I had the country skillet and it was just a soupy mess of tomato sauce. It was basically inedible. My husband had the omelet and it was the most basic bland omelet. It just wasn't great. I wouldn't eat there for breakfast again. Capon's burgers had a weird system and gave our food away to a woman when it had a man's name on it after we had waited a long time to get it. We had to chase her down to get our food. We went back again another night to get ice cream and that took a long time. Chez Bon Bon was good overall, except there was plastic on the egg of each our breakfast sandwiches. I would still try Chez Bon Bon again, but not the other ones.

reviews.title: Luxurious and stunning resort!
reviews.text: The aromas alone in the lobby are so inviting along with the beauty of the roses! The rooms are beautiful and the view from the 69th floor was mesmerizing. We chose the mountain view and could also see the Sphere. The bathrooms are ample and luxurious. Our room rate was excellent in terms of quality/price. The location is fabulous for the convention center and if you have a car, as we did, nothing is too far away.

reviews.title: The FountaineBleau does not disappoint!
reviews.text: My fifth stay since they opened in December 2023.Offered a reasonably priced room upgrade at check in.  This made me feel like a valued upper customer / rewards member.Room, Staff, and Dining facilities are all top notch in my opinion.  I had some problems with my room account portfolio that were addressed promptly and courteously.The hotel and casino are beautiful structures.  The rewards program is appealing to me and has attainable goals that offer valuable services, like free valet parking...Take the short walk to the Peppermill Restaurant, just across from RW.  It is full of history and character, with large portion meals that easily justify the costs.This will be my "go to" hotel for the foreseeable future.

reviews.title: Very nice and clean hotel.
reviews.text: Positive experience at this property. Very neat in terms of order and cleanliness. The room nice spacious, ours had a view of the sphere and mountains .. Very clean and always stocked with everything you need. Inside the hotel there were several restaurants and bars, as for the restaurants I do not know the quality not having tried while for the bar I can say that I made good breakfasts, a little expensive but acceptable in terms of cost given the average of Las Vegas. Anyway I would stay there again even if it is a bit out of the strip but not too far.Just a note about the room, during the night even with the air conditioning off you could hear an annoying noise.

reviews.title: Fabulous place to stay
reviews.text: I have been there twice.  Once in January and again in March.The hotel has everything you need for your stay.  You don’t need to leave the hotel. Great choice of restaurants.  7 pools, a great gym and the casino is huge.  They offer a great rewards program also.

reviews.title: A good experience...could have been better....
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel with all of the amenities.  Check in was a breeze but we were placed in a room so far away from the elevator that I thought we were in a different building.  The young person who checked us in SAW that my sister was walking with a cane (recent surgery) so it was interesting and inconsiderate that she would do that.  Fortunately, when we asked for a change, we were accommodated immediately.  The place is huge so even getting from the parking lot to the guest elevators was quite a trek.  We ordered room service only once since we spent most of our time out.  But the one time we did order food - two omelets cost nearly $80!  Even with the high cost of eggs this was insane!  No drinks, nothing additional, just two omelets....The one other time we wanted to grab a bite we decided to try the food court.  Everything was closed.  Maybe around 10pm?  Seems one or two places should stay open later - maybe burgers, sandwiches, pizza - since the casinos are open and people are up very late.Overall, it was a decent experience.  The hotel is beautiful, and the rooms are comfortable.  The beds and robes are comfy cozy, and I may stay again.  But there are so many options in Vegas, I may not....

reviews.title: Not typical of Fountainbleau, but I will definitely stay there again
reviews.text: Great place.  I was there for a convention so it was nice to be able to walk to the tradeshow.  Beautiful hotel and comfortable rooms.  Housekeeping didn't do so well of a job on this stay.  They did not inspect the room before I checked in because the drawers should have been emptied out.

reviews.title: Pleasant Stay
reviews.text: Overall, a very good hotel. Staff is very professional and experienced. We use d the gym which is equipped with all the equipment necessary to have a great work out. The SPA is absolutely a must. Restaurants, a must go is Vida for breakfast or lunch. Food is excellent.Another one that tops it all is ITO located at the top of the hotel. Only two seatings 6pm and 8:30pm I believe. Breathtaking experience not only for the superb food but for the view.

reviews.title: Lights came on randomly in the middle of the night.
reviews.text: Worst hotel room I have ever had. A hotel's fundamental purpose is to allow you to sleep and the Fontainebleau Las Vegas failed at that. The lights in the room came on randomly at 11:21pm and at 4:48am. When I called the front desk and asked if this happens to other people, the answer I got was "in some rooms the lights sometimes randomly flicker on".  Ours did not flicker; they came on and stayed on. To turn them off I had to read the complex bedside panel to find the "off" button.The front desk person offered to send the facilities maintenance team.It is an otherwise very nice hotel.

reviews.title: Not the greatest for being the newest
reviews.text: For the price I would go back to Aria from now on. Pretty place but nothing that stands out. Food court is garbage. Restaurants that I could get into couldn't cook steaks to right temp, but took so long to get first time wouldn't send back. If u wanted to walk anywhere u can go a mile to wynn or resort world that had much better food. There was a shooting g at circu circus while we were there watching out windows.

reviews.title: Please train the front desk better
reviews.text: I was so excited to try Fontaine Bleau but I don’t think I’d go back. To start, our room was not ready when we checked in and we didn’t get into our room till after 7pm and 3 trips back to wait in line at the front desk. I overheard several others having similar issues. This set the tone for our entire stay and was extremely disappointing. Once inside, I found several hairs in both the tub and shower. We did have a resort credit so we tried a few restaurants on property. The food was ok but extremely overpriced for what it was ($115 for 2 sandwiches and soda !?) On the good side, the rooms are new with lots of outlets and that was convenient. We also liked the view and how close it was to the Convention center. Overall, there are many other choices in Vegas. This will not be at the top of list for us again.

reviews.title: Made a memorable trip
reviews.text: Check in was quick and easy, though we arrived late at night. Beware if you are sensitive to smells as this hotel like many, pump strong perfume out into the air. A large hold was placed on my credit card upon check in, something to be prepared for.My kid and I were in a two Queen Better Mountain view room on the 61st floor for 5 days. The room was beautiful and clean, other than the half eaten food that was not cleaned out of the fridge from the previous guests. The pillows, bedding and mattresses were dreamy. Extremely comfortable. All of the lights and drapes were controlled with panels by the door and bed. The bathtub was massive and could probably fit 6 people comfortably. The hotel has excellent water pressure and the enormous tub did not take long to fill at all. Toilet and shower had their own separate stalls which is nice for privacy when you are sharing a room.There were plenty of drawers and an illuminated closet with very cozy bath robes. The ‘pay bar’ fridge was the size of a normal mini fridge but the fridge you could put your own food or drink items in was extremely tiny. For some reason they have included compartments to separate items which takes up even more of the space.Climate control worked well. I do have a complaint about the noise. Almost every night without fail, we were woken up by women fighting in the halls. Also traffic and music at ground level despite being so high up were very loud. I ate at two of the food court places, the burger and the pizza ones. Both were delicious but the pizza really stood out. I frequented the Bon Bon Cafe daily and nightly for their lattes and also their selection of gelato which I would eat in my giant bubble bath! I liked the proximity to the Fireside Restaurant as well as the Walgreens down the road just past the Sahara (go there for drinks and snacks, not the AMPM). I had purchased unlimited passes to the monorail but found it was too much of a hassle to walk to the nearest station and resorted to taking ride share instead. Check out consisted of simply turning my keys in and leaving, however a few days later I had charged on my credit card from the hotel with no folio or explanation as to what they were for, so I do wish I had waited for a receipt. Overall, I would stay here again and I would recommend it to others. I feel like the hotel had a lot more to offer that I didn’t get a chance to experience.

reviews.title: Going to Vegas and not checking out Fontainebleau would be a mistake!
reviews.text: The fontainebleau in Las Vegas is worth every effort to visit. The staff truly welcomes you and makes every effort to make you feel important as a guest. The cleanliness is way above average for casinos. It is off the strip but a short cab ride from wherever you are staying- the pools are amazing and the food choices cover everything!!

reviews.title: Spring break family trip
reviews.text: We were in town for spring break with my son and daughter.  Room was beautiful, plenty of good food options for all of us and went to see the Pitbull residency show which was so fun.  Breakfast at Cafe Cuto was delicious - only wish there was more seating.  Kids enjoyed Miami Slice and El Bagel.

reviews.title: Spring at the Fontainebleau
reviews.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas was exceptional! Food was delicious, rooms were comfortable and clean! In room dining for breakfast was very good. LA Fontaine for lunch and Miami Slice for midnight snack hit the spot. We will definitely be back. Thank you!

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: We stayed at FB and had a great weekend!  This place is beautiful and offers great food and gaming experience.  The GYM is a top gym with everything needed for a workout during your stay.  We also enjoyed drinks at the BLEAU bar right in the middle of the casino floor.  Such a great HOTEL, we will be back next month for sure!

reviews.title: The Pros and Cons of Size
reviews.text: Fontainebleau is a gigantic structure with two valet entrances. The entry is cavernous. Noise throughout is intense and busy. For some, this could be a plus. Mixture of casino and hotel is apparent. Orientation is as expected in casino hotel. Stayed in Royal Suite, gigantic soaking tub, high quality, nice. Two rooms, separate bedroom, fabulous views. Nice decor. Bed, King, excellent, tooth brushes and shaving accoutrements a nice extra, cleaning service great. Cons: No coffee maker in room, to order half a liter of coffee is $32 and up. The setup for restaurants forces wandering the casino. I do gamble, but I hate roaming or searching for restaurants I can’t find. Always waited with the crowds in morning around Azul entrance. I usually stay at 4 Seasons. Fontainebleau is not at the level of the 4 Seasons, but its newness is worth a visit.

reviews.title: Best of the Best
reviews.text: Best Hotel in Vegas, the best experience for a family getaway, it has everything for all ages. The staff is very attentive and always attentive to all the details, the rooms are very well maintained. The restaurants are perfect and their food is exquisite, the service at the bars in the pool are excellent.

reviews.title: Top Notch
reviews.text: First time staying at this property and loved it. The rooms were clean and luxe. They thought of everything from variable lighting in the rooms and bath, to soft close drawers in the dressers and night stands, even motion activated closet lights. It was so nice not to have your typical low quality hotel hair dryer and iron. Instead they had a T3 professional hair dryer and an  easy to use garment steamer. The beds and pillows were incredible too. Love the floor to ceiling windows for a fantastic view of the sphere and strip. I know you won’t be disappointed if you book your stay here.

reviews.title: Breathtakingly beautiful and exquisite
reviews.text: Upon entering, I was taken away by the entrance area. The hotel looked very clean and refreshing. I loved the rose display that sits in the middle of the floor. The chandeliers are breathtaking. The center bar in the casino area is absolutely beautiful. The restaurants and shops were very classy. If you dine, be sure to dine at VIDA...they have blueberry pancakes that will knock your socks off. There were beyond delicious. There was construction going on inside, that caused a bad look, but it didn't interfere with maneuvering through the hotel. We did encounter some issues within our room that were resolved quickly, but those issues did make me frown upon my experience, which is why I did not give 5 stars. Had I not encountered any issues, I would have definitely given 5 stars. I have, however, recommended this hotel to others that have asked about our experience, personally. Despite the issues, I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Fontainebleau Las Vegas.
reviews.text: The hotel is wonderful. Our experience was top-notch. Everything was clean well-maintained weight staff were courteous and professional. We loved lounging by the pool. There were more than enough seats. And I love the fitness center. It was incredibly well appointed and easy to maintain my Fitness goals while away from home.

reviews.title: Great Weekend
reviews.text: FREE parking. Great room, pool, and food. Loved breakfast at VIDA. Had a great time at the pool. Pool water was clean and warm. Ate lunch at the pool and enjoyed the food. Loved the huge bathtub in the room. Loved all the lighting buttons in the room.

reviews.title: Fantastic resort/casino
reviews.text: Fontainebleau is one of the best resort/casinos in Vegas. Every single person we dealt with was as friendly and professional as could be. The room was clean, modern, and well appointed. The casino is great (we're blackjack players and unlike most Vegas casinos they aren't trying to win ever. single. hand.) I cannot recommend them highly enough

reviews.title: Opulence and Grandeur
reviews.text: Truly one of the best experiences at our recent visit. From the room, to the food, to pool and safety, it was all perfect. The staff were friendly and helpful.   This was our first get away as empty nesters to celebrate my 50th birthday. The room and views were perfect. Everything is high end, down to the toiletries in the bathroom. The bleau bar is opulent and phenomenal. I found myself without one of my credit cards after visiting the bar. It was given to lost and found (Kansas girls shouldn't leave Kansas!). The promenade had great, affordable food options. My favorite was Miami Slice! It was still pretty cool outside but went to the pool to soak up some vitamin D. Plenty of chairs and very clean(the whole resort, really). While we are not the biggest gamblers, the casino floor was great. Plenty of slots and gaming tables. It didn't feel jammed packed because of the high ceiling, like many of the casinos. I can't wait for my next visit!

reviews.title: Overall, Absolutely Amazing stay with 2 small concerns
reviews.text: This was am absolutely beautiful hotel/casino with top notch service, restaurants, and shops.  Our stay there was wonderful, and we thoroughly enjoyed exploring some of the many wonderful restaurants, bars, and cafes, especially the specialty chocolate shop and gelato shop. We attended a concert at their venue, which was an amazing experience.  They handled the sold out crowd with no delays and no issues.I had only 2 issues which prevented 5 star rating.  First, and not sure if all of the hotels are doing this, but note that there are no coffee makers in any of the rooms.  I called to inquire, and they confirmed, no coffeemakers.  So if you're an early riser, or had a late night out, you need to get dressed and leave your room to get coffee. They have plenty of choices, but all coffee, just regular "drip" is $7 for a medium in any of their cafes / patisseries/ food court/ etc.The other issue was the room.  Although VERY beautiful, and clean, with one of the most comfortable beds we have ever slept in, the room we booked stated "Mountain View", which was a stretch.  Although the mountains were visible in the way distance, most of our view was blocked by the incredibly awful Circus Circus Hotel, quite possibly the ugliest remaining hotel on the strip. The other issue is that the Fontainebleau had a VERY large (we saw it from our plane) display board with rotating visuals and dynamic images of all of their restaurants, shows, and amenities.  Although beautiful, is was on 24 hours a day, and even with our privacy drapes drawn, lit up our whole room all night.  We were already unpacked and settled in before we realized it late on our first night, and with only 3 nights there, didn't ask to switch, so I'm not sure how they would have handles it or if they would have up charged us for another "view".  I would highly recommend a stay here, but note the coffee maker issue (it is very important to some travelers), and be careful of inquiring about the view and what's outside your window.

reviews.title: Definitely will stay here again!
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, the room was nice, but the staff are outstanding! They were kind and considerate and made my family believe they truly cared that we had a good experience. The pool area was a bit crowded and I had to stand the entire time I watched my grandson swim.

reviews.title: This casino will take every dollar you have not just on gaming!!
reviews.text: This hotel is seemingly struggling to make ends meet.
