We ordered room service tonight , 2 items, sliders and lobster rolls totalling $59 and was handed a bill for $91, we had asked for two empty glasses and we’re charged $5 dollars each for the empty glasses, we graciously gave the glasses back and said no thank you please remove them from our bill, we were also charged 18% gratuity and a nine dollar service fee. When we asked about the nine dollar service fee and what it was for on top of the gratuity, we were told it was a Casino charge. Keep in mind we were ordering room service to our hotel room and clearly the nine dollar service charge is just an extra money grab. The manager, I spoke to you tried every excuse in the book. Honestly, the customer service at this hotel is terrible. You don’t recommend it, they are far more capable casinos in Las Vegas than this one.

reviews.title: Vegas fun
reviews.text: One of best hotels on strip, modern , spacious and never felt crowded. High quality rooms and experience . Go for rooms overlooking pool and high as you can get - great views .Really top draw swimming pools and great fitness facility . Crowned off with 2 great barista style coffee shops -1 open24 hrs.

reviews.title: Terrible Experience at Property, Beware!
reviews.text: Terrible service and property. Never received  new host after my old one was terminated. Restaurants commit fraud by charging illegal tips. Beware. Overall guest services are absolutely terrible with attitude and security knocking on bathroom door 6 times in HL slots area causing major disturbance. Be aware, and look at the Wynn or Venetian as an alternative.

reviews.title: Worked for us!
reviews.text: Went for a quick getaway with the fam and wanted to try this hotel. It was perfect. Clean, wonderful service. Our room was basic but it was a decent size and very clean. Staff was on top of things and very kind. I will absolutely go back as soon as I have the chance.

reviews.title: It was worth the wait
reviews.text: Overall wonderful experience.After all the years of sitting half finished they really did something special there.Our room was great, everything was spotless and the dining options were fantastic.The staff was friendly and very knowledgeable.

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.text: This hotel is amazing. The scent as you enter is incredible. The rooms are spectacular. Beds and pillows so comfortable. Felt like I was sleeping on a cloud. Classier crowd outside the strip. Beautiful experience. The casino is gorgeous. A lot of beautiful shops! The check in was flawless. Staff all so friendly.  Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Not my cup of tea!
reviews.text: Nice luxury hotel but not my cup of tea. (Boring vibe) but I must say our room was perfect clean with a nice view!For me it was awful air freshener smell on the main floor  gave me a headache the two days I was  there and it discouraged me from gaming and trying  out to the hotel restaurants.

reviews.title: Great Pools!
reviews.text: Such a great property and second time staying. They make it hard to stay anywhere else. The service is top notch and anywhere you go you get great service. They have some of the best venues for clubs, pools, day parties, and restaurants! Enjoy the view from our room and have one of the best hotel gyms. Will definitely stay again!

reviews.title: Would recommend to everyone!
reviews.text: This hotel was breath taking, from the reception areas to the rooms. Everything was finished to such a high standard. The comfiest beds and pillows and it also offered some of the nicest food I have experienced. Would recommend this hotel to anyone visiting vegas.

reviews.title: Pool closure for ‘weather’ on reasonably nice day.
reviews.text: They completely closed the pool with little explanation other than ‘weather.’ Not even allowed to sit outside. It was a bit on the chilly side and windy, but truly not that bad - 60 degrees, with winds up to 20 mph (and was only supposed to get better). Will not stay here again. There are other places that won’t close completely for mild weather concerns. Incredibly, incredibly disappointing. Strong regrets. Would never have booked here if we’d known they would completely shut down over a bit of wind. Avoid this hotel.

reviews.title: Dangerous mold in bathroom so bad mushrooms were growing
reviews.text: Mold so bad in the bathroom mushrooms were growing, don’t be fooled by this beautiful new facade. We brought the mold to management’s attention and they downgraded our room and simply offered us a food and beverage credit less than one night’s stay when we had already been there for 5 nights. Was a truly bizarre experience

reviews.title: Nice room with a view of the Sphere by........
reviews.text: Room was very nice with a good view of the Sphere. Tavern restaurant food mediocre at best.  Casino is very poor at payout for amount of bet placed. Concert arena is a nice place to see a concert but a $64.00 margarita in a souvenir cup a bit too much

reviews.title: 10/10 Would Stay Here Again
reviews.text: Great experience! All staff is friendly and attentive, I couldn’t be happier with the experience! Amber at Bleau Bar and Shayla at LIV Beach are the sweetest servers and will take great care of you! Do not miss out on the Lapis Spa, the Celestial Waters experience is very relaxing

reviews.title: Avoid at All Costs
reviews.text: My card was hacked on check-in. It was downhill from there. No one helped. Locked out. Cynthia was rude and condescending. As a 30 year local, having stayed in every luxury casino and some not, this place is NOT a place I would ever step foot into again. Don's is a joke: $85 filet was tough and mushrooms inedible. Outback is better!Don't bother to visit. Better off going to Miami or not at all. Bet it will not be long in FB brand. It just doesn't belong there. Oh, there's an odor not well hidden by the fragrance in the air. Mr Soffer should be ashamed!

reviews.title: Pretty but needs better service and attention to detail
reviews.text: It’s a beautiful hotel but I was disappointed with the lack of attention to detail that the property has. First and foremost, at check in they neglected to put my Fine Hotel guaranteed 4pm late check out so of course we could not get back into our room. Once calling the front desk from outside our room, they made us walk all the way back downstairs where we waited in another line. Then that guy asked us our hotel room number and then said we were on a government room (what?) and had a 11am check out. Then he stated a room number that we were not in, to which I had to correct him that that was not our room number, and then he finally located my reservation to then say “oh you have a 4pm check out.” There was no apology for the inconvenience or mix up or the fact that he tried to tell us that we were wrong about our check out time. And then finally after going all the way back to the room, we were in the room and then the shades all closed and the television turned off after five minutes. The room was pretty and the bathroom was gorgeous, but at one point we smelled something was off and it was the back of the bathroom door with a robe that was folded nicely but clearly was old and unwashed. The back of the door was an absolutely awful rancid smell. The closet door by the handle was stained. I am disappointed that while I loved the look and feel of the room and hotel, I was not happy with how we were treated by the front desk regarding the mix up on our check out time. And the cleanliness of the bathroom — that door was awful.Steve - probably a pit boss? - on the casino floor was super helpful and the best level of service we got during our stay.

reviews.title: Humidity in the room at the edge of human comfort
reviews.text: The hotel is outstanding in many ways—truly a 10 out of 10. However, I can’t help but wonder: why do we build spaces for humans that feel so uninhabitable?The humidity in the rooms is consistently below 30%, sometimes dropping as low as 20%—a level at the extreme edge of human comfort. Waking up with a blocked nose and a sore throat becomes inevitable.Why create such an environment? Why not allow windows to open or implement better air circulation to naturally maintain humidity at a more comfortable level, at least 40%?I appreciate that humidifiers are available, but they are not a standard part of the room setup. Even when provided, they struggle to reach 40%, taking hours to make a noticeable difference.Ultimately, the designers who created this hotel (who I'm sure you payed extremely well) have failed the most basic test: be human with humans.

reviews.title: Luxurious Las Vegas
reviews.text: Excellent stay! Hotel rooms were luxuriously appointed. They thought of everything. Robes and slippers were provided. The Bathroom had toothpaste, shaving cream along with a razor and toothbrush. The bed was incredibly comfortable. The bathroom was huge. The toilet closet should have had a door but otherwise it was great. Drapes and lights are operated with switches that are everywhere. We had a room looking at sphere and that was a great view. The casino had everything you would want and wasn’t crowded. They had lounges everywhere that you could sit and talk. The sportsbook was great on a Saturday afternoon for college basketball watching. We didn’t eat dinner here but definitely want to try Papi Steak and Mother Wolf next time. They need a few more casual breakfast options. Hotel is still being built out so I will want to come back when it is all finished. Great hotel for adults in Vegas

reviews.title: Beautiful but Boring
reviews.text: This hotel has no energy, no Vegas Vibe.  If you’re looking for clubs, pubs, shopping, heck excitement, choose one of the other hotels.  This one is located at the North Part of the strip so expect paying extra for transportation on a daily basis.  We spent all of our evenings elsewhere cause there’s nothing exciting going on here,  there’s only 5-6 places at the food court but closed after 10pm.  Very disappointing and very expensive even for Vegas standards.

reviews.title: Incredible Stay All-Around
reviews.text: From check-in to check-out, from Spa to Pool, from housekeepers to games Dealers and from one Guest to another......nothing but welcoming kindness.Truly an incredible hotel. Had smiley faces the entire time! Well done Fountainebleau Las Vegas. Can't wait to come back.

reviews.title: Stunningly Beautiful...But...
reviews.text: My family (all adults) wanted to visit the property as we had not seen it before. We did not stay at the resort. It is breathtakingly beautiful. The colors, decor, casino, and layout are gorgeous and unique. This is where things go south. While there, we stopped at the 'food court' to grab an easy bite. The service was terrible, the food barely warm enough, and our order was incomplete. When we brought it to their attention (with the receipt) they told us we hadn't ordered the items missing,... and then, they read the entire receipt. They filled part of it right away, and then we waited another 10 minutes for the last item. I'm not one to, create a scene, so we didn't raise a fuss there. All told, while we don't have a problem paying crazy prices for a unique experience, ultimately, after this, we truly have no inspiration to return.

We had an AMAZING stay at the Fontainebleau hotel. It was a 10/10…very clean and we had exceptional views on the 53rd floor. The bed was very comfortable and the robes were so thick and warm. Our standard room was so spacious. The hotel was very modern (I loved) and the restaurants had great food - Azul, Miami Slice & the Sports bar. It was close proximity to everything we could have needed. We really enjoyed our 3 night stay and would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Fountainebleu concert weekend
reviews.text: This is our second stay. The rooms are beautiful  and spacious. The bathrooms are big and huge shower. We have booked the gold executive king room both times. We were able to get a nice view of the Sphere. Beautiful casino and nice atmosphere. Definitely would stay there again in the future.

reviews.title: Go back for sure
reviews.text: Great hotel, beautifull roses in the lobby and a good experience. Staff is very friendly.No problems. Will go there again.Great casino en theater.Restaurants are tasty.Nice place on the strip.Travelled to a lot of different places in vegas, the strip en freemont street but i can recommend Fontainblue.

reviews.title: Nice, New, Not Staying Here Again
reviews.text: 1. we stayed here primarily for the spa. However, when we arrived, they said there are no reservations left, unless we paid for a service, which was another 60 dollars for a 40 minute chair massage? A chair massage for 60 bucks? I could get a full body Thai or Swedish massage for 60 bucks. Clearly a scam.2. The location isn't great and is out of the way. If you want to go to the strip for other activities, you'd have to pay for parking or uber. If #1 wasn't available, why would I ever stay here again? Half the stores aren't open, so forget shopping and the food options are limited.I've worked in Vegas for many years and stayed at all hotels on the strip, mainly Caesars. Fountainebleau's rooms are pretty much the Augustus Tower in Caesar, but you're in the prime location of the Strip. Hence, I wouldn't recommend anyone staying here, unless the rates were super cheap. Not worth the location hassle and their trickery to upcharge you on the things that are actually worth doing.

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: Bed and bedding were very comfortable,  it is extremley important for us to sleep well. The robe was very nice but my skin started burning and turning red.  Very spacious and quiet room with a great view, we choose strip view room.Staff was extremely polite and eager to help. Really loved the technology of the lights and drapes it was great to turn all the lights on and off with one touch.Plenty of outlets throughout the Room.Unfortunately no coffee maker, but a clothes steamer  was handy.  Wish the fridge would have a little room to put a beverage or left over. There was however a cooling drawer that worked good for a few bottles of water. We enjoyed our stay.

reviews.title: Amazing Hotel Experience
reviews.text: We had an incredible experience and will definitely be returning to this hotel. From the moment we checked in until the end of our stay, everyone was incredibly friendly and welcoming. Lee at the front desk was especially kind and helpful, ensuring we had a fantastic view of the Sphere.We treated ourselves to the Lapis Spa experience, booking a massage and enjoying the amenities. A special shout-out to Grace, the amazing masseuse, who worked wonders on releasing all my tension and knots. It was one of the best spa experiences I've had, and I’ll definitely be back.The location is perfect, and there are so many great restaurants to explore on our next visit. Thank you for a fun weekend.

reviews.title: Fantastic with unbelievable spa!!
reviews.text: Fantastic with unbelievable spa!!  This is a must go it you enjoy a unique and massive spa area.  We also enjoyed the excellent dining options and Miami slice is key to cover you in a pinch quickly.  Finally it was an easy walk to several Vegas staples including the Pinkbox Donut.

reviews.title: Fontainebleau did not disappoint!
reviews.text: Overall fantastic experience! It’s immaculate and inviting. No smoke smell at all and the staff rocked it. It’s quieter than the  casinos on the strip, but on the other hand, it is far from the strip so it’s a taxi or uber to visit that area.  One plus, it was not as crowded when we were there so moving around was easy! Downside, no coffee makers in your room, and no Starbucks in the casino…not really a deal breaker, but I do love my Starbucks. Would we stay there again? Hell yeah!

reviews.title: new hotel with nice facilities & minimal cigarette odor
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay: new & spacious room, huge fitness center, good restaurants, best of all barely any cigarrete odor. Room was state of the art with all the bells & whistles, we had a great view of the Sphere, love the huge bathroom which had shower as well as a hot tub, there was a safety box. We didnt gamble but ate at several restaur. Washing Potato dimsm was better than I expected, love that petite pineapple bbq pork bun. La Fontaine was just ok. Cafe Cuto had good pastries such as the signature raspberry bowtie croissant. Fitness center was the largest I have even seen in any hotel, prob the size of any local gyms.  I would def return if the price is rght.

reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: 1 night stay, but overall great! The rooms were really nice. No issues with staff or parking. It was a nice experience overall. The location isn’t my favorite, but that’s just my preference since I’m used to staying closer to the middle of the strip where there’s lots of places to walk to.

reviews.title: Hidden gem
reviews.text: Nice new hotel. Hallways are very spacious, lots of high-end shopping, the service is great. Really awesome pool area. Their sports book is combined with a tavern which is really cool and relaxing to hang out and watch a sporting event at or just to dine. The rooms are beautiful with lots of technology in them automatic opening drapes and lights and all the right hook ups for charging equipment. The showers have amazing pressure and you will get a great night sleep in those comfortable beds and pillows. I was here in March so it’s very reasonably priced right now. They also have a great concert hall.

reviews.title: Old Hollywood glamour meets Las Vegas.
reviews.text: As a longtime admirer of our Miami property, I was beyond excited to discover that I could bask in that same enchanting old Hollywood charm at there Las Vegas location! From the very moment I stepped inside, I was absolutely dazzled by the elegance of the property, which radiates the glamour of a bygone era.The staff truly elevated my experience; they were warm, attentive, and genuinely invested in making my visit extraordinary. The atmosphere was dripping with sophistication, making it feel as though I had walked right into a classic film. Every moment I spent there was pure joy, and I can’t wait to return and dive even deeper into all the incredible offerings the property presents.Everything about my stay was outstanding! From the luxurious accommodations that enveloped me in comfort to the exquisite design elements that evoke nostalgia, this place undeniably lives up to the celebrated reputation of our original location. I am already counting down the days until I can immerse myself once again in that timeless old Hollywood ambiance!If you're looking for a classic hotel experience that stands apart from the usual Las Vegas scene, this is the ultimate destination to relive a forgotten era of glitz and unparalleled customer service. Don't miss out!

reviews.title: Won’t budge on resort fee when services not provided
reviews.text: Stayed here twice, pool closed both times and still had to pay full resort fee. They told me resort fee had nothing to do with pool. Kinda like a rental car company saying A/C not working is not part of rental agreement. That woman that checked me in 3/6/25 told me that.

reviews.title: Rewards program is pitiful
reviews.text: Their rewards program is pitifully.  Their so called hosts are really just customer service reps that don’t really understand their job is meaning of customer service.   I have stayed there and reached silver tier status and get offers regularly from FB.  When you actually call to speak to a host, you get a poorly trained , un-accommodating customer service rep that could not care less about meeting your needs or helping you.     The Wynn, any of The Stations Properties, and the Venetian all offer better service.     I spread my play amongst many casinos, so partially my fault—but I know good service and training from bad.   FB is just plain bad.

reviews.title: Service issues, lack of 24/7 food options, nice rooms
reviews.text: At face value this place looks great. New build, beautiful, food options, all the usual Vegas style amenities. However, as someone who is a frequent traveler and expects a lot when I’m paying a lot of money, this experience had several key cracks that revealed some issues in primarily two categories:- service quality / customer care - amenities To start, check in was far from smooth. I’ll spare you all the details but we spent around one hour just to both get into the room. The room itself was beautiful. Design flaws in the bathroom which has a water runoff issue, the shampoo bottles are inconvenient to operate, and the shower doesn’t get warmer than a sort of average temperature. Mini bar etc well stocked and lots of options. There are no proper sit down food or snack options late night (and I’m talking like 10-11pm lol) on a weeknight besides some cafe that had run out of most items. This is a disgrace. We are in Las Vegas which is known for partying off hours. I had even made a dinner reservation that evening at Komodo at 10:30. I first got a call at 7 from the hostess asking if we can come earlier. No, I said, we cannot. Then at 9:30 she calls me again to tell me the restaurant is closing early and my reservation is being cancelled.I worked in fine dining restaurants for five years and not once did we close our restaurant early even if we only had one couple on the books for the latest possible reservation slot. Very poor hospitality and when I asked her for other options in the hotel we got sent to that french cafe. No thanks!! I don’t want a stale pastry for dinner under overhead lights. That night we had bar snacks from Collins bar for dinner. Ridiculous. Anyways, willing to look past it, we went about the rest of our five day trip. We took a trip to Lapis spa and I had really hyped up this experience to my partner; who had never gotten a couples massage before. We got there and the lobby was so… vibrant?! Lots of people with luggage lounging about chatting loudly/ the opposite of a calming spa welcome that I’m used to virtually anywhere I’ve been in the world. It was chaotic and loud and social. Inside not much better, the plunge pool/sauna area was totally overrun by so many people, loud chatter, etc. you’d think you were at a pool party. Further, we did end up eating breakfast at La Fontaine which was great. Also there were issues with housekeeping. They did not come the first day until like 3pm despite me calling twice in the morning to get our room fixed up and being told it had been noted. Just tell me if you can’t do it but I’m planning my time around it. Further, no personal touches or requests for feedback throughout our stay. It’s a 5 star property but felt like I was sleeping in a giant mall. This place needs to train all their staff much better, needs to expand food options around the clock, needs to seriously improve their check-in services, and needs a new spa manager.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: I'm feeling picky. The receptionist was not having a good day? She did not give us a rundown; we saw other guests getting welcome waters which is key in the desert. On that note, there are water dispensers in the ice rooms on each floor, but they are not well filtered (bad taste). We walked to the store and bought bottled water. The rooms were nice, clean. The lighting switches can be confusing. Like most Vegas hotels, the hotel itself is just too big. It was a 1:20 walk from the elevator to our room. We got 7K steps each day just going to and from the lobby every day. The two restaurants we went to were great. The service at the Collins bar is wonderful. The gym is the nicest hotel gym I've ever used; it has everything.

reviews.title: Convenient and Fun
reviews.text: Comfortable rooms.  Wonderful tower views.  Modernized outlets and sufficient outlets.  Closer to both the downtown area and the strip.  There are lots of events and dining places that make this place a convenient location if you don't want to venture out to the downtown area.

reviews.title: Fontainebleu Las Vegas is my new favorite destination in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The reom was beautifully decorated and very spacious. The bed was so comfortable and cozy. The bathroom included an amazing shower and soakng tub, and the towels were so soft! The staff from checkin, bell service, concierge, valet and housekeeping strived to meet my every need.

reviews.title: Second visit was as good as the first.
reviews.text: This was our second visit to the FOUNTAIN BLUE (as they all seem to pronounce it) ;)It did not disappoint.  The staff is fantastic (shout out to "Jay" (sp?) at check in.  Wide hallways, super clean, beautiful rooms, if slightly less "lux" than the Wynn.  Love this place.We ate at MOTHER WOLF, LA FOUNTAINE (incredible breakfast), WASHING POTATO, KOMODO, and on or last visit, DON'S PRIME.  All of them were sincerely outstanding.  I don't throw these words around loosely, I panned my last visit to an upscale Gordon Ramsey restaurant in London - it sucked HARD.Anyway, the Fontainebleau is first class, it's right up there with the Wynn for top choice in LV.  If you're on the fence - GO.

reviews.title: Best of the Best Place to Stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas is out of this world fabulous.  Parking is easy. The lobby is full of fresh floral arrangements. The chandeliers are breath taking. We enjoyed a wonderful concert in the comfortable theater. The food was good and a nice variety is offered.  The casino is clean and the staff is attentive. Our room offered a terrific view.  Beds are so amazing and the lighting in our room was perfect.  Amazing hotel!

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful. Extremely clean. Restaraunts were amazing. No riffraff. Easy check in.  Very polite staff. The food is amazing. Pappi steak was just great!  Baked clams were to die for. Wagyu strip steak was on point. Service was amazing.

reviews.title: Beautiful Newer Hotel
reviews.text: Stayed here for a girls' trip. The hotel and rooms are beautiful and a good value! You can tell it's a newer hotel. Loved the bathroom and robes! The staff were great and went out of their way to make things right. My server forgot to put my lunch order in at the pool, an hour later when I asked about it, she was very apologetic and didn't charge me for my food. The shade umbrella on a chair we rented was broken, so they heavily discounted it. These things happen. We did request adjoining rooms, but upon check-in, they said they couldn't accommodate it, but when we went to the rooms, the adjoining room was almost done with housekeeping.  Better communication would have been better as they still wouldn't let us change rooms so we could be together. Keep in mind that you will need an Uber to go anywhere on the strip. This added up fast. Also give yourself a lot of time! The walk to the car pick up is far, the lines are long, and it takes a really long time for the driver to get out of the hotel, though the lights and onto the main drive. We were really late to our dinner reservations. We would not recommend the spa. We booked massages at the spa for around 315. We showed up at 2, so we would have time to enjoy the rooms and saunas, but it took over 45 minutes to check in. We had dinner reservations, so we could not stay afterward. They left us sitting forever in the main lobby because they were "understaffed," so we didn't get to enjoy the rest of the spa. The massages were over $500 each, so you would expect more. The place was bright and not really warm and relaxing once we did get to go inside. The sushi place in the hotel was wonderful!

reviews.title: FONTAINEBLEAU is the TOP Hotel on the Strip!
reviews.text: FB continues to exceed and anticipate your every wish.  Without a doubt, this is now the new Luxury Property on the strip.  I can not say enough good things about this property, the staff, the spa, or our gaming experience. We can not wait to return.  FONTAINEBLEAU is the TOP Hotel on the Strip!

reviews.title: Good, but VERY expensive if you eat or drink there.
reviews.text: Very new hotel, and located next to the LV Convention Center.Room was great, Elevators can be slow, and personnel are very friendly.Very clean and friendly, in general.  Maintained very well.  VERY EXPENSIVE compared to alternatives.  I am considering staying at the Conrad next time.  Very comparable ammenities, more dining venues, and lower pricing in general.  Spa was $180 for four hours use of the spa - not included in the room rate.Restaurants averaged over $120 per person, and that was only with one drink.  Exceptionally expensive.If money is not important, then this is the place for you.  If you want a luxury hotel that is a fair value, the rooms meet this criteria, but everywhere that you go in that complex is going to reach into your pocket and not let go.

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel with caveats
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful. I enjoyed the quiet of the casino floor. It wasn't blasting in your face. The restaurants are fantastic. The conference center was excellent - probably the best in Las Vegas. My issues came with the hotel side. I am 6'4" and I had requested a king room at reservation (a month before) due to the need for the longer length so my feet wouldn't stick off the bed. When I went to check-in, the hotel hadn't reserved a king room for me, nor did they have one to give me for at least two of the nights of the 4 I would be staying with them. Honestly, the rooms are beautiful and if their checkin/reservation systems were fixed, this would be a 5 star place.

reviews.title: Fitness Centre needs a rethink
reviews.text: Beautiful Hotel but the Fitness Centre has serious safety issues.  I was injured twice in the same week using their gym due to the actions of other gym patrons.  The spacing of equipment stations is too close together, which can result in a misuse of equipment causing injury to others.  They also have two spinning tower racks of dumbbells, and I was injured by these when someone spun the rack while I was putting away a 70lb dumbbell, breaking my toe.  The Fitness centre needs a serious rethink to remove some cardio stations and give more room to weightlifting equipment, the spinning dumbebell racks need to be replaced by a regular style with all weights in a row at waist level.

reviews.title: First time and won't be our last
reviews.text: This is the first time staying here. We came to see Heart in concert and loved it. The hotel was pristine and beautiful. Check in was easy and they were very nice during that process. The room was fantastic and gorgeous. The bed was very comfortable and the views were amazing. We had a view of the strip which includes the sphere. The hotel wasn't super busy which was great because it wasn't crowded. The restaurants at the promenade weren't busy at all and the food at Capon and the begal were so good. We ate dinner one night at the Tavern which offered really good pub/sportbar food. The casino was fun and we walked away winners. And the music played at the hotel was awesome... 70s and 80s. We would totally stay here again!!!!

reviews.title: Fontainebleau Las Vegas… ok but lacks charm
reviews.text: This hotel is massive and although very clean and new, it lacks the charm of most of the other hotels in Vegas, especially when its closest neighbour (Wynne) has so much charm. The restaurants are trying to be high end but the prices are very high for the food quality that we were served. We ate at Vida, Komodo, Cafe Cuto, and several outlets at the food court. We actually had a bad experience at both the Taco outlet (upset tummies) and the Sandwich concession (Nona’s) who took so long to prep our sandwiches that we nearly missed our check out time on the last day. No complaints re the bars or casino. We saw “Heart” live in concert at Bleu Live Theatre. We booked these tickets in advance from the UK and again feel we were overcharged for a very short gig (compared to Uk gigs which we attend often). Rooms are spacious and beds are comfy but no tea/coffee in rooms. No bath tub in our room also a little disappointing. Service generally ok but again just not quite slick enough compared to the many other high end hotels we have stayed in. Took ages to get drinks served at the poolside. They are definitely missing a truck here as so many people would have spent much more on drinks had they been able to find a server (1 attendant for hundreds of people).

reviews.title: It’s meh
reviews.text: Need coffee machine in room.  Main entrance was closed when I arrived so had to drag luggage from southern entrance to check in, not fun.  In room catering food was okay but arrived late for a client meeting.  Don prime was over rated.  Food court was pretty good.

reviews.title: Best Hotel In Las Vegas
reviews.text: The best hotel in las vegas. Everything was beautiful and lovely from the moment you walk in the lobby. Casino floor is very spacious not too much cigarette smoke, lots of machines to win and a very nice bar on casino floor. The rooms were amazing, i love how they had floor to ceiling windows and also how from the moment we open the door to our room the windows shades and curtains automatically open up for you to see the view. The spa is the best in vegas wonderful but it was a headache to get in since it was always booked and we didnt have reservations ahead of arriving at the hotel so make sure if you want to pamper yourself with the spa make reservations and book your massages section at least 2 weeks before your arrival if not just get a day pass.

reviews.title: Fontainebleu was Amazing
reviews.text: I had an amazing stay at Fontainebleau! The rooms were really nice, with a stylish and comfortable ambiance. The beds were incredibly comfortable, ensuring a restful night's sleep. One of my favorite features was the oversized sink in the bathroom—it added such a touch of luxury and convenience. From check-in to check-out, everything exceeded my expectations. I can’t wait to return!

reviews.title: Amazing Las Vegas destination
reviews.text: Must see and experience Las Vegas destination.  Absolutely gorgeous spaces, rooms, spa, etc.  From your first step into the lobby you know you have arrived at a very special place.  It's my go to look forward Las Vegas location, can only imagine how great it will continue to develop as the North end of the strip makes additional investments and places of interest.  Urging all to visit and experience excellence at the Fontainebleau!

reviews.title: Not just a hotel, but an experience.
reviews.text: The beds were as comfortable as home, rooms are spacious, the staff is welcoming, friendly and informative.  We ate at Komodo, which was one of the best dinners we've had.  Their venue is intimate and beautiful.  The hotel is definitely an exquisite experience.

reviews.title: Fontain-Fabulous
reviews.text: What a beautiful hotel!! We had amazing Valentine’s Day celebration!  We arrived and were greeted with warm welcomes and smiling faces!! Since we used Amex platinum we were invited to the poodle room, which is absolutely breathtaking!!!  We then had the most amazing experience at ITO where we had access to a private bar and an intimate omakase overlooking the amazing Vegas lights!!  We had spa treatments at the Lapis spa which was again amazing, my only recommendation is to make sure you bring swim suits as you can not enjoy the entire experience without them!!  We then went to the Colin’s bar which again was lovely, and then Papi steakhouse a lively great show starter!!  I look forward to returning in the summer to enjoy the pool vibe as again it looks amazing!!!

reviews.title: Ridiculous high prices for drinks and food, but very nice hotel and casino
reviews.text: The hotel is very good. The casino does a nice job of mitigating the smoker's smoke from being over powering. I would rate FountainBleau higher, but the prices at the restaurants and bars are just stupidly high, even by Vegas standards. If they would drop the food and bar prices, it would easily the best hotel / casino on the Strip, but at this time, it's just a money grab.

reviews.title: If the staff pronounce it Fountain Blue, then its Fountain Blue
reviews.text: We liked the hotel overall.  However, there were a few issues.  First, we specifically asked for a quiet room and instead our room was very loud and we could clearly hear our neighbors next door as if they were in the room with us.  Upon checking out, we were able to speak with the same employee that checked us in and told her we requested a quiet room but instead it was actually quite loud. She told us we should have asked for a room that could not be adjoined rather than asking for a quiet room. This was a rude response and we have never had this experience during any of our several stays in Vegas. This did not give us a good feeling about staying at this resort again for our next Vegas vacation.  Also, we booked a Gold King Strip Best View room thinking it had a deep soaking tub. Since it did not, we switched at check-in to a queen room and were told we would be on a higher floor and other than losing the king bed, we were not downgrading.  This was not the case. Despite being on a higher floor, we had a mountain view and not the strip view or room size we paid for. This definitely took away from a post Valentine's Day romantic getaway and felt like we didn't get our money's worth. We also paid for late check-out however Housekeeping was not informed and came by our room twice on our last day. The restaurants and bars we visited were amazing however, there were some places that we would have loved to try but seemed they were always closed.  Azul Bar in the lobby was never open past 11p during our stay. We made attempts to visit 2x nights in a row and they had just closed both times. This was disappointing as we specifically researched this bar and made a plan to visit while on our trip.  This was also the case with Vida, which had just closed when we visited on our last day in town.  Bar Ito did not have similar hours to other restaurants in the Promenade so we were not able to try them either.  Please bring back the crepes at Chez Bon Bon or at least to another restaurant onsite.  Having crepes during our Vegas vacation is a tradition we were not able to enjoy this time because there was no where on property to get one and we did not have the time to go all the way to Paris. Having some of the same options as other resorts further down strip may attract more customers to the area instead of only Vegas veterans like us that don't need to be center strip. The $25 for 2025 casino reward was also hard to use.  We wasted a lot of time trying to find a machine that would except the free credits which became more annoying than anything. We enjoyed Lapis Spa but wished it wasn't so busy on a Monday afternoon.  Our experience could have been better if some of the coed sauna rooms were a little bigger and if there were signs encouraging guests to be quiet. Also wish that there were more allergy free options at the restaurants onsite.  If there was at least one meal at every restaurant that was both vegetarian and gluten free, we would have never left the property.  We did not visit Don's Prime or Papi Steak because they were not able to accommodate these dietary restrictions. The only pool that was open was crowded and I'm glad we didn't waste time going to the pool since we likely would not have enjoyed it.  Please consider opening one of the larger pools on busy days or at least not obstruct the view to the larger, prettier pools in order to tempt customers like us to return during normal pool season. On a positive note, we loved the staff and our experiences at No Where Lounge, Roadside Taco, Nona's, La Fontaine, and Miami Slice.  We would have went to No Where Lounge 3x nights in a row instead of just 2x if they were open later.  Even the Bell Desk and Security staffs were excellent and each experience made us like the property even more.  Not sure if we would book another stay at this resort given the problems with the room, but we may stop by one of the restaurants/bars or to visit the beautiful property if back on that end of the strip.

reviews.title: Anniversary getaway
reviews.text: This was the most beautiful and comfortable stay we have had in our 15 years of traveling to Vegas!  Loved our 19th floor room with strip view. Casino is well laid out with lots of VP and slot options. Great place staffed by great people!  We look forward to coming back soon!

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful, never too crowded, great food hall with the most delicious everything bagel I've ever indulged in (2 days in a row).  Great casino with the best rewards program we found during our stay.  Great customer service, very clean, fresh and new.

reviews.title: Not recommended!
reviews.text: Well the stay was supposed to be a family celebration of my 70th birthday and our 40th Anniversary. When I called ahead to check parking I was told that the van was too high and we would have to use the valet to park at the hotel next door. When we arrived the valet said parking was not available and my son had to find parking elsewhere, which he found at Circus-Circus. No ride was offered.. At the front desk we were assigned to RM 847 and our party of 5 went to the room for a short celebration. The key would not open the door, so I called the front desk, and was told that there was likely a bad battery on the door and someone would be sent. No one came. Twenty minutes later I called again, and again was told that someone would be sent. No one came. Ten minutes later I walked back down to the front desk to try in person. Meanwhile a staff member came to let the group in with his pass key, which (for the reason we had already discussed with the front desk) would not work . Then we waited for maintenance, who tried to jimmy the door but was unsuccessful.  Now, an hour later, our dinner reservations were lost, we are still sitting on the floor in the hallway. Our luggage could not be delivered because we did not have a room. I then made ANOTHER trip to the front desk to be offered a similar room (1047).   We had to lug all the luggage ourselves two floors up. All the front desk was willing to do to compensate was $100 in room credits (about 4 drinks). Because of the hour we were forced to eat burritos and fast food and a drink each at the hotel. That was about $260, and the front desk would not even allow that amount to be comped. Finally, to add insult to injury, the manager would not allow us a shuttle to get us to our vehicle, telling us to call Uber! So we had to carry all our luggage through traffic back to Circus-Circus. I have traveled all over the world, and the service offered by Fontaine Blue was the worst I have experienced

reviews.title: Loving Fountainebeau!
reviews.text: We went to experience the new kid in town and we weren't disappointed.  The rooms were beautiful and super clean. Bedding plush, towels fluffy and very nice toiletries.The casino was laid out so logically that we didn't get lost even though it was huge.  It had retail nearby to take a break and shop. Food courts, restaurants and theaters were on the second floor easily reachable by escalators scattered around the casino.We ate at Komodo.  Very pretty, great food and fast service.Located at the end of the strip was not a problem either. We took a quick cab ride to a more central location and cabbed back.  If going to a meeting or convention, it is right next to the LV Convention center.It was still too cold to lounge by the pool but there were several.  I will come back and lounge by the pools next visit.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay, everything was excellent from the amenities to customer service. The facility is just marvelous, clean, elegant and top notch. Next time I ll go back to Vegas, I will definitely stay there again. New favorite hotel.

reviews.title: An experience for the senses!
reviews.text: From the moment the doors open to the moment you leave, FoutainBleu is filled with the scent of fresh roses, hospitable staff, sparkling floors, and attention to detail throughout the property. The staff were always smiling and willing to assist as needed, the restaurants and bars were exceptional, and the rooms are fantastic.

reviews.title: Great new hotel
reviews.text: Wonderful service, dining, beautiful views. We went for Keith Urban concert and Valentine's Day weekend. We enjoyed Mother Wolf, Washing Potato, The Tavern and Collins Bar. All great food and service. The facility is top notch, very clean, all team members are ver courteous and professional.

reviews.title: Deluded
reviews.text: Quite frankly I have little positive to say about this hotel. I totally fell for the marketing on their website and so arrived with expectations for a luxury resort offering a comfortable stay a great nights sleep. Unfortunately, I left feeling really disappointed.First of all the location. This hotel is in what seems to be Vegas’ seedier side surrounded almost completely by low end properties, boarded up shops and dispensaries. Stepping inside the entrance first impression is strong with a huge lobby. As is often the case with vegas properties there were ridiculously long queues to check in and we wanted over an hour to check in due in large part to the disinterest and glacial pace of the staff.After having checked in I went to my room only to discover it wasn’t the room I had booked. On calling down to the front desk I was told there was nothing they could do on the phone and I would have to come down to reception again and yes queue again. This was exactly what I wanted after nearly 24 hours of travelling. Luckily it was only a 30 minute queue this time but no change in the disinterest and rude nature of the staff. The member of staff admitted that they had actually tried to fob me off with an inferior category room without informing me.Finally with the right room I explored the hotel and casino and found this to be completely fine but certainly again not worthy of the luxury and high end promises. The restaurant selection seemed reasonable but I didn’t try any with the exception of the patisserie.The room was actually relatively nice being of a large size with a very comfortable bed and a bathroom containing an oversized bathtub and separate shower. Cleanliness seemed to hit and miss with visible dust and dirt and stains on the carpet and also an over perfumed air freshener sprayed in excess.The biggest frustration with the room was with the automatic drapes and curtains which had a mind of their own and would suddenly close without any instruction. They would also close any time you left the room meaning that on return you had a multiple click effort to get natural light into the room.Outside the room the winter pool was nice and the gym was also niceOn departure day I had booked and paid for late check out and had this confirmed. Of course my keys stopped working at 10am and so I had to queue yet again only to be berated for not letting them know I actually needed access to my room for longer as part of my late check out.

reviews.title: Take me back to the Fontainebleau!
reviews.text: If you are looking for the quintessential high-end Las Vegas experience than the Fontainebleau is for you. Exceptional cocktails, cuisine, and experiences from an amazing concert venue to the most relaxing spa I’ve ever been to and worth ever cent.  I honestly never want to leave!!

reviews.title: 5 star property but 1 star service
reviews.text: Aesthetically pleasing and large hotel, we enjoyed our first few days but unfortunately personal items were removed from our room when we were at the pool area (nb no bar servixe at the pool area despite it being busy with guests). Poor response from management thereafter.  Wouldn't recommend this place but if you are staying here, put your belongings in the safe although it is small. The Wynn Encore is a superior resort and more central to the strip.

reviews.title: Best hotel
reviews.text: One of the best hotels I've stayed at. Great staff that is very cheerful and attentive. Zero complaints. Don's Steakhouse was amazing - you must try the Tomahawk STEAK! Everything was exceptionally cleaned, fresh, and updated. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.title: #AmazingPlace
reviews.text: Hello All, we want to tell you All that if You come to Vegas for an amazing time. Stay here if You can . We know it might be a little bit pricey but it’s well worth every dollar! From the property to the staff. It is by far top 3 properties on the strip. We come to Vegas 3 times a year and We stay at Venetian/Palazzo, Wynn/Encore and now Fountainbleau. We have stayed at other properties in the past but We found these 3 properties to be the best of best.

reviews.title: Theft from hotel room
reviews.text: Aesthetically pleasing and large hotel, we enjoyed our first few days but then had a theft of personal items from our room. Provided a statement to security but we've heard nothing further following our departure, despite a promise to update us. No apology or reimbursement. Have since learned that theft by staff is not a one off at this property. Either they need to vet housekeeping staff better or improve surveillance and security.  If you are staying here put your belongings in the safe although it is small.

reviews.title: Strong perfume smell may cause problems.
reviews.text: Unfortunately, the perfume that is pumped into the lobby and common areas caused a severe allergic reaction for my fiance.  We left on our 4th day of a 5 night stay because he was in such discomfort.  The hotel should provide a notification of the smell as many people are sensitive - hence why many workplaces and healthcare facilities have "no scent" policies.   Also, if you want to enjoy a morning coffee in your room, bring your own coffee maker.  Otherwise your options are getting dressed and going to the cafe for a $7 drip coffee or spending close to $45 to have a one litre carafe delivered to your room.

reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: This is a Beautiful resort.  All the staff go out of their way to provide amazing service. The spa is the best in the strip.  Every food option is top quality.  The drinks are the best on the strip.  As this resort grows and becomes more popular will be hard to beat

reviews.title: Great trip but more costly than expected
reviews.text: Hotel rooms are the best! They are clean and refreshing. The water pressure is 10/10! Food is expensive but quite tasty. Better than your average. Down sides-table games are always $25+parking isn't free unless you're staying there. Rooms are also pretty pricey and they dont offer much comps. Overall the experience was great but it was a pricey adventure. If you can get their deals when they have them, it will balance out and take a little weight off. Not much but some.

reviews.title: Superb Experience at Fontainebleau.  Best time ever!  I'd highly recommend it to anyone!
reviews.text: Great hotel stay.  Concierge staff were helpful in getting my transportation reserved from the airport to the hotel and return.  The checkin process was fast and easy.  The restaurants were great.  The Mother Wolf and the Washing Potato resturants proved excellent service and good food.  The Nowhere Lounge provides live music and the server proves great service. The pastries and the coffee are excellent in the morning at the Nowhere Lounge.  The Fitness provides multiple workout machines and free weights.  Enjoyed my workouts.  The Tavern provides good food and friendly service. The hotel theater provides some great concerts.  I saw Duran Duran in December and Tears for Fears in February.  They were excellent shows.  Overall, I had a superb experience at the Fontainebleau.  I would highly recommend it to anyone.  Robert

reviews.title: Was wishing for WOW but got Meh!!!
reviews.text: The hotel is drop dead gorgeous. The service is subpar and the answer to most requests to make a stay epic is “NO” So many fees for everything under the sun. It was an hour wait at the bagel place for a quick take away bite. We got there a little late in a Friday nite but when we went to get a bite to eat there were no descent sit down restaurants open past 10:00pm, in Vegas on a Friday on a long weekend?!?! Weird. The saving grace was our epic dinner at Mother Wolf. One of the best dining experiences we’ve had. It was my husbands 50th birthday and that meal with their impeccable service saved the trip. For as opulent as this hotel is, they need to do better in the service dept for sure.

reviews.title: Vegas trip
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, rooms and spa.I was too far from everything tho.The spa was fantastic.Main reason we stayed there was for the coed spa area.Food promenade was good didn't get to any of the resturants other then a cute little cage with amazing service...Jesse and an apple braid

reviews.title: Fleur-de-Lis Executive Suite
reviews.text: Wonderful experience at Fontainebleau, stayed at Fleur-de-Lis Executive Suite, great decor, comfortable, and excellent butler services.  Worthy alternative to Wynn Tower Suite Salon, in fact cost less, better services & amenities.  Suites has VIP check-in area and private entrance/exit & elevators.

reviews.title: Beautiful and comfortable, but lacking
reviews.text: FountainFountainebleau is a beautiful and nicely appointed resort that features most of the amenities we have come to expect from a property of this caliber. That said, there are some gaps in the guest experience. There’s no faulting the design, amenities, or service. However, the property is still not fully realized and has large unused sections throughout. The casino is small compared to the competition on the strip. The shopping is lacking with only a few very high end options. There are no guest shops with needed sundries. The rooms, while beautiful and comfortable with lots of high end features, are missing the details and creature comforts that make for a more pleasant and enjoyable stay (no iron, coffee, or bathroom sundries). And the location, which makes for a relatively quiet and less crowded experience, can also be a bit isolating. Basically, everything is nicely executed and top notch, but there’s very little depth, the details are missing, and there’s no extra conveniences for guests.It’s also worth mentioning that Fountainebleau is expensive. Everything costs more, and not just little, but a lot. Which isn't unexpected. This is a five star property in Las Vegas after all. However, what I find frustrating isn't the high price, but when these prices don't translate into superior service, execution, or experience. They're charging more because they can and that's just price gouging. At the very least, I want to feel like I’m getting something more for the extra cost, and we just didn’t.In the end, we enjoyed our stay, but I don’t think I’d go back. Beautiful and pleasant as it is, there just isn’t enough value in staying here.

reviews.title: Las vegas hotel
reviews.text: Goid beds, good casino, good people, stay away from room service . We enjoyed our stay here. The view was amazing.   We like it allot we will come back.   Valet was perfect. Flower smell was good. People seems to want to help us. All I got to say.  They want more, blah blah

reviews.title: Great room
reviews.text: Our room was very spacious, clean and modern. One of the best room we have stayed in in Vegas.  Only thing I did not like about my stay at Foutainebleau was that the entire resort was so warm temperature wise.  Even the dealers were complaining about how hot it was.

reviews.title: First visit and will be returning!
reviews.text: The place is new and still working through some things and the place is nice, clean and classy. The front entry is clean and crisp, the car drop off in the front needs more logistics for smoother drop off and pick up. The room was very nice, the beds are super comfortable, nice bedding and bathroom was very elegant. Consider changing the shampoo/conditioner bottles as the it is very hard to get the product out of the bottles, especially thr conditioner.

reviews.title: HIGH in Vegas
reviews.text: We spent a fabulous Valentine's Day weekend at the Fontainebleau Hotel in Las Vegas!  Our room was spacious, clean, comfortable and bright.  We enjoyed delicious food, awesome entertainment (especially at the No Where lounge), the friendly staff, and we took full advantage of the amazing Fitness Center and gym.  We saw Keith Urban in concert Friday night (at the wonderful hotel theater).  The performance was incredible, as was our entire weekend!

reviews.title: Not worth the money. Beautiful hotel but better cleaner rooms at Hiltons and mandalay Bay.
reviews.text: Room not clean and dirty sheets 2 days as we were ready for bed. Bath had other peoples hair in it. Beautiful hotel not worth the money at all for the rooms and don’t touch anything it will cost you.  Regular coffee $7 a cup cheapest thing there. I’m happy to pay for good service and quality food. This is not the hotel ill stay at again

reviews.title: If you want nicer hotel near the Convention Center, stay here, if not, save your money for the Wynn/Encore
reviews.text: If you want nicer hotel near the Convention Center, stay here, if not, save your money for the Wynn/Encore

reviews.title: Excellent Experience!
reviews.text: Everything about my stay was great!  The fitness center was amazing - every piece of equipment imaginable with great views of outside on the cardio machine.  The food was drink was amazing.  Great Atmosphere.   The rooms were brand new, comfy beds, and very spacious.  We will be back!

reviews.title: Wonderful hotel
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau is the best casino/hotel in LV.  It is not only beautiful, but every single staff there is wonderful, helpful and a joy to be around.  The restaurants, especially Komodo are amazing.  The rooms are wonderful, great workout area and cafe's. Beautiful view from any room!!  We loved it!

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: My stay at Fontainebleau Las Vegas was absolutely incredible! The rooms were luxurious, the service was top-notch, and the atmosphere was unbeatable. From the stunning decor to the world-class dining and entertainment, every detail was perfect. Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.title: Excellent Bleau Live Theater Experience
reviews.text: Visited the Fontainebleau to attend a Tears for Fears concert in their theater.  Excellent experience!  Pleasant, helpful staff.  Love the intimacy of the 3800-seat venue.  Seats were comfortable, not too close together.  Sound quality was outstanding!  Reminded me of the very old Aladdin Theatre for the Performing Arts experience: no nonsense, just enjoyable sightlines and sound quality for all seats.  Keep bringing shows here!

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: This is a gorgeous hotel that rivals or exceeds the Wynn properties. Plenty of reasonable food options. Great sportsbook and outstanding service. I like the fact that they had plenty of staff in all areas and that all were friendly and engaging. Felt like old customer service you used to get in Vegas. We used self park. It is nice that there are two exits on opposite sides of the property and two entrances to the south or north lobby. This would be a 5 easy if the pillow and the bed was more comfortable

reviews.title: Shard Sheet Gate
reviews.text: Living in Las Vegas we have plenty of options. Every 4 months my lady and I have a date night staycation. We stayed on 2/8, booked through Amex fine hotel and resorts. After a great evening of food, gambling and drinks we decided to call it night at 1AM. When pulling our bed coves open to sleep there was a large shard stain from what looks like the previous people covered with some napkins. Disgusting! Room service came to change sheets and three others ones they grabbed where dirty also. When checking out in the morning, we brought it to the managers attention. The only compensation given was $100 off our bill. I have been a manager in the hospitality industry for 14 years and understand how to ensure guests leave happy no matter what. The level of compensation for Shard sheet gate does not fit the crime. I would have expected to be compensated for our room that evening especially since the amount of $$$ spent on our evening.

reviews.title: Love the Hotel, but as a guy with a wheelchair loved the accessible room
reviews.text: I will keep this brief. The hotel is impeccably beautiful. I was particularly impressed with the room I selected, which featured a very nice roll-in shower bathroom. As someone with a disability, booking a room sight unseen can be quite daunting. One never knows if it will meet their needs without compromising on upscale quality.

reviews.title: Feeling Bleau when I have to Leave
reviews.text: Second time at the Fontaine! I wouldn't stay anywhere else on the Strip. I love this place. Modern and Bright atmosphere, friendly staff, comfortable room, excellent bars + dining and beautiful spa. I visit Vegas just to have a weekend at this Resort. See you next trip.

reviews.title: Fontainbleau...your new destination in Las Vegas!
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful hotel!  Staff was very friendly and accommodating, my room was fancy and super clean, and the vibe was very "inviting", I think, because of the large spaces and high ceilings.  Plus the bar in the center of the casino floor is amazing.

reviews.title: Finally a Hotel in the U.S. that can hold its own with the 5 stars overseas
reviews.text: Wow!  What an incredible experience.  Fontainebleau achieves the impossible by being even more beautiful in person than online.  The customer service is exceptional and doesn’t miss from the front desk to valet and everyone in between.  5 stars all the way around! We will be back time and again.

reviews.title: luxury defines fountainbleau
reviews.text: i had the most relaxing and enjoyable stay at the luxurious foutainbleau.  the ambiance, the numerous slot machine, nice room accomodations and friendly staff contributed to the overall positive experience.   i also recognize the excellent filtration system which removes smoke.   i will definitely come back soon

reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: OMG the absolutely best experience in my traveling life. What made it special was not the smells, beauty, cleanliness, and experiences, but the amazing and friendly staff and customer service.  It’s so beautiful and we were made to feel like Royalty!  SAVE FOR A STAY here!!! Totally worth it!!!

reviews.title: 10/10 would NOT recommend
reviews.text: The check in process was a nightmare.  Be prepared to wait in line for nearly 2 hours if you are attending a business meeting there. You will not receive the room you requested, and the room you get is likely to be dirty. I found hair and tissues on and in my bed. The water pressure is poor and the water is COLD no matter what time of day you shower. If you like a relaxing spa experience, I would NOT recommend the Lapis Spa. I had the worst experience of my life here. The massage therapist, Pedro, made inappropriate comments about my neck and how I have a horrible hump there for my age. He did not give me the massage I requested, and I felt so uncomfortable with him the entire time I was there. I did receive my money back for the massage which is why I didn't give this place 0/5.  But, why would you waste your time with such a horrible experience with so many nice places on the Strip?

reviews.title: The best experience in Vegas so far
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time at Fontainebleau in Vegas! The property is new, modern, and beautifully furnished. Unlike many other casinos, there was no noticeable smell of cigarettes, even in the gaming areas, which was a huge plus. Every employee we interacted with was well-trained, professional, and courteous, making our experience even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Great hotel, typical of Vegas.
reviews.text: The.hotel is amazing. The perfect standard room in size, the wonderful bed, the amazing bathroom in both size and distribution.  She feels sorry for a closet of consistent size with the room or a walkinn closet as the one she has is very small.The bad thing, the distance to the center of the strip makes its location a little awkward and forces you to use Uber for everything.

reviews.title: Elegance and attention to detail
reviews.text: The level of detail and elegance at the property is impressive, it it’s a much more exclusive feel than the rest of the strip. Our favorite spot at the hotel was listening to the piano at Collins. I would recommend this hotel to anyone who is looking for a more refined Vegas experience.

reviews.title: A place to remember and return
reviews.text: Where can I start. This place was so amazing. The atmosphere was so relaxing and calm and the staff I’ve never encountered a staff that was so friendly, every single person had a smile and  was happy to help. Always offering to go out of their way anytime.The food we had for in-room dining was most delicious plus an incredible meal presentation I think I’ve ever had and I travel quite a bit with my wife at high-end resorts.This is the only place I’m going to go to when I return to Las Vegas.Also my wife took snapshots of the tags on the sheets on the bed because they’re so comfortable and the bed itself wow she said she’s never slept better her whole life and she has back pain every single morning she wakes up.

reviews.title: A very nice hotel
reviews.text: We chose to stay at  Fontaineblue because the concert we went to see was at the hotel making just easier to leave the concert and go back to room. Our room was very clean and high tech, buttons to turn on all lights and open/close the curtains. No sticks to pull or dirty curtains. We took an upgrade and ended up with a suite with a great view of the Sphere and two bathrooms and separate bedroom. Being during the week it was quiet which is always nice. As much as we loved the room the food on the Promenade was not great. We ate at Roadside Tacos and the food was bland, the nacho cheese was lumpy and tasted like it was made from a powder. Not enjoyable. We did breakfast at the Bagel Bet and were much happier. Food was fresh and hot. Overall we really liked the hotel. The casino was not overly busy but that could be because it was midweek. We drove to Vegas from AZ and it was easy to get to the hotel without too much traffic. I would definitely stay there again mainly for the room.

reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel with amazing restaurants, casino, and amenities. Everything is to the absolute highest standard! Although it is at the end of the Vegas Strip it is easily walkable! Would absolutely recommend to stay here on your next trip to Vegas!

reviews.title: Gran Hotel. Highly recommended.
reviews.text: We went to Vegas to go to the Tears for Fears concert and it was convenient to stay at the same hotel where the show was taking place. Great decision! Great hotel. The automated rooms. Spacious without being ridiculously large. Comfortable well lit (although the view did not favor us). Outstanding cleanliness and services. It was low season and there were few people. But the ceilings are so high the light colors and well lit that it gives you a different feel to the hotels and casinos in the area. We would stay there without thinking!

reviews.title: 5 Star experience and felt like a VIP
reviews.text: Loved everything about the clean and spacious property.  Hotel room was very nice and convenient.  Easy and comfortable with electronics in room.  Loved the three restaurants we ate at.  Komodo, Vida and Tavern.  Great food and superb service.

reviews.title: Great, Quieter option in Vegas
reviews.text: The Fontainbleu is a lovely newer hotel in Vegas that is a bit off the beaten path from the craziness of the main Strip.  Our room was a very good size, beds were comfortable, dining options were great.  We stayed here because we were attending a concert in their theatre and had a great time. Not huge gamblers but the casino seemed fine.

reviews.title: Amazing new Vegas property MUST TRY
reviews.text: Beautifully clean place to visit when in Vegas. Being brand new you can still smell the freshness. Plenty of different level rooms to choose from and the pool area is amazing. Lots of offers around to try yourself. Location isnt the best but its not as bad as it once was.

reviews.title: Terrific hotel off the Main Strip Area-Great View of the Sphere
reviews.text: We booked the "strip view" room (stack 37) and forget the strip--it is a PERFECT view of the Sphere!  Room is huge, comfortable and beautifully decorated. Auto drapes did not work on one control, but did on the others.The lobby is huge with some great art, particularly the "wave" sculpture.  But it seems a little sterile.  Self parking is easy, plentiful and included in the resort fee.This is a great location to access events at the Smith Center--easy 10 minute drive on back streets.Also easy to access great restaurants just outside. Ate at Mother Wulf and it was terrific.

reviews.title: Vegas has more options
reviews.text: The rooms are small for waht you pay for , I was gambling at night and did not see any waitress so I had to walk to the bar and buy a drink the bartender didn't care , the next morning I got a players card horrible comp system I guess you don't want people coming back

reviews.title: Bad experience and broken promises
reviews.text: This trip was to celebrate a friends birthday.  He arranged it with a host, Mike W.   The agreement with the host was that 4 nights would be comped for everyone, and drinks and food would be compensated base upon individual play.Upon arrival, some of our reservations hadn't been made.   One being mine.  From there on there was confusion within the hotel.  Long story short, some guys did not get their rooms comped as promissed.   I was comped for only three of the four nights.  And we found out that our host, Mike W. was terminated prior to our arrival.

reviews.title: Great stay for a concert!
reviews.text: Stayed here to see Tears for Fears and was very impressed with the Fontainebleau!  The rooms were nice (comfortable bedding), great bathroom with powerful shower and deep bathtub.  NoWhere was a great lounge after the concert - had a couple of drinks that were covered by our “food and drink” credit (book the room through their website to get best deals and credits).  Also, sign up for the Rewards Card if you plan to gamble - but also use it when you buy meals and drinks.

reviews.title: Shiny and calm
reviews.text: Shiny and new and calm. It’s big enough to handle the crowds and not feel crowded. Very high ceilings on the first floor with two cool sculptures (one interactive). Our stay started off nicely with a friendly check-in (thanks, Estevan), and our room being available so early!  Woohoo!  After walking through other hotels during our trip, it was really nice to come back to the Fountainebleau. The pool and most restaurants are tucked away on the 2nd and 3rd floors. Housekeeping brought us a microwave (who knew?) as there’s no coffee pot in the room; we had brought tea bags. Enjoy a stay here!

reviews.title: Great getaway from CA. Taxes
reviews.text: The Fontaineblue looks very luxurious, clean, wonderful decor. The service was second to none, and for for the promenade ambiance is just fresh, spacious and lots to offer. Next time I’ll try the Prime restaurant. The location is also great because it’s close to other wonderful casinos, The Trump tower, the Mall. Parking is also very accessible with close parking to the facility.

reviews.title: Unforgettable BDay Trip
reviews.text: I’ve lived in Las Vegas over 28 years and my wife and I completely enjoyed every minute we spent at Fontainebleau this past weekend. The staff was engaging at every return, my wife commented the shower had the best pressure ever… Mother wolf is not to be missed!

reviews.title: My second visit to Fountainebleau in the last 6 months!
reviews.text: The hotel is well designed. Immaculately clean and all areas except for the casino is smoke free.. even the casino area seems to be well ventilated.  All staff memebers I encountered were courteous and professional.   I saw the Tears for Fears concert, not really a bad seat in the house! Food court was great!

reviews.title: Sensationnel
reviews.text: This is the best of the best hôtel ever, the staff, the atmosphere, the food, the great professionalism of the staff, the cleanliness of the rooms, the great diversity of slot machines, the security, advantages on membership cards rewards, wide variety of restaurants

reviews.title: Some things to like about Blue
reviews.text: The hotel is a little out of reach from most of the strip action.It's not as inviting as some other resorts because it has a colder conference center vib. But there are some pluses. The gym and fitness center is superb.The beds are really comfortable.The staff is very friendly.In the end I might stay again, but for the price there are better options.

reviews.title: Must Stay in Vegas
reviews.text: I have stayed at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas two years in a row for our internal company meetings and I would definitely recommend to stay here again. The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful. Everyone from the wait staff to the managers were extremely catering to my needs during my stay. I had a 16 party team dinner at KYU and received several compliments on the food experience and a follow-up email from the manager to ask about my experience. The rooms are exceptionally clean and modern. I absolutely loved my stay and can't wait to come back!

reviews.title: Our vehicle was stolen at the Fontainebleau!
reviews.text: Be careful staying at the Fontainebleau if you have a vehicle!  We stayed there for 7 nights and our vehicle was stolen from their parking garage on the second night. We had even parked right under a security camera. We are a rewards member and have stayed there numerous times since it opened.  I understand things happen but I was waiting to see if management would contact us while we were still there to see how they could help us.  Never happened. I had to call to speak to a manager in guest relations who said she would look into it and get back to me but never did. When we checked out, I spoke with a front desk supervisor and told him how upset I was that my vehicle was stolen and that I thought the right thing for the hotel to do is to comp us all or part of our stay. He assured me that I would most likely be compensated one way or another after it was investigated. I was afraid that once I paid the bill they would flush us afterwards which was exactly what happened when we received a form letter email saying they were sorry about our vehicle being stolen but there would be no compensation of any kind…not even 1 night free!  Las Vegas police found the vehicle abandoned the day before we left but it was not drivable and everything had been stolen from inside. We had to leave the vehicle in Vegas for insurance to deal with and rent a car to drive back home. You would think a classy hotel would try to help you out by covering part of your stay since we have so many other expenses now as a result of what happened there…but not Fontainebleau. We will never stay there again.  It’s too bad because we liked the hotel and the restaurants.  Terrible management and bad security!

reviews.title: Bleau…
reviews.text: One of the newest nicest and tallest hotels on the strip. I had a great room with a great view directly looking at the sphere. Not all of the restaurants are open yet, but what’s available currently is really good. I was on the company dime so I took advantage of that eating and drinking at the best restaurants and bars in the place. Great pool area and I actually liked the location a little further down the strip.

reviews.title: No in-room coffee and disorganized service
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and the rooms are well-appointed, but the lack of a coffee-maker in the room was a deal-breaker for us.   Also, some of the employees don’t seem to know what they’re doing.  When we checked in, the front desk clerk never mentioned that we had a $50 per day resort credit or address whether parking was included.  We also had no soap in our room, so we had to call housekeeping.  After the first night, they cleaned our room, but forgot to replace the hand towels & wash cloths.  These are minor issues, but I expect better service for a hotel of this caliber.

reviews.title: Just go, if you want to an amazing time.
reviews.text: OMG, I don't know why this property is not as recognized as the others down the strip.  The property is impeccable, the service from the team members is outstanding.  I mean, whenever I asked a team member where something was, they would escort you over to it, instead of just pointing and giving me a bunch of directions.  The choices for gaming is wonderful, and the hotel rooms are to die for.  It is a little further north of the main strip, but you will be glad you did.  I have stayed at almost all the resorts on the strip, and this is my all time favorite.

reviews.title: Tremendous experience at Fontainebleau Las Vegas!
reviews.text: Fontainebleau Las Vegas is a very remarkable property. Decor is absolutely unique, bright and beautiful as well as comfortable. Very comfortable and clean room with great shower head water pressure. All food was delicious with quick, knowledgeable, and friendly service. Wife loved the spa. Casino was so fun - bright, clean, right mix of slots and table games. I can not imagine anyone not being very pleased with their entire experience at Fontainebleau Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Disorganized
reviews.text: Tried sending a simple gift of champagne and charcuterie to a room. It has resulted in confusion, missing items, duplicate charges, and the run-around between depts even after escalating. They are so disorganized I wouldn’t trust them to do anything correctly

reviews.title: Modern, luxurious and clean Las Vegas hotel
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at the Fontainebleau Hotel in Las Vegas for one night at the end of April. Overall, we had a pleasant experience. The staff was extremely friendly and kind, and our room was very clean. We enjoyed the spacious and fully equipped gym, which offered every piece of exercise equipment imaginable. The hotel also featured a variety of excellent dining options, and every meal we had—from breakfast to dinner—was delicious, though on the expensive side, which is to be expected in Las Vegas.However, we did encounter a few issues during our stay. There was confusion among the hotel staff regarding the amenities at the guest pool; multiple staff members informed us there were no private showers, but we later found several near the guest pools in the restrooms. Given that the pool had only recently opened for guests, the hotel should ensure staff are fully aware of its amenities. Additionally, the spa seemed extremely overpriced, even compared to New York City and the Los Angeles metropolitan area where I live. The hotel is located at the far end of the Strip, making it less lively than some of the larger hotels and casinos, and it doesn’t offer as many casino options as other hotels in the area.Despite these drawbacks, we would consider staying here again.
