reviews.title: Did not dissapoint 🥰
reviews.text: Booked our trip through Virgin as uk residents and got an excellent deal for this new hotel. I went to las vegas 16 years ago and always wanted to go back. I was nervous about booking this hotel as i had never heard of it and it seemed a bit further out (opposite circus circus) but I couldn't have been more thrilled..... it was perfect and the location for me personally was amazing....... I found the centre of the strip almost felt a bit too hectic and this hotel was slightly out the way of all the craziness but easily accessible on the duece bus or via a cab. The hotel was just incredible. Brand new. Beautiful room. Most fancy hotel and room I have ever stayed in infact. Stunning pool and hotel interior. I would stay again in a heart beat. Even the smell of this hotel as you walk in is just incredible. Lovely staff. Thank you fountainblue, one of the best trips ever......x

reviews.title: When Luxury Slips: Mishaps and Missed Service at the Fontainebleau
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau: where luxury meets limping. My spa day quickly turned into a slapstick skit when I slipped on a wet surface. I immediately plunged my foot into the cold plunge (self-medicated first aid at its finest) and waited for help. At first, I thought it was manageable—I could still walk—but then the comedy of errors began.I filled out an incident report and requested a wheelchair to get back to my room. Thirty minutes later, it finally arrived. I asked if I could keep it for my work lunch. “No,” they said, as if I was planning to steal their one and only wheelchair. Back in my room, I called again for a chair, waited another 20 minutes, only to be told I’d need to pay for it. Seriously? A rental fee for your own negligence?Frustrated, I decided to hobble my way to lunch with a colleague acting as a human crutch. Picture this: a business meeting featuring me, a swollen foot, and sheer humiliation. By lunchtime, walking wasn’t even an option anymore. I called a manager, who responded with all the warmth of a TSA agent at rush hour. “There’s a process,” she said, as if I had slipped on red tape instead of their wet floor.I explained I had tickets to The Sphere but couldn’t attend because of my new hobble life. She promised help, which apparently meant leaving me stranded at the hotel’s potato restaurant since 11 a.m. It’s now 3 p.m., and I’m still here, making lemon drop martinis my emotional support beverage. No assistance. No apologies. No discounts. Not even a comped spa treatment—the spa treatment where I had my literal downfall!Here’s the kicker: I’m here scouting venues for a technology conference my company is hosting. If this is how they treat me, I’d hate to see how they’d treat our customers. Needless to say, the Fontainebleau won’t be seeing us again. But hey, at least their lemon drop martinis are world-class. Too bad their service is not.

reviews.title: Fontainebleau is a Gem
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau is a gem of a property. The rooms are clean, well appointed and have very comfortable pillows and bed. An overall Beautiful resort with plenty of amenities and fantastic restaurants. I have stayed in over two dozen hotels in Las Vegas over the past 5 years and the Fontainebleau is tops in my books. I very rarely write reviews but I honestly think you need to consider this property next time you visit Las Vegas. 10/10

reviews.title: Heavenly perfection!
reviews.text: Every detail was striking and beautiful!  I will never think of Vegas in the same way again.  I was there for business, got in late and left early so desperately need to get back for my own personal enjoyment and experience all that the fontainebleau has to offer (which is a lot!)

reviews.title: A Major Room Problem, With No Help from the Hotel
reviews.text: TL DR: had a major problem with my room during my 1 night Fontainebleau stay 12/29. The front desk at checkout said a manager would "get back to me" about a refund, but I've heard nothing from them. I've NEVER asked for a room refund before, but this situation warrants it. I stayed for one night last month, 12/29, having booked through Amex Platinum's Fine Hotel and Resorts program.I really enjoyed the hotel; service was wonderful, beautiful space and great food.However, the room had a major problem, in that the lights wouldn't work. It's one of those fancy modern lighting systems, like at Wynn, where everything is controlled by a panel on the wall, labeled "all on," "all off," "low," "drapes open," etc.My room was apparently broken, because when we needed the lights on in the evening, they would stay on for a few minutes, then turn off. We'd have to continually turn them back on to get ready to go down for dinner. I called down to the front desk, but by the time the technician came up, I was in the middle of getting ready, and since the lights had been on for more than a few minutes, figured the problem was resolved, so sent him away so I could keep getting dressed and head down for dinner.However, he did say someone would take a look at the electronics outside the room and troubleshoot to fix the problem. I figured that would be it...Unfortunately, when we came back up around 10:30pm to head to bed (we needed to get up for a drive to Salt Lake City the next morning), the opposite problem happened: THE LIGHTS WOULDN'T STAY OFF.Trying to sleep, we'd have to continually turn the lights back off, but a minute or two later, they would pop back on.I called down to the front desk again (the agent had the temerity to suggest to me that I could "just sleep in" since Amex's FHR program includes late checkout), and they sent up a technician. So around 11:30pm or so, a technician came in and took a look, unscrewed a few lamp bulbs, but still couldn't get the lights to stay off.He was apologetic and said he'd escalate it and get another tech up right away, that night, so we could sleep. So I waited up another 45 minutes, but the next tech never came, and I finally just laid down and slept the best I could with the lights on.The next morning, I headed to the front desk. The agent was kind and said she could see the notes about the trouble in my account, and went to talk to someone higher up about the room refund I requested. She came back and said the manager would "get back to me" about a refund, and it would take 2-3 days. The only thing she was able to do was waive my resort fee for that night, which I appreciated. The manager has yet to get back to me.It's unfortunate, because otherwise I really enjoyed the hotel and thought the rest of the service was wonderful. I'm currently working with Amex concerning a refund.

reviews.title: Extremely disappointing check-in experience
reviews.text: The hotel has a strange check-in process whereby the front desk staff call a "room coordinator" to assign the room when you arrive at the hotel. I have never experienced this before and it just adds another layer to checking-in, and I believe  it attempts to absolve the front desk staff from all accountability.Anyway...we specifically booked a "Gold King Strip Best View" room - not the ADA version. When I was making the booking, the ADA version came up as a separate option and I did not select it because I did not want it. On our arrival at the hotel, the front desk woman called the "room coordinator". She then hung up and told me that they had assigned an ADA room to us because the room we booked was not available. I indicated that this was not acceptable. Since she had already hung up on her call with the "room coordinator", she had to call them back. After speaking with the "room coordinator" again, she hung up again. I was then offered another room. On further questioning, I established that this room was on a very low floor, possibly overlooking the pool. I had particularly booked a room on a high floor with a view - not a room overlooking a noisy pool. I did not want this room and told the front desk woman so. She then went to speak to her supervisor. This took a while. It seemed as though they were just trying to wear me down into accepting a room that I did not book. I got sick of waiting for them so I went up to speak with the supervisor. I had to challenge her repeatedly into giving me the room type that I booked. Eventually, she said that there was another guest that hadn't checked in yet so we could have the room that was assigned to them. I asked her how a specific room had been assigned to them if they hadn't turned up yet - since it is clear that their practice is to get the "room coordinator" to assign rooms when guests arrive at check-in, not in advance. The supervisor said that the other guest had specifically requested that particular room number in advance. I didn't believe this for a second and I told the supervisor so. In addition, if that guest had specifically requested that room number in advance, why did they freely give it to me!  It appeared to me as though the room type that I booked was always available and they were just trying to assign me an ADA room to see if I would accept it. They should keep these rooms for people who need them. The whole check-in process took at least half an hour which was just terrible. At no point was I given the option to speak to someone who could actually do anything about the fact that they had assigned the wrong room type to me. I had to hunt down the supervisor. It leaves a very bad impression. I would not stay at this hotel again - nor would I book their hotel in Miami as a consequence of their practices.

reviews.title: Don't try to plan for a group here
reviews.text: It was my Dad's 85th.  He loves Vegas and the FB vibe is from his generation so we were so excited.  They were disorganized and bad to work with to plan, couldn't accommodate ADA needs for our group & is very un family friendly for kids &screwed up our check in.

reviews.title: Top Hotel in Vegas!
reviews.text: Hotel is pristine. And the service is unmatched. Everything from how quickly elevators would arrive to the water pressure was top notch.Bars and restaurants are expensive but in line with other Vegas properties of similar quality / value.I highly suggest a bow tie croissant!

reviews.title: upset by the attitude towards customers
reviews.text: My partner and I spent two days at the hotel from December 31 to January 2.  the hotel is new and looks great.  The room is large and with a good view.  one minus in the room - there is no coffee machine.  everything was fine, upon check-in they took a deposit from my card of $400, upon departure we paid all the bills with my partner’s card.  It's been 22 now!  days and my deposit has not been returned!  my emails are being ignored!  I'm furious!  I think this is an outrageous attitude towards the client.  starting next week I will contact a lawyer and check whether these actions are legal.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel but terrible cocktail service
reviews.text: Fabulous hotel and restaurants, the rooms are very comfortable and the casino area is  beautiful but the drinks/cocktail service is absolutely terrible compared to other hotels on the strip and we have stayed in plenty over the 20 years we have been visiting -  we managed to get 1 drink in over 2 hours playing !!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Cleanest most thoughtful hotel going!
reviews.text: Like many folks I find myself in Vegas for business at least once a year. This is the best hotel experience I have had in Vegas in decades. Clean, modern, thoughtful, comfortable! Fitness center is world class. Extremely comfortable beds, thick doors, terrific room lighting.    My wife had decided she was done with Vegas many trips ago but she agreed to come on a lark and Fontainebleau won her over! I am now indebted to them because I am almost certain she will come back the next time I have to go.

reviews.title: beautiful new clean hotel, great beds and service.
reviews.text: comfortable clean rooms. The restaurants were WAY overpriced but the quality was good. Just ridiculous high prices and no other options in this hotel or anywhere nearby. The beds and pillows were very quiet. Dont get room facing the strip rd or you will be blinded all night by a 300 ft tall electronic billboard.

reviews.title: Nice option by the end of the strip
reviews.text: This would be a 5 star review, hotel is brand new, very beautiful, room is amazing, bed, pillows, bath, everything top notch. IMO the nicest cassino in the strip. However there are a few negatives, being:1) Digital customer service - I'm trying to get in touch with the hotel to get a folio that should've being sent digitally to me and it is completely impossible.2) Location - Far from the strip, you will need to take an Uber for almost everything3) Expansive- Everything costs a lot inside the hotel.

reviews.title: An excellent addition to the North Strip
reviews.text: Excellent hotel with great restaurants, clean rooms with convenient amenities, and a location that is ideal to the convention center. Valet and self parking were easy, the gym and fitness center was spotless, frequently cleaned, and has great hours.

reviews.title: Excellent stay!
reviews.text: If you want to be spoiled in luxury, head to Fountainbleu. The beds are the most comfortable we've experienced in our travels. Everything we ate while there was amazing! Staff are accommodating and friendly. The hotel is absolutely lovely,  we shall return!

reviews.title: Amazing Vegas Experience.
reviews.text: This is one of the best hotel casino-resorts I have ever been to in my life.   Best spa, amazing food at Komodo, Kyu, and Mother Wolf.   Great mixed drinks across the casino.   I need to try Liv next and Don's Steakhouse.   Papi's Steakhouse is a fun experience but remember to bring your ear plugs!

reviews.title: Home away Home
reviews.text: I always enjoy my time here. Been here since the opening month and stayed here several times. From the check-in to check-out the process has been always smooth. The service is solid. The amenities are amazing and I love being away from the crowded strip. This has been my favorite spot to book.

reviews.title: First class all the way.
reviews.text: Clean hotel. The most amazing spa. Love the food there. We ate at Mother Wolf and Dons Prime. Been multiple times and can’t wait to go back. We watched football games in the sports book at the Tavern. The food hall there is first class as well. Our favorite place to stay in Vegas and will continue to go back.

reviews.title: 4th time to Fontainebleau - excellent place each time!
reviews.text: Fantastic place!  just going to list what was excellent about it: pillows, beds, linens, mattress - incredible sleep.  Bathtub and bath.  View. Cleanliness of rooms. Property is immaculate and beautiful.  Very good people. Have a hot lap pool in January - love it. Excellent food - Mother Wolf and La Cote especially.

reviews.title: Exceeded My Very High Expectations
reviews.text: One of the nicest properties I have ever been to. It is not overcrowded, which is probably not what the investors want, but it is very nice for those who are staying there now while the property develops their regular clientele. The restaurants are all first class. The shopping is starting to expand now that the place has been open over a year. The rooms are amazing, and the strip view is incredible with unblocked views of the Sphere if you are on a higher floor. Finally, the service is second to none. everyone is so nice and professional and they treat you as a VIP. I won't stay anywhere else when in Vegas from now on. Stay here before the secret is out and this place explodes in popularity!

reviews.title: Good vibe, meh rooms
reviews.text: Beautiful lobby, amazing restaurants, great spa… rooms were very sub par. It already looks dated and scuff marks everywhere. Felt like it was a cheap and rushed build and already seems dated. If you want to be in this area I recommend the Conrad and just going there to visit. Mother Wolf was amazing! This should not be placed in a 5 star category.

reviews.title: Nicely done, however, very pricy.
reviews.text: Nicely done, however, very pricy. Promised discounts to "members" are unfounded, and there are "blocked out" dates, so reservation could not be made.No indoor pool.Exercise facility closes too early. No showers. Rude staff.No work desk in the guest room.Wifi requires daily registration during the stay.

reviews.title: Fontainebleau - best new spot on the strip
reviews.text: Fontainebleau is top notch. The hotel and casino is incredibly designed, superb staff, and beautiful rooms and general resort. The food and rooms were incredible and would definitely go back when in Vegas for either business or personal!

reviews.title: Nice but too far
reviews.text: This is the kind of hotel you make once... very nice contemporary, but nothing really French in fact. No theme so it's the pretty kind without soul. Since it is very far from the center strip , (1h30 walk) , you are there only to sleep , not to live the moment . A semi-disappointment

reviews.title: Luxurious rooms
reviews.text: Wow what can I say. This hotels is absolutely beautiful, from walking through the doors you are made to feel so special.Everyone was so welcoming and couldn’t do enough for you.Cleanliness is of the highest standard and the room was absolutely breathtaking, quality and luxurious throughout.

reviews.title: Very classy inside and sober outside.
reviews.text: I just spent one night at thé Fontainebleau after spending a week at the venetian. This hotel is extremely classy, i loved the decoration of blue and gold. The bars and restaurants are very nice also. It’s not the nearest of the certer of the stripe

reviews.title: Dining
reviews.text: We had an unpleasant and rude customer service with the security guard at the front check in. She left a bad first impression.  Other than that, the hotel is very spacious, clean, and elegant. We enjoyed our dining experience at La Fontaine restaurant.

reviews.title: The best!!
reviews.text: The best Vegas experience that I can remember. Very stylish and clean. Top notch amenities throughout. Royal suite was amazing with a great view of the strip. The room was very modern and had everything we needed. The food court was amazing (Miami Slice is a must), so many top restaurants to choose from (we ate at Kyu), the best meal I’ve had in a very long time. Service was top notch and every staff we encountered was exceptional. Worth every penny and reasonable for what you get. I am officially switching from a Wynn guy to Fountaine!

reviews.title: Exceeded my expectations.
reviews.text: Elegance and comfort to the 9s'!!!!  I experienced the best sleep ever! My husband and I stayed at the Fontainebleau in Miami and couldn't wait to stay at the Vegas location.  We will definitely be back in the summer to enjoy the pool and hopefully LIV nightclub.

reviews.title: Fontainebleau over the Wynn
reviews.text: Love the fontainebleau for a weekend getaway! The most relaxing (in a good way) and nice resort we've experienced in Vegas, and we've been to them all, we used to be Wynn people but have converted to Fontainbleau, positives over Wynn include a) not bumping elbows constantly with a million people at every turn and fighting crowds, Fontainebleau is huge and spread out, b) you're not rammed through their smokey casino for absolutely anything, at FB it's actually pleasant when you need to walk through casino and you don't even need to for most things, c) MUCH better food options, especially easy options, Wynn is nearly impossible to 'grab a quick bite,' whereas super easy at FB and their food court is seriously the best ever, every single spot is worth visiting, 'food court' doesn't do the words justice, it's amazing, d) easily the best gym at FB in all Vegas whereas Wynn is just ok, e) their spa is incredible, f) price is right compared to Wynn, g) staff all around have been much nicer and genuinely happy you're there. Still love Wynn pool the most, but FB's is very nice as well.

reviews.title: Good Hotel, a little far away
reviews.text: The hotel is very well designed. elegant, fine, not ostentatious. Your location is base away from everything. There's nothing relatively close except a ROSS and a Wallgreens at 200 yards and a McDonalds in front. What if, it's a good location if you go to the Convention Center. The rooms were spotless, good shower, good light, digital curtains and honeycombs, excellent soap.

reviews.title: 100% Luxurious in every way!
reviews.text: Best weekend ever!We stayed for 5 nights and loved every minute of our new room. The whole experience was amazing but the prices of room service! We were upgraded for free upon arrival and the room was out of this world. Bellagio is old hat, Fontaineleau is the new Bellagio of Vegas,

reviews.title: Anniversary trip to Fontainebleau
reviews.text: The ambiance is ecstatic. The pillows are nice and fluffy. The staff is nice and friendly knowledgeable and approachable. I visited the solo bar and had a drink that was awsome. We booked a king room great strip view but the view could of been better! The mini bar was cool also but there was a charge if you ate or drank anything. Over-all it was what I expected worth every penny and I will definitely do it again!

reviews.title: Unfortunate
reviews.text: First, let me make it clear that the reason for the poor review is for billing only. We loved the room and the service and the food at the different restaurants. However, we did a 2 night prepaid stay with Amex in order to get our $200 annual credit. Unfortunately at check out they said we still owed for one night. Our check out process ended up taking more than 20 minutes and involved a manager. Unfortunately they were unable to resolve the issue which meant we had to take the dispute to Amex. I would have liked to return to this hotel but based on the overbilling we will not be able to return. Another negative is that it is far from the "action of the strip."

reviews.title: Exceptionalism
reviews.text: Ive been staying at Fontainebleau for a year now and it has the best restaurants, the best staff and they have such a beautiful facility. I love their larger executive suites. Ive stayed at every major resort property in Vegas and they all pale in comparison.

reviews.title: A joke of a hotel. Do not stay here.
reviews.text: Where to even start… Let’s start with this. There’s a mini bar in each room, like most Vegas hotels. Several bottles of wine and 2 champagne options. Great. I go to look for the wine glasses…. Guess what. There aren’t any. There’s a cutout for them in one of the drawers, so I assume they just forgot to put them in here.I call down. I’m informed that no, there aren’t supposed to be wine glasses in the rooms, and that if I’d like some, there will be a $9 charge to bring them up… You’re telling me if I want to pay the $100 for the half bottle of champagne in the mini bar, I have to pay another $9 to get proper glassware for it? The biggest joke.What else… the first room I checked into was dirty. Stains on the comforter, hair in the bathtub, and trash by the end table. I call down. It’s fine, it happens. Hotel is EMPTY, so I assume it will be relatively quick to get me into a new room. Finally get to a manager, who puts me on hold for 18.5 minutes. 18! To check for another room at an almost empty hotel? Are you kidding? She offered me a F&B credit for the inconvenience, but I already wasted a total of 40 minutes between the hold and then waiting for the new keys. Again, it happens, but that was anything but professional service.I genuinely don’t know how this place is still open. Vegas sets a pretty high bar for hospitality. I was excited to try out the newest offering on the strip (which yes, it’s in a terrible location if you’re doing anything other than going to the convention center).Will not be back. SO many better options. Stay at Wynn or Encore down the road and you will have a MUCH better time. Don’t even consider this joke of a property. They just really do not care.

reviews.title: Negative experience
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel but not well as far as surveillance in the corridors of the rooms they entered at night in my room and robbed me and the hotel washed its hands despite the complaint they have not even answered my e-mails

reviews.title: 10s across the board
reviews.text: Amazing property. Super clean. Kind and assisting staff. Top top concierge well connected and can get you exclusive access to various venues. The rooms are super clean and the bathrooms are superb. Doesn’t smell like smoke like most Vegas hotels even in the casino. All the dining and bar options are phenomenal especially Komodo, Vida, and Chez Bon Bon. Very close to the Sphere.

reviews.title: Excellent service kind personal
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel, best service , kind personal, I ll like to go there again , I decided when go to Las Vegas stay only in Fountainbleaue , because there is kind personal , best service Ill say In United states , and compare prices to other old Hotels it is much cheaper

reviews.title: Loved our trip and want to go back soon.
reviews.text: Excellent overall experience for our New Years Eve four day visit. The NYE dinner at Don's prime with prix fixed menu and wine pairing was well worth the premium price considering the quality and the overall experience. The champagne New Years Day special Brunch at La Fontaine was terrific and so much better than most other Las Vegas offerings. The hotel room, Panoramic suite was excellent, and the views of the NYE fireworks gave us a good reason not to be outside on the strip. The gambling experience was good for us as my wife had several hand pay jackpots. We loved our trip so much we cannot wait to go back.

reviews.title: Top notch accommodations and excellent customer service.
reviews.text: The lobby and casino were breathtaking, modern, new.  Service was exceptional from the reception through our stay.  The room was well appointed with a wonderful mountain view.  Happy that they had a separate cold drawer from the mini-bar. I forgot my toothbrush and was delivered a kit within minutes.  Food at the Tavern was super!  Never have seen and doubt I will see again bigger, tastier chicken fingers!! These aren't for the kids!

reviews.title: Good clean fun
reviews.text: Beds are comfortable, water pressure and temperature in shower were amazing, awesome view of the sphere. The ice skating rink was a wonderful experience for the whole family definitely looking forward to see what the pool is going to be like in the summer. Not much to do with kids other than ice skating, but if you cross the street you have plenty of things to do at the circus circus. Pizza and burgers were great for quick meals and Riding the super long escalator was also very fun. Overall good times

reviews.title: vacation in vegas
reviews.text: Every thing was excelent good restaurants & bars  & the atmospher is perfect, good place to spend yor vacations or other kind of travel ; bussines or plesure .The room is big an comfortable and good service .I recomended the hotel Thanks it was a plesure

reviews.title: The Bleau
reviews.text: Incredible new resort... Watched it being built for many years (from our timeshare across the street)... Very clean, beautiful decor and style... Lots of eateries... Show theater... High end shopping...One of the tallest hotels on the strip (maybe THE tallest)...Parking was free for hotel guests (most Vegas resorts charge to park)... Staff was top notch... I will be back to check out the pool in the summer

reviews.title: Service was outstanding!
reviews.text: Service was outstanding from check in to check out. This was our first visit. We like to avoid weekends to enjoy a more relaxed atmosphere! Property is beautiful! Returning again in April for 4 nights. Being north of strip is perfect for us. We play golf so nice to have easy access to surrounding courses.

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel in vegas
reviews.text: Beautiful Hotel, excellent service, delicious restaurant and great bars. Our room was with a great view to the mountains and the Sphere. Room was modern and well decorate, comfy bed and pillows, super clean, the dining in room service was great also. Everybody was nice and providing and excellent service.

reviews.title: Pricey beautiful mess!
reviews.text: Beautiful resort,  but they say they offer "First Class Service" but couldn't get someone to clean our room after pressing the Service button and being gone 6+ hours, still came back to a dirty room. When I called, they basically blamed me and said that I must have pushed the wrong button! Grrr

reviews.title: Worth a stay
reviews.text: The rooms are spacious with floor to ceiling windows and the multiple pools are well staffed and clean. The modern design is stylishly simplistic with a few good dining options. Worth the stay if you don’t mind being further down the strip. Management is still working on consistency since it is a newer property.

reviews.title: Too expensive for stay, cute for visiting only
reviews.text: For the price that I paid I thought the room would be much nicer and I thought it’ll be an stress-free fun New Year’s visit. But it was not when I initially got to my first room. The room was dirty. There was a big hairball in the shower and the loose hair is on the entrance floor. I had to call the front and they said another room key wouldn’t be ready until 45 minutes, but it took almost 2 hours. Then when I did move rooms and I Use their phone the phone kept disconnecting the calls. They eventually fix this and for the TV instead of being able to just mirror or use a streaming service you have to use Chromecast, which is a little annoying. I had ordered DoorDash later that night and the driver forgot to give me utensils so I called room service and ordered utensils. They said there was a service charge for nine dollars and said it would be right up but that took 30 to 45 minutes I ended up eating my food with my fingers, washing my hands and falling asleep. I’m just saying for the price that I paid I’ve had way nicer rooms for New Year’s on the strip or near the strip and better experiences and it was cheaper. I was expecting more. Not sure I will stay here again.

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: Bad experience. We asked for a suite and had a leakage on one of our rooms. We had to wait for technician to fix it from 4:30 am to 6am in New Year’s Eve. Compensation offered felt like an insult, they offered a compensation on late checkout and a small fee

reviews.title: Best NYE experience
reviews.text: Definitely lives up to its hype. Visited the Miami Fontainebleau years ago. High-end, clean, well-managed property. We went there to celebrate NY and booked last minute with high prices. We were lucky enough to get a room with the strip view as requested and really enjoyed the spectacular fireworks from our room. Totally worth the money! A very memorable experience for my kids and I as the first time spending NY in Vegas. We had NYE dinner at Mother Wolf and NY Day Brunch at La Fontaine, and even late night gelato. All excellent meals!

reviews.title: Luxury Vegas experience
reviews.text: Rooms are gorgeous and clean. The service has improved and staff are friendly. They take great care of the facilities and maintenance and make sure everything is clean. The place is huge and there’s plenty to do for anyone in your party. Whether with your family or a couple this spot does not let you down. The food options and dining experiences are fabulous and I recommend anyone to stay here. If there are any issues- let the staff know and they will make it right. 5/5 recommend!

reviews.title: Good stay with some caveats
reviews.text: Clean and new room, good amenities. Lacks attention to detail and there are some service gaps to be addressed if this resort wants to stay competitive. Would stay again, but would not be my first choice due to location and the lack of things to do in the area.

reviews.title: Superb hotel in every way
reviews.text: Amazing hotel with a lovely, huge, spotlessly clean room overlooking the Strip and the Sphere.  Every single member of staff that I encountered was friendly and helpful, often going out of their way to help me.  Cannot fault anything at all about this hotel.

reviews.title: The new spot for Luxury on the Strip
reviews.text: I chose to spend my birthday at Fontainebleau Las Vegas.  I love luxury hotels and wanted to see what they had turned that dormant massive waste of steel into.  I was super pleased.  Access to the property from the strip is super easy.  Valet is beautiful and there are plenty of staff to assist you with getting to check in.  Everyone is smiling and nice as they welcome you in.  Front desk check in was super quick.  There was no line so the process went smoothly.  The walk to the guest elevators isn't as long as some but wear your walking shoes.  My Noble suite best view of strip was everything.  I could see the Sphere and the Marquis in front of the hotel.  The suite was bigger than I expected and had a second bathroom with a glassed in shower.  It was so relaxing and invigorating at the same time.  I never heard any noise from the hallways and there is a filtered water spout on the ice machine!  I didn't have to buy water!  The property also smelled wonderful!

reviews.title: Enjoyable holiday at FB!
reviews.text: Oscar at front desk and the housekeepers (sorry I forgot their names) provided excellent customer service! The room was immaculate and the food at the restaurants were mostly good - Kyu, Capons, Ito bar, Mother Wolf and washing potato was just ok. It’s at the end of the strip so the casino is not as crowded. Stay here if you want to relax and have a more peaceful ambiance. Would like to experience their spa the next time we come back.

reviews.title: Bar too small
reviews.text: The hotel is brand new which is great. But both the inside and outside looks dull. Entire building is just a rectangular box. Also, the bar is too small. Three of us cannot find seats and ended up going to outside bar.The cafe is great especially the bakery and cake are amazing. In

reviews.title: Best in class
reviews.text: This is an outstanding property. You will not be dissappointed. Check it out and thank me later!Spa is amazeballs:) Food choices are off the hook from formal to casual. Shopping hits the mark, friendly staff as well. In my time there, four days from Dec 25-29th the hotel was tastefully adorned with fresh flowers. The only negative is due to airline delays, I was not provided with the highest floor as requested in my reservation, despite 2 phone calls to advise of arrival time changes.

reviews.title: First Visit - won't be the last!
reviews.text: From the minute you walk in, you are just "wowed" by the place.  I checked in solo, I was there to visit a family member and friend who live in Vegas.  I also pampered myself at the spa.  It was worth every penny!  I would suggest to go early, use the facilities before and after your treatment.  The soaking, the treatment, the lounge, the massage - all of it was wonderful!  I felt so recharged.  I also enjoyed the fitness center quite a bit to start my mornings.  Then I'd grab some coffee across the way at the little coffee place.  Next time, I will try to see a show there.  The tickets were sold out this time for Duran Duran. The location was good and it was not far from other things I saw and did.  The food court was pretty good.  I did not try any of the restaurants.  I had some drinks in a few of the bars.  Everyone is really friendly.  The customer service was very good overall.

reviews.title: Best Hotel Experience on the Strip
reviews.text: The suites are exceptional. Very clean, great service and Christmas time is a wonderful time to visit. The variety of restaurants is excellent and they all offer a different atmosphere. It’s worth earning royal status because of the room upgrades and free valet.

reviews.title: Wonderful beds & food.
reviews.text: They have the most comfortable beds and bedding. So much so I wanted to take the bedding home with me. The rooms are a nice size along with the bathrooms with a huge tub.  The hotel is just beautiful and not overly crowded, so it makes it more enjoyable. It was a great one night stay.

reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.text: Absolutely outstanding hotel with exceptional customer service. Our room was stunning with a fantastic view and the bath robes were to die for. Miami Slice and Vida were both fantastic and we can't wait to try the bagel and sandwich place. The pool is beautiful, as is the casino and we can't wait to stay again in July 2025

reviews.title: A winter trip to FBLV
reviews.text: Overall Review of Fontainebleau Las VegasI recently had the pleasure of staying at Fontainebleau Las Vegas and came away with a mixed but mostly positive experience.Check-In Experience:The check-in process was a bit slow and unorganized, which was a minor inconvenience at the start of my stay.Room:My room was excellent. It had a great view and came with high-quality amenities like soap, a robe, and toiletries. It was very clean and smelled nice, providing a comfortable and relaxing space throughout my stay.Bell Services:I used Bell Services to drop off a gift for a guest, and they were helpful and efficient.Concierge:The Concierge team stood out by providing me with a high-class gold toothbrush and shave kit, both of which were impressive and added a nice touch of luxury to my stay.Pool and Oasis Deck:The Oasis Pool Deck was open, and I appreciated the sunshine during the late morning and early afternoon. However, I was disappointed that food service wasn’t available at the pool deck, which would have made the experience much better.Lapis Spa & Wellness:Lapis Spa was a highlight of my visit. The steam room and pool facilities were great, and the coffee and fruit offerings were a nice touch. My massage was exceptional—the therapist did great work and even provided me with valuable insights that I appreciated.Fitness Center:The fitness center at Fontainebleau is by far the best I’ve encountered on the Strip. The calisthenics setup was perfect for my workout style, and there were plenty of high-quality stationary bikes. Mckenzie, a staff member, was especially helpful and knowledgeable, which made the experience even better.Dining:I had great experiences at both Washing Potato and Vida. At Washing Potato, the food was excellent, and they accommodated my carnivore diet request without issue. I also had a romantic and unplanned dinner with a beautiful young lady, which added a memorable personal touch to the evening.Vida, in particular, was outstanding. It’s easily one of the best breakfast spots on the Strip. The atmosphere is bright and inviting, and I loved the coffee, fruit, and steak and eggs. Adrian, my server, provided exceptional service that made the experience even more enjoyable.The Tavern:The Tavern was a fun place to eat, especially with action on the game. I found plenty of great menu items for my carnivore diet and had a good time overall.Gaming Experience:I had a mostly positive gaming experience at the casino. The $20K line of credit redemption was a hassle and took much longer than I’d expect, especially compared to places like Caesars Palace. The cashier had difficulty with my request, and I was given slot tickets instead of cash. That said, I did hit a nice jackpot on video poker, getting a straight flush while playing 10 lines max bet at $5—definitely a highlight of the trip.Disappointing Incident:The most disappointing part of my visit occurred at the end of my stay. I'll leave out the specifics but it left a negative impression on what otherwise would have been a great experience. Feel free to reach out to me for more color.Overall Experience:Fontainebleau Las Vegas offers a beautiful and upscale experience, with standout features like the spa, fitness center, and breakfast at Vida. However, there were some operational kinks, including the check-in process, issues with the gaming experience, and the food service at the pool. Despite these drawbacks, the property offers a lot of great amenities and a fantastic atmosphere.

reviews.title: Great Stay After Christmas
reviews.text: Stayed here under an Amex FHR rate and was overall extremely happy with my stay. Parking was very easy and it's great that it's at least included in the resort fee (whereas most other resort fees on the Strip don't have any actual benefit...also free parking on the Strip is basically gone at this point). Check-in was fast and efficient. The hotel itself is absolutely beautiful and stunning, if this was located more south in the heart of the Strip, it would definitely be a lot more busy IMO. The stay was right after X-Mas and overall the hotel was pretty busy it seemed (at least near the check-in area).The room was really luxurious and definitely one of the best standard rooms on the Strip. Bathroom amenities were in these small bottles and while nice, were hard to get out of the bottle. Would probably prefer a large dispenser bottle instead honestly. The facilities were great all around with one of the pools still open and the gym being one of the best I've seen anywhere. Breakfast at Vida was really good (albeit pricey) with a good brunch selection. Chez Bon Bon had a really long line for coffee and it was a little disappointing to see them use an automatic espresso machine instead of a true manual espresso machine for a hotel of this caliber. Cafe Cuto upstairs though did have a true espresso machine. All the food in the Promenade was fantastic, we tried the Bagel shop as well as Miami Slice. Only negative experience was my keycard not working at around ~1330 even though I had a 1600 checkout confirmed during check-in. Thus, I had to go all the way downstairs to get a new key. Thankfully there wasn't much of a wait. Everyone here for the most part was very friendly and definitely more personable than the large casinos/resorts.Would definitely come back for the right price.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Lots of positives, really nice modern room (well it is a brand new hotel), very large bathroom. We were on the 70th floor, and it was so incredibly high, the lift was something else, so fast! The view was great , we could see the sphere and enjoyed looking at the different illustrations. We went to New York after and I think the hotel lift and view was more impressive than the viewing platforms we went to!The pool closing at 7pm was rubbish as the weather was still perfect.The main downside was how massive the hotel was, it was a very long walk to everywhere and hard to navigate. The location is not great, but we took an Uber to the other end of the strip and spent the day walking back, which worked really well.

reviews.title: Clean and modern. Well designed, helpful and friendly staff. One of the nicer hotels on the strip. 👍
reviews.text: Clean and modern. Well designed, helpful and friendly staff. One of the nicer hotels on the strip. 👍

reviews.title: Hotel double billed me and would not refund!
reviews.text: The hotel staff billed me incorrectly!  They double charged me for my stay and would not refund me!  I tried to call numerous times but the staff would not listen or refund me.  I am owed over $500 from them because of this billing error!  Would love if someone from the hotel can contact me to correct this.

reviews.title: You can't go wrong here
reviews.text: Fine luxury hotel with a few minor flaws.  This is a newish hotel and the rooms reflect that.  The bathrooms are wonderful with a separate shower and bathtub. The vanity is large with 2 faucets. The main issue is that it takes minutes before hot water flows in the shower.  And even then it isn't totally hot. The bedding is superior and my room had a fabulous view of the mountains.  In the winter, when they are snowcapped, this is a superior view to the strip. One small issue is that there in a spiked spiral ornament on the headboard above the beds for interior design.  I wasn't a fan of this as it occurred to me that if there was a jarring event, it might come unglued and impale me.  But I eventually got over that. Still, it wasn't my style. Overall, it was a high quality room with surfaces finished in marble. Housekeeping was excellent and timely in cleaning the room. I appreciate this and that team deserves credit.  By the way, pictures in the hallway are from Napolean's Fountainbleau in Paris.  Many guests did not recognize this, so I'd like to point it out.The gym was excellent and not too crowded.  It had free weights, all sorts of cardiovascular equipment,  mats for stretching etc.  They close at 7pm and I suggest they stay open to 8pm because quite a few of us were still in the gym at 7.In the winter, an ice skating rink opens in the pool area and this was quite popular. Still, one pool remains open, and while small, it was heated to perfection.Some say the hotel is a bit far from the main strip.  I did not find this to be the case as the Resort Worlds, Encore, and Wynn, as well as the Convention Center and Fashion Mall are not far away.  And the traffic in the area is reasonable.  This contrasts with the traffic in front of the Bellagio where you have to wait for the signal to change 7 times before you can move forward. I ate mostly offsite, so I can't comment on the restaurants.  And unfortunately, I did not game this time because it was a short excursion.This is an aside, but if one is interested in a nice bottle of wine/champagne  for the room, head to Wally's at the Resort World across the street where the selection is comme il faut.  And for Las Vegas, the prices are reasonable.  Or for quick Mexican food, look for Tacos el Gordo down the block where the lines are long but the food is good.I plan on returning.

reviews.title: Comfortable hotel for conventions, Not so much for gabmling/nightlife
reviews.text: Nice hotel with very good looking accommodations.  Lackluster casino floor especially compared to Wynn, Venetian and many others.  Location excellent to get to Convention Center, West Hall in particular but not hard to take loop to others.  Spa is most expensive on the strip though very nice. If in town for a convention and the price is right I'd stay again.  If looking to gamble/night life then not the place for you.

reviews.title: Perfection!
reviews.text: The hotel was perfection down to every little detail. The bed was super comfortable, the restaurants were classy and great food. The spa exceeded my expectations. The Christmas trees and decorations throughout the casino and hotel were beautiful. Definitely a 5* hotel.

reviews.title: Luxury stay, but be prepared to pay.
reviews.text: There are many great things about staying at this hotel. The rooms are big and clean, with full tubs and super comfy beds. The spa is hands down one of my favorite experiences in Vegas. However, you can't get a glass of wine for under $30, half the restaurants were closed, and overall you are just a little far away from the rest of the action on the strip.

reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text: One of the cleanest restaurants on the strip. I love that everything is new. The food is fantastic. Highly recommend Mother wolf and Komodo. Rooms are gorgeous. Customer service was top notch. Its a little bit of a walk to get down the strip but Uber is easy to get to at Fontainebleau. I would definitely stay here again

reviews.title: very nice
reviews.text: very nice and clean hotel and casino, about a year old but is being kept up nicely. A little far from the main area of strip but nice not being overly crowded. easy to catch Lyft and not that expensive to get anywhere. Easy walk to some of the other nice casinos too.

reviews.title: Fontainebleau - Beautiful Place - Can't wait to stay here again
reviews.text: Highly recommend this hotel. We stayed here for 7 days and didn't venture outside of it till after 2nd day. Many places to eat, shop, or just stay and gamble. All the staff from cleaning staff, security, front desk, concierge, and various other staff we encountered were so friendly and helpful. The hotel was glamorous and felt like you were enjoying a bit of luxury. You felt welcomed and safe here. Security was throughout. Very clean hotel. Had the mountain view room - gorgeous view! Room and bed was so comfortable - had some of the best sleeps ever!  Fitness area was large and had various equipment from weights, treadmills, fitness classes, crossfit  equipment. No issues with it being on the north end of strip - easy to get to the rest of the strip as the Duece bus runs every 10 mins. Bus stop just outside the doors. Each night you stay gives you a $50 credit to use throughout the hotel, promenade, restaurants or in-room. We had a vehicle and did the self-parking - no cost for guests.

reviews.title: Horrible experience exiting parking structure after concert.
reviews.text: We attended the Derek Hough Christmas show in the theater.  It took us over an hour to get out of the parking garage.  Every floor and every aisle was backed up and had to do a 4 way merge.  It was chaotic and dangerous as tempers flared.  I will not attend another concert at this hotel due to the parking situation.  Also, what I saw of the hotel did not impress.  Very cavernous feeling.  Everything is so spread out and hard to find your way around (poor or no signage.) Not very welcoming.

reviews.title: Just Outstanding!
reviews.text: Food was just outstanding and resort people were just great.  An outstanding experience (despite losing at casino) as everyone was so nice and accommodations were very clean and nice!  Highly recommended!  Without hesitation, I would choose Fontainebleau as my first choice for a return visit.

reviews.title: My new favourite Vegas Hotel
reviews.text: I had booked a paid for an early check in and had an email letting me know this was going to be honoured, and when I arrived at 11 I was told there was a room ready on floor 36. I had booked a Bleau room because the website said they all had soaking tubs and the Gold rooms did not. I asked for a room where I could see the Sphere and the receptionist (Kayleigh, who was lovely) said the Bleau room that was ready did not have a tub. So she changed me to a room on a slightly lower floor (24) with an excellent view of the Sphere. My room was the basic Bleau room and it was lovely, a large double wardrobe, chiller draw to store my own stuff as well as the usual mini bar. There was plenty of draws and hanging space as well as two hooks by the large mirror in the hall for coats. Like most of the Vegas hotels I have stayed in there was no kettle or coffee maker but I was expecting this and had my own travel kettle and tea. The room was beautifully furnished, curtains and sheers controlled from a small panel by the bed and another by the door, all the room lighting was also controlled in this way. However there was a glitch as the lights came on on their own two nights in a row, waking me up, and I was sleeping far away enough from the panel to know that I did not accidentally turn them on in my sleep!The bathroom had a large soaking tub, shower, double sink and WC. There was an opaque glass door between the WC and the rest of the bathroom. The shampoo, soap etc was provided in small bottles and smelt lovely too. And unlike the Bellagio where I had been staying prior to this, the Fontainebleau provide cotton wool, cotton tips and a shower cap, all useful! Their robes are also a lot nicer than the standard Bellagio robes - towelling on the inside and cotton on the outside, very comfortable for the times I was just chilling in my room. The shower was very strong and hot, and the towels and bed linen were high quality. I had a table with two chairs for in room dining as well as a sofa to chill out on. I spent the rest of the day exploring the Fontainebleau - there was one small pool open which was very warm, next to the ice rink. They were showing Christmas movies up there during my stay and I saw Home Alone. I could see at least two more pools and guess there was one under the ice rink too. The hotel is lovely, with a great ambience. I had dim sum for lunch at Washing Potato and dinner at Mama Wolf. There is a food court there too so plenty of choice for food - I collected pastries from the cafe for breakfast each morning. Some of the bars and restaurants were closed and due to reopen on Christmas Day but the bars I went in were quiet. Having stayed at the Wynn Tower, NoMad and Bellagio, all high end hotels, I think that the Fontainebleau is better than all of these and will be my new favourite hotel. It might be north of the Strip but I didn’t feel the need to walk elsewhere as there are handy bus stops close by and plenty of taxis.

reviews.title: Fontainebleau LV experience
reviews.text: Overall check in experience & room was phenomenal. I stayed here twice already & love the atmosphere there. Only thing i wish is that they would have more food restaurants open after midnight on a friday night. There was only 1 spot that was open at midnight & that was chez bon bon. The food was good but kind of pricey.

reviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas!
reviews.text: Most fabulous hotel we have ever had the pleasure to visit!The rooms, the restaurants, the Casino and the staff were all top notch! Everything you need all in one gorgeous hotel! Staff is always available to guide you, give recommendations or answer questions. The rooms are spacious and beautiful. An abundance of restaurants with all types of menus and varieties of food. The burgers and tacos on the Promenade are spectacular.  So many amazing restaurants we need to return to try more!

reviews.title: A must stay
reviews.text: The hotel was very Beautiful  with plenty of things to do while staying there.  Casino was big with friendly dealers and plenty of slot machine to choose from.  Rooms were big and spotless with plenty of amenities.  You will not be disappointed.

reviews.title: Our New Favorite!
reviews.text: Fontainbleau is our new favorite!  We stayed here in Dec 2024 for the first time even though we visited a couple of times prior to this we did not have the opportunity to stay at the hotel.  The rooms are extremely nice, they are beautifully decorated and spacious.  The restaurants are fantastic, the bars/lounges are great.  Plus there are a lot of things to do here besides gambling, which we did our fare share of!  See you soon!

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with excellent staff
reviews.text: The rooms are beautiful and very up-to-date. The staff is friendly and professional. Check-in was a breeze and she was able to offer a discounted upgraded room that was amazing. On site dining options are plentiful and vary greatly in cost and food options. I hope to stay there again.

reviews.title: Very Good.....But NOT Great
reviews.text: Spent two separate 3 night stays at the Fontainbleau in Las Vegas, one in July and the other over Thanksgiving weekend.I really wanted to love this hotel and instead I walked away thinking I liked it but there's still a few hiccups along the way.I would not honestly characterize this hotel as a 5-star property.    4.5 stars would be more appropriate.Firstly, in the Summer, there are no cushions on the chaises and no one helps you to set up your chair with towels and coverings.   Instead, you come out to the pool, get your towel and you're on your own.    Providing service at the pool should be a total given, especially in a property that believes they are 5-stars.Second, the gym, while amazing,  closes at 7pm daily.    That one is a big-time head-scratcher.   You have to sign in to access the gym at the spa, but to not provide 24 hour access to the gym, (especially in Las Vegas) is inexcusable.Turn-down service was spotty.  Offered one day but not another.No coffee maker in the room, which is odd.Although I asked prior to arriving in July for my son's room to be in the immediate vicinity and was told it was given at check-in, he was actually placed way over on the other side of the floor.While this is minor, it was mentioned in other reviews.   The shampoo/conditioner/lotion are all in hard plastic bottles.   It is sometimes very difficult to get the product to come out.   The bottle cannot be squeezed so you have to furiously shake it.   This is probably something that should have been rectified a year ago with the packaging.The food at Vida for breakfast is excellent.  The hotel allocated only the bare minimum of $60 per couple when you book thru AMEX FHR.   The breakfast menu was replaced by a brunch menu so there is really only 1 item on the menu offered daily that covers that $60.   Hotel sets the dollar amount too small.Service in Vida was mostly excellent but on the last day it was a disaster and the server vanished, then blamed the kitchen for the delay.All in all, I would return to the hotel but with lower expectations.   The rooms are clean & luxurious.   The views are amazing and the beds are very comfy.  You are north of the main part of the Strip but I know that going on and was fine with it.  Also be mindful that the resort fee includes things that you aren't necessarily using, especially in Winter, such as the pools or self-parking (if you come without a car.)

reviews.title: Great, clean, beautiful hotel & casino
reviews.text: The hotel was designed with such great care and necessities in mind that you might need when you travel. They had a clothes steamer, bottle opener in the drawer, cozy robes, comfy bed, and just over all a beautiful place to stay. I thoroughly enjoyed my time there and plan to go back in the future!

reviews.title: Nice new option for staying in Vegas
reviews.text: I was very happy staying here.  I did not have any problems.  The hotel is nice.  Check in was easy.  The staff is great.  There are some hidden gems with the restaurants.  The gym is excellent. I would go back.  I was concerned because there were some negative reviews when this place opened but I did not have any problems at all.

reviews.title: Awful experience.
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and clean, but was ultimately so disappointing (mostly on the service side). The room was large and clean, but the view out the window was literally a dirt pit (picture attached to prove that I’m not exaggerating). The hotel is pretty far North on the strip, so it feels a little quiet and like you are not in the middle of the action. I’m sure that is appealing to some, but I feel like most people don’t come to Vegas for a nice, quiet experience. We also had 2 extremely poor service experiences. 1. We made a reservation at Papi steak based on a recommendation. It is inside the hotel, and I was told it had a great “nightclub like” atmosphere, which was appealing to me. I was seeing a show that night, so I had to make the reservation for 10. I figured it would be no problem since the restaurant was open to 11 and supposedly a “cool” place. That afternoon, the restaurant called and said they wanted to seat the last table at 9 pm that night and asked if I could move the reservation up. I could not since the show didn’t even get out before then, so I was forced to cancel and find something else at the last minute. I can easily get seated at any chain restaurant in the suburbs after 9 pm, so I’m not sure how they can justify holding themselves out as a cool destination when they can’t even compete with a Chili’s or an Applebees. 2.  I was attending an industry awards dinner and sent a dress shirt out to be pressed. I did it very early in the morning to meet the same day deadline, but it was not returned by 7 pm as advertised. It ended up being delivered much later (well after the dinner started). The concierge did recommend a men’s shop in the hotel to possibly buy a shirt last minute, but I could not justify paying their low, low price of $360 for a plain white button up shirt. I ended up having to attend in something other than a suit and tie and felt extremely underdressed. It ruined what should have been a great night as our company won our category, but I had to take pictures as pretty much the only person not in a suit and tie. The night was embarrassing enough, but I never got the impression that the staff cared at all or wanted to do anything to proactively help me solve the problem that their hotel created. I’m sure others have had good experiences, because the hotel does have its strong points, but based on personal experience, I can not recommend it, and I would strongly encourage others to stay elsewhere.

reviews.title: North end of the Strip is my go to now
reviews.text: Second time here and love it. Easy check in and lots of fast elevators. Room is large and when compared to NYC or most large cities it’s huge. The Xmas decorations or very nice and the place is very walkable. In too visits I’ve yet to stay on the weekends so don’t know how  crazy that can be. Ice rink out in the pool area is cool

reviews.title: Best beds in Las Vegas
reviews.text: They have the most comfortable beds. The pools in the summer are great. The atmosphere is wonderful. Lots of different food choices that will not all break the bank. Everyone that works there is pleasant and you really feel safe on their property.

reviews.title: Broken amenities, tasteless food, wouldn't return
reviews.text: Nothing about my stay was 5 stars. I give it 2 because at least employees were friendly. The "upgrade" I was offered resulted in a low room facing the skating rink with screaming children outside my window and a 100 foot tall LED wall that the shades were not able to block out. The electronic controls for the shades did not work, maybe because the control panel is not even secured to the wall, similar to the HVAC intake. I ordered a pizza and salad to room my room that cost $100 and were void of any flavor whatsoever. Couldn't use the $3 billion fitness center because despite paying a hefty resort fee it closes at 8pm.

reviews.title: Beautiful Gem at the end of the Strip! A must stay !
reviews.text: From the moment you arrive it is the best experience in Vegas. Combination of new with the flare of vintage Vegas. The food is the best-The convenience of the casino to rooms is great - best bathroom / bedroom. Newer hotel that is very well maintained! Mountain View’s are spectacular- the Spa is a Must! Bring your swimsuit to enjoy the amenities though.

reviews.title: Nothing but the best in Vegas...
reviews.text: Perhaps the best hotel I've ever experienced.  No attention to detail left unturned. The staff was friendly and helpful at every turn.  The fabulous restaurants had world-class food and service, the fitness center was second to none, the numerous bars were comfortable with great bartenders and wait staff.   The hotel presented unbelievable luxury.   Even the room cleaning staff was responsive and the room was cleaned almost immediately when the service light was turned on. And there was even an outdoor ice skating rink for the holidays.  I could go on and on but I think you get the idea.    After visiting other hotels on the strip, we found nothing to compare to the experience we had at the Fontainebleau.

reviews.title: Beautiful property, great staff, superb rooms.
reviews.text: We have been visiting Las Vegas for several years and always wondered about this big building that was just sitting there. It was exciting to hear that they were opening and even more exciting to have the opportunity to book a couple of nights here. First thing to know is that this is what I call the north end of the south strip. The Sahara and Strat are the only big names between here and Downtown. If you walk it is a really long way to the Mandalay Bay. However, the monorail, the Deuce, or ride share are all reasonable ways to get around. The hotel is impressive, no doubt. The lobby is large and shiny, the ceilings are high and opulent, and the bars are beautifully laid out. The choice of dining in the hotel is broad and everything we tried was very good, and (on the Vegas scale) reasonable. The people here made all the difference. Our bartenders and servers were all attentive, accurate, and gave us a great experience. Fontainebleau has a very wide array of slot machines, scattered all over the floor. Every corner we rounded, there were more machines. The tables are laid out in areas around the floor, with a longer cluster set in one wing. While they were not crowded, there were quite a few people playing and there were some tables available for overflow.All in all, this is a new, gorgeous hotel. The staff is invested in your experience, the rooms are spectacular, and while smoking is permitted, the high ceilings seem to help avoid the cloud of smoke that gathers in some casinos. I will return.

reviews.title: FontainBleau - Gorgeous, pricey and maybe a bit over-deccadent.
reviews.text: Fantastic experience at this new property! Yes, it's pricey. My wife and I both have special dietary needs and we got outstanding accommodations with our food allergies (non-Gluten). Highly recommend getting the app for the property and put in your guests' dietary needs - it will make it much easier for the staff to prepare accommodation and offer suggestions. Gluten free bun at the fast-casual burger joint? Sure! Gluten free rolls at Don's Prime? Yup! Gluten-free toast as an option for breakfast? Sure! No upcharge for these, by the way, which would be a normal addition at most establishments. Now the "shops" are a bit silly - as you'll find at places like The Venetian, Bellagio, etc. These are shops that seem to solely exist where you blow the money you just won at the casino, or you're a world traveler with no concerns for expense. Branded stores (Gucci) with very limited selection and very expensive merchandise. There is a small shop for necessities that's located just off the lobby, but you can probably skip the rest of the "shops" which carry luxury purses, clothing and accessories. Unlike further down the strip, there aren't any walking-distance shops like Target or Ross, so you may not be shopping much, and the area, on the end of the strip near Downtown is pretty limited. Avoid walking around the area at night, and consider taking an Uber to get you to additional shops at places like Miracle Mile.

reviews.title: Almost perfect stay
reviews.text: I really enjoyed this hotel. The staff were very nice, the facilities were upscale. It was decorated beautifully for Christmas. The only reason I did not give 5 stars is because the sink in our room barely had any water pressure and it took foreeeever to get warm or hot water. And the toilet paper sucked. It just broke apart while I tried to use it

reviews.title: Wow Bleau! Wow!!!
reviews.text: This has to be the best room in Vegas for the price. Wonderful on all aspects. The ambience is the best. My rooms was comforable on a different level which allowed me to relax for short stay in Vegas. Top class. Everything about the establishment it Top Class.

reviews.title: Must go
reviews.text: This place was amazing! The spa was out of this world.  Only comment would be expanding the sit down breakfast options but well worth the prices! Comfy bed. Room service was great. Would go again next year.  Try it for yourself, you won't regret it

reviews.title: Definitely Coming back
reviews.text: The hotel was absolutely fantastic and Service was Five Star for sure - from the moment you get there you feel like your taken care of and the people at the Hotel really care about your overall experience.  Lots of smiling faces.   Papi restaurant was epic, saw a show at the concert arena that's next door to the restaurant.  Komodo had amazing food and drinks.

reviews.title: Glamourous..oh the glamorous
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel with amazing shower pressure. Bed was comfortable and furnishings were all of high quality. The only hotel we stayed in Las Vegas that still provides slippers. Sometimes it's the little touches that make the difference.Staff absolutely amazing. Attentive, helpful and friendly. All restaurants we ate in, whilst prices were a little high, were above average. All quality and simply delicious and we went back to some places simply because everything was so good.For us, we like the North end of the Strip and Fontainbleau is reminiscent of a glamourous hotel from the past with a modern and sophisticated vibe without the pretentiousness.

reviews.title: Spectacular weekend at the Fontainebleau
reviews.text: We just stayed at the Fontainebleau last Thursday through Saturday.  Each part of our stay at the Resort exceeded our expectations.  The Fontainebleau was beautiful and tastefully decorated.  The gym was spectacular.  The pools and ice skating rings were beautiful and inviting. We ate at Komoda and Mother Wolf and had delicious dinners.  World class dinning.  Our daughter joined us (recent Cal grad) and loved the experience.

reviews.title: Classy Fontainebleau!
reviews.text: It’s a class act resort. It’s beautiful and the service, food and ambiance are excellent. It’s my new favorite place. I love the rooms, in room dining and the Casino is amazing. The staff goes out of their way to be accommodating and welcoming!

reviews.title: Nice place to stay
reviews.text: I stayed here for one night on a recent trip. The hotel looks new and they really did it first class. It’s a pretty great place.  The room was large and had a great view.  The people were all super nice.  There are a ton of places to eat and it’s easy to find things. It’s really well done.

reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: Great property. 10/10 The staff is amazing, and the property is fresh and clean. I've stayed here 5 times, & it has become my favorite Vegas get away spot. The bars are amazing, and Lapis spa is incredibly luxurious. The pools are really nice with plenty of space to spread out.

reviews.title: Amazing anniversary trip!!!! 10 out of 10
reviews.text: This was my second time in Vegas. My wife and I were celebrating our 14th anniversary. My wife had seen the Fountain Bleau on instagram and we decided to book it. We hade an amazing time. The resort is upscale and doesn't lack in any amities. Everything from the room, bars, restaurants, and casino are amazing! Truly a place to go and not have to leave in search for anything else! This resort is what Vegas needed!

reviews.title: Always 5 stars for us!
reviews.text: The rooms are very comfortable and inviting. The staff is very friendly and helpful in all areas of the establishment. Casino is easy to get around. We love to eat at La Fontaine for brunch, you can't go wrong with anything on the menu. The endless champagne is one of our favorite things to get. We always make reservations so we don't miss out on starting our day out right!

reviews.title: I recommend it highly.
reviews.text: Excellent food, service is outstanding and the ambiance with high ceilings make it feel at ease, also smells nice without the taste of cigarette smoke in your mouth. You might be a little away from the other casinos but a little walk good for us.

reviews.title: Don’t be fooled by a few nice pictures. It’s not a nice stay
reviews.text: The place is like a sterile castle. I was shocked how empty it was. Not just of attractions but of people. Thomas Rhett was playing here but the casino and restaurants were still empty on Friday and Saturday night.  It might be because it’s further away than you’d think looking on a map. The rooms were a little small too. Some nice decor in them, but ours hadn’t really been cleaned and there were several things broken.

reviews.title: Loved this hotel.
reviews.text: Loved it here. Beautiful hotel and lovely staff. Had a wonderful room on the 61st floor. Great views. Loved the ambience of the casino and great restaurants. Would definitely stay here again. Location was 30 mins walk to the Sphere which was perfect for our Eagles concert. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Fountaine Bleau
reviews.text: My husband and I have been going to Vegas twice a year for years. This was our first time staying at the Fountaine Bleau and it’s the best hotel we ever stayed at. Lots of restaurants, room and view were beautiful, staff was great, smelled wonderful, ceilings were very tall so didn’t smell smoke and a variety of slots. Many slots min bet of .75 cents. This is our new go to hotel!!  It was amazing!!!

reviews.title: Other places are better
reviews.text: This hotel is new-ish, but there is better locations. Parking is a nightmare with traffic going every which way, food was ok, the gambling area was lacking items. Hotel is down the strip, so if you are use to being on the middle of the strip don’t stay here.

reviews.title: Well Heeled.
reviews.text: Fun Place to visit.  Many well heeled people walking around; great for people watching.   Slots are loose.  Staff friendly.         You can walk across the street and see the last slot machines that take coins.  See you there, see you on The Strip !!!!!!!

reviews.title: Amazing week
reviews.text: The smelling good pillows were the fluffiest and comfortable.  We were at right across the nightlight view of the Spheres.  My family were very satisfied and love the view of the skating rink also outside.   We’ll definitely come back again to spend our relaxing visit.

reviews.title: Great view, but not the bathtub I paid for
reviews.text: This is a beautiful property, but it is at the end of the strip, so access from the airport is problematic.  Coming in last night the traffic on the cab ride was terrible, to the point of carsickness, so beware of the access issues.  The main problem I had was the room I received vs. what I thought I ordered.  I paid a premium - last minute to see George Strait/Chris Stapleton and go to the NFR.  Looked at the Fontainebleau’s reviews and properties - great, for the most part.  The problem was the hotel filled up, and instead of a nice bathtub, I got an ADA accessible room.  I understand that the hotel has ADA obligations, and that is a great thing, and I fully support that accessibility.  Management just needs to realize that a guest may have been looking forward to soaks in the beautiful bathtub that was advertised as part of the room (not the minimum price mind you, but a premium view room) and should have made sure that a room was available that had the advertised amenity, in this case a bathtub.  If I had known my room was going to not have the bathtub I thought was included with the premium price, I would have found another room, for sure closer to the airport, and avoided the carsickness on the cab ride.  I asked for another room, or a discount, and was told, the “Hotel is full and I can’t do anything, you need to go to the front desk”.  Just make sure you get the room you ordered, and don’t leave the front desk until you have their assurance that you are going to get the room you ordered, and watch out for the cab ride.  Beautiful property, I just wish I got what I thought I paid for.  Another problem is the gym closes early, at 7 pm, so that was another small burr under the saddle.

reviews.title: My New Favorite Hotel In LV
reviews.text: This hotel is AMAZING, from the staff, the decor, the room accommodations, the spa, the huge choices in dining, the shopping, and the entertainment. You can see that they take great care of the hotel, because every where you go there is staff cleaning and sanitizing, and that's an A++ for me.  The guest rooms are also cleaned and maintained very well. This place definitely will not disappoint!!

reviews.title: Extraordinary Resort
reviews.text: No other resorts or hotels compares to the Fountainebleu. This resort hold a category of its own. I will stay only at the Fountainebleu Resort when visiting Las Vegas. The #1 resort in Las Vegas! This is my second time staying at this resort and I recommend this resort!

reviews.title: Interesting…..
reviews.text: Have looked forward to staying while watching the construction process. I think this property will have to up its game to truly be considered a 5star. The food outlets are sub par , no excuses at this point! Property has been open a year. Considering the quality and options in LV this should not be the case. Retail is basically non-existent… sad.  The rooms are comfortable and functional. The casino floor is ok. Not sure if I would recommend.

reviews.title: AMAZING all around!
reviews.text: Noble Suite facing the pool/Las Vegas strip and you won’t forget it! You’re one lucky customer if you encounter Karen Crisostomo at Concierge. Amazing customer service! She will make your stay a wonderful experience. Resort is newer, modern with luxurious finishes. Smells so good too! Food promenade is yummy and unique to only Fontainebleau resorts. You have to try Miami Slice! Komodo is also a must for dinner! Guests have free parking using your room key.

reviews.title: Great first experience
reviews.text: The whole resort is spacious, clean, well kept, with great lighting.  The staff is friendly and responsive.  The food court had great options.  Bar Ito had great hand rolls and poke bowls and miami slice had great fresh put of the oven pizza.  Room was spacious and clean.

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: We had a great experience! Rooms/bathrooms were exceptional, the decoration of the hotel is so pretty and it's not very crowded. Food and service at the restaurants can get a bit better but they were good. Will definitely come back and highly recommend.

reviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas.
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau Las Vegas Is now the place to stay in Vegas. The staff is precise and attentive. The views are amazing and the dining exquisite. It was worth every penny, my only regret is not staying longer. I will definitely return to soak it all in.

reviews.title: Great Value!
reviews.text: I really like this hotel, especially the staff. Everyone is incredibly friendly and helpful. I also appreciate that it’s a non-smoking hotel. Although I did notice a few people smoking inside and could smell the smoke, overall, it’s much better than the MGM hotels.While many people enjoy a bustling atmosphere, I prefer the more spacious and less crowded feel of this hotel. Some shops are still under construction, but I think they’ve curated a great mix of stores, and I’m looking forward to their opening. The parking lot is also more spacious, which is a big plus—I hate searching for parking.Overall, it was a great experience, and I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.title: Go for the vibe, stay for the Matzo Ball Soup!
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau is a must visit in Las Vegas. The vibe is amazing and food is out of this world. Don’s Prime on the Casino level and Bagel Bagel in the food court are outstanding! You have to try the Matzo Ball Soup. They have 24/7 restaurant and the hotel is dog friendly. What more can you ask for.

reviews.title: November to Remember
reviews.text: Excellent hotel with 5-star ambience and service.  Must try the resto - Washing Potatoes - unusual name but delicious dimsum !  The check-in experience is prompt and staff is courteous. The rooms are clean, the linens crisp and the daily cleaning of the rooms are prompt.

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: Best hotel ever I had the best shower here the water pressure is great the towels smells like flowers everything is good here we were at the 59th floor hotel is beautiful !!! It’s at the end of the strip but it’s ok I love to walk! The receptionist are all nice here

reviews.title: Absolutely Awesome (Versailles 2.0?)
