reviews.text: Immaculately kept and almost brand new, this is actually an oasis resort filled with all of the most beautiful and interesting items and memorabilia that I have ever seen.  It’s like the most beautiful museum I’ve ever seen (besides Art Institute of Chicago) where my wife and I went on our first date. I love the atmosphere, the stores are all of the highest luxury imaginable and it’s a place you hope you have unlimited money to buy whatever your heart desires.

reviews.title: Worst hotel experience in Vegas.
reviews.text: An absolute scam. Our stay was awful. If they would have refunded us (they refused), we would have left the first night. Our room was beautiful, and except for the painters tape we found everywhere. The hallway for our room was still being built. The was construction all night. It increased after midnight! Drills, saws, hammering. We paid over $6,000 for an f1 package that basically gave us tickets that cost $1000 and charged us $5000 for a 4 night stay. It’s $250 on the site. The shuttle left us at the stadium and we stood in the cold (41 degrees) for an hour. We were given a $100 credit when we asked about the high price of our package vs the average rates, but their room service charged a $9 fee and included an 18% tip. We were going to tip anyway, but our $100 credit got us two pieces of cheesecake. We didn’t receive our refund for the full incidental and deposit fee either? Still waiting for a response. I have worked in the hospitality industry and never leave bad reviews, even if the stay isn’t the best, but this place is beyond disappointing. I honestly felt scammed. Everything was falsely advertised and misrepresented.

reviews.title: Pamper Yourself at the Fountainebleau Las Vegas
reviews.text: Our staycation at the new Fountainebleau Las Vegas for my husband's birthday was perfect!  We had a view of the Sphere which was a treat.  The room was immaculate, roomy and modern.  The pressure in the shower was incredible.  Bed was super comfortable and sheets divine.  Check in was easy.  Stayed the Monday after the Formula 1 race and got to see a car just outside of the ride share area.  Wasn't crowded and we were able to get around very easily.  Wanted to eat at Azul, but was closed on Monday. Went to The Tavern instead and was a great choice.  Brandy was our server and she was exceptional. I ordered what had to be the best Fish and Chips in Las Vegas, 3 pieces, delicious coleslaw and lots of crispy fries.  Hubby had a double cheese burger and announced it as the best he's had ever.  Cudos to the chef.For breakfast we ate at Chez Bon Bon, excellent coffee, croissants and fruit parfait.All and all extremely positive experience with the exception of the gaming machines.   Tight machines, no payouts after several hours of play:-(

reviews.title: Bleau Bar Better Than Collins
reviews.text: This review is for both bars at the Fontainbleau.  We went with friends to Collins bar.  It was OK.  I much preferred the Bleau bar for atmosphere and a great bartender.  Cory was a great bartender at the Bleau Bar.  He made the best espresso martini.  I told him I liked it a little creamier and he put Bailey' in.  We like the open atmosphere at the Bleau bar compared to Collins, which was inside, kind of dark and not as good.

reviews.title: Loved this upscale option
reviews.text: Nice hotel experience where I felt like the staff were a bit more attentive than usual for Vegas, which was a pleasant surprise.The room was spacious and well decorated with good amenities. Even though I got the lowest level of room, I still felt like I was getting a treat, particularly with the huge soaking tub.I ate at three of the restaurants and enjoyed all of them, particularly Kyu and Washing Potato. They were a bit expensive, but I didn't feel ripped off. Service was very good at all also.I used the North uber pick up only and found it to be relatively convenient compared to some of the other rideshare pick up options at other Vegas properties.The spa was a happening place and had top of the line facilities. In the women's area it was a little hard for them to keep up with replenishing the snacks and beverages. It was also inconvenient to have to ask for a lot of typical amenities like hairdryer because they didn't put much out. I assured the staff I would not steal the hair dryer they handed me. They have a rule against using cell phones in the spa, which I was surprised to see appeared to be well obeyed by patrons. Because of that rule, I would have expected better kept and more options for magazines available in the relaxation area. The spa did feel a bit excessively priced. The nail service pricing was an absolute joke, particularly the $60 upcharge for Dazzledry when a Dazzledry manicure tends to cost less than $60 for the entire manicure.I thought my room rate was on point pricing wise. I asked for a quiet room and indeed got one. Despite the fact it was the weekend, I got a great quality sleep. I asked for a late check out so I could do my spa treatment and then head back to my room but it was denied. So I was forced to check out at 11am and then hit the spa. Unconventionally the hotel does not accept room charges after you check out. So I had to take my spa treatment receipt to the awards desk to make sure I got credit for it with the membership rather than just being able to add it to the room like literally every other hotel. If you can't extend late check out, please figure out a way for guests to continue to charge hotel expenses to their account.

reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.text: Nice relatively hotel, very nice and comfortable rooms, big  casino including slkt machines and gaming  tables, variety of restaurants, friendly staff especially the host Mr. Scott Poster.Location on Las Vegas strip, easy to drive to, big and clean parkinglot.

reviews.title: The Newest ‘Go-To’ Hotel in Vegas!
reviews.text: I was booked in to Fontainebleau for business and wasn’t sure what to expect as it’s not one of the ‘recognised’ Vegas names but I have to say I was blown away! The decor and quality of the rooms were amazing. The staff were all superb and so helpful and friendly. As a fitness enthusiast I was probably most excited to see the gym. I’m often not hopeful with hotel gyms but the gym here was really different class! It’s better than most commercial gyms. As a former Equinox employee, I would say this is at a very similar size and standard!They have a fantastic array of restaurants - from Chez Bon Bon for your morning coffee and overnight Oats, Washing Potato for some of the best Dumplings I’ve ever eaten, and Don’s Prime Steakhouse for that special treat.Can not recommend highly enough. I’ll be back next year!

reviews.title: Calm and relaxing
reviews.text: What an incredible Hotel! Beautiful beautiful beautiful! Every inch sparkles! All the employees are incredibly nice! Can’t wait to go back! The room and the view were breath taking! Everything was done to perfection! I am so impressed with everything!

reviews.title: Fantastic F1 Weekend At The Fontainebleau
reviews.text: I had the privilege to be invited to F1 by Puma and watch the race from their hospitality suite. I stayed in a Noble Suite for the weekend which definitely had a eurotrash vibe to it. The hotel of course was full and they did a fantastic job of catering to race fans and A listers alike. We had a low key dinner at Don's Prime which was stellar as always and a nice alternative to Papi Steak. The casino floor was busy but easy to get on the tables and the dealers were patient with some of the Aston Martin team that were a little green on playing craps for the first time. I took advantage of a quiet Saturday afternoon to enjoy a massage and steam at Lapis Spa  followed by a pre party at Komodo before the race. Overall F1 weekend in Vegas was a blast and given the opportunity I'd do it again as the Fontainebleau continues to execute the art of hospitality flawlessly.

reviews.title: Best Resort in Vegas!
reviews.text: This resort is the best resort in Veags in my opinion! I have stayed at all of them and never had service at this level from start to finish! Food was excellent, facility was extremely clean and EVERYONE was so friendly and helpful! We will be back!

reviews.title: My new go to
reviews.text: The Lighting and the smell of the lobby was breath taking. The accessibility to the strip was convenient . My room was very modern decor, technology but the best was the ability to cast from my phone to the TV. Will stay here again, cant wait…..

reviews.title: Designed by out of touch bros bathed in cologne.
reviews.text: Other than being new, it was an uncomfortable stay. There were no good food options after hours. The lobby scent was musky and strong like a group of boys bathed in Axe spray walked by. The functional design of the rooms was not well thought out. Door to the toilet barely clears when pushed inwards. The shower heads could not be adjusted, shorter people basically will have to touch the wall to get in the spray of the shower. The toiletry products came in pretty blue bottles that were a nightmare to get the product out of. On top of the that it’s poorly run, first room we got was not cleaned, crumbs and hair all over the floors. The solution to this was to send house keeping to the room? So we can awkwardly sit in the room while they clean? I had to demand a room change. Bad training for the staff even thought they were every where. This place is designed and run by some rich guy who thinks he knows what luxury is but obviously never pays attention to or appreciate people in their lives that’s do all the little things to make life easier or functional. This place is out of touch for what it wants to charge and to be labeled luxury. Bring in a Hilton or Marriott to run the place at least they have a baseline of hospitality even if they don’t want to go for the pedestrian strip casino market

reviews.title: High end Vegas. Regal and top notch!
reviews.text: I stayed at this resort and also partially at Mandalay Bay. The stay at fountainbleau surpassed Mandalay by mikes for me. The quality of room and service can’t be compared. Everything felt new and crisp. The views were incredible overseeing the sphere and portions of the strip. The amenities were extremely plush and well thought out. I loved every second of my visit.

reviews.title: Pool hours limited.  Food overpriced.
reviews.text: Resort fee not justified.  Silver tier does not get resort fee waived.  Front desk would not waive it when asked based on emails sent saying they would waive it in November if you booked two nights.  Well this email came after we booked and were on our way.  But it seems FB just nickels and dimes you on this resort fee which is not good value.

reviews.title: Favorite LV resort
reviews.text: This has become our favorite property when in Las Vegas. Everything is top notch. Very well done. Staff is wonderful. Attention to detail is wonderful. The atmosphere and tone the entire resort sets is a step above. It is easy to get to and slightly removed from all the craziness of the strip but still close enough to get to center stop with a short taxi ride. Love it.

reviews.title: Birthday Stay
reviews.text: We just completed our 4th dtay at the Fountainbleu for my birthday.  We stayed in a Noble Suite with a great view of the Sphere and south strip.  The customer service was top notched shout out to Aislinn and Karen Crisostmo for taking care of all of our needs.  We were able to check in around 10:00am without a hitch.  They were able to change our initial room because the view was horrible.  The food and bars are outstanding.  Our favorite place to stay on the strip. Love the free coffee

reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.text: This is an excellent hotel to stay at. The roomsare wonderful and customer service first class. Everything is first class. The rooms were spectacular and also very quiet. The location is right in the middle between freemont and other casinos. Highly recommend

reviews.title: Highly recommended. The perfect setting and position to be able to really enjoy Las Vegas.
reviews.text: An exceptional hotel, perfectly positioned to get the most of Las Vegas. We loved the light and bright rooms with floor to ceiling window and views of The Strip and The Sphere. The Lapis Spa is the perfect antidote to jetlag; we could easily have spent the entire day there. The choice of bars and restaurants is incredible, from fine dining and cocktail bars, to the Promenade of classy bagel, pizza and taco options. The Fontainebleau has all you need on site, and is within easy reach of the Strip, shopping and the Convention Centre.

reviews.title: The most twinkles in a Las Vegas casino on the strip
reviews.text: Great rooms, clean and nice finishes. housekeeping was fabulous. Restaurants are top notch. In terms of gaming - they are giving away the money in this beautiful casino. All my friends won big money. I only won $300 but at least I didn’t have my clock cleaned

reviews.title: Vegas charm
reviews.text: This was our second time stay at this fabulous resort. Unlike other Vegas Mega resorts, the service by far is the best to be had in Vegas.  The gambling tables have happy smiling dealers who actually want you to win.  The choice of restaurants is amazing and elegant.  The pool is heaven on its own and has a covered full casino, a full bar and full of employees ready to help.  The rooms are fresh, clean and always ready upon check in.  Highly recommend this resort.

reviews.title: First time at FB
reviews.text: A beautiful property! One of the cleanest on the strip!Rooms were so fresh it actually had a live plant on the table.It was costlier that other casinos to get money out of my checking account.  One night I did very well in the casino the next night not so lucky!  Would love to return.

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: Friendly staff,  clean, beautiful rooms. Promenade food delicious. Restrooms very clean. Every employee there was always willing to help and give suggestions.  Second time I have stayed here and will continue to in the future. Beautiful decor and great food choices.

reviews.title: Great Hotel and Casino
reviews.text: Best food and clean rooms. Staying here we were well taken care of. So much to do at this casino always packed on weekends. Looking to revisit hopefully sooner rather than later. Hopefully during the summer to try out the pool area. Casino was huge with plenty of room between machines waiting staff exceptional with drinks.

reviews.title: Fountaine fabulous
reviews.text: Rooms and services were great. Super new and super clean. Nice food. Nice casino. Saw a show in the theater. Was a great stay. The bed was super comfy. We enjoyed a casual meal in the sports tavern. We also had some great dim sum. Would highly recommend staying here in Vegas.

reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: The hotel room provided an excellent experience, offering exceptional comfort and ample space. The decor was nice and the environment was quiet, ideal for relaxing after a busy day. The furniture was of high quality, ensuring a comfortable stay. In addition, the room space was perfect, with enough area for us to move freely and accommodate all our needs. Without a doubt, this convenience contributed significantly to making our stay even more pleasant.

reviews.title: Would stay again for sure
reviews.text: I had not stayed at this property before and needed something on short notice. After a quick search I noticed that the prices here were significantly lower than prices on the central part of the strip, so we decided to give it a shot. It was an easy Uber ride from the airport and the property was clean and well maintained. Check in at 10pm was easy and straightforward. We had booked a double queen room and it was large, with comfortable beds and very nice bathroom (separate tub and shower and vanity/sink that was large enough for two people to use at the same time). My single room complaint was that there isn't a coffee machine, but the coffee shop downstairs was easily accessible and fast ($7 cup of drip coffee). At night there was some noise from a TV in an adjacent room but it wasn't bad.In the past this has been a sketchy part of town but after walking from the Cosmo to the Font at 11pm on a Saturday night, I found it to be very mellow. No insane behavior/drug addicts or homeless people and we felt quite safe walking LV Blvd through this section. We were only hassled by one guy who was hustling for some strip clubs, but he was pretty friendly and not aggressive. We didn't gamble or eat at any restaurants on the property and we didn't use the pools or the gym, but what I appreciated was that it wasn't as crowded as other resorts on the strip, and it felt very clean and modern. It was very easy taking a ride share service from the Font to other areas. It's also close to the arts district, which has great breweries and casual food. Absolutely would stay again if I needed to be on the strip.

reviews.title: They have a lot of work to do
reviews.text: I should preface this with Vegas hotels were the pinnacle of service pre covid and they have not bounced back. This hotel was brand new so I'd like to give them some leeway but it was an meh experience for a lot of money. We had connecting rooms both of which were dirty with big black hairs left in the sinks, gross. We ordered room service for dinner twice, the food was hardly edible.for dinner. Breakfast room service though was delightful. The room was spacious and beds comfortable.

reviews.title: Maybe the best experience I've had in Vegas.
reviews.text: I visit Las Vegas quite regularly and although this was my first time at the relatively new Fontanbleau,  it won't be my last. I was there for 9 night enjoying every aspect of this resort. Room, staff, restaurants, bars were all amazing. Everyone seemed to go the extra step to insure an enjoyable experience.  This was one through ten on my bucket list and it achieved them all. Absolutely beautiful. If there's  anyone out there with a bad experience, they are too critical or lost more money than they had set aside.

reviews.title: New Luxury stay on the Strip
reviews.text: Hotel is great and service was fantastic. Rooms were spacious and the bathrooms high end. We went for a long weekend, and the hotel itself did not seem to be that crowded, which we appreciated. The restaurants were full but the casino and bars were not over run like some hotels on the strip get. We ate at several restaurants and had very good food. Papi steak was the best - similar to Delilah in my opinion but more of a party - and the service at the Chyna club was excellent.  We did not make it to LIV, so I can’t speak to that. Would definitely recommend staying here for an upscale vibe in Vegas!

reviews.title: It’s Not Just For Gambling
reviews.text: What a beautiful and well-appointed property, with fabulous facilities and sumptuous service in safe and secure surroundings. An exceptionally attentive staff. The food for our meetings was appetizing, handsomely presented, and delightfully varied.

reviews.title: Fabulous Experience
reviews.text: The Fountain Bleau was a very Pleasent Experience.  The personal were above and beyond then most places on the Las Vegas Strip.  The Check-In experience was above and beyond anything I have experience here in the States, it has a European flair to it.  As does all the employees associated with this Hotel.  In addition, the cocktail waitress were "Fast" and friendly.  Fountain Bleau should be the trainers for the other casinos in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: My new go-to on The Strip.
reviews.text: this is my first stay. the hotel is brilliant. The architecture and interior design are draw-droping in awe. The rooms - even a "normal one" are roomy, brilliantly decorated with tons of natural and ambiemt light. The staff is as professional as can be. Mother Wolf, imho, is the best Italian restaurant on The Strip, nhands down.

reviews.title: Move Over Four Seasons...
reviews.text: Obsessed with this property!  We were long term Four Seasons Las Vegas devotees and tried the Fontainbleau on a recommendation. So glad we did.  This will now be our LV default hotel.  Everything is new, sparkling and amazing.  The hotel is well staffed and the rooms are nicely appointed. I'd read reviews about cleanliness and dirty rooms, but our rooms were spotless!  Definitely one of the best/most posh rooms (especially the baths) on the strip. Everything is well run EXCEPT check-in/check-out front desk.  There was a 35 min wait/line at the front desk at check-in and check-out at mid day Friday, Saturday and Sunday.  Rule #1-don't make guests line up to give sign for money they've already given you!  That 30-35 minutes could have used spending more money on the casino floor, restaurants or elsewhere. This has to be fixed!  Otherwise, it was one of the best experiences I've had in Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Stay somewhere else...
reviews.text: I expected a lot more for the price we paid.  The hotel/ room was nice but we've stayed at much better for much less money.  The environment was very "snooty" and the customer service was sadly lacking.  The vibe was very dull and it did not feel like Vegas at all.  I would not recommend staying here.  If you do want to check out the hotel, have dinner at Mother Wolf.  The food was delicious and their customer service was exceptional.

reviews.title: Was hoping for better : (
reviews.text: I was hoping for a lot more from Vegas' newest hotel.  The rooms were small and average compared to many Vegas hotels.  The prior occupants of our room left jewelry and drugs behind in the dresser, which were found by our young children.  The solution was a $100 hotel credit, which seemed a bit lack luster.

reviews.title: Breath of Fresh Air for Vegas
reviews.text: Wonderful experience all around. The facility is clean and breath taking, live fresh flowers through out the whole property. Staff was friendly and helpfully.  The fitness center is the best I have ever seen traveling. The spa facility is epic, lots of amenities and friendly staff.the food is amazing, while we didn’t get to every resturaunt we did hit most and they were all top notch, the steak house Don’s Prime was amazing. Even the food court had amazing food! Fun table action

reviews.title: The Prestigious Experience
reviews.text: The room was beautiful. We had Mountainview Bleau King. WOW. The in room service. The on site restaurant experience. Just 10/10. I loved the directives for the ease of getting an Uber pick up. It was just a great experience. I wouldn’t stay anywhere else from the other casinos we visited while on our stay.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Resort BUT…
reviews.text: Massive and Beautiful BUT…. We’re currently staying at the Fontainebleau.This is just a general view covering a couple of things we noted upon arrival. It is a beautiful massive  sprawling resort. Be prepared to walk a lot because it is massive.  Just wanted to point this out  for anyone with mobility issues.Unfortunately, the common areas of the resort have a very strong, overwhelming scented chemical odor.  It is so strong they we have had to limit our time being in the casino, restaurants, etc.  We had to go to other casinos on the strip because the odor is so strong we couldn’t take it.We did not smell it in the hallway or room (68th floor).   Also, we visited last December and we did not smell it then.   For allergy and asthma sufferers these chemical ‘fragrances’ are irritants can be troublesome.  It’s not healthy for anyone.About 15 years ago, a very popular resort on the strip used a similar chemical scent.  There were many many complaints.  Eventually the resort stopped using it.The Fontainebleau is gorgeous.  We really hope that management will eliminate the use of this piped in ‘fragrance’.  It’s such a shame we couldn’t spend more time at the resort.  We will be checking out early.  We look to forward to returning if and when the ‘fragrance’ is no longer used.

reviews.title: Honest impartial review from an experienced traveller
reviews.text: The good:The hotel itself is immaculate. The staff professional and attentive. The food is good. Cocktails are on point.The bad:Possibly it’s due to the time we were there, SEMA week, however: restaurants are all always busy and a wait. Bars even worse. Get fed up and ate elsewhere several times.The ridiculous:The Lapis spa, incredible property, treatments were superb. HOWEVER, and again, perhaps it was due to the week we were there and the clientele present, but the coed area was filled with loud, obnoxious clients. Remarkable a facility like this wouldn’t enforce a quiet policy.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: We heard good things and decided to try this new Vegas property. The room is fine, but on the small side. The restaurant options are good. But they are clearly still trying to figure out their customer service. We went to check out the pool and learned that’s it’s closed for construction. Any credible hotel will let you know about construction when you book your reservation. We called guest services about this and spoke with two supervisors. Both had quite an attitude and said it’s not their policy to let customers know about pool closures. I asked about crediting us back the resort fee given that the main pool area is closed and they refused. Oh well. There are so many nice properties in Vegas with good customer service. No reason to settle for one that doesn’t understand what good customer service is.

reviews.title: Amazing casino
reviews.text: Beautiful experience, very clean and staff was great. Definitely the best casino in the strip. Room was spacious and their food court areas was great, great delicious choices to choose from. Would definitely recommend and choose this casino for my future visits.

reviews.title: Nice room, not so great service
reviews.text: I had high expectations because the hotel is so new and the overall Fontainbleau brand, however a lot of annoying lapses in service happened during our stay, listed below. I did really enjoy the restaurants on site, especially Washing Potato and Mother Wolf. And the room itself was really nice with a great view (from the 69th floor). Small but annoying experiences: - Housekeeping did not come even after we pressed the service button. We had to call to request they come. When they did come, they did not remove our in-room dining items. They also did not tell in-room dining to come clear it. So we came back to the plates still there and had to call again to have them removed.- Internet did not work after the first day of our stay. Impossible to connect both phones and laptops. - When we checked in, we were given late check out because of our Amex Platinum booking. I told the staff member we were going to check out at 4pm and she noted it. However, on the day of check out, our room keys stopped working in the afternoon. We were locked out. I asked a woman from housekeeping for help but she refused to help me. It was only after I basically begged her to call her manager that she helped. She refused to let me use the phone in a room that was unoccupied. She also couldn't give me the phone number of the front desk. It was only when her manager arrived that we were let into our room. - Maintenance and painting of the hallway started on our floor. We weren't given any notice of this. It was noisy, smelly, and blocked the hallway. - The main pool deck was closed. We weren't given any notice of this prior to our arrival. Ridiculously, we were still charged the resort fee. - Unacceptable that there isn't coffee in the room. - The small bottles of shampoo and body wash in the shower was very difficult to use. The bottles are too hard to squeeze so it's very difficult to dispense liquid. Not practical and very wasteful to have single-use plastic like that in every room.- A lot of shops are closed or boarded up and not yet open. It feels very empty walking around the first couple levels of the hotel. - Check out took too long. The combined check in and check out lines meant we had to wait with newly arriving guests. The line was 4 rows deep. The staff member who checked us out made errors on our final bill that I had to spot and correct. This also took a long time. - We were not told how to exit the car park after check out. We were stuck at the gate and had to wait for a staff member to arrive to tap their card to let us out. This surely can't be the most effective way of guests leaving the car park after they've checked out. While none of these are really that terrible on their own, the fact that they all happened to us on a short, 2 night stay isn't really acceptable.

reviews.title: A five star resort
reviews.text: A conference at the Fontainebleau brought my husband and I in October 2024. We were super impressed with the hotel. Every single staff member was friendly and so helpful. Honestly, the staff was probably the best I’ve ever encountered at a resort. It’s a beautiful resort and smells AMAZING!  Our room was quite large for a standard king and the bathroom was very nicely appointed. The bed was extremely comfortable too. We spent 6 nights here and explored many of the restaurants and we were not disappointed with any of them. We liked that there were so many dining options on site.  Some might not like the distance from the main part of the Strip, but we didn’t mind that. We liked the quiet. We enjoyed that the casino was not filled with smoke, like so many others. We will definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Great hotel, BUT.............some disappointment!!!
reviews.text: I actually would have given our stay a FIVE, except a couple problems.  After staying there 6 days, five nights, spending several $1000s, Sunday our flight departed Vegas at 4:30, I called guest services and requested a late check out until 3:00 instead of noon.  They charged me $125, said we could not stay until 3:00 unless we paid $125 (did I mention we had spent $1000s over the week?).   I told her that was not fair, she said she couldnt do anything.....very unusual lack of service for any Vegas hotel.Secondly, we were in a Noble Suite, GREAT VEIW, but the furniture is small and uncomfortable....couch is like of love seat, cant relax and chill to watch the sunset.  Lastly, none of the fine dining is open late.  WE MAY OR MAY NOT TRY IT AGAIN.

reviews.title: New but very raw
reviews.text: Terrible place service is very bad, awfully crowded, disgusting service and awfully expensive not delicious restaurants. Especially surprised breakfast, was a tight line, $150 bill for two and not delicious. In the tea room casino cheap chips on the tables . In general, there was a feeling that the hotel was opened not ready for further work with guests , of the pluses probably only good rooms , large enough and beautiful , but it is not a hotel 5 stars ...

reviews.title: Best hotel vibes on the strip
reviews.text: Best hotel in Vegas, great food and service.  Mother Wolfe was amazing.  Hotel staff and service is second to none.  The spa is amazing and made us feel so good.  The beds are comfortable and pillows are amazing.   We will be back as often as they will have us.

reviews.title: Wonderful stay!
reviews.text: Gorgeous room and so many wonderful little details that added up to a wonderful stay! We have stayed at some very fine hotels, and I would definitely rank this one up in the top three hotel stays!  Check in was a breeze, loved the casino and the bars are top notch!

reviews.title: Best Resort on the Strip.
reviews.text: The most beautiful resort on the strip period. Pair that with the best set of restaurants, great gaming, beautiful rooms, and an incredible spa, what more could you ask for.  So many hidden gems, I find new things every time I come. Can't wait for my next trip.

reviews.title: Best hotel on the Strip!
reviews.text: Fantastic hotel! By far the best hotel I've stayed at in Las Vegas. Hotel was spotless, room was fantastic, staff was extremely nice and helpful. Worth every penny and I can't wait to go back and attend another concert in the incredible concert hall.

reviews.title: Bonkers amazing!!
reviews.text: I stayed 1 night and had an amazing time.  I went to the Oct 30th Tears for Fears show.  The bed was delicious and the pillows so soft. The promenade is a spectacle  all on it's own with the art and flowers. The staff were so attentive and kind.  I'd do it all over again but stay a couple nights next time.  I just loved it!!

reviews.title: The newest kid on the block, is the best in vegas in the last 20 years!!
reviews.text: It is the best Casino Resort on the strip and the best I have been to in years!! The facility is beautiful, big and awesome.  The service top to bottom was 5 star, the rooms were very big, well appointed, will the finest linens and towels.. The casino was expansive with games and ranges for everyone.  The slots were the newest and the best. The food offerings was outstanding

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Everything was amazing the staff the hotel was really nice and clean. Smelled amazing, I did not have one complaint. The room was very spacious and everything was upgraded of course. I loved the real roses they were everywhere. Room service was good also.

reviews.title: Awesome and Clean
reviews.text: Very clean, new and great fun.Was there for Tears for Fears concert in the theatre. While far more upmarket than most Vegas properties it also has maybe older client set. Also a little more on expensive side but ok as not as crowded. Service was ups ale. Ate at Mother Wolf really good.Probably has best hotel gym I have ever been in.Tavern/sports book was good and unlike some properties on the strip they do not hit you up for a beverage minimum if there for NFL on Sundays

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, well-thought-out room lighting
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, very stylish without being gaudy. Prompt and friendly car valet service, they even charged my car (after signing a consent form). My favorite part was the in-room lighting controls. Very high-end glass control panels, and great features like room scenes, bedside controls, a nightlight in the bathroom and a dimmer on the vanity mirror. The shower is huge! I wish it had a shower wand - that is my only (Very minor) wish. I stayed in a Gold room.

reviews.title: Fountainebleau Vegas Shining Diamond Experience
reviews.text: This is a must visit first class resort style hotel, check in, pool area, rooms and room service dining was above and beyond for the nightly price in comparison to other hotels on the strip. Advice for those that have sensitive skin to request a humidifier and wear single layer nurturing lotion, it will help with the Vegas dry air and AC in the various venues. You won’t want to leave this facility once you spend an evening there, every room have floor to ceiling windows capturing the strip and sky of either early morning sunrise or evening bliss of sunset.

reviews.title: Friends weekend at the Foutainbleau Las Vegas
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, excellent accomodations, great restaurants, best work out facility, with free pilates classes and tons of equipment, rooms were attractive, clean and very comfortable. Service was terrific! The pools and outdoor seating areas were very attactive and there was ample seating and lounges. Overall a great place to stay!

reviews.title: Fontainebleau experience - Las Vegas
reviews.text: Very welcoming. Spacious room, great view. Fantastic gym facilities.Plenty of dining options available - promenade food hall was good for relatively quick bite; sushi etc in Komodo was delightful; good breakfast portions in Chez Bon Bon.

reviews.title: Huge Disappointment-Luxury just not for you.
reviews.text: Disclaimer, this was my first visit to Las Vegas.  The list price for a basic room at this hotel during my visit was north of $800.  So I had high expectations for comfort and luxury.  What I experienced was something very different.FIRST IMPRESSIONS We entered the built from the far side, and were greeted by security staff who very politely directed us to the lobby.  It took a while to traverse the shopping and casinos to reach the lobby. The building is grand and beautiful. The floral arrangements and artwork are beyond belief.  The lines for checking in were long, and moved quickly.  The desk clerk was efficient and waived an early check in fee, but also would have allowed us to store our luggage at the bell desk.  Everything, was great.   Or so I thought.  When I looked around the lobby, I noticed there wasn’t a single place to sit, no benches, no chairs, no couches.  There was a hard plastic ledge alongside one of the planters between the lobby and the elevators.  But where could an elder or a weary traveler rest?  In front of a casino machine.  It struck me—the lack of seating was intentional and despite the fact that millions of dollars were spent on the lobby—-nothing was spent on the comfort of guests.  I asked the concierge if I could get a razor as I left mine at home.  THE ROOMThere was no offer of a bottle of water, piece of fruit—nothing.  The elevators are quick and frequent.  The room key worked.  The room was as promised—-two queen beds., a dresser with medium sized capacity. There was no fridge, microwave, coffeemaker, balcony or desk.   Clearly not appointed with the comfort of the guests in mind.  There were very expensive amenities for purchase —and for which I was charged despite never having used.  The room appeared fairly clean, however when I went to put my clothes away I found the floor of the closet to be unvacuumed and quite dirty.  The  same when I looked around the edges of the roomThe bathroom was spacious  with tub shower stall, two taps (one big sink basin).  And a toilet in a separate enclosure.  The toilet needed to be flushed three times to fully flush down No. 2.  Water pressure was adequate, it often took a long time to get hot water.  The towels were of moderate quality.  The toiletries were similar.  Oddly the shampoo, body wash and conditioner were in small bottles (not the typical pumps found in  modern hotels seeking to minimize environmental impact. The bottles were so rigid and the product so thick thst it was almost impossible to dispense.  Like trying to get ketchup out of a glass bottle.    Clearly not well thought out and not in the interest of the comfort of the guest.OTHERThere really want much else except the pool which was off opened only from 9am-6pm.  There is what I can describe as an unusual level of scrutiny of the guests bags-/just to insure no outside food or beverages were brought in.  Security actually build some guests the could not bring coffee purchased on the second floor into the pool. There were no staff assisting guest in finding or setting up a chair.  It was a free for all of getting through security and running to a vacant spot.  Reminded me of a concert—not a luxury hotel.  Lastly the most disturbing part of the visit was the experience I had with the residents of another room.  Late one evening I heard a screaming child in the hall and came out to see if everything was okay..  the mom “apologized” as they were just playing.  I suggested they play in their room or in the downstairs areas it was disturbing, Hours later I hear a child screaming again, put on a robe and went into the hall, a father was throwing his child in the air.  I said that it was late, I was trying to sleep and it was very kid and disturbing.  Several doors opened, and others added their voice saying the same thing. The dad, and an uncle told me to mind my f-ing business and approached me threateningly.  I returned to my room called security but never heard what happened.  Didn’t feel safe or comfortable.  No follow up from Management.—so disappointing.

reviews.title: Welcoming elegance.
reviews.text: I am a local but I’ve been staying away from the strip because of parking fees. I just discovered that Fontainebleau has four hours of free parking.  We went Thursday and were back today. The hotel ambience is elegant and tastefully done. They have restaurants open for lunch  that has sophisticated service and upscale dining  atmosphere. And the car exhibition are piece of art. I think I found a place where I could hang out whenever I need a place to go.  One more thing- they are arguably the best hotel food court in Vegas. - teaaroundtheworld

reviews.title: An ok stay but won't be in a hurry to return.
reviews.text: A difficult review for me as I want to be fair:  obviously a very new hotel and the room was v comfortable however there were a few niggles:  the elevators are a LONG waĺk from reception which I found weird, the car valet pick up was at a different to valet drop off, and again a long walk away, the food prices were on the high side and finally, having paid for a strip facing high floor room, I was a little dissapointed because despite being on the 62nd floor, my strip view was largely blocked by the Encore Hotel.  I had no sight of any hotel on the east side of the strip and only down as far as Ceasars on the west side, although I did have a good view of the Sphere.  All in all, nothing not to like, but equally I wouldn't be in a hurry to return.

reviews.title: A Resort not to miss
reviews.text: The most amazing experience with customer service. Everyone was eager to help. The room was sparkling clean. Great choice for restaurants which were reasonably priced. The complimentary fitness classes were flawless. Unfortunately the spa services were very very expensive. The location is in a good area for walking and felt safe with all the security. The size of the room was enormous and the soaking tub was just what I needed

reviews.title: Looking for luxury? ... then Fontainebleau should be your choice
reviews.text: Staying in Suite 65-21 was nothing short of incredible! The view alone is breathtaking, offering an unobstructed panorama that truly makes you feel on top of the world. The suite is outfitted with high-end amenities that elevate the entire experience—every detail has been carefully considered. The bed was superbly comfortable, and I have to say, the pillows were the fluffiest and softest I’ve ever slept on, making each night a restful retreat. Being a newer hotel, everything is immaculate and luxurious, which only enhances the sense of a premium stay. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a perfect blend of comfort and elegance!

reviews.title: The most beautiful new hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Fontainebleau, which opened this year in Las Vegas, was a lovely surprise. We were in LV on business and took an afternoon to explore the hotel. As a designer, I was deeply impressed by the thoughtfulness of the design which permeated the whole property, including lobbies, retail areas, restaurants, and bars. It's big, and tall and impressive, but also calm and sophisticated. Definitely worth checking out!

reviews.title: Sticker Shock
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, good food, comfortable beds and spacious rooms, but all highly overpriced. Pool was closed. limited table games with very high limits. Guests charged for valet parking, although when I called the hotel before coming they told me parking was free, but they didn't clarify that was only self parking.Service was great everywhere.

reviews.title: Mother Daughter Trip
reviews.text: Great hotel to bond with your adult child. The beds were firm and soft. The robes were a nice amenity. The building and people were very attentive. The food at Mother Wolf and Don's Prime was cooked to order and melted in our mouths. I did miss an in-room coffee machine :)

reviews.title: Great Stay at the Fontainebleau!
reviews.text: The hotel is gorgeous. The spaces are expansive and dramatic. I had a standard king room and it was much larger than the average room. The toiletries smelled amazing smelled amazing. Everything in the hotel was very clean and of course new. The  pool area was very pretty as well. I went to the pool in the mornings as it started to get crowded by Eleven o'clock or so and hard to find a place to sit. All of the food that I had was good as well as the service. The staff I interacted with were very nice and helpful. I would definitely recommend staying at the Fontainebleau.

reviews.title: Beware of Theft in your room!
reviews.text: Warning, I had $1,500 stolen from my room. The hotel security team didn’t care to do any sort of investigation whatsoever. They wouldn’t tell me on the phone if my room was accessed by hotel staff and told me to file a police report so they can then subpoena for the records. Filed the police report and haven’t heard back. STAY AWAY. I don’t think they hired the most competent of staff. Will never stay there again. I’d say the only positives was the sushi bar upstairs in the food court, high quality and not offensively expensive.

reviews.title: Be careful
reviews.text: Customer service should’ve been a lot better. Make sure that you check your receipt upon checking out because I was triple charged and room service is very expensive so I would just be very very careful. Make sure you stay on housekeeping to make sure your room get cleaned

reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: This property is beautiful, comfortable and clean. One of the best hotels I've ever stayed at. Casino is great, restaurants were awesome and the location is perfect especially if you came for the football game. I will definitely be staying again .

reviews.title: Don't Arrive Hungry If Checking In Late
reviews.text: Checked in after midnight after long flight from Florida was starved but there was no open restaurant besides Chez Bon Bon which has very little offerings besides were out of 75% of the items on the "menu." I've never stayed in a major casino that didn't have a full sit down 24 hr restaurant availableAlso no convenience type store on premises, Walgreens was a 4 block walk in not a great neighborhood.Besides that hotel was beautiful and stay was wonderful.

reviews.title: The Best
reviews.text: Just outstanding!!!The resort experience is the best on the strip, having stayed in just about every resort along Las Vegas Bl. The casino floor was clean and smoke free making it feel healthy. The resort atmosphere make you feel secure. Will definitely be on top of my goto resort on the strip. My host Jen was professional and very helpful.

reviews.title: Get Here Before Everyone Else Does
reviews.text: This hotel is brand new and doesn't disappoint.  The casino was very clean.  The rooms were very clean with a great layout.  I interacted with probably 10-20 staff besides the casino people and everyone couldn't have been more helpful, cheerful and eager to please.  It was just a thoroughly enjoyable experience.

reviews.title: Vegas at its best !
reviews.text: The overall quality and attention to detail are best we have seen in Las Vegas or anywhere for that matter! We typically stay at Bellagio but this was another level up of quality. Quality restaurants and fantastic lounges cannot be beat. Can’t wait to return

reviews.title: Excellent Vegas strip hotel experience
reviews.text: Beautiful not overly done hotel on the Vegas Strip, away from the crowds but easily accessible to key destination sites. Not too smoky, plenty of restaurants, games, pool, bars, and the like. We will return to this our newest favorite strip hotel.

reviews.title: VERY expensive resort
reviews.text: This resort is very nice, but over-priced for what you get.  The pool areas were crowded (one pool was closed completely) and it was hard to find lounge chairs and umbrellas.  The resort restaurants are hit or miss in terms of food quality.  Some of the details are very nice, while others seem like they weren't completely thought through.  For example, the blue plastic soap containers in the shower are hard plastic, which makes it hard to get the soap out of.  This seems like a weird, nit-picky thing to put in a review, but this resort is EXPENSIVE, so details like that matter.  The resort is quite far from the liveliness of the strip, which is bad and also good.  It was much less crowded than, say, the Bellagio but also, it doesn't offer quality enough food to make you want to eat there.

reviews.title: Las vegas Fountainbluea Hotel not bad either.
reviews.text: We went to Las Vegas and stayed at the Fountainbluea (across from Circus Circus).  It is at the other end of strip, but we didn't want to be in the crowd of the strip.  My husband loved this hotel from the restaurants, prominaid,  room service, the room itself,  ( it has a razor, shavingcream, toothpaste and toothbrush) NICE ROOM Royle Suite, pool and there is different one's too. Next door is Sarah's which you can catch the tram from there, also restaurants over at Sarah's too.  Bell services ( at the airport) takes you right to the door.  We got a taxi to take us to Fremont Street.   All the staff is professional and know their stuff.  I recommend that you stay here at least once it's not your average stay (hotel).

reviews.title: Awesome Resort!
reviews.text: What a wonderful and beautiful resort! First class in every respect! The room was immaculate and the bed and pillows were unbelievably comfortable! Excellent food and service and a great casino. Don’t miss this resort! It’s well worth checking it out!

reviews.title: Pool!
reviews.text: Main reason for booking was for the pool, I visit on an annual basis and I am a true Resorts World fan, but I thought I 'd give it a try. I'm sorry that I did, 2-3 of the pools were closed and therefore the others could not accommodate the guests properly. There was no music, or so low you couldn't hear it. Wait staff stated there had been complaints by "families" that the music was too loud. Family demographic is not the audience and therefore unsure why this would be accommodated over the actual demographic of people there with no children. (note: this was "end of season" Oct24). But they should've waited to turn the pools into ice rinks a week later then as they were doing nothing, one still had water in it. AND NOTE THIS ON THE WEBSITE, somewhere visible so guests are aware.Overall the property lacked character as well, it seemed very bland and stale with no personality but a bunch of "bow-ties".There are positives also. The staff was great and the room was a good size.Note: there are 2 rideshare pick ups/drop offs.

reviews.title: Finally heading home after a fantastic stay at Fontainebleau Las Vegas!
reviews.text: The resort was generous with promotional credits, which made my time at the slots even more fun, especially on the last night. 🎰🤘🏼 The hotel itself is stunning, with a classy, modern vibe and plenty of high-end amenities. While it is a bit north on the Strip, making people-watching less of a priority here, the distance does lend a more relaxed and refined atmosphere that’s perfect if you’re looking to escape the usual hustle and bustle.Rooms were beautiful and comfortable, and I managed to book at a really reasonable rate by keeping an eye out for deals. The dining options were excellent, with a mix of reasonably priced and high-end restaurants that add a real touch of elegance. Just a heads-up—guests definitely bring their style game at night, so if you’re heading out for a late dinner or drinks, expect to see some serious fashion statements!All in all, Fontainebleau makes for a luxurious and memorable Vegas stay, and I'd definitely come back!

reviews.title: Recommend
reviews.text: We found the big F a great visit, nice, clean, new recommend.  Would stay here again. Recommend Mother Wolf restaurant, and El Bagel for morning food & coffee but be prepared for a wait or order ahead on the app.  Now I am writing to hit the maximum characters to post.

reviews.title: Don't Overthink It - Do It
reviews.text: What a gem of a hotel.  They've transplanted the iconic style and feel of the original Miami Fontainbleau, but updated it really well.  The casino was hopping but not crazy, the jazz bar Nowhere spun 1940's post-WWII joyful vibes, and the food at Mother Wolf was transcendent.  My Noble Suite was pitch perfect with its decor and charm and mid-Century understated elegance, and all the employees were en fuego and on point.  I'm a picky and long-time Vegas lover.  Oh yeah, the fitness center was large and impressive.  This place is great.

reviews.title: Excellent Stay. Looking forward to our next visit!
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, modern, luxurious and elegant. Service was excellent, our room was pristine (like the rest of the hotel) and the atmosphere was sophisticated and fun. Less crowded than the other big hotels which was nice and relaxing, but still had enough of a crowd to give fun energy. There were so many upscale and incredibly well designed lounges and restaurants it reminded me of NYC, but  we just didn't have time to visit most of them. Highly recommend Motherwolf for dinner. Vida was good and simple for breakfast, along with more beautiful design. The pools were fun, and LIV nightclub was fun too. Excited to stay here again in December.

reviews.title: Expected much more
reviews.text: Disappointed:Room was (just) okay, clean etc. Plugs not in convenient spot to work at table; had to stretch them across the floor.  Lighting was also not good for working at the table.Bathroom/Shower extremely poor design.  Although shower was reasonable size, the location of the showerhead made it almost impossible to rinse the lower part of the body as the shower  stall width was too narrow.  Discussed my stay while at the airport with a stranger and he had the same problem in the shower.  Also tried running the hot water for at least 10/15 minutes multiple days and could not get hot water in the sink to shave.Was attending a conference that included food.  Overall the food was also just "okay".  Have been at many conferences on the strip in the past and I would have to say the food was nowhere near the top.  Also room labeling at the conference was not great.  Even the coffee was sub-par.Nothing like the Fontainebleau in Miami.  Expected much more here.

reviews.title: Extraordinary on all levels
reviews.text: Where to even start giving our experience has been fabulous. The food and beverage is fantastic as we’ve eaten on premises at several restaurants, including room service breakfast each day. I highly recommend Komodo for dinner. The self parking is free and very convenient to get in and out. The hotel is absolutely gorgeous in all respects, from the common area’s exquisite design and architecture, to the casino, to the rooms. The beds and pillows are extremely comfortable and everything is in excellent condition and good working order. We’ve had quiet nights of sleep and the fitness facility is exceptional and energizing. The equipment options could suit anyone of any age, of any condition. It’s nice that it’s not a party scene and all of the staff and guests we encountered have been very friendly.The new retail that’s opening is absolutely exquisite, and worthy of a visit on its own.

reviews.title: Luxury Personified
reviews.text: I initially had a reservation at Mandalay Bay, but later discovered this hotel and boy am I glad I did. The only thing better than a 5 star hotel is a brand new 5 star hotel that opened less than a year ago. Just to echo what others have written, this hotel is spectacular. Beautiful room with marble everywhere. Hi tech lighting. Incredible bathroom. Super comfortable bed. Even the hallways are beautiful- very wide with artwork on the walls. Elevators are touch screen which I’ve never seen before. The fitness center stands alone as the best hotel gym I have ever seen, and I’m an old man.  The gym is as big as a commercial gym, but has equipment that’s better than 90% of commercial gyms. All of the hotel employees are incredible. Special shoutout to Gabriel who works at the fitness center. Nothing I have said is hyperbole. It’s the truth.

reviews.title: Shaken not Stirred
reviews.text: First trip to the Fontainebleau Vegas was for Business, it was so nice we decided to return for pleasure. If you are looking for top shelf, pampering without the usual Vegas clutter and commotion, upscale pool vibes. Think James Bond/Sinatra old time classy vibes only. If you want oversized margaritas look elsewhere.

reviews.title: A First Class Luxury Experience
reviews.text: I’ve been visiting Las Vegas for over 25 years and I must say, this is the finest resort I’ve ever stayed. It was top notch from the moment I checked in. I felt like a VIP. It is so well thought out and designed. The staff is first class, friendly & very helpful. I do not miss the location south strip that is so congested and feels like a circus. I will certainly be making plans to come back very soon!

reviews.title: Strange housekeeping situations
reviews.text: View is great, bed is comfortable, Don's Prime is amazing!  This was our 2nd stay here and we enjoy the property however the housekeeping was subpar this time.  Upon checking in, we went to our room and it smelled as though there had been a serious sewer issue so we immediately returned to the check in desk.  The woman made a call and was told to put us in a certain room number so we went there and the room was smaller but that's okay, there are only 2 of us and we still had a great strip view.  2 days into our stay, we came back from the pool and the door would not open.  The latch that flips across the door was closed somehow and Engineering had to come open it.  He had a "tool" to open it so this must be a common issue.  Later that night when we returned to the room, a staff member was coming out of our door.  We asked her what she was doing and she brushed us off saying we were "VIP" guests so she was doing an inspection and quickly walked away.  Please note there was no other evidence or mention of a "VIP status" the entire stay and the room smelled strongly of perfume when we entered as if it had just been sprayed.  The following day, we returned from brunch around 2 and a male employee was directly outside our room, walking away.  The sink drains had been closed (we were unable to open them), water was slowly running in one sink (more than a drip), 2 garbages were still full but we had new towels and the bed had been made.  We were both feeling poorly so we climbed in bed and did not report the water/garbage issues.  We left early the next morning.  Stay was good overall, but the housekeeping situation was very odd.

reviews.title: You won't regret staying here!
reviews.text: Beautiful and very spacious rooms.  Excellent views with a whole wall of windows to see that view from.  An amazing giant tub 2 people could fit in, might need a step to to get in and out of lol.  Probably the most comfortable hotel bed I have ever slept in.

reviews.title: Very nice place to be in vacation with your friends and family
reviews.text: This place is awesome. I will recommend this place to my friends and family. They have good drinks good comps it’s a must go! Also the view is beautiful restroom super clean my room had a tub and a shower. The housekeeping is awesome there they clean up with the room. Every day!

reviews.title: Couples trip
reviews.text: We only stayed 1 night at this beautiful hotel and my only regret was that we didn't stay longer. From the minute we walked through the door, the customer service was faultless. At check in, we were given 2 bottles of water each, without us having to ask.Our stunning room on the 33rd floor had a spectacular view. The room was spotlessly clean, super comfy bed and was finely appointed and decorated. Unfortunately, I didn't get a chance to enjoy the super deep soaking tub but we did enjoy an hour or 2 at the beautiful pool. Breakfast at Vida the next morning was outstanding and I would stay at this gorgeous hotel again in a heartbeat 💓 💗

reviews.title: Beautiful resort!
reviews.text: This was my second visit to Fontainebleau this year. I love it there!  It is a beautiful resort. The vibe is unmatched.  The decor is glamorous yet modern. The service was fantastic and the restaurants and bars are all amazing.  They even have live jazz and a piano player.  There’s something for everyone.  It is spacious and open which is nice and makes it feel more comfortable than other resorts on the strip.  The pool area is beautiful as well.  I will definitely be going back soon!

reviewsWithMentions.title: High expectations but left a little salty
reviewsWithMentions.text: When my wife and I walked in the lobby we felt like celebrities.  The place is beautiful and massive but after a few days it starts to feel like a hotel within a luxury mall.  Far enough away from the strip to avoid the congestion and chaos but close enough to walk there.  Also within walking distance of Fremont Street. The gym is spectacular.  The staff was great. The casino is clean and nice but allows smoking including cigars.  That was annoying and I smoke cigars. Most of the pools were closed due to ice rink set up.  Our suite was big and had a great view of strip and sphere.  I know it is Vegas but $54 for two glasses of house wine at the main casino bar is a joke.  $27 for a smoothie in the food court is also absurd.  My wife and I make great livings but overcharging for basic drinks and food pissed us off. We found a local liquor store and walked around with our own cocktails after night one. Also, as we read in several reviews, get rid of one ply toilette paper and clear some space in the room fridge for guest waters (so guests don’t have to buy $20 bottles from you).  Those little things make a five star hotel a four star. This is a nice, clean and modern hotel but we left feeling a little salty and will try somewhere else next time.
